TEXT_HELP_10101_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Tim yang dibentuk dari 3 pahlawan , 1 Dewi dan seorang Champion
2. Saat membentuk tim, kamu harus memilih satu pahlawan sebagai pimpinan tim. Pimpinan tim menghasilkan 50% skill blok lebih banyak daripada lainnya
3. Kamu dapat merekrut teman sekali sehari ( Hanya di Mode Skenario )
4. Membawa pahlawan teman dalam pertempuran akan memberimu EXP 50% tambahan. Teman akan mendapatan 3 honor sebagai balasannya
5. Kamu dapat menyimpan tim dari Pahlawan > Team Menu dan gunakan mereka saat persiapan pertempuran

TEXT_HELP_10102_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Seorang pahlawan bergerak dan menggunakan serangan normal secara otomatis 
2. Jika menyentuh blok skill pada bagian bawah layar, pahlawan akan mengeluarkan blok skill mereka
3. Kekuatn dan efek dari skill blok berbeda tergantung dari jumlah blok yang digunakan dalam rangkaian. Maksimal adalah 3 rangkaian 
4. Menggunakan blok skill mengisi bar Skill Dewi yang ketika disentuh akan mengaktifkan skill dewi. Setiap Dewi memiliki skill yang berbeda, jadi pastikan untuk mempelajarinya di ruang Dewi 
5. Menekan tombol Champion akan mengaktifkan skill aktif Champion. Harap diingat terdapat batasan dalam menggunakan skill Champion per putaran

TEXT_HELP_10201_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Anda juga dapat memeriksa Level Akun. Popularitas, dan informasi dari fitur lainnya
2. Kamu juga dapat memeriksa pencapaian, distribusi popularitas dan panel potret di tab popularitas
3. Memeriksa monumen yang telah kamu kumpulkan didalam game
4. Memeriksa kekayaanmu dan sumber daya

TEXT_HELP_10202_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Menerima dan mengelola berbagai hadiah dan barang.
2. Baca pengumuman resmi, Dev Letters, dan Patch Notes di tab 'Letter'.
3. Item yang Anda terima melalui Kotak Pesan akan dikategorikan ke dalam berbagai tab tergantung pada penggunaannya.
4. Semua surat disimpan sampai 30 hari. Mereka akan otomatis dihapus sesudahnya.

TEXT_HELP_10203_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. You can add up to 70 friends in game. Trade Meat and Honor with your game friends once every day!
2. Receive additional rewards by trading daily Honor with more game friends.
3. You can bookmark friends by pressing the star button left of the player's portrait icon. Bookmarked friends are automatically listed at the top of your friends list.
4. Up to 10 friends can be deleted per day.
5. Search and add friends through searching IGN!

TEXT_HELP_10204_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Anda dapat mengembalikan atau membatalkan pembelian Anda dalam waktu 7 hari sejak pembelian jika Anda belum menggunakan produk tersebut. Harap dicatat bahwa ada kemungkinan Anda akan kehilangan informasi pembelian jika Anda tidak menyinkronkan data Anda.
2. Membeli berbagai barang permainan, termasuk Item Paket, Permata, Emas, Item Game, dan Skins Hero!
3. Anda akan menerima Poin Bridget sebanding dengan harga pembelian dalam aplikasi Anda.
4. Bridget Points dapat dihabiskan di tab 'Point' dari Shop

TEXT_HELP_10205_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. You can use Jewels to recruit Heroes or acquire Weapons.
2. Different Contracts will recruit different types of Heroes.
3. Support Hero Contracts can be purchased with Honor twice a week.
4. If you recruit duplicate 4-Star and above Heroes through 10 Consecutive Gold, Special, or Event Contracts, you will receive as many Books of Inheritance as the number of duplicate Heroes recruited.

TEXT_HELP_10206_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Gunakan Oven di Toko roti Chocolat untuk menerima roti setiap beberapa jam sekali.
2. Setiap Oven memerlukan waktu yang berbeda untuk menyelesaikan pembuatan kue, dan memberi berbagai jenis roti setelah selesai.
3. Anda bisa menggunakan Jewels untuk segera menyelesaikan pemanggangan.
4. Oven Misterius bisa digunakan 5 kali sehari dengan menonton iklan

TEXT_HELP_10207_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. View information on your collection of Heroes, Weapons, Sigils, and more.
2. Check other Captains' tips on training Heroes in the Hero Tome. Through the recommendation menu, you can see how other Captains have trained their Heroes.
3. Recruiting certain Heroes will unlock Hero Stories and rewards.
4. Replay past stories of Hasla.
5. View illustrations of Heroes you have recruited.
6. Record your achievements throughout your gameplay and receive rewards.

TEXT_HELP_10208_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Skill Istimewa dibagi menjadi Keterampilan Khusus Normal, yang dapat ditransfer ke Heroes 3-Stars dan yang lebih tinggi, dan Advanced Special Skills, yang dapat ditransfer ke Heroes 5-Stars dan yang lebih tinggi. (Excluding Support Heroes)
2. Seorang Pahlawan hanya dapat belajar satu Keterampilan Khusus dalam satu waktu.
3. Pahlawan kelas yang berbeda bisa belajar Keterampilan Khusus yang berbeda.
4. Mentransfer Skill Khusus membutuhkan Gold and Honor.
5. Anda harus memenuhi persyaratan tertentu untuk membuka dan meningkatkan Keterampilan Khusus.
6. Mendapatkan Great Success transfer ke Hero Anda skill yang lebih tinggi dengan 1 level.
7. Keterampilan yang ditransfer bisa dihapus.

TEXT_HELP_10209_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Hiasi Rumah Pahlawan Anda sendiri dengan menggunakan Heroes, furniture, Monuments, dan hiasan lainnya.
2. Anda dapat menempatkan hingga 6 Pahlawan di dalam Rumah Pahlawan Anda.
3. Pahlawan ditempatkan di dalam Rumah Pahlawan dapat berinteraksi dengan berbagai cara. Cobalah menyentuh dan menyeret mereka berkeliling!
4. Tempatkan perabotan dan hiasan di Rumah Pahlawan Anda dengan memutar dan membalikkan.

TEXT_HELP_10210_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Mengelola Roti, Berries, dan Buku Warisan yang dibutuhkan untuk pertumbuhan Pahlawan.
2. Gunakan Item untuk meningkatkan statistik Pahlawan Anda.

TEXT_HELP_10211_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Secara permanen menyimpan Chests, Sigils, dan Buff Potions.
2. Hingga 999 dada dapat disimpan dalam satu slot. Maksimal 99 dada dapat dibuka sekaligus.
3. Satu Sigil disimpan per slot.
4. Susu Pertumbuhan bisa digunakan dari menu ini. Ramuan Buff lainnya bisa dipilih dalam menu Battle Preparation. "

TEXT_HELP_10212_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Mengelola kostum yang telah Anda dapatkan dalam game.
2. Dandani Pahlawan Anda

TEXT_HELP_10214_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Menerima Quests dan menyelesaikan mereka untuk mendapatkan hadiah.
2. Quests diklasifikasikan ke dalam tab yang berbeda tergantung pada kategori mereka.

TEXT_HELP_10215_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. In the Orchard, you can assign Heroes to plant and grow Berries on Plots and, after a certain period of time, receive various rewards!
2. Choose the type of Berry to plant and the time to grow and cultivate it. The 'Growth Time' of Berries decides the quantity of the harvest and the quality of the reward.
3. Only ★4 and above Heroes can work in the Orchard.
4. Rewards are divided into 'Fixed Rewards,' which are decided by the Berry Type and Growth Time, and 'Bonus Rewards,' which are obtained by chance.
5. The chance to obtain Bonus Rewards is marked in percentages and is increased by fulfilling Bonus Conditions and assigning certain Orchard Helpers.
6. Different Plots have different Bonus Conditions. Fulfilling at least 8 Conditions will greatly increase your chances of obtaining a Bonus Reward.
7. The 'Great Harvest Rate' is your chance of obtaining even further rewards. It can be increased through rarer Plots, Orchard Tools, and Great Harvest events.
8. When more than one Plot is ready to harvest, the 'Harvest All' button will be activated to harvest all fully grown Berries.
9. Life Essence can speed up Berry growth to immediately harvest Berries.

TEXT_HELP_10216_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. You have a chance of rescuing Traveling Merchants in stages in Scenario and Challenge.
2. You will fail to rescue the Traveling Merchant if you give up or fail to clear the stage.
3. Once rescued, the Traveling Merchant will stay in the Town for 15 minutes. Take a look at their wares for various rare items!
4. You can pay jewels or watch ads to bargain for lower prices of all products.

TEXT_HELP_20101_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Pahlawan Crusaders Quest dikategorikan menjadi 6 kelas: Warriors, Paladins, Archers, Hunters, Wizards, and Priests.
2. Selain itu, mereka dapat diklasifikasikan lebih jauh oleh kelangkaannya: Legendaris, Kontrak, Promosikan, Rahasia, Normal, dan Dukungan.
3. Pahlawan bisa diratakan dengan bermain Skenario Mode dan Dungeons, serta menyelesaikan Explorations.
4. Pahlawan dengan tingkatan berbeda memiliki Level dan Level Training yang berbeda:
- Bintang 1: LV10 / -
- Bintang 2: LV20 / + 1
- Bintang 3: LV30 / + 2
- Bintang 4: LV40 / + 3
- Bintang 5: LV50 / + 4
- Bintang 6: LV60 / + 5
5. Anda akan menerima 1 Jewel saat melatih Hero manapun sampai level maksimum untuk pertama kalinya.
6. Pahlawan 4-Bintang dan di atas diselaraskan dengan faksi-faksi.

TEXT_HELP_20102_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Pahlawan legendaris dapat direkrut melalui pembersihan Dungeons khusus dan mendapatkan Destiny Points.
2. Mereka berkisar antara 1- sampai 6-bintang, dan tetap dalam tahap promosi mereka.
3. Pahlawan Legendaris memiliki statistik yang lebih tinggi rata-rata dari jenis Pahlawan lainnya.

TEXT_HELP_20103_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Pahlawan Kontrak dapat direkrut melalui Premium dan Kontrak Khusus.
2. Pahlawan Kontrak berkisar antara 4- sampai 6 Bintang, dan ditetapkan dalam tahap promosi mereka.

TEXT_HELP_20104_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Temui Pajlawan Mempromosikan secara acak dengan mempromosikan Hero 3 Bintang di kelas yang sama.
2. Promosikan Pahlawan berkisar antara 4- sampai 6 Bintang, dan tetaplah dalam tahap promosi mereka.

TEXT_HELP_20105_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Pahlawan Normal bisa direkrut melalui berbagai cara.
2. Mereka berkisar antara 1- sampai 3-Stars, dan berubah menjadi pahlawan acak kelas yang sama pada saat promosi.

TEXT_HELP_20106_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Secret Heroes can be recruited only through participating in limited events or meeting special conditions.
2. Secret Heroes ★4 and above are fixed in their promotion. Certain ★3 Secret Heroes cannot be promoted.

TEXT_HELP_20107_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Pahlawan Pendukung digunakan untuk memperkuat faksi (Champions).
2. . Pahlawan Pendukung bisa memperkuat semua faksi. Jumlah persahabatan yang mereka suplai bergantung pada peringkat Bintang mereka.
3. . Pahlawan Pendukung berkisar antara 3- sampai 6-Bintang. Mereka tidak bisa dipromosikan.

TEXT_HELP_20108_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Memberhentikan Pahlawan akan memberi Anda Honor .
2. Pahlawan tidak kembali begitu mereka sudah diberhentikan. Hati-hati!

TEXT_HELP_20109_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Otherworld Heroes come from other dimensions, drawn by a strange power to Hasla.
2. Otherworld Heroes can only be recruited during limited periods of time or through fulfilling special conditions.
3. While some Otherworld Heroes are fixed at ★3, others promote/grow steadily from ★4 to ★6.
4. Otherworld Heroes do not belong to a particular faction and can be sent to reinforce all Champions.

TEXT_HELP_20202_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Pahlawan bisa dipromosikan begitu mereka mencapai Level dan Training maksimal.
2. Mempromosikan membutuhkan sejumlah penghargaan untuk setiap kelas Hero.
3. Pahlawan 6 Bintang dan Pahlawan Dukungan tidak bisa dipromosikan.

TEXT_HELP_20301_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Semua Pahlawan memiliki Skill Block sendiri.
2. Semakin tinggi Pahlawan peringkat bintang, semakin kuat Skill Blok Pahlawan.
3. Sampai 3 blok bisa bergabung untuk membentuk rantai. Menggunakan rantai yang lebih panjang akan memicu keterampilan yang lebih kuat atau efek bonus.
4. Sentuh ikon Skill untuk melihat informasi lebih rinci.

TEXT_HELP_20302_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Pahlawan 4-Bintang dan diatasnya memiliki Skill Pasif yang spesial. (Tidak termasuk Pahlawan Pendukung)
2. Keterampilan Pasif diaktifkan oleh penggunaan blok Pahlawan sendiri atau blok rekan tim lainnya, jumlah serangan, hits ditangani musuh, waktu musim dingin, dan berbagai kondisi lainnya.
3. Skill Pasif dibagi menjadi Jenis Utama dan Dukungan tergantung pada kondisi aktivasi mereka.
4. Skill Pasif dapat ditingkatkan dengan melengkapi Soulbound Weapons

TEXT_HELP_20303_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Skill Istimewa dapat ditransfer ke Pahlawan Bintang 3 dan yang lebih tinggi di Lab Skill.
2. Menggunakan Skill Blok Pahlawan akan meningkatkan SP mereka sebanding dengan jumlah blok yang digunakan.
3. Sebuah blok Skill Khusus terbentuk setelah mencapai 100 SP, setelah itu gauge di reset ke 0.
4. Blok Skill Khusus tidak bisa dihubungkan ke rangkaian.

TEXT_HELP_20401_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Soulbound Weapons hanya bisa diperlengkapi dengan 4-Star tertentu dan diatas Heroes.
2. Pahlawan kelas bawah tidak bisa melengkapi senjata nilai lebih tinggi dari nilai mereka sendiri.
3. Soulbound Weapons dapat diperoleh melalui tempa Old Weapons atau membuka Golden Weapon Chests.
4. Semua Soulbound Weapons memiliki 1 Soulbound Ability dan 2 Random Upgrade Options (Attack, Defense, and Function).
5. Dua Pilihan Upgrade acak dapat diubah dengan menggunakan Tiket Pilihan Senjata Instan dan Pilihan Pilihan Senjata.
6. Kemampuan Soulbound dari Senjata Soulbound sangat meningkatkan keterampilan Hero, memberi mereka serangan yang lebih kuat atau pasif baru.
7. Menempatkan Senjata Soulbound untuk meningkatkan kemampuan Soulbound-nya dengan potensi maksimalnya.

TEXT_HELP_20402_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Old Weapons can be forged into Soulbound Weapons, which are special gear stronger than Normal Weapons.
2. Old Weapons can be acquired from the Fortress of Souls, Dungeons, Raids, or purchased from Traveling Merchants.
3. Forging requires Iron and other materials found in the Fortress of Souls.
4. Old Weapons can be equipped by Heroes, but they have no weapon options whatsoever.

TEXT_HELP_20403_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Senjata Normal bisa dilengkapi oleh pahlawan kelas yang sesuai tanpa memandang kelas mereka.
2. Mereka dapat diperoleh melalui berbagai rute.
3. Senjata Normal memiliki berbagai pilihan berdasarkan nilai mereka.
4. Jenis pilihan senjata (Attack, Defense, Function) ditetapkan untuk semua Senjata Normal, dan tidak dapat diubah.

TEXT_HELP_20404_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Senjata Pedagang dapat dijual atau diurai untuk mendapatkan bahan yang banyak
2. Senjata Pedanag dapat diperoleh dari Peti Senjata Emas dan Box Jiwa

TEXT_HELP_20405_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. You can salvage Weapons to earn Danan's Fragments and Iron.
2. You can choose either Normal Salvage or Enhanced Salvage to salvage Weapons.
3. Every salvage has a low chance of obtaining Great Success, which yields 25% more resources for Normal Salvage and 100% more resources for Enhanced Salvage.
4. Enhanced Salvage requires Gold to perform but has a higher Great Success rate and rewards.
5. Danan's Fragments and Iron acquired from salvaging Weapons differ in accordance with the salvaged Weapons' Grade and Type.

TEXT_HELP_20406_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Mengupgrade senjata akan memindahkan opsi secara acak pada slot.
2. Opsi senjata terbagi pada tiga kategori: Serang, Bertahan, dan Fungsi
3. Pastikan untuk mengecek ‘Info Opsi’ sebelum mengupgrade senjata. Disini kamu dapat melihat Opsi Senjata yang tersedia sesuai level karaktermu
4. Opsi Senjata Soulbound dapat diubah menggunakan Tiket Opsi Senjata Acak atau Tiket Seleksi Option Senjata
5. Mendapatkan Sukses Besar pada peningkatan senjata memberimu 15% bonus pada Opsi
6. Senjata yang telah memiliki semua opsi yang diupgrade melalui Sukses Besar akan ditandai ‘MAX’
7. Ketika mengupgrade senjata, kau dapat memilih antara opsi semula atau opsi baru dan konfirmasikan berdasarkan pilihanmu.

TEXT_HELP_20407_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Hanya Old Weapon dan Soulbound yang bisa ditempa.
2. Menempa Old Weapon akan menghasilkan 2 Senjata Soulbound 4-bintang acak yang mana dapat kamu pilih penempaan finalnya
3. Kamu dapat menggunakan poin untuk mengulang proses tempa pada senjata lainnya sebelum memilih diantara keduany. Kamu tidak akan mendapatkan senjata duplikasi maksimal 5 kali percobaan
4. Menempa SBW akan meningkatkan peringkatnya
5. Bahan tempa dapat diperoleh dari Benteng Jiwa dan Mode Tantangan

TEXT_HELP_20408_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. ★6 Soulbound Weapons can be inlaid with Sigils to gain extra stats.
2. In order to inlay a Sigil, you must first add a slot to a Soulbound Weapon.
3. Adding a slot to a ★6 Soulbound Weapon requires other ★4~6 Soulbound Weapons and Fergus Points.
4. First Slot: Add any 1 Material to add the first slot.
5. Second Slot: Adding Materials increases the Slot Point Bar (0~100). Reaching 100 Points will result in the addition of the second slot.
6. Different Materials are valued at different points, as listed below:
- ★4 Soulbound Weapon: 5 Slot Points
- ★5 Soulbound Weapon: 10 Slot Points
- ★6 Soulbound Weapon: 20 Slot Points
- Fergus Point: 10 Slot Points
7. Materials disappear once used and cannot be recovered.

TEXT_HELP_20409_MAIN_DESC.text:
1.Dapat memasang Sigil di Senjata Soulbound yang memiliki slot
2. Membutuhkan emas untuk memasang sigil
3. Dapat melepaskan sigil dengan bantuan Fergus
4. Jika kamu mencoba untuk memasang sigil pada slot yang sudah diisi, sigil sebelumnya akan hilang

TEXT_HELP_20410_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Rings can be obtained through clearing Manacar Raids, Weekly Quests, and Legend of Primal Flames Side Story Dungeon.
 2. A Ring has a main option and several sub options depending on the ring's grade.
 - 1-Star Rings: 1 Main Option / 2-Star Rings: 1 Main Option + 1 Sub Option / 3-, 4-Star Rings: 1 Main Option + 2 Sub Options / 5-,6-Star Rings: 1 Main Option + 3 Sub Options
 3. Rings are classified by their main options and ranks.
 4. Ring options are randomly drawn within a certain range.
 5. They are further classified by their option grades, ranging from Bort, Inferior, Intermediate, Superior, to Premium.
 6. Further information on Ring options can be found through Ring information.
 7. The special options of a ring equipped by a friend Hero are not applied.

TEXT_HELP_20411_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Converting ring options requires either Essence of Flames or Essence of Mana.
2. Essence of Mana can be obtained by extracting rings or playing the 'Legend of Primal Flames' Side Story Dungeon.
3. Essence of Flames can be obtained by playing the 'Legend of Primal Flames' Side Story Dungeon.
4. Essence of Flames can be used to upgrade the rank of the main or selected sub options of rings.
5. Essence of Mana can be used to randomly convert sub options of rings.
6. The number of possible conversions by Essence of Flames and Essence of Mana depends on the ring's grade.
- ★1, 2 Rings: 1 time
- ★3, 4 Rings: 2 times
- ★5 Rings: 3 times
- ★6 Rings: 5 times
7. The conversion limit can be reset by using Fergus Points.

TEXT_HELP_20412_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Kostum mengubah penampilan pahlawan dan memberi stat tambahan
2. Dapat digunakan dan diatur pada Inventori: Kostum

TEXT_HELP_20501_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Pelajari Skill Dewi yang telah bergabung denganmu
2. Kamu dapat berbicara dengan para Dewi. Dialog tambahan ditambahkan saat kamu melakukan Mode Skenario

TEXT_HELP_20502_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Hanya satu Dewi yang dapat ikut dalam sebuah tim.
2. Tombol/Bar skil Dewi dapat ditemukan diatas blok panel skil
3. Menggunakan skil blok pahlawan akan mengisi bar/tombol skil Dewi. Jumlahnya tergantung pada jumlah blok yang digunakan.
4. Jika kamu mengisi bar/tombol skill dewi pada level tertentu, kamu dapat menekan tombol tersebut untuk menggunakan skil Dewi
5. Kamu dapat mengubah posisi tombol/bar skill Dewi pada Pengaturan

TEXT_HELP_20601_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Champion menunjukan beberapa Faksi atau negara tertentu di Hasla
2. Champion direkrut melalui beberapa kondisi
3. Pahlawan Bintang-6 tertentu dibutuhkan untuk merekrut seorang Champion
4. Skill Champion secara otomatis ditingkatkan ketika Champion naik level
5. Saat Champion mencapai level maximum, mereka mendapatkan skill yang sangat kuat
6. Stat Champion dihasilkan dari akumulasi stat kelompok pahlawan

TEXT_HELP_20602_DESC.text:
1. Sending Heroes of the relevant Faction to reinforce a Champion will increase the Friendship Level of the Champion.
2. The amount of Friendship obtained by sending a Hero depends on the Hero's category and Grade.
3. Support Heroes can reinforce all Champions.
4. After reaching maximum Friendship with a Champion, further reinforcements will yield bonus rewards.
5. After reaching maximum Friendship with a Champion, you can send particular Heroes to form and strengthen a Bond with the Champion.
6. A Hero will not return once sent to a Champion.

TEXT_HELP_20602_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Sending Heroes of the relevant Faction to reinforce a Champion will increase the Friendship Level of the Champion.
2. The amount of Friendship obtained by sending a Hero depends on the Hero's category and Grade.
3. Support Heroes can reinforce all Champions.
4. After reaching maximum Friendship with a Champion, further reinforcements will yield bonus rewards.
5. After reaching maximum Friendship with a Champion, you can send particular Heroes to form and strengthen a Bond with the Champion.
6. A Hero will not return once sent to a Champion.

TEXT_HELP_20603_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Hanya satu Champion yang dapat ikut dalam sebuah tim
2. Ketika Champion ikut dalam tim, Tombol/bar Champion muncul diatas blok panel skil
3. Kamu dapat menyentuh tombol/bar Champion untuk mengaktifkan skillnya, skilnya terisi saat stage dimulai
4. Setiap skil Champion memiliki waktu cooldown yang berbeda dan batas pengaktivas maksimum
5. Tombol Champion ditempatkan pada arah yang sama seperti blok panel skil

TEXT_HELP_30101_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Mode Skenario terdiri dari bermacam episode, chapter, dan Stage yang melintasi hasla
2. Memainkan Mode Skenario membutuhkan Daging. 1 daging akan terisi setiap 3 menit
3. Kamu bisa mendapatkan tidah hanya EXP tentara bayaran dan pahlawan, tapi juga bermacam hadiah yang berguna 
4. Dewi, Champion dan teman pahlawan dapat ikut dalam kelompokmu
5. Teman pahlawan punya cooldown 24 jam setelah ikut serta
6. Kamu dapat mengecek pada Menu Catatan untuk melihat Kelompok pahlawan yang digunakan pemain lainnya untuk menyelesaikan Stage
7. Jika kmau kalah dalam Stage Skenario, kamu dapat melanjutkan dengan menonton iklan atau menggunakan Jewel
8. Jika kamu lanjut bermain setelah kalah, Pahlawanmu akan hidup kembali dan kebal selama beberapa detik
9. Jika kamu menyelamatkan tentara bayaran yang berkeliling dalam Stage, ia akan berjalan – jalan dikota selama 15 menit

TEXT_HELP_30102_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Mode Tantangan dibuka setelah menyelesaikan episode 1 Chronicles Kalard
2. Memainkan Mode Tantangan membutuhkan Daging
3. Waspadai monster penantang yang kuat dan serangan mereka!
4. Setelah mengalahkan monster Champion, kamu dapat memilih untuk lanjut atau keluar dari stage. Jika kamu keluar, kamu akan mendapat hadiah pada poin itu.
5. Jika kamu kalah pada Mode tantangan, kamu dapat melanjutkannya menggunakan Jewel
6. Jika kamu kalah pada Mode tantangan, kamu akan kehilangan seluruh hadiah yang kamu dapatkan.
7. Kamu bisa mendapatkan Besi, Sigilm dan buku warisan 
8. Dewi dan Champion dapat ikut serta dalam kelompok

TEXT_HELP_30103_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. You can acquire resources required for forging Soulbound Weapons in the Fortress of Souls.
2. A Hero can enter the Fortress only once a day. You can use Jewels to reset a Hero's entrance.
3. Each stage can be played only once per day. You can use Jewels to reset and replay a stage.
4. The Hero Bosses of the Fortress are constituted of Heroes from top Colosseum victors of the previous week.
- March of Darkness: Last Week's 3rd Place Colosseum Victor
- Looming Darkness: Last Week's 2nd Place Colosseum Victor
- Lord of Souls: Last Week's 1st Place Colosseum Victor
4. If you die in the Fortress, you can continue playing by watching an ad or using Jewels.

TEXT_HELP_30104_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Earn special Rings and Essence required to convert Rings.
2. Each Hero can play only once a day. You can use Jewels to reset Heroes.
3. Each stage can be played only once a day. You can use Jewels to reset stages.
4. Heroes and stages are reset every day at 00:00 UTC.
5. If you die in a stage, you can continue playing by using Jewels or watching an ad.

TEXT_HELP_30105_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Bermain-main dengan berbagai pengaturan untuk menguji tim dan mempelajari kemampuan mereka.
2. Aktifkan lebih banyak scarecrow sepanjang Mode Skenario.
3. Scarecrow level tinggi memiliki HP dan kekuatan serangan yang lebih tinggi.
4. Anda dapat mengubah tim atau pilihan scarecrow tanpa harus keluar dari stage.

TEXT_HELP_30201_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Gunakan Tiket untuk bertarung melawan lawan acak di Koloseum.
2. Tiket diisi ulang setiap 2 jam, sampai maksimal 5 Tiket.
3. Setelah menghabiskan Tiket, Anda memiliki satu jam untuk bermain 5 putaran pertempuran.
4. Koloseum akan tertutup saat Anda mencapai batas waktu, atau kehilangan putaran.
5. Sebelum setiap putaran, Anda dapat membeli Buffs yang berguna dengan Gold.
6. Setiap putaran memiliki batas waktu 3 menit. Statistik Pahlawan Tertentu akan dikotori untuk perjalanan pertempuran.
7. Jika pertarungan tidak berakhir pada akhir 3 menit, pemenang ditentukan oleh jumlah total HP Heroes yang tersisa.
8. Hanya dewi yang bisa menemani tim ke Colosseum. Champion tidak bisa masuk
9. Jika Anda menang, Anda akan mendapatkan Meat, Honor , dan Poin Kemenangan. Mendapatkan sejumlah Poin Kemenangan tertentu akan meningkatkan Tingkat Koloseum Anda (Perunggu / Perak / Emas / Master) dan Reward Peringkat.
10. Koloseum Tier Anda disetel ulang setiap Senin setiap minggu. Anda akan menerima Reward Rank berdasarkan Koloseum Tier and Rank terakhir untuk minggu ini.
11. Tempat pertama Koloseum pemenang akan memiliki patung Pahlawan Utama mereka ditempatkan di kota untuk minggu berikutnya.1 ke 3 tempat Koloseum pemenang akan membuka dialog khusus dengan para dewi dan penduduk kota.
12. Setelah memasuki Master Tier, Anda bisa menggunakan Honor 10 kali sehari untuk mengganti lawan Anda.

TEXT_HELP_30202_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Melawan secara real-time dengan pemain lain.
2. Anda dapat memilih untuk bertemu lawan yang benar-benar acak atau bertarung melawan pertempuran yang dipilih melalui persiapan sebuah ruangan di Lobby.
3. Rekaman kemenangan dan damage disetel ulang Senin setiap minggu.
4. Rekaman disimpan hanya di Pertarungan Teman secara acak.
5. Hanya dewi yang bisa menemani tim ke Pertarungan Teman. Champion tidak bisa masuk.

TEXT_HELP_30301_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Obtain useful items or recruit Legendary Heroes.
2. You can enter by using Keys. Keys recharge at a rate of one every 20 minutes, to a maximum of 45 Keys.
3. You can use Jewels to purchase additional Keys.
4. You can view the Dungeon Schedule to check daily Dungeons on the upper left screen.

TEXT_HELP_30302_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Recruit Legendary Heroes and acquire weapons and other useful items. There are six Legendary Hero Dungeons:
- Disarm / Black and White / Gravity Labyrinth
- The Void / Path of Rage / Road to Ruin
2. Legendary Heroes can be recruited through Destiny Points, which are earned by clearing the Dungeon.
3. If you are lucky, a Legendary Hero may choose to join you right away!
4. Using the Potion of Destiny from the Shop will earn you extra Destiny Points every round.

TEXT_HELP_30303_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Earn various items useful for training your Heroes.
2. Each Dungeon opens on different days of the week.
- Chilly Bread Storage (Tuesdays, Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays)
- Goblin's Secret Storage (Mondays, Thursdays, Saturdays, Sundays)
- Witch Rage (Wednesdays)
- Ancient Training Grounds (Every Day)
- Time Acceleration (Sundays)

TEXT_HELP_30304_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Event Dungeons open randomly for a limited time.
2. Check official announcements and the official website for the latest schedule!
- Rush! Heroid
- Weapon Ordeals
- Return of the Rabbit Army
- Draco's Nest
- Sneaky Sneaky Fergus

TEXT_HELP_30402_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Powerful Apostles appear as Bosses of the stage.
2. You can earn Iron and Old Weapons.
3. Each Apostle Boss gives different types of weapons.
4. Two Apostle Bosses appear each day of the week. All Apostles appear on the weekend.

TEXT_HELP_30403_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Raid Penguasa Mana hanya bisa dimasuki setelah membersihkan Dungeons 'The Void,' Path of Rage ', dan Road to Ruin' Dungeons.
2. 'Penguasa Mana' tetap terbuka setiap saat setelah unlocking.
3. Membersihkan Raid akan memberi Anda Rings and Gold.
4. Setiap lantai Raid membutuhkan strategi yang berbeda untuk diselesaikan.
5. Jika Anda mengalami masalah, periksa Panduan Guide Toon di Menu> Media> Comic Menu

TEXT_HELP_30404_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Fitur ini dibuka saat menyelesaikan episode 1 
dari Kalard Chronicles
2. Memiliki peluang untuk mendapatk Sigil Laut saat 
menyelesaikan Raid
3. Penjaga dari Kerajaan yang Hilang tahan terhadap 
kerusakan fisik maupun sihir
4. Setiap monster Boss akan menggunakan skill terkuat
saat mencapai HP tertentu, Tap pada layar untuk 
menghindari bahaya!

TEXT_HELP_30501_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Tangkap ikan untuk meningkatkan Peringkat Pemancing & dapatkan Koin Ikan
2. Meningkatkan Peringkat Pemancing akan membuka peralatan dan lokasi pemancingan lebih baik
3. Koin Ikan dapat ditukarkan dengan bermacam item di Trading Post
4. Memancing membutuhkan 1 umpan perputaran
5. Memancing tidak dapat dilakukan jika tidak ada umpan
6. Pahlawan utama mu yang akan memancing, kamu dapat mengganti pahlawan utama dari menu Peralatan Memancing

TEXT_HELP_30502_MAIN_DESC.text:
1.Setelah sampai pada lokasi pemancingan, sentuh tombol reel untuk melemparkan tali dan mulai memancing
2. Casting 
- Kamu harus mengcast tali untuk memulai memancing. Jika kamu berhasil menekan tombol ketika mencapai posisi tengah gauge , kamu memiliki peluang lebih tinggi untuk mendapatkan ikan yang lebih besar  
3. Biting 
- Tunggu saat ikan menggigit umpan
- Proses ini berlangsung 60 detik
- Semakin tinggi peringkat Memancingmu (FR), dan Rate Bite, semakin cepat ikan menggigit umpan
4. Pulling 
- Ketika kamu merasa ikan telah menggigit umpan, sentuh tombol Reel dan mulai bertarung dengan ikan
- Jika kamu gagal saat menekan tombol, ikan akan lepas
5. Fighting 
- Agar berhasil mendapatkan ikan, kamu harus menarik ikan mendekati pahlawan kita
- Jarak antar ikan dan pahlawan kita dalam unit meter. Jika ikan berada dalam jarang 40% lebih jauh dari karakter kita, ikan tersebut akan lepas
- Tekan tombol reel untuk menarik talimu , lepaskan tombol untuk mengulur tali 
- Penarikan tali juga meningkatkan tekanan pada Tension Gauge 
- Jika Tension Gauge mencapai batasnya, talimu akan putus dan ikan akan melepaskan diri
6. Tension Gauge
- Tension Gauge di bagi menjadi 3 bagian. Tiap bagian ditandai dengan warna yang berbeda
- Biru : Tali kendor , Ikan akan semakin jauh dari pahlawan kita 
- Hijau : Tegangan dari tali cukup baik, Ikan akan tertarik ke arah pahlawan kita 
- Merah : Tali dalam kondisi tertarik, ikan akan tertarik ke arah pahlawan kita lebih cepat, tapi kamu harus berhati-hati agar tali tidak putus 
7. Skill Ikan 
- Ikan kuat terkadang melompat dari air
- Ketika ikan melompat keluar air, akan menghasilkan blok board atau slide contol event
- Jika kamu berhasil pada block atau slide control , akan memberikan kerusakan hebat pada ikan dan menarik ikan lebih dekat 
- jika gagal , kamu tidak dapat menarik tali dalam waktu beberapa saat  dan ikan akan menjauh

TEXT_HELP_30503_MAIN_DESC.text:
1.Kamu dapat membeli atau menggunakan peralatan pancing
2. Setelah didapatkan, alat pancing dan pelampung dapat dipergunakan secara permanen
3.Umpan adalah sumber daya yang dapat habis dan harus dibeli agar dapat memancing
4.Stat dari perlengkapan mempengaruhi pengalaman memancing dan hasil
- Power : Reeling lebih cepat
- Big Fish Chance : Rarer, ikan lebih besar. Berpengaruh pada auto fishing
- Bite Chance : Peluang lebih tinggi ikan menggigit umpan
- Bonus : Stat tambahan pada lokasi pemancingan

TEXT_HELP_30504_MAIN_DESC.text:
1. Melihat daftar ikan yang telah ditangkap di setiap 
pemancingan, progres koleksimu saat ini, dan informasi 
lebih lanjut tentang ikan yang kamu tangkap
2. Jika kamu menangkap seluruh ikan yang dapat ditangkap 
disetiap tempat pemancingan, kamu akan menyelesaikan
Album Koleksi ikan dan mendapat hadiah spesial
3. Catatan terbaik dari setiap ikan akan direset sehari sekali

TEXT_HELP_ARENA_01_DESC.text:
1. Fight real-time battles with other Captains to raise your Arena Rank and receive a weekly reward!
2. Each Arena competition starts every Monday and lasts a week.
3. The Arena goes under maintenance every Monday for one hour, from 00:00~01:00 UTC. You cannot enter the Arena during this time.
4. You will receive your weekly reward after Arena Maintenance in accordance with your Arena Rank and Tier.
5. Winning a round will award you 20 Arena Coins; losing will still award you 10.
6. The Arena requires no additional conditions to play after you initially enter.
7. Each round lasts 3 minutes. Victory goes to the player with more Heroes standing at the end of the round.
8. Should both players have the same number of Heroes remaining at the end of the round, victory goes to the player with the higher sum of their Heroes' remaining HP.
9. Only Goddesses can accompany your team to the Arena. Champions are banned from entering.
10. If you exit the game or lose connection during the round, you will automatically lose the battle.
11. Using a forbidden third-party program may result in penalty regarding your gameplay.
12. Only ★6 Heroes can play in the Arena.
13. You will have a short time to prepare for battle before each round in the Arena.

TEXT_HELP_ARENA_02_DESC.text:
1. All Captains who play the Arena will be given an Arena Rank.
2. Arena Ranks are divided into Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Master.
3. Bronze, Silver, and Gold Ranks are further divided into Tiers.
   - Bronze Rank: Tier I
   - Silver Rank: Tiers I~III
   - Gold Rank: Tiers I~V
4. Each victory in the Arena will award you 1 point. Winning a round at 5 points will take you to the next Tier, where you will start with 1 point. Leveling up from the highest Tier 1 will take you to the next Arena Rank.
5. Each loss in the Arena will cost you 1 point. Losing a round at 0 points will take your Tier down by one grade, where you will start with 4 points.
6. While losing a round may result in the decrease of your Tier, it will never affect your attained Rank.
7. There are no Tiers in Master Rank. You will start Master Rank from 1 point.
8. Each victory in Master Rank will award you 1 point. Each loss will cost you 1 point.
9. After Arena Maintenance every Monday, you will receive your weekly reward in accordance with your Rank and Tier. Your Rank will be adjusted to the final Tier of the previous Rank.
10. Achieving Master Rank will earn you a special Frame that can be used until the next Arena Maintenance.

TEXT_HELP_ARENA_03_DESC.text:
1. You can ban Heroes before finding a match in the Arena.
2. Bans can be applied to Heroes, Classes, and Factions. The ban functions will regularly change during the Arena Beta period.
3. You must meet different requirements to play the Arena according to the ban type.
- Hero Ban: You must have at least 6~12 ★6 Heroes, depending on the number of banned Heroes.
4. The number of bans you can apply changes according to the ban type.
- Hero Ban: 1~4 Heroes can be banned out of all Heroes.

TEXT_HELP_ARENA_04_DESC.text:
1. After finding a match in the Arena, you will get ready for the duel with the opponent.
2. You and your opponent will take turns choosing the Heroes to use in the duel.
3. The Captain with the first pick will choose one Hero, after which the other Captain will choose 2 Heroes.
4. Each Captain will need to choose a Hero from their own roster.
5. You cannot choose a Hero that has been banned or already picked by the other Captain.
6. You have a time limit of 10 seconds to select each Hero. Confirming your pick will automatically decrease the time limit to 0 seconds.
7. After each player picks 2 Heroes, both players will simultaneously select their third Hero and Striker.
8. The last two Heroes simultaneously selected by each player will not be revealed to the other player until the final preparation session. The same Hero may be picked by both parties.
9. If you do not confirm a Hero within the time limit, the Hero you have selected will be automatically confirmed. If you have not selected any Hero, a Hero will randomly be confirmed from your roster.
10. You can change your ally leader at any time after selecting your first Hero and before entering battle.
11. You can change your Goddess at any time before entering battle.
12. After selecting all your Heroes, you will have 10 seconds to make your final preparations before entering battle.

TEXT_HELP_ARENA_STRIKER_DESC.text:
1. In the Arena, a fourth Hero can be added to a team as a Striker. 
2. Pressing the Striker button during a round will call forth the fourth Hero who will assist the team in battle.
3. Striker Heroes use skills based on the usage of the leader ally's blocks.
4. Striker Heroes cannot use Special Skills.
5. Strikers who leave the field or die can be called back after a cooldown period. 
6. Each game has a limit on the number of times a Striker Hero can be called.
7. The survival of a Striker Hero does not affect wins and losses.

TEXT_HELP_AUTO_DESC.text:
1. You can delegate battle to your Heroes and repeat stages.
2. Only cleared 'Scenario' and 'Challenge' stages can be delegated.
3. Only one stage can be delegated at a time.
4. You can select the number of rounds to be delegated before starting the stage.
5. Delegation will be aborted when all Heroes fall in battle or your inventory reaches maximum limit.

TEXT_HELP_BOOST_DESC.text:
1. The Boost feature can be used after clearing Kalard Chronicles Episode 1.
2. It can be used in Scenario and Challenge.
3. Upon using the Boost feature, twice the normal amount of Meat will be consumed.
4. Upon using the Boost feature and clearing a stage, you will receive twice the normal amount of rewards.
5. The count limit for Boosting is reset every day at 00:00 UTC.
6. When using the Boost feature, you cannot use Goddess Elixirs.

TEXT_HELP_CHAMPION_LINK_DESC.text:
1. After reaching maximum Friendship with a Champion, you can form a Bond with the Faction.
2. Forming a Bond will allow you to send Heroes to further increase your Friendship Level.
3. As your Bond becomes stronger, your Champion will learn new Bond Skills, and the Heroes belonging to the Faction will receive a Bond Buff that boosts their stats.
4. After a Bond reaches maximum Friendship level, sending Heroes to reinforce a Champion will contribute only towards Bonus Rewards until you meet the unlock conditions.

TEXT_HELP_COLLABO_HERO.text:
1. Otherworld Heroes can only be recruited during limited periods of time.
2. Otherworld Heroes range from ★1 to ★6 and are fixed in their promotion.
3. Otherworld Heroes do not belong to a faction of Hasla and can be sent to reinforce all Champions.
4. Certain ★3 Otherworld Heroes cannot be promoted.

TEXT_HELP_EVENT_MAZE_BASIC.text:
1. Explore the Maze and reach the Goal during the event period to earn various rewards.
2. You must acquire at least three keys in the Maze to open the Gate to the Goal.
3. The Maze consists of tiles that each require 1 Energy to move.
4. You cannot move in the Maze without Energy. Some events in the Maze will also require Energy to continue.
5. 10 Energy are recharged every day at 00:00 UTC. You can also acquire more Energy by clearing Daily Event Quests.
6. Different Maze events will activate depending on the type of the tile you enter.
     - Normal: Nothing happens.
     - Treasure Chest: Earn bonus rewards.
     - Mini-Game: Play one of the following games - Rock, Paper, Scissors; Card Match; Crystal Tap. Victory will earn you a reward, while defeat will cost you Energy.
     - Options: You can use Energy to take a specific action or you can ignore it. If you ignore the event, you can't do it again later.
7. Events in the Maze automatically begin upon entering the tile. However, you must have a minimum amount of Energy to proceed with the event.
8. If you do not have enough Energy to continue the event, you enter standby mode and will be barred from moving to other tiles. You can continue the event after recharging your Energy and tapping the Event in the Maze Map.
9. Each Event can be played only once.
10. You can use Warps to teleport to tiles that have already been explored by tapping on the tile in the Maze Map. You can only use a limited number of Warps.
11. The Maze Event is held for a total of seven days. After this period, you can only collect rewards and use the Maze Shop for the next seven days.
12. You cannot replay once you reach the Goal and clear the Maze.

TEXT_HELP_EVENT_MAZE_REWARD.text:
1. Maze Coins can be acquired from various places in the Maze. They can be exchanged for rewards at the Event Shop. 
2. Expedition Rewards are acquired in proportion to the number of treasure chests opened in the Maze. 
3. Clear Rewards can be acquired by reaching the Goal of the Maze within the event period. 
4. After the event period, there will be an extra period during which you can exchange leftover Coins or gather uncollected rewards.

TEXT_HELP_EVENT_SEASONAL_BASIC.text:
1. Within the event period, acquire the event resources by using in-game resources such as Meat, Keys and Colosseum Tickets.
2. You can trade Event Currency for a set number of rewards every day.
3. If you earn all daily rewards, you get one Complete Stamp for that day.
4. You can acquire various rewards with each Complete Stamp.

TEXT_HELP_EXP_BUFF.text:
Efek Aktivasi
Dapatkan 100% lebih EXP pahlawan dengan menyelesaikan Mode Skenario selama {0} jam
#Hanya Skenario#

TEXT_HELP_FISH_EXCHANGE_DESC.text:
1. Tukarkan Fish Coin dengan berbagai item di Trading Post.
2. Batas pembelian setiap item di Trading Post direset setiap hari Senin.

TEXT_HELP_HASLAWARS_BASIC.text:
1. Fight Giant Bosses and receive rewards!
2. You will receive additional rewards if you successfully defeat the Boss Monster within the event period.
3. A Hero can fight only one battle a day.
4. 'Devilish Coins' acquired through the event can be traded into items from the stores of Hell Island.
5. You receive more Devilish Coins the longer you survive in battle.

TEXT_HELP_HASLAWARS_RANK.text:
1. The Total Dmg Rank menu lists Captains who have dealt the most total damage. 
2. The Team Rank menu lists Hero teams and their Captains who have dealt the most damage in one round.
- Teams composed of the same Heroes will be registered with the information of the Team that dealt more damage.
- Teams composed of at least one different Hero are registered separately. (Goddesses and Champions are not taken into consideration.) 
- Rank information is cleared with the start of every new event.
3. The Hero Rank menu lists Heroes that have most frequently participated in the event.
4. All ranks refresh every 5 minutes.

TEXT_HELP_HASLAWARS_REWARD.text:
1. Rewards are given according to your damage grade once the event is completed. Captains are categorized into different grades based on each individual's total damage dealt during the event period.
2. Victory Rewards are additional rewards that can be acquired after the event by defeating the Boss within the event period. 
3. If you fail to defeat the Boss, you will not receive a Victory Reward.

TEXT_HELP_MIX_DESC.text:
1. Kombinasikan item tertentu dan sumber daya untuk mendapatkan item baru 
2. Kombinasi berbeda akan menghasilkan item berbeda
3. Item tempa akan membutuhkan biaya tempa disesuaikan dengan material yang dipergunakan. Resep berbeda akan memiliki harga yang berbeda
4. Tempa membutuhkan setidaknya 1 ruang di inventori 
5. Material yang dipergunakan untuk tempa secara permanen akan hilang
6. Tempa tidak pernah gagal – akan selalu menghasilkan sesuatu

TEXT_HELP_ORCHARD_03_DESC.text:
1. You can hire and manage Orchard Helpers.
2. Once acquired or purchased, Helpers can be permanently used. They cannot be sold.
3. Helpers have different abilities to help out on the Orchard.
- Increase Great Harvest Rate
- Increase Bonus Reward Rate
- Decrease Growth Time

TEXT_HELP_PVP_DESC.text:
1. Spend a Ticket to battle a random opponent in the Colosseum.
2. Tickets recharge every 2 hours, up to a maximum of 5 Tickets.
3. Upon entering the Colosseum, you have 1 hour to play 1 round of battle.
4. The Colosseum closes when you reach the time limit or lose the round.
5. You can use Honor to purchase helpful buffs before each round.
6. Each round has a time limit of 3 minutes. Particular Hero stats will be buffed for the duration of the battle.
7. If the battle does not conclude at the end of 3 minutes, the victor is decided by the total sum of the remaining Heroes' HP.
8. Only Goddesses can accompany a team to the Colosseum. Champions cannot enter.
9. Winning a round will earn you Meat, Honor, and Victory Points. Obtaining certain amounts of Victory Points will upgrade your Colosseum Tier (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Master) and Tier Reward.
10. Your Colosseum Tier is reset every Monday. You will receive a Tier Reward based on your final Colosseum Tier and Rank for the week.
11. The 1st Place Colosseum victor will have a statue of their Main Hero placed in town for the following week. 1st to 3rd place Colosseum victors will unlock special dialogue with Goddesses and residents of the town. 
12. You can use Honor to change your opponent up to 10 times a day.

TEXT_HELP_QUEST_01_DESC.text:
1.Quest ada kaitannya dengan kisah Crusaders Quest
2.Kamu dapat mencoba quest ini sebanyak mungkin 
3.Setelah quest selesai, quest tidak akan tampil kembali

TEXT_HELP_QUEST_02_DESC.text:
1. Kamu dapat rank up dengan menyelesaikan quest yang selalu muncul berulang untuk mendapatkan Poin Quest Rank (QR) EXP 
2. Ada keuntungan saat melakukan Rank Up
- Limit Quest  dan penolakan Quest di reset setiap kali rank up
- Memiliki kesempatan lebih baik untuk mendapatkan rare Quest dan hadiah lebih baik
- Banyak quest yang ditampilkan pada ranking tertentu
- Limit Quest Harian meningkat pada ranking tertentu
- Jumlah penolakan quest meningkat pada ranking tertentu 
- Ikon ranking di upgrade pada ranking tertentu
3. Quest akan ditampilkan secara acak
4. Ada peringkat untuk Quest. Quest yang lebih tinggi dari ranking tidak akan ditampilkan
5. Quest yang setidaknya berada pada peringkat 200 kebawah tidak ditampilkan 
6. Semakin langka quest semakin baik hadiah yang didapatkan 
7. Tidak ada batasan untuk menerima quest, tapi ada batasan penyelesaian harian 
8. Sekali kamu menolak quest, quest lainnya akan ditawarkan. Ada batasan penolakan harian ( Quest yang ditolak tidak akan tampil)
9. Sentuh pada gambar peringkat quest untuk  memeriksan info peringkat

TEXT_HELP_QUEST_03_DESC.text:
1.Quest dengan waktu yang harus diselesaikan
- Harian : Reset pada waktu tertentu harian
- Mingguan : Reset pada waktu tertentu mingguan
- Terbatas : Tersedia hanya pada waktu event
2. Kamu tidak harus menerima semuat tipe quest ini. Kamu dapat menyelesaikan quest di menu Quest dengan memenuhi persyaratan
3. Jika tidak dapat menyelesaikan Quest pada waktu yang telah ditentuka, quest akan di reset atau menghilang sama sekali

TEXT_HELP_S2_EP2_RAID.text:
1. This feature is unlocked after clearing Episode 2 of the Kalard Chronicles.
2. You can earn Set Sigils upon clearing the raid.
3. Loki Incarnate and his monsters regularly unleash their strength to become stronger throughout the battle. Make sure to cancel their buffs and attack.
4. Boss Monsters will threaten Heroes with chains of the Sanctuary upon reaching a certain point of their HP. Quickly destroy the chains to avoid damage!
5. When the screen completely freezes over, your line of sight becomes impaired and Heroes receive additional damage. Use a Goddess Skill to clear the frost.

TEXT_HELP_S2_EP3_RAID.text:
1. This feature is unlocked after clearing Episode 3 of the Kalard Chronicles.
2. You can earn ★3 Set Sigils upon clearing the Raid.
3. Electromagnetic fields will block Heroes from generating shields.
4. Shields generated by Boss Monsters will absorb all damage targeted at them.
5. Use Goddess Skills to neutralize Boss Monsters' laser beams. Succeeding will also neutralize the Boss Monsters' shields.
6.When Battleloid NS000 attempts to self-destruct, tap on the screen repeatedly to help Stanya deactivate the attack.

TEXT_HELP_S2_EP4_RAID.text:
1. The Raid can be entered after clearing Episode 4 of the Kalard Chronicles.
2. ★4 Set Sigils can be obtained by clearing the Raid.
3. Heroes who gaze into the Eye of the Abyss will receive an attack power debuff, while Goddess powers will be restricted. The Boss, on the other hand, will receive an armor and resistance buff.
4. All Boss buffs and debuffs can be dispelled.
5. Block the Boss's giant tentacles with Goddess skills. Successfully blocking the tentacles will also weaken the Boss.

TEXT_HELP_SOUL_HARD_DESC.text:
1. The Fortress of Raging Souls can be entered after defeating Lord of Souls Soltar. Fight against a mightier, more vengeful Lord of Souls!
2. Corrupt Soul Fragments are used in the Alchemy Lab to craft a special reward.
3. Heroes share the same team formation with the Fortress of Souls.
4. You can enter each stage once per day, and can use Jewels to re-enter.
5. Danan's Fragments and Corrupt Fragments do not appear in stages.
6. If you die in the Fortress, you can continue playing by using Jewels or by watching an ad.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_RZ_1_1.text: I'm going to make you King, Emilia!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_RZ_2_1.text: Will you keep me by your side?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_RZ_2_2.text: I'll kneel and beg you to stay with me if I need to.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_RZ_3_1.text:
I do not deny there were occasions when my hearstrings
felt a pull, but my heart lies at the end of my dream.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_RZ_3_2.text:
If I didn't already have a number 1 and number 2 in my heart,
this could have been dangerous…

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_RZ_4_1.text:
With your look and your cat ears and -! Who would believe
that you're a GUY?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_RZ_4_2.text:
Even so~ you're the one who made the wrong assumption,
Subaru-kyun~!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_RZ_5_1.text: My specialty is potatoes, freshly steamed.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_RZ_5_2.text: That's not something you brag about so proudly!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_RZ_6_1.text: It is alright, Rem. I am here. We have nothing to be afraid of.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_RZ_7_1.text: Ferri-chan's loyalty is only for you, Lady Crusch!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_RZ_7_2.text: I wholeheartedly accept, and shall return, your loyalty, Ferris.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_10_1.text: Oh, Kamu bersemangat seperti biasanya ! Hahaha!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_11_1.text: Orang-orang ditempat ini tidak begitu berbeda dengan kita

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_11_2.text: Sepertinya ada pihak lain yang bernasib sama dengan kita

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_12_1.text: Aku rindu dengan Istri dan anakku…

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_13_1.text: Banyak hal yang menarik!! Ricotta melihatnya untuk pertama kali !

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_13_2.text: …Ya.. Banyak hal yang benar - benar baru bagiku

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_14_1.text:
Dana, Dana, banyak hal yang menarik. Ricotta tidak pernah 
melihatnya sebanyak ini, ini pertama kalinya !!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_2_2.text: Uhuk uhuk! Waaa! Hampir saja aku 'lewat'! Apa yang terjadi?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_4_2.text:
Hmm… Adol, sepertinya kita dipindahkan ke sebuah tempat 
bernama Hasla

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_5_2.text: Adol, tempat apa ini …? Kristal Energi tiba tiba bercahaya dan ….

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_7_1.text:
Haha.. Nona Ricotta, kamu tampak lebih bersemangat daripada 
saat kamu tiba di desa Pengungsi

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_7_2.text:
Benar! Begitu banyak hal yang aku belum pernah lihat,
bahkan dari dalam buku. Masih banyak lagi!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_8_1.text:
Terdapat beberapa komplikasi, Hummel, tapi aku yakin kamu 
akan terus melakukan tugasmu seperti biasa

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_8_2.text: Tentu saja. Ini juga merupakan bagian tugas 'Transportasi'

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTEREGG_YS8_9_1.text: Apa kamu baik-baik saja nona Dana?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_246_1.text:
Sekali pengkhianat, tetaplah pengkhianat. Aku akan 
mengawasimu

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_246_2.text: Ha. Aku tidak menyangka akan ada penyambutan

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_247_1.text:
Putri dari Jenderal Besar, sangat disayangkan dia
telah bertunangan

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_247_2.text: Apa yang dikendarai orang itu? Dasar orang aneh…

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_248_1.text:
Sangat mengagumkan bahkan dengan kebutaan anda, 
Engkau adalah jenderal yang sangat hebat…

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_248_2.text:
Tidak ada yang tidak mungkin saat mata hatimu telah 
terbuka

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_249_1.text:
Seorang penari monda-mandir keluar istana! Apa kata 
leluhur kita nanti ?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_249_2.text: Aku sedang dalam misi yang penting!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_250_1.text:
Siapa yang tega memfitnahku seperti ini? Berpikirlah 
Zahard!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_250_2.text: Hatsyii!! Apa ada orang yang sedang membicarakanku?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_251_1.text: Atas dasar apa kamu menuduhku sebagai agen ganda?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_251_2.text:
Huh~ Ada beberapa laporan yang masuk yang mengatakan
bahwa kamu telah menyusupkan bahan terlarang

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_253_1.text: Hei kamu, raja botak, ingin bersenang-senang ?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_253_2.text: Tidak akan pernah aku biarkan orang melukai rakyatku

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_254_2.text:
Siapa sangka terdapat manusia yang lebih 
jahat daripada pemburu binatang tidak bersalah

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_255_1.text:
Panggungku adalah DUNIA! Aku akan pergi kemana
saja untuk mencari penonton

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_255_2.text: Ooh, seorang badut! Apa yang membawamu kesini

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_256_1.text:
Oh aku juga suka memecah belah desa juga! 
Mari kita bersenang-senang, kawan?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_256_2.text:
Aktingmu bisa jadi kurang bagus jika kamu sampai
membuat penontonmu terbunuh

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_257_1.text:
Ekspresi orang-orang saat mengetahui bahwa
mereka tertipu.. Adalah alasan aku melakukan ini

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_257_2.text: Aku setuju ~ itu adalah kucing ~ meoww !

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_258_1.text:
Aku akan buang ikatan ini dan mencari tempatku didunia
ini

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_259_1.text:
Kehidupan hanya di jalani dengan bebas, bagai aliran
sungai menuju lautan

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_259_2.text:
Ugh..walaupun takdir selalu saja mengganggu tidur
siangku

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_260_1.text: Sebuah pulau penuh dengan orang kaya? Katakan dimana?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_260_2.text: Aku tidak akan beritahu dengan cuma-cuma

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_261_1.text:
Asah kemampuanmu dan tidak ada seorangpun akan 
mentertawakanmu

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_261_2.text:
Hmm.. Sepertinya kami memiliki semangat seorang 
pejuang sejati

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_263_1.text:
Seorang ketua peneliti Rapture Science?? Aku akan 
cari tahu tentang masalah ini

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_263_2.text:
Seseorang telah meretas Database…Aku harus 
memberitahukan Departemen Keamanan tentang hal ini

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_264_1.text: Huh? Bagaimana bisa kamu tidak memiliki foto dimanapun?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_265_1.text:
Seorang Perawat yang dahulu bertempur di NDD.. 
Sesuatu terdengar mencurigakan

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_265_2.text:
Giliran kerja darurat lagi ? Aku bahkan tidak punya 
waktu untuk beristirahat

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_266_1.text:
Seorang pembuat roti dengan rutin di datangi oleh kapten…
itu pastilah tempat persembunyian rahasia

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_266_2.text: Mmm.. Makaron buatan Chocolat adalah yang terbaik

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_267_1.text: Yah, aku rasa kamu bisa katakan hal tersebut

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_267_2.text:
Aku dengar semunya, Suster Genevia! Pemanah dalam
dirimu bangkit untuk menyelamatkan seorang anak

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_267_3.text:
Kamu adalah pahlawanku, Suste Genevie! Kamu adalah 
kebanggaan dari Orde

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_268_2.text:
Aku juga memiliki rahasia… yang aku pilih untuk tidak aku 
katakan

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_269_1.text:
Emm.. Apa yang seorang suster lakukan dengan seorang
pencuri? Ha ha ha ..

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_269_2.text: Mmm.. Aku merasakan bau sesama pencuri

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_270_1.text:
Aku yakin pencuri itu telah melarikan diri. Jika saja aku 
tidak sebodoh ini.. Hiks

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_270_2.text:
Aku melacak seorang pencuri yang bersembunyi di desa ini
Aku minta kerja samamu !

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_271_1.text:
Hoahm.. Apakah kita pernah bertemu sebelumnya?
Aku rasa aku pernah melihatmu didalam mimpiku

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_271_2.text:
Tunggu … Aku tahu kamu.. Kamu Marpei dari Akademi 
Pelatihan

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_272_1.text: Aku mengerti.. Terima kasih karena telah bertahan hidup

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_272_2.text:
Saudariku dan aku tidak membencimu lagi.. Tapi aku 
tidak akan memaafkanmu sepanjang hidupku

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_273_1.text: Tuanku.. Tuanku? Ugh.. Kemana dia pergi kali ini ?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_273_2.text:
Aduh.. Sepertinya aku telah membuat Joan marah lagi, 
haha

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_274_1.text: Terima kasih. Ini adalah tugasku untuk melayani Tuanku

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_274_2.text: Anda selalu memiliki rasa syukur saya, Lady Joan.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_275_1.text: Aku merasakan kehadiran mencurigakan di sekitar sini ...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_275_2.text: Hah, ksatria itu ... aku harus lebih berhati-hati di sekitarnya.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_275_3.text: Oh, lihat, Tia! Betapa indahnya taman.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_276_1.text:
Hrrmph. Saya masih berpikir Hikari lebih cantik, 
tapi saya akan mengakui bahwa pertunjukan lumayan

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_276_2.text:
Tidak mungkin. Tapi aku akan mengakui bahwa dia 
berada di posisi kedua, SETELAH Rachel.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_277_1.text:
Oh, tidak sama sekali! Saya hanya menyukai 
pertunjukan Anda - seperti biasa!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_277_2.text:
Saya minta maaf untuk adik perempuan saya. 
Dia bisa agak protektif ...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_278_1.text:
Apa yang harus saya lakukan? Hatiku hancur setiap 
saat memikirkannya.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_278_2.text:
Jika Anda benar-benar mencintainya, Anda harus 
percaya padanya.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_280_3.text: Dia tampak berbeda dari kita semua, woof!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_281_1.text: Haha, hati-hati jangan sampai terbawa suasana

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_281_2.text: Iya nih! Snowboarding adalah yang paling keren !!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_282_1.text:
Hohohoho! Bangun kebun putih mewah 
di istana sekaligus!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_283_1.text: HEI! Tidak ada api di sekitar boneka kayu saya!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_284_1.text:
Kualitas melebihi kuantitas, 
itulah yang selalu saya katakan!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_284_2.text: Ha! Cobalah memasak lebih dari 300 tentara setiap hari.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_285_2.text: Huh, gang ini rasanya seperti rumah ...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_285_3.text:
Dengar, Saudari! Ini takoyaki - 
sama seperti yang biasa kami makan!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_286_2.text:
Huh ... manusia atau kuda ...? 
Anda di sana, apakah Anda mau wortel?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_287_2.text: Apakah ini yang Anda sebut penunggang kuda sejati?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_288_1.text: Aura gelap apa ini ? Ini pasti adalah roh jahat!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_288_2.text: Ugh ... 72 jam tanpa tidur BUKAN ide bagus ...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_289_1.text:
Oh, apakah Anda mahasiswa pertukaran baru dari Chen?
Ayo makan siang bersama!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_289_2.text: Maaf, aku disini bukan untuk mencari teman

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_290_1.text:
Saya tahu bahwa nilai Anda sempurna, Cronette, 
tapi mungkin Anda bisa lebih memperhatikannya di kelas.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_290_2.text: Oh, tapi aku sudah tahu segalanya.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_291_1.text: Ksshhh ... Api ini ... tidak bisa dipadamkan ...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_291_2.text: Saya-ini mengatakan sesuatu, Pak! Aku-apakah itu iblis, Pak?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_291_3.text: Fu fu fu .. Tidak ada yang mampu memadamkan api neraka!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_292_1.text: Hisss … Berhati-hatilah untuk tidak menyentuh apinya

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_292_2.text: Eh? Api ini tidaklah panas, Tuan!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_292_3.text: Aku dapat mengendalikan mereka, Keren bukan ?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_293_1.text: Penyihir Api.. Ugh. Aku pikir dia hanya ada di kisah dongeng

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_293_2.text: Aku akan menemukan Penyihir Air juga Tuan!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_293_3.text:
Eh? Vesper? Buat apa orang bodoh itu? Tunggu 
siapa kamu?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_294_2.text: Esensi dari Api Kuno, adalah inti dari Gunung Purba

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_294_3.text: Apapun yang akan kalian lakukan, aku tidak akan lakukan

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_295_1.text: Teknologi Neth adalah yang terbaik di dunia !

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_505_1.text: Say, is it you, Master Hansheng? You've outright beat me to the chase! I've been meaning to visit you at your home after making this short visit to the Royal Court. Aiya, what's become of your hair? When did it become so white? Master Hansheng, every man should fight to serve his country but that doesn't mean his country can order him around until his head is full of white hair. Seems there should be some retirement laws for the Five Tiger Generals, too! And with you not being able to see - they should doubly respect your service and let you leave if you want. Of course, I mean the best for you, Master Hansheng. You're like family. I reckon that your dragon powers are still going strong judging from your arms. Good for you, Master Hansheng, good for you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_505_2.text: Hoho, you're the same as ever, lad.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_506_1.text: So you're Mengqi! Don't look so surprised that I know your name, lad! I heard from people along the way here that the Royal Court had picked a new Tiger General after I left. To become a Tiger General at so young an age! Must be quite the honor, and quite the skill, too. Let me give you a piece of advice as your senior and also man to man: you must train your heart as well as your skills and strength. Now, to explain the reasons of my coming here, I hafta start with the day I gave up my place in the Five Tiger Generals. And to tell the story of why I gave up my place in the Five Tiger Generals, I hafta start with that day 40 years ago those damned monsters came attacking our town. It's gonna be a long one, so take a seat, lad. Now, I remember clear as crystal...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_507_1.text: Lady Rebecca! Am I glad to see you! How have you been? And have you been training as I' taught you? No, don't tell me! I can tell from your aura that you have trained well. What a happy day, a happy day indeed to be crossing paths with Lady Rebecca. To see you grown up a fine young lady, that brings tears to my eyes - it feels like only yesterday that you were a little girl hiding behind the General's knees. Must be my age - at this rate I'll have to retire soon if all such happy meetings bring tears to my eyes! Oh, and I've almost forgotten. How is your father the General, blessed soul that he is? I trust that he's doing fine!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_507_2.text: Oh, Uncle Shuwen! It's been so long! You seem... erm, to be doing well.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_508_1.text: An enlightened otter! By my beard, I've always known the world is wide and full of all sorts of odd things that I've yet to see, but this is a strange sight indeed. Oho... Well, I reckon that it doesn't matter whether you're a human or an animal to have an epiphany, there's no such thing as a lesson too late is what my dear old mama used to tell me. Good otter, you've already taught this old man another lesson with your presence alone! But before you go, let me ask you this one thing. It's been bothering me since we've met. How is it that you're floating in air? Training ain't a bother for me, and even if it were it wouldn't be if it meant I could fly like that. Or do you need to have a special sorta enlightenment? Ain't every day that you meet an enlightened otter and I'm set on receiving some answers.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_509_1.text: Huh! What a curious aura! As far as I know, only Ethereals training in the high peaks of the Kunlun Mountains can maintain such a pure aura. Maybe you're an apprentice training under Ethereals? Haha, a long time ago I too thought I could train to become an Ethereal myself and learn that enlightened magic. So I set out and met a Saint by the name of He Xiangu - huh, you don't say! You too trained under Saint He Xiangu? Well, that means I'm your elder brother in a way! Anyway, I spent some years training under Saint He Xiangu, but she told me that I had been born under too strong a star and was fated to become a fighter. 'It's no use attempting to become an Ethereal when you're meant for another road' is what she told me. Instead, she taught me a few training tips that would keep my mind pure as the purest of crystals, which proved handy when I had to spent years and years of harsh training. May all the mountain peaks of Chen and the Ethereals of the kingdom bless her soul, Saint He Xiangu. Only goes to show you that no man is made in a day or just by himself - he receives the help of many people in paving the path that is his life.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_509_2.text: Ahh! Someone make this man stop talking! I'd rather go back to my lessons if I could only keep him away!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_510_1.text: Do you happen to know that strong-lookin' lass there? Your daughter? Ain't she a sight to behold! And I'd thought I'd been born strong with the strength from my mama's side o' the family. She's what you could call a fighter chosen by the heavens themselves. And even with her strength she's not one bit proud, and loves and takes care of her father like her own arm... She's a treasure, yessir. Say, why don't you let me train her? With the proper training, she may become the stuff of legends that these lands have never seen the likes of.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_518_1.text: I am haunted by memories that are not mine, these days. I seem to 'remember' a promise made under a peach tree...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_518_2.text: Hmm... And I thought I had been the only one. I 'remember' hundreds of ships on a river, ablaze with the flames of war.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_518_3.text: Oho, that's mighty curious! Before I came to be called 'the Fist King,' I was told to 'remember the order in which things disappeared' and 'look to the end of the world.' Baffling words, eh? Well, I 'spose I could tell you how I came to hear those words...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_519_2.text: I will not allow any mortal, insignificant as they may be, to tread unsanctioned the lands of my ancestors.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_520_2.text: Hmm? Oho! How strange, a penguin seems to be emitting the signals of my Steamer army.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_521_2.text: Captain, this is offensive! It's Animal Hero discrimination!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_521_3.text: Did you really think we would speak the same language JUST because we're of Animal race, Captain?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_522_2.text: What's that, meow? I may understand cats, but not penguins!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_524_1.text: MY HEAD IS BEING CONTROLLED BY AN ANTENNAE! I REPEAT! MY HEAD IS BEING CONTROLLED BY AN ANTENNAE! I AM OLGA DAUGHTER OF ORCA OF THE PENGUIN KINGDOM! MY HEAD IS BEING CONTROLLED BY...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_524_2.text: Wooah!! It's so black and white and fluffy and I WANT TO TAKE ONE HOME!! I shall call her Squawky and she'll be mine!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_524_3.text: I've made it possible for you two to understand each other for a short period of time. Go nuts.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_525_2.text: Gon confused! This person, smell like Gon's mama.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_526_2.text: I see you too were only recently released from the clutches of the ice. Huhu, perhaps we should create a support group with the other Guardians?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_527_1.text: Awooah awoo awoowoo wooah awoowooahah awoooo!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_527_2.text: Woomparoompapa pawooroompa. Apa roopawoompa woomroom. Woompa woomparoopa.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_528_2.text: Hmm, this creature... may resemble a dragon, but she is not one. There is no need for me to hunt her.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_529_2.text: Huh? This person isn't on the list of the dead!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_529_3.text: It seems she was born before written language was invented in the Realm of the Dead. Where should we send her, then...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_530_1.text: Oh, Y-Your Majesty! It's such an honor! I-I'll try my best!!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_530_2.text: Oho, so you're the holy knight everyone's talking about these days! What do you say to my properly knighting you as the Captain of the Order of the White Lion, right here and right now?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_531_1.text: O-of course... I'll do anything, if it means I'll be able to repent for the sins of the Order!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_531_2.text: The Order of the White Lion! I know about you bullies! If you ever harass other people again, I won't forgive you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_532_1.text: The Holy Sword of Elanuma... I still can't believe I'm the one who pulled it!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_532_2.text: The Holy Sword only lets those destined to fulfill the will of the Goddess draw it. I hear it's very picky when choosing a new partner... Congratulations!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_533_1.text: Of course! The Order may be important, but what's more important are my knightly duties and love for my people!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_533_2.text: At the heart of light... slumbers a darkness beyond belief. Do not let your faith blind you to the secrets of the Order.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_534_1.text: Wow! Is it really you, Master Leon? I'm a big fan!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_534_2.text: Wait, is that the Holy Sword of Elanuma? I never did manage to draw it... I guess Goddess Elanuma doesn't like me as much...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_535_1.text: Excuse me... Have you ever met the Maesters of the White Lion?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_535_2.text: Most of them should have returned to Grancia. ... The ones who remained are no more.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_535_3.text: The Order of the White Lion, of Grancia... They had been stationed at our kingdom at the request of the former Cardinal.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_536_1.text: (So this is the man who leads bloodthirsty fools to a hollow doom. Yes... I will wait by his side and bring down judgment when the time is right.)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_536_2.text: O Night Raven, come with me. Together we shall punish the unworthy ones and restore glory to the lands of our fathers!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_537_1.text: (Oho. So the blind king means well! What an honor - is that what I should say? He does not understand the lives of those who must linger in the shadows. ... I grow sick of this kingdom...)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_537_2.text: You can choose a better life than this. Will you not reconsider your decision?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_538_1.text: (The likes of her make me sick to the stomach. Does she not know she fights for a mere illusion?)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_538_2.text: The life of a warrior must be dedicated to the glory of the battlefield and war cries drenched in blood! My life for Nosgard!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_539_1.text: (The best assassin waits for the right moment to strike from the shadows. To reveal oneself before the enemy is the greatest mistake that can be made!)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_539_2.text: Huh, how old school... That attire just screams ‘assassin.’

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_540_1.text: (He left so soon... And I never got to thank him.)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_541_1.text: (A home to protect... How I envy you. May you keep your faith to a noble end.)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_541_2.text: Hrrmph. Fools may sing for war-bound glory, but I myself have always deemed my home village most precious. Worth even more than a captain's position granted by His Majesty himself.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_542_1.text: (Why is that Frost Elf staring at me so?)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_542_2.text: Oh, crap. It's that Night Raven Captain everyone's talking about... Should I run? Will I make it if I run?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_543_1.text: What is this? A mere stroke of fortune? A keen eye that sees through my motives? ... Whatever she is, the heavens are hindering my revenge through her!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_543_2.text: I don't know what you were up to, but I'm definitely not letting you ruin a joyful ceremony!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_544_1.text: I'll kill the Emperor. I will give up everything if I have to!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_544_2.text: I too share your hatred for the Emperor. But do you not see that your chosen path leads you across thin ice?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_545_1.text: That old man... I'd heard that he went blind, but it almost feels as if he sees right through me. I'll have to be careful.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_545_2.text: Hmm... A face may hide itself behind a mask, but the blade of vengeance in one’s heart can gleam bright as a full moon without clouds.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_546_1.text: Look at that twit babbling about something he doesn't know! This is a beautiful art I've devoted my life to!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_546_2.text: Hrrmph. I'll never understand why people get so excited over such trivial tricks.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_547_1.text: I almost fell asleep... Thank the heavens my mask was on.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_548_2.text: My father always told me, never trust people who don't reveal their eyes!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_549_1.text: Ohoho! Really? Maybe I should publish my special recipe - though I doubt anyone could ever properly follow it!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_549_2.text: Ooh, this is some neat stuff! I never thought to remodel a dessert into bullets!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_550_1.text: So it's true that Chen people eat anything and everything! You really find my tteok delicious?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_550_2.text: Ooh~ This is delicious! The texture is very unique...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_551_1.text: That tiger... I don't like admitting it, but to this day he's the only one who really liked my tteok.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_551_2.text: Haha, tteok are considered an irresistible delicacy by tigers. Or so a little bird told me up in the mountains.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_552_1.text: Hrrmph, the nerve of that tiger. If he ever returns, I'll make sure to fill up his no-good belly with all the tteok I can pelt at him!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_552_2.text: A talking tiger? And he disappeared after giving you a big present of mountain insam roots... Maybe he just wanted to be friends?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_553_1.text: Go home, you buffoon! How many times have I told you, you can't eat any more on credit?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_553_2.text: Kyah~ Now this is the stuff! One more bowl of gukbap here, Malsook!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_554_2.text: A taste of utter darkness, straight from the abyss... Huhu. This is to my liking.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_555_1.text: Look at you, dressed up in such finery! Seems you passed your exams with flying colors!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_555_2.text: Thank you for your wonderful cooking. Haha... It was one of the things I missed the most while studying for the gwageo examinations.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_556_1.text: That supposed to be a compliment, or what?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_556_2.text: Ooh! So these are the tteok that kills two with one bite! Thank you for helping me reap souls so easily, Tteok Mama!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_557_1.text: It's been a while, Master Wolfram... You are beautiful as ever...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_557_2.text: Loviatar... You too look your old self. Welcome back.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_558_1.text: You can be very cruel when you wish to be... But I know you are saying such things on purpose, Shasha...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_558_2.text: Huh? I thought you died of old age. You aren't her daughter, right?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_559_1.text: Oh, dear... Vesper, don't cry... Everything's alright now...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_559_2.text: Sob~ Loviatar! I missed you! You won't believe how much the others kept teasing me in your absence!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_560_1.text: I never thought you would call me 'Master'... Huhu, you must have read my journal... I always wanted to apologize... for the things I couldn't do...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_560_2.text: ... Master Loviatar. I... I wanted to say thank you... for saving my life.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_561_1.text: A true heart... Perhaps the Neth Empire has been waiting for you to cleanse it of its sins... I have great expectations for you...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_561_2.text: Yes. I shall do everything in my power to save the Empire... If only to continue his will.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_562_1.text: Oh, how romantic... If I had had a lover... I suppose I wouldn't have had to spend all these years in the Lab...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_562_3.text: If Lyudmilla ever gets into trouble, I would do anything to save her, too!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_563_1.text: Sigh... I cannot return to my homeland... For I have betrayed my father to succeed his throne: an unforgivable sin!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_563_2.text: You're worried about getting scolded if you return, right? I understand...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_564_1.text: A-a gigantic spider! Never have I seen such a disgusting monster!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_564_2.text: Hmm... First spiders, now moths. I guess moths are a lot more talkative than spiders.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_565_1.text: Ooh, finally a human worthy of my time! Are you the Empress of Roman?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_565_2.text: Oh, I am Athena - not an empress, but a mere low-ranking senator. Welcome to the Roman Republic, Lady Fairy.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_566_1.text: Aahh!! Is it really you, Lady Kriemhild?! I read about you in my book of human tales! I'm such a big fan, can I have your autograph??

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_567_1.text: Hrrmph, that puny human doesn't deserve the beautiful Lady Kriemhild!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_567_2.text: Why is that fairy glaring at me...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_568_1.text: Almael! That human says she'll take us to the Beast King!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_568_2.text: W-what? Erm, Your Highness... This book... Well, it says something quite different... about the Beast King...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_568_3.text: Wow, a Fairy Queen and a Fairy Knight...! This is so adorable...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_569_1.text: Come on, Almael! Let's go defeat the Beast King and free our people!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_569_2.text: Yes! Your wish is my command, Your Highness! I'll fight with my life!
