TEXT_RARE_3G_STONE_1_DESC.text: Tato Mineral Georgia yang berada di punggungnya. Bentuknya seperti sabit

TEXT_RARE_3G_STONE_2_DESC.text: Kaca Pembesar Gujarat yang dia gunakan untuk mengeker sasarannya. Sepertinya produk dari Kerajaan Neth

TEXT_RARE_AMMUT_STONE_1_DESC.text: Hmm, mungkinkah ini ayam? Atau rasanya lebih seperti daging babi?

TEXT_RARE_AMMUT_STONE_2_DESC.text: Legenda mengatakan bahwa sup yang dimasak dengan timbangan ini memberikan keabadian. Sayangnya, bau busuknya membuat orang kehilangan selera

TEXT_RARE_ANUBISIS_STONE_1_DESC.text: Terbuat dari kain terbaik dan dipergunakan oleh anggota kerajaan. Sangat nyaman dipergunakan

TEXT_RARE_ANUBISIS_STONE_2_DESC.text: Hiasan dada yang di hiasi oleh Lapiz Lazuli. Sepertinya ada penunggunya

TEXT_RARE_ATK_POWER_STONE_1_DESC.text: Meningkatkan Kekuatan Serang dari Senjata Soulbound

TEXT_RARE_BLOODHOUND_STONE_1_DESC.text: A small air conditioner found in Blood Hound’s coat. Especially useful if you’re equipped with a lot of overheating machines.

TEXT_RARE_BOUILLABAISSE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Inti dari mesin Bouillabaisse digunakan untuk meningkatkan kecepatan kekuatan

TEXT_RARE_CHANGGWI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A barrel cover with an animal-print that Changgwi decorated his gun with. It's actually made of cowhide, but it feels great.

TEXT_RARE_CODEVV_STONE_1_DESC.text: A heat tile made of mercury and unobtanium alloy, the latter of which leaks out of Rapture Science in small amounts. It dissipates heat so well that it even withstands V’s Slash attacks.

TEXT_RARE_CODEVV_STONE_2_DESC.text: Excellent head gear recovered from V’s old body frame. Recorded within are V-Berserk’s history data. Although the data consists of only unnecessary actions, it still seems to increase androids’ attack power when applied.

TEXT_RARE_CRIT_DODGE_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Meningkatkan Resistansi Kritikal dari Senjata Soulbound

TEXT_RARE_CRIT_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Meningkatkan Peluang Kritikal dari Senjata Soulbound

TEXT_RARE_DALGI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A hairpin made with poisonous wood. Turn the golden ornament to see the sharp end.

TEXT_RARE_DOMPERIGNON_STONE_1_DESC.text: Serpihan "kemanusiaan". Menggenggamnya ditanganmu memunculkan banyak emosi : kebahagiaan, rasa bersalah, kesedihan, keputusasaan, kemarahan, kematian …

TEXT_RARE_ENBYEONG_STONE_1_DESC.text: A poster scroll of Five Tiger General Hansheng and Shuwen discussing about strategies. It shows the artist's ulterior motive.

TEXT_RARE_EVE606_STONE_1_DESC.text: It may seem like ordinary wreckage, but it boasts tremendous durability and weight as it once constituted Galatea’s physical body.

TEXT_RARE_EVE606_STONE_2_DESC.text: The one eye of EVE-606, said to predict the future. It is actually a computing device equipped with a high-performance camera.

TEXT_RARE_FREYJA_STONE_1_DESC.text: Allegedly, this necklace is supposed to grant immense beauty to its wearer. But maybe it's just a rumor, and Freyja is exceedingly beautiful even without it? Or at least that's what the warriors of the Einherjar think, anyway.

TEXT_RARE_FREYJA_STONE_2_DESC.text: Rumored to be one of the secrets to Freyja's beauty, this golden essence is said to create flawless skin. Needless to say, it is coveted by countless people.

TEXT_RARE_GAPGWI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A lump of rock salt that Guard Captain Gapgwi carries for Ochu. It's absolutely needed for a cow's health.

TEXT_RARE_GENERALWINTER_STONE_1_DESC.text: If there is one thing General Winter is proud of, it's his beard: seemingly rough and coarse, but velvety soft upon touch. He took care of it quite diligently.

TEXT_RARE_GENERALWINTER_STONE_2_DESC.text: It may resemble an ordinary conch, but 'Ahh!' is actually the roar of General Winter frozen into physical form. If you put your ear to it, you can hear the echoing shouts and war-cries.

TEXT_RARE_GG_STONE_1_DESC.text: Batu pengendali yang Georg dan Geratl gunakan untuk mengatur level sinkronisasi mereka. Jumlah standarnya adalah 30%

TEXT_RARE_JANGPO_STONE_1_DESC.text: A poster scroll of Five Tiger General Hansheng when he was young. How handsome!

TEXT_RARE_JANGSANBEOUM_STONE_1_DESC.text: Jang San Beom's fluffy fur. It feels like a cloud, but it's heavier than expected.

TEXT_RARE_JERAPHIM_STONE_1_DESC.text: Sebuat alat yang dapat mengendalikan energi didalam kuil. Kehilangan kekuatannya saat dibawa keluar, dan menjadi seonggok batu keras

TEXT_RARE_JERAPHIM_STONE_2_DESC.text: Serpihan Halo Jeraphim. Bagaimana caramu memecahkan benda keras ini ?

TEXT_RARE_LEESIN_STONE_1_DESC.text: Penutup Mata Zatorat, yang dia pergunakans setela kehilangan penglihatannya karena kotornya selokan

TEXT_RARE_LEESIN_STONE_2_DESC.text: Barang milik Warrat yang mengajari semua pengetahuan yang dimiliki Zatorat. Benda itu membantunya untuk mengendalikan inderanya

TEXT_RARE_MATAHARI_STONE_1_DESC.text: Tanda yang dipegang oleh Matahari, diberikan oleh Musketeer Trista

TEXT_RARE_MAX_HP_STONE_1_DESC.text: Meningkatkan maksimum HP dari Senjata Soulbound

TEXT_RARE_NATI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A precious crystal of Ishimi. It was thought to be a dragon ball, but it was just a gallstone.

TEXT_RARE_OMEGA_STONE_1_DESC.text: Mata kristal yang melekat pada topeng Subyek Peneltian Omega. Mempunyai kemampuan melihat tembus pandang

TEXT_RARE_OMEGA_STONE_2_DESC.text: Sebuah organ indera keenam yang ditransplantasikan melalui operasi. Membuat seseorang dapat melihat yang tidak dapat dilihat sebelumnya

TEXT_RARE_PANDEMONIUM_STONE_1_DESC.text: Pandemonium’s mighty claw. On the inside are engraved an ornate pattern and the words “Developed by the greatest genius scientist Gunther, who threatens the power of the Goddesses themselves."

TEXT_RARE_PANDEMONIUM_STONE_2_DESC.text: Pandemonium’s left arm component. Open it to see the words “I am now death, the destroyer of the world.”

TEXT_RARE_PENETRATE_DEF_STONE_1_DESC.text: Meningkatkan Penetrasi Armor dari Senjata Soulbound

TEXT_RARE_PENETRATE_RST_STONE_1_DESC.text: Meningkatkan Penetrasi Sihir dari Senjata Soulbound

TEXT_RARE_QIONGQI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A claw of Qiongqi, one of the four evils. Good-hearted people will face a misfortune if they get close to this claw.

TEXT_RARE_RAVENLEADERRAN_STONE_1_DESC.text: Anxious about being the only white-haired assassin in the Night Ravens, Ran has been secretly using hair dye to fit in with the rest of her troop. Recently she has given it up after discovering the excessive damage done to her hair.

TEXT_RARE_RAVENLEADERRAN_STONE_2_DESC.text: The white mask worn by Captain Ran. Rumor has it that she was rescued by a passing 'evil spirit' and afterwards vowed to wear this mask to honor him.

TEXT_RARE_RECEIVE_DMG_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Meningkatkan tingkat pengurangan kerusakan dari Senjata Soulbound

TEXT_RARE_RI_DELTASQUAD_STONE_1_DESC.text: The official equipment of Road Industry’s private troops. As the soldiers often face wizards in battle, it has high resistance to magic but is ironically more vulnerable to bullets.

TEXT_RARE_RSFLAMETANK_STONE_1_DESC.text: A fragment of a Rapture Science Upgraded Flame Tank’s gun barrel. It is composed of a special alloy made to withstand the flames of synthetic spirits.

TEXT_RARE_SEKHMET_STONE_1_DESC.text: Intisari dari api kekuatan Sekhmet. Menyala terang namun masih dapat disentuh

TEXT_RARE_SEKHMET_STONE_2_DESC.text: Serpihan dari tanduk hiasan kepala yang dipergunakan oleh Ratu di medan perang. Dapat menaikkan moral

TEXT_RARE_SET_DEFFENCE_STONE_1_DESC.text:
Cairan yang ditemukan mengalir melalui sendi Narmer. 
Bersinar secara teratur

TEXT_RARE_SET_DEFFENCE_STONE_2_DESC.text:
Sebuah batu melayang yang kuno. Masih dapat mengapung
walaupun rendah

TEXT_RARE_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_1_DESC.text: Don't let its simple appearance fool you - this material is essential to the mobility of the armor.

TEXT_RARE_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_2_DESC.text: The blue blood spilt by the Incarnate. It is of a strange color and texture, almost as if intangible.

TEXT_RARE_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_3_DESC.text: One of the many steel plates that fell from Bjorn's shield. Arraying it into layers provides protection that no weapon can penetrate.

TEXT_RARE_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_4_DESC.text: A fragment of armor weathered by the harsh winds that ravished the northern lands long ago.

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP1_HEAL_1_DESC.text:
Memulihkan HP rekan tim sebesar 1000 per detik. 
(Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk.)

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP1_HEAL_2_DESC.text:
Meningkatkan armor dan resistensi seluruh tim 
sebesar 150. (Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk.)

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP1_MAGIC_1_DESC.text:
Meningkatkan penetrasi resistensi pemakainya oleh 500 
dan kerusakan kritis sebesar 15%.

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP1_MAGIC_2_DESC.text:
Meningkatkan kekuatan serangan pemakai sebesar 300 
dan penetrasi resistensi sebesar 500.

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP1_PHYSIC_1_DESC.text:
Meningkatkan penetrasi armor pemakai sebesar 500 
dan kerusakan kritis sebesar 15%.

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP1_PHYSIC_2_DESC.text:
Meningkatkan kekuatan serangan pemakai sebesar 300 
dan penetrasi armor sebesar 500.

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP2_MAGIC_2_DESC.text:
Upon using 1-chain, accuracy is increased by 15 for 1 second
Upon using 3-chain, resistance penetration is increased by 1625 for 1 second

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP2_PHYSIC_2_DESC.text:
Upon using 1-chain, accuracy is increased by 15 for 1 second
Upon using 3-chain, armor penetration is increased by 1625 for 1 second

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP3_AIR_1_DESC.text: Upon using own 3-chain, knocks all enemies into the air. (Cooltime: 10 seconds)

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP3_AIR_2_DESC.text: Upon using own 3-chain, knocks all enemies into the air. (Cooltime: 10 seconds)

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP4_MAGIC_1_NAME.text: Shining Intuition of the Ancient God

TEXT_RARE_SET_EP4_PHYSIC_1_NAME.text: Shining Fragment of the Ancient God

TEXT_RARE_SET_HEAL_STONE_1_DESC.text:
Mesin ditemukan di inti Khasekhemwy. 
Cahaya di pusatnya tidak bisa padam.

TEXT_RARE_SET_HEAL_STONE_2_DESC.text:
Mahkota dari kepala Banoub. Sudah retak namun 
keindahannya masih terlihat

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAGIC_STONE_1_DESC.text:
Sebuah pecahan yang memancarkan sinar biru. Jika 
kamu memegannya dapat membuatmu merasa tenang

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAGIC_STONE_2_DESC.text:
Pisau yang ditemukan di dalam ekor Narmer. 
Sebaiknya kamu tidak membawanya kemana-mana

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_AIR_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: Durable cable used to hold incomplete Battleloids' frames in place. The cable is made of technology as advanced as that used in constructing the main robot.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_ATK_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A handmade Night Witch badge, with the words 'Loviatar, Night Witch Third Division' sewn in the back.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_ATK_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: The ribs of a luminous moray that inhabits the deep waters of the mystical sea. They are of extraordinary hardness and, in the hands of an excellent swordsman, will serve as a valuable weapon against enemies from other dimensions.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_ATK_EP4_STONE_2_DESC.text: A jewel carrying a part of the consciousness of the 'Deepest Abyss,' as used when they imitated Habaek's dream. Hold it and fragmented memories of another dimension will flow into your mind.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_DEF_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A mask once known throughout the continent as the feared face of an Apostle. Sometimes its eyes will light up for seemingly no reason at all...

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_DEF_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A torn piece of a robe that belonged to a king whose name cannot be mentioned. On the back the reason for his notoriety is written: 'You must not call his name. The king of yellow will come and destroy your kingdom. The last of a doomed land leave this final warning to you.'

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_EP2_STONE_1_DESC.text: A block of ice that cracked off Logi's body. It coldly burns with a blue flame.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_EP2_STONE_2_DESC.text: A fragment of Bjorn's broken hammer. Its unimpressive size hides its massive weight.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_SP_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: Moss that can be found growing on the metal coverings of Battleloids. Containing great quantities of pure mana, it is a valuable research material.

TEXT_RARE_SET_MAG_SP_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A mysterious powder that allows one to see things that usually go unseen. Those who use it report sightings of terrible creatures that continue to exert their influence in nightmares.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHYSIC_STONE_1_DESC.text:
Sebuah pecahan yang memancarkan sinar merah. Dapat
membuatmu gelisah

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHYSIC_STONE_2_DESC.text:
Pecahan batu yang dulunya merupakan bagian dari 
Khasekhemwy. Anda bisa merasakan kekuatan misterius 
di dalamnya.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_AIR_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A cylinder alloy specially built to withstand the power of Battleloids that have been upgraded with all kinds of magical engineering weapons.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_ATK_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: One of the power sources that fuel Battleloid ST006. Turning the crank will generate power at surprisingly efficient rates.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_ATK_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: The mucus exuded by an otherworldly creature crawling the lowest floors of the deep sea. It refuses to dry or adhere to anything, almost as if it cannot mix with anything of this world.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_ATK_EP4_STONE_2_DESC.text: The fragment of an extremely durable glass mirror that used to serve as the door between worlds, but was destroyed by the power of light.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_DEF_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A voice changer tuned to the voice of the Apostle Nemesis. If you turn off the settings, it will instead play the voice of a lonely old man.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_DEF_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A stone on which the Deros, the residents of 'Lemuria,' carved their likenesses. Their ghoulish faces may resemble that of a vile serpent, but one can discern traces of delicate intelligence.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_EP2_STONE_1_DESC.text: A transparent blade almost wholly enveloped in ice. Could it be changing shape?

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_EP2_STONE_2_DESC.text: A blue mane that shines with a transparent light, as if it were made out of ice. It is tougher than it looks.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_SP_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A chipset made with magic engineering technology. It boasts of a conductivity rate of 100%.

TEXT_RARE_SET_PHY_SP_EP4_STONE_2_DESC.text: A flask imprisoning an intelligent creature captured by a forgotten ancient race. Even after the fall of the ancient civilization, the creature is said to have survived and continues to suffer today.

TEXT_RARE_SHADOWDEVILFINAL_STONE_1_DESC.text: Inti dari tenaga yang dimiliki oleh  Hibrid Tipe Bayangan Iblis

TEXT_RARE_SHADOWDEVILFINAL_STONE_2_DESC.text: Dekoras Kepala yang menciut yang dimiliki oleh Kelompok Bayangan Mawar

TEXT_RARE_SHADOWDEVILFINAL_STONE_3_DESC.text: Sebuah serpihan bayangan yang mengeras, Jika tidak dengan baik menanganinya dia berusaha mengamil alih tubuh pemiliknya

TEXT_RARE_SKIRIMIR_STONE_1_DESC.text: An icy cold yet surprisingly soft paw obtained from Skrymir's footprint.

TEXT_RARE_SKIRIMIR_STONE_2_DESC.text: A leg bone that Skrymir picked up before he completely faded away. It is made of pure ice.

TEXT_RARE_SVENJA_STONE_1_DESC.text: The pointy fangs of the smaller Warhound models. Svenja cleans them herself before every battle campaign.

TEXT_RARE_SWORDEN_STONE_1_DESC.text: Black sesame rice cake that has an unbelievable smell and is rock solid.

TEXT_RARE_TAOIST_STONE_1_DESC.text: A copy of a forbidden spell that the imperial Taoist copied from a scroll of magic. It's encoded so it cannot be read, but it's ominous.

TEXT_RARE_THIALFI_STONE_1_DESC.text: SIGYN was the most popular brand of running shoes in Ancient Nosgard. This pair had been carefully packaged, as if meant to have been given as a gift.

TEXT_RARE_THIALFI_STONE_2_DESC.text: A token bestowed upon Thjalfi by Ancient Nosgardians as acknowledgement of his extraordinary speed. It becomes translucent at certain angles.

TEXT_RARE_TOMBKING_STONE_1_DESC.text: Sepotong kain dicelup dalam pewarna yang disediakan hanya untuk anggota kerajaan Gurun. Mungkin cuma tiruan, tapi setidaknya tahan lama.

TEXT_RARE_TOMBKING_STONE_2_DESC.text: Dekorasi Uraeus yang dibuat dari kayu.

TEXT_RARE_TRUEGULLVEIG_STONE_1_DESC.text: Elaborate lies deceive even those who are lying. But truths get in the way and remain as weights in the conscious.

TEXT_RARE_TYRANT_STONE_1_DESC.text: A durable bundle of artificial muscles modeled after Galatea’s physical body. It bestows the user with superhuman power, but it will quickly shrivel up if not infused with energy through its tube.

TEXT_RARE_TYRANT_STONE_2_DESC.text: It seems like mere tattered leather, but due to the various drugs saturating the material, it cannot be stretched or folded.

TEXT_RARE_VAJRAPANI_STONE_1_DESC.text: Deva King's eyebrow. It looks shiny, but it's just plated.

TEXT_RARE_VALKYRIESTONESTATUS_STONE_1_DE.text: The letter of a powerful lord who, long ago, divided Nosgard into two and fought to dominate both halves. Yet its recipient also received the fury of the king.

TEXT_RARE_VALKYRIESTONESTATUS_STONE_2_DE.text: Only this fragment remains of the sword of a fabled warrior who knew no defeat. Legend has it that fate, in the form of a one-eyed man, came and finally broke the undefeated blade.

TEXT_REACH_6GRADE_MAXLV_POPUP_DESC.text:
Pahlawan pendukung bintang-3 telah dikirim ke kotak 
surat

Your ticket will remain spent.

Restart anyway?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_1_1_2.text: Baby, baby, baby, oh~ I'm only yours~ Your one and only chocolate gentleman~

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_1_2_1_1.text: ... Do you even know what a Music Festival is?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_1_2_1_2.text: It's on, Caroline! But how do we decide the winner? By volume?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_1_2_2.text: Wow, someone clearly hasn't gotten over her emo phase. Seeing this was worth the long walk.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_1_2_2_2.text: Do you fear the rapid evolution of the android race? Soon humanity will become obsolete, and what is obsolete must be eradicated... Oh, I was simply making a 'joke.'

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_1_1.text: Come on, the only song you manage to sing is the national anthem.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_1_2.text: Can you feel the difference? Uncle always did tell me I have a powerful voice.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_2_1.text: So what? Want me to stick a gold star on your armor?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_2_1_1.text: I've heard you sing at office parties. Your entire repertoire consists of military music. How did you ever pass the preliminary rounds?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_2_1_2.text: Huh, but Commander Spyro said my singing was cute!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_2_2.text: Ahem, I too sang in the choir before I received my knighthood.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_2_2_1.text: Judging from that grin on your face, I'd say you're enjoying this much more than you let on.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_2_2_2_2.text: Well~ I originally wasn't planning on entering, but Spiny kept begging me to...

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_3_2_1.text: So, are you a wolf or a hyena? You can't be both.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_3_2_1_1.text: Yuria... How unexpected of you. I never knew you wanted to become a popstar.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_3_2_1_2.text: T-the same goes for you! Stop looking at me like that!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_3_2_2.text: Yeah, I'm the lone wolf of Pumpkin City! A hyena who hunts for the beat, YO!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_3_2_2_1.text: I can't believe I'm performing with THE legendary popstar, Cano - at the Hasla Music Festival, no less!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_3_2_2_2.text: Let's do our best to perform a never-before-seen show!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_4_1_2.text: Through music... my soul is reborn from the ashes...

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_4_2_1.text: Weren't you on the phone with your wife back there?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_4_2_1_1.text: Levine... I've changed for the better. And I'm sure you can, too.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_4_2_1_2.text: Grr... Have you forgotten that this was your plan from the beginning, not mine? What's wrong with you?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_4_2_2.text: I hail from the ancient lands of Nosgard. The god of music himself has led me forth.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_4_2_2_1.text: The world is beautiful, full of love and hope!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_4_2_2_2.text: This confirms my suspicions that those strange weeds growing around the Hero Town farm are much more than what meets the eye.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_1_1.text: Cano... I dedicate my debut to you!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_1_2.text: Let's make this the best show ever - together!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_2_1.text: I don't believe it... I'm speaking to THE Cano, the legendary pop star...

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_2_1_1.text: I refuse to follow your orders any longer. I reclaim my freedom!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_2_1_2.text: Why are you doing this? Your employee welfare benefits were better than anyone else's; your paychecks were always on time!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_2_2.text: We're the same age, aren't we? Let's be friends!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_2_2_1.text: ... I saw it with my own eyes. The terrible icon that stood in the chambers of every Hero, drowning out all other sounds with its terrible song...

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_5_2_2_2.text: What horrors have the humans of this world suffered to survive the fatal melodies of D-CAT?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_END_1_1.text: I... I won...? I beat Cano...?

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_END_2_1.text: I won! End of Round Three!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_END_2_1_1.text: What was that? On second thought, I don't think I want to know.

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_END_2_1_2.text: We won! We're the winners of the 4th Hasla Music Festival!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_END_3_1.text: Okay, tour starts now! You're going to tag along, right? Here, catch!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_START_2_1_1.text: Even if I'm a substitute, we still can try our best to win the competition!

TEXT_RHYTHM_LEVEL_START_2_1_2.text: ... So this is Hasla Music Festival...

TEXT_RYU_BOTTOM_BASKET_01_DESC.text: A bucket used to scoop up hot water and rinse one's body. Necessary equipment for any serious bather!

TEXT_RYU_BOTTOM_CAT_01_DESC.text: A raccoon dog statue that greets patrons as they enter the baths.

TEXT_RYU_BOTTOM_CAT_02_DESC.text: A cat statue that thanks patrons as they leave the baths.

TEXT_RYU_BOTTOM_FENCE_01_DESC.text: It's evident that people of Ryu prefer their baths well-furnished.

TEXT_RYU_BOTTOM_LIGHT_01_DESC.text: A beautiful wooden lantern that amplifies the tranquil ambiance of the hot springs.

TEXT_RYU_BOTTOM_MONKEY_01_DESC.text: This macaque knows the good things in life.

TEXT_RYU_BOTTOM_SAKE_01_DESC.text: A traditional drink of Ryu that can't be drunk by children.

TEXT_RYU_BOTTOM_SPAGATE_01_DESC.text: The Eastern Kingdom of Ryu is famous for their natural hot springs. Heroes wearied by battle will gladly enter these gates for a chance to clean both their body and soul.

TEXT_RYU_BOTTOM_SPA_01_DESC.text: After many rounds of Challenges, why don't you treat yourself to a nice and relaxing bath at the hot springs?

TEXT_RYU_BOTTOM_SPA_02_DESC.text: The perfect way to unwind after a long day battling at the Raids.

TEXT_RYU_BOTTOM_SPA_03_DESC.text: A soak in this hot spring bath will surely loosen up all those tense muscles from the Colosseum.

TEXT_RYU_BOTTOM_TREE_01_DESC.text: On a closer look, you can see that the flowering tree is actually crafted out of paper, as the heat and humidity of the hot springs create a harsh environment for actual flora.

TEXT_RYU_CENTER_FISH_01_DESC.text: A koi-shaped flag that seems to swim with the wind.

TEXT_RYU_CENTER_FISH_02_DESC.text: A koi-shaped flag that seems to swim with the wind.

TEXT_RYU_CENTER_LAMP_01_DESC.text: The symbolic signboard of the hot spring baths. It lures in visitors with its mellow light.

TEXT_RYU_CENTER_STATUE_01_DESC.text: Many patrons pray to this traditional statue that is commonly found in the hot spring baths of Ryu, thanking it for the recovered purity of their body and soul.

TEXT_RYU_CENTER_WINDOW_01_DESC.text: These bamboo shades let in only the gentlest of light to create a relaxing atmosphere.

TEXT_S1_GROUP3_DESC.text: Persekutuan Batu Jiwa menerima kabat dari Kerajaan bahwa ada monster di daerah utara. Sebulan setelah mengirimkan pengintai, mereka kemudian memutuskan untuk menuju utara untuk mengetahui lebih lanjut mengenai masalah ini

TEXT_S1_GROUP4_DESC.text: Persekutuan ini harus menuju utara untuk mengalahkan robot yang terus menerus melakukan teror

TEXT_S1_GROUP5_DESC.text: Setelah kejadian di utara, Prestina dan teman-temanya menikmati waktu liburannya dengan meneliti Batu Jiwa. Kedamaian telah pecah, namun mereka mendengar kabar mengejutkan dari pedagang dari desa, bahwa kerajaan Neth mendeklarasikan perang dan tentara mereka mendekati desa

TEXT_S1_GROUP6_DESC.text: Aliansi, setelah mendengar sisa dari pasukan Neth masih berada didalam kota, mengumpulkan kekuatan dari seluruh Grancia untuk mengalahkan mereka, ketika Lednas pergi ke Edenburgm Chronos menyarankan persekutuan untuk membantu pertempuran

TEXT_S1_GROUP7_DESC.text: Semuanya adalah kebohongan. Para dewi tidak memenangkan perang melawan sang utusan seratus tahun yang lalu karena Destalos, sang utusan terakhir telah menunggu di kegelapan selama ini. Sylunis juga telah bangkit dari kegelapan diikuti oleh pasukan kuat. Persekuturan harus memulihkan kekuatan cahaya dan menyelamatkan dunia sebelum semuanya jatuh ke dalam kegelapan

TEXT_S1_GROUP8_DESC.text: Pada hari damai sebelum perang, Sylunis mengingat kenangan terakhir dari pertempurannya. Dia bertanya-tanya kenapa Elanuma menyelamatkan dia dari kegelapan dan bersumpah akan mencarinya untuk mencari jawaban. Sementara itu kegelapan masih berada di kota suci walaupun El Thalnos telah dikalahkan, Sylunis menyarankan untuk membuat perisai disekeliling kota untuk mencegah bayangan melarikan diri

TEXT_S2_EP4_WB_WORLDRULE_DESC.text: Atk Decrease, Armor Increase, Goddess Blocked

TEXT_S2_GROUP1_DESC.text: Tiga tahun berlalu setelah pertempuran terakhir melawan sang utusan. Setelah mengurung El Thalnos dan Batu Jiwa di lubang dimensi, umat manusia dengan pelan memulihkan luka perang dan berusaha memulihkan kembali kedamaian. Tugas dari Elard telah selesai dan memutuskan untuk pergi. Semua menyelamatkan Prestina yang menunggu Sera pulang. Namun tidak ada kabar dari Sera selama 3 tahun, Prestina dan teman-temannya memutuskan untuk menerima tawaran dari Kaisar Alexander dan pindah ke ibukota Grancia

TEXT_S2_GROUP2_DESC.text: Para penjaga reruntuhan adalah lawan yang kuat. Untuk merawat luka-luka mereka, kapten dan kelompoknya kembali ke Impelis, dimana mereka menerima surat darurat dari Lorereil . Kapten dan Ellie memutuskan untuk menerima permintaan dari sang arkelog untuk melakukan eksplorasi Kuil Ilusi misterius untuk menyingkap sejarah gelapnya

TEXT_S2_GROUP3_DESC.text: Loki, his true form revealed, is barely captured and sealed back into the Seal of the Sanctuary by the Captain and company. Yet they cannot stop the storm of destruction from ravaging the kingdom, as it did hundreds of years ago. Under the advice of the Goddess Dionne, the Captain hastily departs for Snorri Edda, the capital of Nosgard, to save its people from the ancient chaos.

TEXT_S2_GROUP3_TITLE.text: A Myth of Ice and Snow

TEXT_S2_GROUP4_DESC.text: Having fled to safety from the Laboratories of Rapture Science, Captain and company turn to their unexpected accomplice: Benjamin, the Chief Office Researcher of Rapture Science himself. Benjamin reveals that someone from the House of Nobles is orchestrating the inhumane experiments of magical engineering, and they must be stopped at all costs. The trail seems to lead to Road Industry Headquarters...

TEXT_S2_GROUP5_DESC.text: The master of the Mysterious Sea, Habaek, is unable to awaken due to the weakened veins. The Oracle of Water, Haerang, and our Heroes are headed to Han of the Three Eastern Countries in order to meet the patron saints who control the energy of the mountains and find the culprit behind the weakening of the veins and find a way to awaken Habaek.

TEXT_SHOP_SUBSCRIBE_BUY_INFO_DESC.text:
This package is a Subscription product and can be purchased with other Subscriptions.

It will be automatically renewed every month on the date of the purchase until you choose to cancel your Subscription. If you decide to cancel your Subscription, all items of the purchased package will stay in effect until the next billing date.

If you want to cancel your Subscription, please do so at least 24 hours before your next billing date to prevent automatic renewal of the Subscription.

You can undo your cancellation by restoring your Subscription. Please note that you must do so before the next billing date.

Captains who continue their Subscription for 3 / 6 / 12 consecutive months will receive a Loyalty Bonus with the original contents of the package.

Please note that your Subscription information can be lost if the automatic renewal process fails.

Unused contents of the package can be returned within 7 days of purchase.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_FENRIR_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using another ally's block, Fenrir pulls in the enemy with the highest HP. (Cooltime: 5 seconds) If Fenrir uses her own block within 3 seconds of using an ally's block, she leaves a 'Wolf's Mark' on the nearest enemy for 5 seconds. 'Wolf's Mark' decreases armor and resistance by 30% and prevents enemy buffs. If Fenrir used a 3-chain to leave her 'Wolf's Mark,' she enters the 'Day of Sol' phase.
 
 'Day of Sol' (Duration: 10 seconds)
 While 'Sol' is in the sky, Fenrir's armor and resistance are increased by 50%. Upon using her own block, Fenrir receives all damage targeted at the entire team for 4 seconds. If pressing her block at the moment 'Sol' shines, her evasion is increased by 15 for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_FENRIR_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using another ally's block, Fenrir pulls in the enemy with the highest HP. (Cooltime: 5 seconds) If Fenrir uses her own block within 3 seconds of using an ally's block, she leaves a 'Wolf's Mark' on the nearest enemy for 5 seconds. 'Wolf's Mark' decreases armor and resistance by 50% and prevents enemy buffs.
 
 If Fenrir used a 1- or 2-chain to leave her 'Wolf's Mark,' she enters the 'Day of Sol' phase; if she used a 3-chain, she enters the 'Night of Mani' phase. Each phase cannot be changed for the other until it ends.
 
 'Night of Mani' (Duration: 10 seconds)
 While 'Mani' is in the sky, Fenrir's resistance is decreased to 0, while her armor is increased by 300. Upon using her own block, Fenrir scratches the frontmost enemy with her claws to deal #physical damage# equal to [100/200/400]% of her attack power; if the hit enemy is marked by 'Wolf's Mark,' Fenrir deals additional #physical damage# equal to [160/320/640]% of her attack power. If pressing her block at the moment 'Mani' shines, her critical chance is increased by 30% for 6 seconds, and the duration of the phase is increased by 6 seconds. When 'Night of Mani' ends, Fenrir is stunned for 2 seconds.
 
 'Day of Sol' (Duration: 10 seconds)
 While 'Sol' is in the sky, Fenrir's armor and resistance are increased by 100%. Upon using her own block, Fenrir receives all damage targeted at the entire team for 4 seconds. If pressing her block at the moment 'Sol' shines, her evasion is increased by 30 for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SUSANOO_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using 'Sword Shot,' Susanoo's auto attack is changed to 'Downward Strike' for 7 seconds. 'Downward Strike' deals #physical damage# equal to 200% of Susanoo's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SUSANOO_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using 'Sword Shot,' Susanoo's auto attack is changed to 'Downward Strike' for 7 seconds. 'Downward Strike' deals #physical damage# equal to 200% of Susanoo's attack power.
Additionally, Susanoo becomes immune for 5 hits from all types of damage for 5 seconds. (Cooltime: 7 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SWORDWAVE2_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using 2 ally leader blocks, the Hero activates 'Extreme Wind Blade.' (Cooltime: 2 seconds)
Extreme Wind Blade: The Hero deals #physical damage# equal to 1000% of their attack power and decreases hit enemies' SP by 10. This attack ignores all enemy effects that take damage in place of others.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SWORDWAVE2_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using 3 ally leader blocks, the Hero activates 'Extreme Wind Blade' and increases their own armor penetration by 50% of their attack power for 3 seconds. (Cooltime: 2 seconds)
Extreme Wind Blade: The Hero deals #physical damage# equal to 2000% of their attack power and decreases hit enemies' SP by 20. This attack ignores all enemy effects that take damage in place of others.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_TWILLY_DESC.text:
Twillie uses [Shield of Glory / Fortress of Victory / Strike of Faith] according to the chain number pressed.
 Shield of Glory: Twillie's armor is increased by 400. (Maximum 4000)
 Fortress of Victory: Twillie's resistance is increased by 400. (Maximum 4000)
 Strike of Faith: Twillie impales her greatsword to deal #physical damage# equal to 2000% of her attack power.
 After 'Strike of Faith,' Twillie lunges forward and uses 'Earth Divider' to deal #physical damage# equal to 600% of her attack power per hit.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_TWILLY_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Activating 'Earth Divider' will change Twillie's block skills to [Enhanced Leg / Enhanced Blade / Last Stand], according to the chain number pressed.
 Enhanced Leg: Twillie's speed is increased by 25%. (Maximum 5 stacks)
 Enhanced Blade: Twillie deals 12% more damage. (Maximum 5 stacks)
 Last Stand: Twillie thrusts her greatsword to deal #physical damage# equal to 700% of her attack power. All block skill effects are reset with this attack. After 15 seconds, Twillie uses her 3-chain.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_TWILLY_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Activating 'Earth Divider' will change Twillie's block skills to [Enhanced Leg / Enhanced Blade / Last Stand], according to the chain number pressed.
 Enhanced Leg: Twillie's speed is increased by 25%. (Maximum 5 stacks)
 Enhanced Blade: Twillie deals 12% more damage. (Maximum 5 stacks)
 Last Stand: Twillie thrusts her greatsword to deal #physical damage# equal to 4800% of her attack power. All block skill effects are reset with this attack. After 15 seconds, Twillie uses her 3-chain.
 Activating 'Earth Shaker' will grant Twillie immunity to all debuffs. Upon using another ally's 3-chain, Twillie will recover HP equal to 200% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_VICTORY_RUSH_DESC.text: Memberi #Dmg Fisik# senilai [150/235/442]% dari Atk sesuai dengan jumlah chain.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_VICTORY_RUSH_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Bandera Kemenangan akan terpancang di barisan depan kawan selama 7 detik jika skill blok dipakai (Sekali dalam 10 detik). Kawan yang terpengaruh oleh Bandera Kememangan mengabaikan kerusakan senilai 50% dari Defens Victoria.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WATER_SWORD_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Saat menggunakan skill bloknya, Koxinga meningkatkan hindaran seluruh rekan tim sebesar 40 dan menurunkan akurasi musuh sebesar 40 selama 5 detik. Jika dia sukses menghindari serangan selama Koxinga memanggil Sea Dragon yang memberikan @kerusakan sihir@ setara dengan 35% dari maksimal Hpnya ( Diaktifkan setiap 1 detik ) Menghindari 2 serangan akan memanggil Sea Dragon kedua (Aktif setiap 1 detik)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WILD_NATURE_DESC.text: The Hero rapidly brandishes their sword to deal #physical damage# equal to [150/300/450]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WILD_NATURE_LV2_SUBDESC.text: With every 3 attacks that are not Special Skills, the Hero uses 'Double Slash' to deal 2 hits of #physical damage# equal to 500% of their attack power. Upon using their 3-chain, the Hero increases their attack speed by 40% for 5 seconds. (Duration renewed with reuse)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WILD_NATURE_LV3_SUBDESC.text: With every 3 attacks that are not Special Skills, the Hero uses 'Double Slash' to deal 2 hits of #physical damage# equal to 1000% of their attack power. Upon using their 3-chain, the Hero increases their attack speed by 80% for 7 seconds, and all of their attacks except Special Skills deal additional $neutral damage$ equal to 250% of the Hero's attack power for 7 seconds. (Duration renewed with reuse)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WIND_CLEAVE_LV3_DESC.text: Memberi #Dmg Fisik# sebanyak 396% dari Atk kepada musuh dengan menyerang 3 kali dengan cepat dan menarik musuh.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WIND_CLEAVE_LV4_DESC.text: Memberi #Dmg Fisik# sebanyak 504% dari Atk kepada musuh dengan menyerang 3 kali dengan cepat dan menarik musuh.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WIND_CLEAVE_LV5_DESC.text: Memberi #Dmg Fisik# sebanyak 798% dari Atk kepada musuh dengan menyerang 3 kali dengan cepat dan menarik musuh.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_ADOL_DESC.text: Adol menerjang musuh dan memberikan #kerusakan fisik# setara 100% dari kekuatan serangnya [1/2/3] kali sesuai dengan jumlah rangkaian yang dipergunakan.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_ADOL_LV2_SUBDESC.text: If Adol's block is pressed immediately before being hit, he activates 'Flash Guard' that increases his critical chance by 10% and decreases the damage he receives by 20% for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_ADOL_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
If Adol's block is pressed immediately before being hit, he activates 'Flash Guard' that increases his critical chance by 10% and decreases the damage he receives by 20% for 3 seconds.
 Upon using 'Flash Guard' or 'Sonic Slide' 3 times, Adol enhances his 'Sonic Slide' to 'Force Edge' for 5 seconds. 'Force Edge' deals #physical damage# equal to 200% of Adol's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_DANA_DESC.text: Dana mengayunkan Pedang Bulan Sabitnya untuk memberikan @kerusakan sihir@ setara [100/200/300]% dari kekuatan serangnya

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_DANA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: If Dana's block is pressed immediately before being hit, she activates 'Flash Move' that increases her motion speed by 10% and decreases the damage she receives by 20% for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_DANA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
If Dana's block is pressed immediately before being hit, she activates 'Flash Move' that increases her motion speed by 10% and decreases the damage she receives by 20% for 3 seconds. Additionally, she activates 'Dragon Spirit.'
 Dragon Spirit (Cooltime: 3 seconds. Cannot be canceled.)
 For 15 seconds, Dana becomes resistant to knockbacks, and her attack power and resistance penetration are increased by 400. During this effect, she uses [Mistrel Blow / Twin Moon Blade / Spiel Round Steps] according to the chain number she uses.
 Mistrel Blow: Dana spins as smoothly as the wind to deal @magical damage@ equal to 400% of her attack power.
 Twin Moon Blade: Dana flashes her crescent moon blades to deal @magical damage@ equal to 600% of her attack power.
 Spiel Round Steps: Dana gracefully dances around the enemy to deal @magical damage@ equal to 1800% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_LAXIA_DESC.text: Laxia dengan cepat menyerang musuhnya sebanyak [2/4/6] kali, memberikan #kerusakan fisik# setara 50% dari kekuatan serangnya setiap kali

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_LAXIA_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
If Laxia's block is pressed immediately before being hit, she activates 'Flash Move' that increases her motion speed by 10% and decreases the damage she receives by 20% for 3 seconds.
 After using 'Flash Move,' Laxia additionally uses 'Break Needle' that deals $neutral damage$ equal to 100% of her attack power and stuns the frontmost enemy for 1 second. (Cooltime: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_LAXIA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
If Laxia's block is pressed immediately before being hit, she activates 'Flash Move' that increases her motion speed by 10% and decreases the damage she receives by 20% for 3 seconds.
 After using 'Flash Move,' Laxia additionally uses 'Break Needle' that deals $neutral damage$ equal to 100% of her attack power and stuns the frontmost enemy for 1.5 seconds. (Cooltime: 2 seconds)
 The block skill Laxia uses immediately after 'Break Needle' is changed to 'Blitz Charge,' through which Laxia charges forward with her blade and deals #physical damage# equal to 400% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANESIDORA_DESC.text: Anesidora shoots gravity spheres to deal @magical damage@ equal to [120/230/350]% of her attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANESIDORA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using her chain 2 times, Anesidora generates a 'Graviton Rift' that lasts 3 seconds and deals @magical damage@ equal to 15% of her attack power and #physical damage# equal to 25% of her attack power every 0.2 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANESIDORA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using her chain 2 times, Anesidora generates a 'Graviton Rift' that lasts 3 seconds and deals @magical damage@ equal to 15% of her attack power and #physical damage# equal to 25% of her attack power every 0.2 seconds. Additionally, her armor penetration increases by 100% of her resistance penetration and her resistance penetration increases by 100% of her armor penetration upon entering the stage. This effect does not activate as a buff and thus cannot be canceled.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANNA_DESC.text: Ana menggunakan telekinesis untuk menembakkan senjatanya, memberikan #kerusakan fisik# setara dengan [120/240/400]% kekuatan serangannya. Dia juga masuk ke mode 'Firearm Control' selama [3/4/5] detik, dengan akurasinya meningkat sebesar 20.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANNA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Dalam mode 'Firearm Control', Ana menggunakan 'Honor Guard's Musket' untuk memberikan #kerusakan fisik # setara dengan 300% kekuatan serangannya per 1,5 detik. Jika dia menggunakan bloknya sendiri selama ini, durasi 'Firearm Control' meningkat 2 detik.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANNA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Dalam mode 'Firearm Control', Ana menggunakan 'Honor Guard's Musket' untuk memberikan #kerusakan physical # sebesar 300% dari kekuatan serangannya per 1,5 detik. Jika dia menggunakan bloknya sendiri selama waktu ini, 'Firearm Control' diperkuat menjadi 'Enhanced Firearm Control.' Selain itu, durasi mode ini meningkat 2 detik. Selama 'Enhanced Firearm Control,' Ana menggunakan 'Honor Guard's Musket' untuk memberikan # kerusakan fisik # setara dengan 540% kekuatan serangannya per 1,5 detik.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANZU_DESC.text: Anzu casts ginkgo leaves at the enemy to deal @magical damage@ equal to [100/200/300]% of her attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANZU_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Every time she uses her block skill, Anzu casts 'Protection of the Wind Blade' on herself for 5 seconds. The effects of 'Protection of the Wind Blade' can be stacked a maximum of 5 times, and increases attack power by 3%, critical chance by 3%, and accuracy by 3 with every stack, with critical chance being limited to a 15% increase and accuracy to 15. This effect cannot be canceled.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANZU_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Every time she uses her block skill, Anzu casts 'Protection of the Wind Blade' on herself for 5 seconds. The effects of 'Protection of the Wind Blade' can be stacked a maximum of 5 times, and increases attack power by 5%, critical chance by 5%, and accuracy by 5 with every stack, with critical chance being limited to a 25% increase and accuracy to 25. This effect cannot be canceled. Upon using her 3-chain, Anzu additionally uses 'Wind Blade' to deal @magical damage@ equal to 500% of her attack power to enemies within her range.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BIHWA_DESC.text: Bihwa uses the strength of her spirits to throw an enormous divine knife to deal @magical damage@ equal to [150/250/350]% of her attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BIHWA_DESC_S2EP4.text: The Hero uses the strength of spirits to throw an enormous divine knife to deal @magical damage@ equal to [150/250/350]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BIHWA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Every second block skill used by Bihwa summons forth the dokkaebi 'Gildal,' who becomes embodied through Bihwa and swings their club to deal @magical damage@ equal to 500% of Bihwa's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BIHWA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Every second block skill used by Bihwa summons forth the dokkaebi 'Gildal,' who becomes embodied by Bihwa and swings their club to deal @magical damage@ equal to 800% of Bihwa's attack power. Upon using her own or another ally's 3-chain, Bihwa embodies the spirit 'Gseundae' for 3 seconds, who attacks enemies with their divine branch to deal @magical damage@ equal to 100% of Bihwa's attack power every 0.1 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_CAMILLABANOUB_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using their 3-chain, the Hero increases their own attack power by 15% and resistance penetration by 500 for 10 seconds. Reusing the skill will renew its duration.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ENERGYBEAM_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using their 3-chain, the Hero immediately shoots an 'Ultimate Magic Beam' to deal @magical damage@ equal to 2000% of their attack power and dispel all enemy buffs. 'Ultimate Magic Beam' ignores enemy effects that take damage in place of their allies. Upon activating 'Ultimate Magic Beam,' the Hero generates 1 block of their own.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_EPENDER_DESC.text: The Hero releases flower petals to deal @magical damage@ equal to [200/300/400]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_EPENDER_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using their 3-chain, the Hero summons a gigantic flower that spits poison and deals @magical damage@ equal to 800% of the Hero’s attack power to all enemies within range.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ESTELLE_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon dealing damage with their block skill, the Hero summons 'Stardust' for 3 seconds that decreases enemy resistance by 20%. (Cannot be stacked)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_EUNGARAM_DESC.text: The Hero deals area @magical damage@ equal to [200/300/600]% of their attack power to the nearest enemy and knocks hit enemies into the air.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_EUNGARAM_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Enemies hit by 'Waterspout' lose 10% of their resistance for 5 seconds. Upon using 'Waterspout,' the Hero increases their own critical chance by 10% for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_EUNGARAM_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Enemies hit by 'Waterspout' lose 10% of their resistance for 5 seconds. Upon using 'Waterspout,' the Hero increases their own critical chance by 10% for 5 seconds. Upon activating another ally's Special Skill, the Hero becomes resistant to debuffs for 5 seconds. (Cooltime: 15 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_FREDERICK_DESC.text: Shoots sacred energy to the front, dealing @magical damage@ equal to [250/300/400]% of attack power according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_FREDERICK_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When the blocks of three different Heroes are pressed consecutively, shoots light, dealing @magical damage@ equal to 1000% of attack power immediately. If Francesca is amongst allies, Francesca's blocks are recognized as all different blocks.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_FREDERICK_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When the blocks of three different Heroes are pressed consecutively, shoots light, dealing @magical damage@ equal to 1000% of attack power immediately. If Francesca is amongst allies, Francesca's blocks are recognized as all different blocks. When activated, shoots 1 additional time.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GG3_DIZZY_DESC.text: Dizzy memberikan @kerusakan sihir@ setara dengan [120/240/400]% dari kekuatan serangnya berdasarkan jumlah rangkaian skill yang dipergunakan

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GG3_DIZZY_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Blok kedua yang dipergunakan Dizzy berubah menjadi ‘For Roasting Chesnuts..’ yang memberikan @kerusakan sihir@ setara dengan 700% dari kekuatan serangnya. TEXT_SKILL_WI_GG_RAMLETHAL_SKILL_LV3_SUB.text: After using her 3-chain after her block skill, Ramlethal uses 'Calvados' to deal @magical damage@ equal to 2800% of attack power and increases critical damage by 20% for 8 seconds. The attack also heals her HP based on 30% of the damage dealt.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GRIMREAPER_DESC.text: Grim Reaper memanggil deadly fog yang memberikan @kerusakan sihir@ setara dengan [200/300/400]% dari kekuatan serangnya per detik dan bertahan selama [2/3/4] detik, sesuai dengan jumlah skill rangkaian yang digunakan

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GRIMREAPER_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Jika hero apa saja dipulihkan selama pertempuran, Grim Reaper meninggkan ‘Mark Of Reaper’ kepada semua musuh dalam jangkauan Fog Of Death. Mark Of Reaper bertahan selama 2 detik dan mengurangi resistansi musuh dan efek pemulihan sebesar 15% (Cooldown : 5 detik)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GRIMREAPER_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Jika hero apa saja dipulihkan selama pertempuran, Grim Reaper meninggkan ‘Mark Of Reaper’ kepada semua musuh dalam jangkauan Fog Of Death. TEXT_SKILL_WI_GROW_WHEAT_DESC.text: The Hero summons 'Catcher in the Wheat' that deals @magical damage@ equal to [85/150/270]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used. Hit enemies receive a 'Mark of Grain' that lasts 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GROW_WHEAT_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When an ally attacks an enemy with the 'Mark of Grain' 5 times, the Hero summons 'Fields of Gold' and 'Raging Catcher in the Wheat' for 5 seconds. TEXT_STAGE_DG_APFOOL_HYW_DESC.text: Set out to uncover hidden memories!

TEXT_STAGE_DG_APFOOL_HYW_STORY.text: Since the beginning of time, light and darkness have warred against each other in endless struggle. The first three ‘Apostles’ who invade Hasla and the three ‘Daughters of Cora’ who have followed them prepare for the final battle that will put an end to the eternal war. The Daughters of Cora create a new generation of Goddesses, the ‘Elard,’ by bestowing them the Daughters’ own powers, as well as human soldiers who will help them fight in the battle: the ‘Chrona Heroes.’ The Apostles besiege the continent with unrelenting forces of darkness, controlling monsters as pawns against the warriors of light. In the face of a seemingly hopeless war, the Chrona Heroes forge a contract with the Goddess Chronos. They relinquish the eternal rest that comes with death and instead sacrifice their souls for the greater good, vowing to be reincarnated again and again as need calls them. After much strife and struggle – with Dionne disappearing from the battlefield, deceived by Nemesis’s trickery – the persevering two Goddesses and Heroes fight the last remaining Apostle, Destalos, and succeed in binding their soul. The war is finally over, and the victorious battle comes to be known as the ‘Apostles War.’ All praise the courage of the Goddess and her Heroes. Yet as the years pass by in idle peace, dust settles on the scars of the war, and the glorious feats of old are forgotten…

TEXT_TIP_ARENA_3.text: After the Arena Maintenance, your Arena Rank will be adjusted to the final Tier of the previous Rank.

TEXT_TIP_ARENA_4.text: Terdapat 4 peringkat di arena, Perunggu, Perak, Emas dan Master

TEXT_TIP_ARENA_5.text: There are no Tiers in Master Rank. Only your points will increase or decrease in accordance with your wins and losses.

TEXT_TIP_ARENA_6.text: Periksa quest yang berhubungan setelah bermain di Arena

TEXT_TIP_ARENA_9.text: Your Arena Rank cannot be downgraded. Losses will only result in the decrease of your Arena Tier.

TEXT_TIP_AUTO_1.text: Stages that have been cleared once can be played again with Battle Delegation.

TEXT_TIP_AUTO_2.text: During Battle Delegation, main Heroes use 3-chains, and support Heroes use 1-chain block skills.

TEXT_TIP_BATTLE_ENTRY_ILLUST_1.text: Illustrations of your team Heroes will be shown when entering battle.

TEXT_TIP_BATTLE_ENTRY_ILLUST_2.text: Hero illustrations in the battle screen can be toggled ON/OFF from Settings > Game.

TEXT_TIP_BATTLE_ENTRY_ILLUST_3.text: Hero illustrations in the battle screen can be toggled ON/OFF from the battle Settings menu.

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_1.text: Play Ordeals to get special Sticker rewards!

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_2.text: Ordeals are a difficult Adventure mode that open every 3 weeks for a week at a time.

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_3.text: Defeat powerful Bosses from the twisted dimension of an alternate Hasla!

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_4.text: Freely experiment with different teams in the Practice Mode.

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_5.text: The Boss's stats increase according to the stage difficulty. Harder levels will activate even more harmful debuffs to Heroes.

TEXT_TIP_CARVE_1.text: Add [Slots] and [Sigils] to Soulbound Weapons to strengthen your Heroes.

TEXT_TIP_CARVE_2.text: Adding Slots requires other ★4~6 Soulbound Weapons and Fergus Points as materials.

TEXT_TIP_CARVE_3.text: In order to add a Sigil to a Soulbound Weapon, you must first upgrade it to ★6 and add a Slot.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_1.text: Kalahkan Monster Champion di mode Tantangan untuk mendapatkan Buku Warisan dan Lambang yang kuat!

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_10.text: Pot Buff tidak dapat dipergunakan di Mode Challenge

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_2.text: Berhati-hatilah terhadap serangan unik Monster Champio! Setiap monster harus dikalahkan dengan cara berbeda

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_3.text: Dikatakan bahwa Lambang yang diperoleh dari Monster Champion mengandung bagian dari pengetahuan

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_4.text: Ada kabar yang mengatakan bahwa ada mahluk yang menakutkan di kedalaman selokan

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_5.text: Saat ini istana dikuasai oleh sisa - sisa anggota Kelompok Siang yang tidak pernah meninggalkan medan tempur di kota Suci

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_6.text: Kamu tidak akan mendapatkan hadiah jika kalah di mode Tantangan. Berpikir dengan bijak dan melarikan diri jika harus!

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_7.text: Kamu dapat memilih untuk melanjutkan atau melarikan diri setelah mengalahkan Monster Champion. Kamu akan tetap memperoleh hadiah yang kamu temukan jika melarikan diri

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_8.text: Serangan dari Monster Champion tidak lebih dari 20% dari maksimal HP mereka tiap serangan

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_9.text: Kamu tidak dapat menggunakan Iklan untuk melanjutkan permainan di mode Tantangan

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_ADVANCE_HERO.text: Promotion Heroes can be randomly recruited through promoting ★3 Heroes of the same class.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_COLLABO_HERO.text: Otherworld Heroes come from other dimensions, drawn by a strange power to Hasla.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_COMMON_HERO.text: Normal Heroes range from ★1 to ★3 and promote to a random Hero of the same class upon promotion.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_EXCEED_1.text: Use Danan's Fragments, Iron, and Gold to forge Soulbound Weapons and unlock the true power of your Heroes!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_EXCEED_3.text: Ikon kelas pahlawan akan bersinar jika dia memakai Soulbound Weapon ★6.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_GACHA_HERO.text: Contract Heroes can be recruited through Premium Contracts.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_GROWTH_3.text: ★6 Heroes can eat Berries to gain additional stats.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_EP_5.text: Cora, the first goddess, is known to have dispersed powers to fight against the darkness across the whole universe.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_MANACAR_1.text: Manacar is a mass of greed that devours whatever contains the faintest trace of magic.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_SOUL_1.text: The bloodline of Soltar, the Apostle who once drove the southern lands of Hasla into deathly terror, still remains standing...

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HELP.text:
Butuh Bantuan? Buka [Kota]> [Menu] untuk mengakses Panduan Bantuan,
 atau sentuh tombol [?] di setiap layar untuk mendapatkan informasi lebih lanjut!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HERO_RANKING.text: Lihat Pahlawan mana yang paling banyak berpartisipasi di Dungeon Raid sebelum Anda masuk!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HERO_VALUE.text: Heroes of Crusaders Quest are divided into seven categories: Legendary, Contract, Promotion, Normal, Hidden, Otherworld, and Supply.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LEGENDARY_HERO.text: Legendary Heroes are fixed in their promotion from ★1 to ★6. Their stats are higher on average than other Heroes of the same grade.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_POPO.text: Successfully bargain with Popo to get deals on all items.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_STAGE_1.text: In the Scenario Selection Menu, you can touch the book icon on Hero Bosses' portraits to check whether you have recruited the Hero.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_TEAM_RECORD.text: Buka menu [Rekam] di layar pemilihan Skenario untuk mencari kombinasi tim Kapten lainnya!

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_YS8_1.text:
Bantu Adol dan timnya untuk menolong para pengungsi dan 
bangun kapal untuk meninggalkan pulau terpencil!

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_YS8_2.text:
Sebuah kekuatan misterius membawa Adol dan kelompoknya 
ke Hasla saat mereka dalam misi memulihkan ingatan Dana

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_YS8_3.text:
Kapal Penumpang Hasla diserang dan dihancurkan oleh Kraken 
yang tiba-tiba saja muncul

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_1.text:
Kucing Pemancing datang ke Hasla untuk menyebarkan 
kebahagiaan memancing

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_2.text:
Koin Ikan dapat diperoleh dari memancing 
dan menukarkan beberapa item di tempat penukaran.

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_4.text:
Catatan terbaik setiap ikan dalam Album Koleksi Ikan 
akan di reset sehari sekali

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_5.text:
Selesaikan Koleksi Ikanmu dari semua 
tempat pemancingan dan dapatkan hadiah spesial!

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_6.text:
Memancing tidak meningkatkan level akunmu, 
tapi akan meningkatkan Fisher Rank mu (FR)

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_7.text: Peluang Ikan Besar' dari Peralatan Memancing Anda meningkatkan peluang Anda untuk menangkap ikan yang lebih besar saat Memancing Otomatis!

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_1.text: Deal damage to Giant Bosses and receive rewards!

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_2.text: A Hero can fight only one battle a day.

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_3.text: You can receive additional rewards by defeating the Boss within the event period.

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_4.text: Devilish Coins can be acquired through Hasla Wars events and traded for rewards.

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_5.text: The longer you survive, the more Devilish Coins you receive.

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_6.text: 'Bloody Rose Jack' is one of the Elite Four, the most loyal subordinates of Gordian, the Devil King of Hell Island.

TEXT_TIP_INHERITANCE_1.text: Pahlawan Bintang 6 yang telah mencapai level maksimal dapat diperkuat lagi melalui warisan

TEXT_TIP_INHERITANCE_2.text: Buku Warisan dapat diperoleh melalui Hadiah Champion, Kontrak, Mode Tantangan dan masih banyak lagi !

TEXT_TIP_INHERITANCE_3.text: Level dari pahlawan yang diwariskan ditandai dengan warna Ungu

TEXT_TIP_ITEM_INFO_LONG_PRESS.text: Press and hold an item in your Inventory to check its information.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_STORY_1.text: The house of Tsukino is one of the three founding clans of the Ryu Kingdom.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_STORY_3.text: The peak of the Primal Volcano has been devastated by heat, but the Woopa Tribe lives in the jungle at the foot of the mountain.

TEXT_TIP_LIBRARY_RECORD_1.text: Pandora is looking for a competent Captain who will help her manage records in the Library of Dimensions.

TEXT_TIP_LIBRARY_RECORD_2.text: You must enter your record into the Library of Dimensions in order to receive its reward.

TEXT_TIP_LOW_INHERITANCE_1.text:
Pewarisan pada level tertentu pahlawan ★6 yang telah 
mencapai level dan latihan maksimal

TEXT_TIP_ORCHARD_1.text: Heroes working in the Orchard are marked with a round tree icon.

TEXT_TIP_PASSIVE_DESC.text: Pahlawan diatas grade 4 memiliki  $passive skills$ tambahan. Dapat berupa tipe #main# atau %support%

TEXT_TIP_PROMOTION_EXCEPTION.text: Certain★3 Secret Heroes cannot be promoted.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_PVP_2.text: In the Colosseum, you will fight against other Captains' A.I. Heroes.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_RULE_3.text: Heroes receive reduced healing during matches.

TEXT_TIP_QUEST_1.text: Selesaikan Quest Rank untuk meningkatkan Peringakat QR mu! Semakin tinggi QR, semakin banyak quest yang muncul dengan hadiah yang lebih baik!

TEXT_TIP_QUEST_2.text: Kamu dapat menolak Rank Quest dan menggantinya dengan quest baru. Ada batasan berapa kali kamu dapat menolak quest perhari.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_META_1.text: Penyerbuan Sang Utusan berubah setiap Senin

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_1.text:
Ketuk layar beberapa kali untuk melepaskan efek
stun pada pahlawan Anda!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_2.text:
Suku-suku dari Gurun Kuno adalah ahli batuan  - 
pencipta teknologi yang hilang seiring waktu.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_3.text:
The Guardian of the Lost Kingdom, yang dibuat melalui 
teknologi kuno yang terlupakan, terus hidup kembali 
dalam berbagai bentuk bahkan setelah kekalahannya.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_4.text:
Menurut Nubuatan Batu Rosetta, rahasia kerajaan 
yang hilang terkubur dalam kedalaman Kuil Ilusi.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_5.text:
Anda dapat memperoleh Sigils spesial dengan 
opsi-opsi yang ditetapkan dalam serangan "Guardian of the Ruins".

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_1.text: The current capital of Nosgard is Snorri Edda, named after the first Great King of Nosgard.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_2.text: Only the silent ruins beyond the Crossing of Frost Wolves remain of Elder Edda, the old capital of Nosgard.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_3.text: Any true Nosgardian would be proud of their heritage. There are many who disapprove of Thor's attempts to unite the diverse traditional tribes of Nosgard into a single, central nation.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_4.text: Be careful not to let your screen freeze over in battle! Use Goddess Skills to prevent the oncoming frost.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_5.text: Quickly cut through frozen shackles to destroy the summoned chains!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_6.text: Bosses of the Sanctuary regularly cast buffs on themselves while canceling Hero buffs. Make sure to cancel Boss buffs!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_1.text: In the Laboratory, Heroes will not be able to generate shields due to a powerful electromagnetic field!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_2.text: Shields generated by Boss Monsters will absorb all damage targeted at them.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_3.text: Use Goddess Skills to neutralize Boss Monsters' laser beams!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_4.text: When Battleloid NS000 attempts to self-destruct, tap on the screen repeatedly to help Stanya deactivate the attack.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_5.text: The science companies that lead the Neth Empire are currently being dominated by the country's House of Nobles.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_6.text: Levine, the former Chief Research Officer of Rapture Science, is the granddaughter of the legendary scientist Ludvico, Hasla's greatest expert on Battleloids.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_1.text: Heroes who gaze into the Eye of the Abyss will be temporarily weakened.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_2.text: All buffs and debuffs cast by the Boss can be dispelled.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_3.text: Use Goddess Skills to block the Boss's giant tentacles!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_4.text: There are old legends that in the depths of the mystical sea dwells an ancient monster that feeds on light.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_5.text: All experienced sailors know that one must not anger the 'Elder Sister of the Sea" if one values one's life.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_6.text: Due to her responsibility and toil of having protected the ocean for decades, Maré, "Elder Sister of the Sea," is seldom found content.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_1.text: Tap the notes in time with the music as they approach the center from both sides of the screen!

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_2.text: Different notes require different modes of tapping, such as tapping in succession or holding down the screen.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_3.text: Go to 'Calibration Settings' to manually synchronize the music and input.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_4.text: You can customize the speed of the notes before starting a song.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_5.text: If you succeed in consecutively hitting notes in a combo, you will enter Fever Mode and earn bonus points.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_6.text: You can continue the stage even if you reach Game Over, but your record will not be registered.

TEXT_TIP_RZ_1.text: Selesaikan stage untuk menaikkan progress bar dan dapatkan hadiah

TEXT_TIP_RZ_2.text: Tiket masuk direset tiap pagi pada jam 9 pagi.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER1_1.text: Beberapa dari monster harus dilawan dengan menggunakan Bom Monster. Gunakan dengan bijak!

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER1_2.text: Hutan Hyro terletak dekat kota Pahlawan

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER2_1.text: Lucuti persenjataan musuh dengan menggunakan granat asap yang dapat ditemukan didalam peti

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER2_2.text: Trista menderita dibawah penguasaan Kelompok Bayangan Mawar, yang dengan misterius muncul tiba-tiba dan mengambil alih kekuasan kerajaann

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER3_1.text: Granat Cahaya tidak hanya menerangi jalan – tapi dapat juga memberikan kerusakan kepada musuh

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER3_2.text: Para ManusiaTikus telah lama hidup tersembunyi di selokan untuk waktu yang cukup lama

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER4_1.text: Gunakan Mana di sekitar Istana untuk memberikan kerusakan kepada musuh !

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER4_2.text: Istana, pernah digunakan sebagai tempat pertemuan raja Trista dengan selirnya, telah ditelantarkan selama bartahun-tahun sepeninggalan mereka

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP3_1.text: In order to improve the worsening conditions of Nosgard, King Thor formed an alliance with Emperor Alexander of Grancia.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP3_2.text: The capital of Nosgard, 'Snorri Edda,' is named after its first king.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP3_3.text: The 'Einherjar' are an elite troop of warriors with a long tradition. They deem strength and glory in battle the highest values in life.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP3_4.text: Many stories lay buried underneath the pure snow of the northern lands.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP4_1.text: Not only is Levine Ludvico the current head of Road Industry, she is also the designer of Neth's magical engineering troops: soldiers who annihilated Trista's Falcon No.9 Brigade in the previous war.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP4_2.text: Arart is the Goddess of Judgement and the former Goddess of the Volcano - as well as Bella's former teacher.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP4_3.text: Use Goddess Skills to neutralize Bosses' powerful attacks!

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP4_4.text: Attacking from outside the range of the Boss's shield will decrease the damage you deal.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP5_1.text: Use the goddess' power to escape from the influence of the corrupted veins.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP5_2.text: If you are not able to escape after the wanted list is out, the amount of damage you receive will get stronger.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP5_3.text: Use a focus block to cancel the shadow of phantasm.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP5_4.text: Collect 3 focus blocks and delete them to cancel the shadow of phantasm for all Heroes.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_S2_EP2_1.text: Ar'rat, Dewi Penghakiman adalah yang melawan dan menyegel Sylunis 100 tahun yang lalu

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_S2_EP2_2.text: Setelah Camilla Banoub di kalahkan, banyak penjarah yang memasuki ke dalam Kuil dan berharap dapat mencuri harta karun

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_S2_EP2_3.text: Walaupun keturunan dari Suku Padang Pasir bertebaran di seluruh penjuru negeri,  mereka tetap yakin akan legenda tiga Raja dan berharap suatu hari mereka akan memimpin kembali

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_S2_EP2_4.text: Elise dan Ar'rat adalah mantan Dewi Gurun dan Padang Pasir

TEXT_TIP_SET_CARVESTONE_1.text: Menggunakan dua sigil dari set yang sama ke SBW akan memicu Opsi Set Unik mereka

TEXT_TIP_SKILL_DELETE.text: Dapat menghapus skill dari pahlawan di Lab.Skill

TEXT_TOPDEALER_RANDOM_EXCLUSIVE_WEAPON_4.text: Sukses Besar! Fergus telah memberimu Senjata Soulbound Bintang 4 Acak

TEXT_TOPDEALER_RANDOM_FUGUS_BOX_HELP.text:
Peti yang diberikan oleh penempa favoritmu. Sepertinya
berisikan beragam item

TEXT_TOTAL_DAMAGE_RANKING_DESC.text: Listed are the Hero Captains who have dealt the most damage in total. This list is renewed every {0} minutes.

TEXT_TQ_008_GOAL.text: Play a Stage with a Mercenary

TEXT_TRADE_HISTORY_EMPTY.text: There is no history to be found.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_BAR_01_DESC.text: A special bar on wheels. Even plain spring water tastes special here.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_CART_01_DESC.text: A cart filled with various drinks and snacks. Very difficult to pass up when it comes by your compartment.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_CHAIR_01_DESC.text: Recline and relax on our comfortable seats as you journey towards your destination.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_CHAIR_02_DESC.text: Recline and relax on our comfortable seats as you journey towards your destination.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_CUP_01_DESC.text: There's not much in life a cup of hot chocolate won't make better.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_KETTLE_01_DESC.text: Full of hot tea for the journey ahead.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_PARTITION_01_DESC.text: Divides passenger cars into compartments for private seating arrangements.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_TABLE_01_DESC.text: Convenient for doodling, reading, snacking, and other pastimes on your train journey.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_TABLE_02_DESC.text: Convenient for doodling, reading, snacking, and other pastimes on your train journey.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_TOILET_01_DESC.text: For number ones and twos on the road.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_BAG_01_DESC.text: Travel light so that you may bring back more memories with you.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_BARTENDER_01_DESC.text: A special cabinet specially built for the bartender's use. One may think that it only contains bottles and other concoctions, but nobody knows for certain...

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_DRINKINGWATER_01_DESC.text: The key to any bartender's trade: know your drinks.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_LIGHT_01_DESC.text: Perfect for some quiet travel reading.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_SHELF_01_DESC.text: For storing luggage. Bigger trunks don't fit, however, and must be stored somewhere else.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_WINDOW_01_DESC.text: A window looking out on grassland plains and, farther beyond, the sea on the horizon.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_WINDOW_02_DESC.text: A window looking out on a vast landscape filled with and... sand... and more sand.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_WINDOW_03_DESC.text: A window looking out at the cold, bleak tundra in a state of eternal winter. When will spring arrive?

TEXT_TRAIN_TOP_CEILINGFAN_01_DESC.text: A ceiling fan with lights. Please don't stare at it for too long, lest your eyes start to hurt.

TEXT_TREASURE_GOBLIN_BARRIER_DESC.text: Immune to Physical and Magical Dmg

TEXT_TREASURE_GOBLIN_BARRIER_KING_DESC.text:
Immune to All Dmg
Cancel with Goddess

TEXT_TROPICAL_FISHING_DESC.text:
Hutan diantara Ryu dan Gunung Purba adalah wilayah liar, 
belum tersentuh dengan manusia. Pasti terdapat banyak 
spesies aneh yang hidup di airnya.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_01.text: Aku akan mengajarimu dasar memancing, Meow.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_02.text:
Ini Menu Memancing, Meow.
Temukan tempat memancing atau 
cek peralatanmu atau koleksimu.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_03.text: Ini adalah peringkat Fisher Rankmu. Ini adalah standar resmi dari asosiasi memancing Hasla yang menilai kemampuan memancingmu ! Meow

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_04.text:
Semakin tinggi rankmu, semakin baik perlengkapan 
yang kamu dapat dan tempat mancing yang menarik.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_05.text: Tangkap Ikan untuk meningkatkan Fisher Rank mu, meow!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_06.text:
Pengalaman itu guru terbaik! Dapatkan lebih banyak ikan 
dan jadilah pemancing yang lebih baik

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_07.text:
Disini kamu dapat mengecek perlengkapan 
memancingmu dan album koleksi ikanmu, meow.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_08.text:
Di menu perlengkapan, kamu dapat memberi 
dan menggunakan peralatan memancing.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_09.text:
Di Album Koleksi Ikan, kamu dapat mengecek seluruh ikan 
yang kamu tangkap di setiap tempat pemancingan, meow.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_10.text:
HFA akan memberi hadiah yang spesial 
jika kamu menyelesaikan koleksimu!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_11.text: Kamu dapat memilih tempat pemancinganmu disini, meow.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_12.text:
Masih terlalu cepat untukmu untuk memancing. 
Ayo kemari terlebih dahulu, meow.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_13.text:
Disini tempat pertamamu memancing, meow! 
Disini kamu dapat memancing sepuasmu.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_14.text:
Baiklah, sepertinya kamu perlu alat pancing, 
pelampung dan umpan ikan, meow..

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_15.text:
Ingat, satu umpan untuk satu putaran memancing, meow. 
Kamu tidak dapat memancing apapun tanpa umpan!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_16.text:
Jika kamu menekan peralatan memancingmu, 
kamu dapat pergi ke menu peralatan

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_17.text:
Sekarang ayo coba memancing, meow! Tekan tombol reel 
untuk melempar kailmu.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_18.text:
Kamu berhasil melempar kailmu, meow! 
Tap tombol reel mu sekali lagi untuk menghentikan 
jarum bar nya.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_19.text:
Kamu punya kesempatan untuk menangkap ikan besar 
saat kamu berhenti ditengah bar.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_22.text:
Sekarang kamu telah menempar kailmu, 
tinggal tunggu ikan memakannya!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_23.text:
Ada yang memakannya! Tap tombol reel dan 
tunjukkan kekuatanmu, meow!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_24.text:
Sekarang bagian terseru nya: Pertarungan sebenarnya, meow! 
Aku akan memberikanmu tips penting sebelumnya.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_25.text: Kamu lihat ketegangan dari tali pancingmu, meow

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_26.text:
Jika ketegangan tali pancingmu terlalu tinggi, 
ia akan putus dan ikannya akan kabur, meow!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_27.text:
Sebaliknya, kalau tegangannya terlalu rendah, 
ikan akan mudah terlepas dan kabur.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_28.text:
Menahan tombol reel akan membuat tali 
pancingmu menjadi tegang

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_29.text:
Sedangkan melepaskannya akan menurunkan 
tegangannya, meow

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_30.text:
Singkatnya, kamu harus menjaga keseimbangan 
dan perlahan menarik ikannya, meow! 
Memancing itu bisnis yang peka!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_31.text:
Tegangan tali pancingmu tinggi, meow. 
Kamu dapat menggulung ikan lebih cepat seperti ini 
tapi ingat jika mencapai batas max nya, talinya akan putus!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_32.text:
Ikannya terlalu jauh. Ia akan kabur jika semakin jauh! 
Kemari, ijinkan aku membantumu. Meow.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_33.text:
Ketika tegangan tali "hijau", makan ikannya akan 
datang padamu.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_34.text:
Kamu harus mengendurkan reelmu pada saat seperti ini, 
meow. Biar aku bantu.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_35.text: Ikannya melompat dari air! Cepat pindahkan reelnya ke kiri!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_36.text:
Pertarungan yang hebat dengan ikan ini. Tekan bloknya 
untuk  melemahkannya!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_37.text:
Ikan yang kuat terkadang menggunakan skill spesial 
untuk kabur. Jangan biarkan itu terjadi. Meow!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_38.text: Kamu menangkap ikan ! Aku rasa itu kucing MEOW!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_39.text:
Sepertinya tidak ada lagi yang dapat aku ajarkan, meow!
Aku harap kamu menikmatinya. Semoga beruntung!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_40.text: Jika kamu mencoba memancing sekarang, Ini kailmu, meow

TEXT_WEDDING_BOTTOM_RING_01_DESC.text: Fergus crafted this ring for a couple's once-in-a-lifetime moment. By putting on these bands, the couple declare their lifelong love for each other.

TEXT_WEDDING_BOTTOM_SWING_01_DESC.text: Legend has it that love that blooms under this cherry tree will remain eternal.

TEXT_WEDDING_CENTER_DOVE_01_DESC.text: A pair of white doves, the symbol of peace. Doves are released at weddings to bless the couple's future with peace and happiness.

TEXT_WEP_LEGEND_BO_BEARS_BERA_4_DESC.text: (Passive Enhanced) 'Baited' enemies additionally lose 6% of their resistance.

TEXT_WEP_LEGEND_BO_BEARS_BERA_5_DESC.text: (Passive Enhanced) 'Baited' enemies additionally lose 6% of their resistance.

TEXT_WEP_LEGEND_BO_BEARS_BERA_6_DESC.text:
(Passive Enhanced) 'Baited' enemies additionally lose 6% of their resistance and, at maximum 'bait' stacks, receive 150% more magical damage.
(Passive Added) Upon using an ally's 3-chain including their own, the Hero uses 'Homing Instinct' to deal magical damage equal to 1000% of their attack power to all 'baited' enemies. 'Homing Instinct' ignores all enemy evasion and effects that receive damage in place of others. Each 'bait' stack increases the number of hits dealt by 'Homing Instinct' by 1. (Cooltime: 1 second)
(Passive Added) Upon using 'Homing Instinct,' the Hero generates 1 block for themselves.

(Passive Added) If the enemy is a certain distance above the ground, Panpan shoots 2 shafts of 'Heaven's Bamboo Rain' that each deal magical damage equal to 300% of his attack power. If multiple enemies meet this condition, Panpan attacks only the rearmost enemy. (Cooltime: 10 seconds)

TEXT_WISH_REWARD_DESC_2.text:
#[How to Acquire Golden Quill Pens]#

- Enter the Bingo Event after 00:00 UTC every day to receive 5 Gold Quill Pens.

- Complete Rank Quests.

- You can purchase up to 10 Golden Quill Pens per day from the menu on the upper right.

- Purchase the Bingo Pass to receive 10 additional Golden Quill Pens per day for the duration of the Event. (The Golden Quill Pens acquired through the Bingo Pass accumulate daily and can be immediately received upon purchase.)

#※ Golden Quill Pens can be stored. However, you cannot acquire or use Golden Quill Pens after the end of the Bingo Event. Any Golden Quill Pens remaining in your Inventory will be reset after the Event period.#
