TEXT_SKILLGET_INFO_DESC.text: You have unlocked a new Special Skill.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_DANGSOHYE_DESC.text: Throws [1/2/3] hairpin(s) according to the number of chains and inflicts #physical damage# equal to [150/250/400]% of attack power per hairpin.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_DANGSOHYE_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
When Xiaohui Tang pushes a block, she eats [1/2/3] toxic herb(s) to take damage equal to 5% of her max HP per toxic herb becoming Poisoned by Herb.
 Poisoned by Herb: Increases her critical damage by 20%.
 When Xiaohui Tang eats 5 toxic herbs, the Poisoned by Herb state is removed and she gains Absolute Poison Immunity for 5 seconds.
 Absolute Poison Immunity: Increases her critical damage by 50% and takes no damage from eating toxic herbs. When the state ends, the toxic herb stack is reset and Xiaohui Tang takes a fixed damage equal to 50% of her max HP. Her critical resistance is reduced by 50% until she gains Absolute Poison Immunity again. (Cannot be dispelled or blocked)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_DANGSOHYE_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
When Xiaohui Tang pushes a block, she eats [1/2/3] toxic herb(s) to take damage equal to 5% of her max HP per toxic herb becoming Poisoned by Herb.
 Poisoned by Herb: Increases her critical damage by 20%.
 When Xiaohui Tang eats 5 toxic herbs, the Poisoned by Herb state is removed and she gains Absolute Poison Immunity for 5 seconds.
 Absolute Poison Immunity: Increases her critical damage by 50% and takes no damage from eating toxic herbs. Duration is reset upon skill re trigger.When the state ends, the toxic herb stack is reset and Xiaohui Tang takes a fixed damage equal to 50% of her max HP. Her critical resistance is reduced by 50% until she gains Absolute Poison Immunity again. (Cannot be dispelled or blocked)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_DJURA_DESC.text: Uses Pulse Laser to deal #physical damage# equal to [100/300/500]% of its attack power, according to chain number used, to the frontmost nearby enemy.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_DJURA_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Grants the Analytical Engine - Galaxy effect to the allied leader other than itself at the start of combat. This effect lasts throughout the combat.
The Analytical Engine - Galaxy grants a buff to the target and self according to the block skills used by the target of the Analytical Engine - Galaxy effect and the caster.

Dawn: Whenever the target of the Analytical Engine - Galaxy effect uses a block skill, it uses Dawn which increases attack power by 10% and critical damage by 5% for 10 seconds. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)
Dim Light: Whenever the caster uses a block skill, it uses Dim Light, increasing critical chance by 10%, penetration by 10%, and resistance penetration by 10% for 10 seconds. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_DJURA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Grants the Analytical Engine - Galaxy effect to the allied leader other than itself at the start of combat. This effect lasts throughout the combat.
The Analytical Engine - Galaxy grants a buff to the target and self according to the block skills used by the target of the Analytical Engine - Galaxy effect and the caster.

Dawn: Whenever the target of the Analytical Engine - Galaxy effect uses a block skill, it uses Dawn which increases attack power by 20% and critical damage by 15% for 10 seconds. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)
Dim Light: Whenever the caster uses a block skill, it uses Dim Light, increasing critical chance by 15%, penetration by 20%, and resistance penetration by 20% for 10 seconds. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_GENEVIE_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Genevie leaves a ‘Mark’ on an enemy target struck by ‘Dagger Throw’ for 5 seconds. The target afflicted with the mark has their evasion reduced by 20, and they take 50% additional damage from Genevie. Only one enemy unit can be marked at a time.
Additionally, if another ally uses a 3-chain block skill, Genevie shoots a volley of ‘Chaser Arrows’ that deals @magical damage@ equal to 1000% of the hero’s attack power to the 3 frontmost enemy units. ‘Chaser Arrows’ prioritize the marked targets. The last unit struck by Chaser Arrows become marked for the next 5 seconds. (Cooldown: 0.1 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_HINA_DESC.text: Throws a paper airplane to deal #physical damage# equal to [300/600/900]% of the hero’s attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_HINA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When the hero uses her block skill after another ally’s, the hero deals #physical damage# equal to 1000% of her attack power 4 times. This attack penetrates enemy units and ignores hero effects that tank damage for the team.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_HINA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When the hero uses her block skill after another ally’s, the hero deals #physical damage# equal to 1500% of her attack power 4 times. This attack penetrates enemy units and ignores hero effects that tank damage for the team.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_LIMITED_BRSK_07_DESC.text: Deals #physical damage# equal to [100/200/500]% of their attack power to the nearest enemy according to the chain number used by throwing stones.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_LIMITED_BRSK_07_LV2_SUBDES.text:
Every time an ally presses 3 blocks, he shoots Explosive Grenade dealing #physical damage# equal to 500% of attack power.
 When Isidro evades the enemy's attack, Roll is activated. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)
Roll: Increases evasion by 30 and critical chance by 30 for 2 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_LIMITED_BRSK_07_LV3_SUBDES.text:
Every time an ally presses 3 blocks, he shoots Explosive Bullet dealing #physical damage# equal to 1,000% of attack power.
 When Isidro evades the enemy's attack, Roll is activated. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)
Roll: Increases evasion by 50 and critical chance by 70 for 2 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_LIMITED_RB2_01_DESC.text: Throws [1/2/3] fire sword(s), each dealing @magic damage@ equal to 150% of attack power per hit.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_LIMITED_RB2_01_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
The special skill is changed to 'Maiden Awakening.'
Maiden Awakening: Reduces SP of the enemy with the highest attack power by 10, and increases her own SP by 10. Shoots 'Dust: Fire Arrow' that deals @magic damage@ equal to 800% of the attack power towards the front.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_LIMITED_RB2_01_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The special skill is changed to 'Maiden Awakening.'
Maiden Awakening: Reduces SP of the enemy with the highest attack power by 25, and increases her own SP by 25. Shoots 'Dust: Fire Arrow' that deals @magic damage@ equal to 1600% of the attack power towards the front.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_NOTTINGHAM_DESC.text: Fires a bolt that pierces the enemy, dealing #physical damage# equal to [100/125/175]% of attack power depending on the number of chains. ‘Piercing Bolt’ ignores the enemy’s armor by 20%.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_NOTTINGHAM_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using one’s block skill, normal attack is changed to 1-chain block skill for 10 seconds, and attack power increases by 75% of one’s attack speed. For this effect, the value before the increase of attack speed is applied, and the Djuration is reset if reused while already in effect.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_NOTTINGHAM_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using one’s block skill, normal attack is changed to 1-chain block skill for 10 seconds, and attack power is increased by 100% of one’s attack speed. For this effect, the value before the increase of attack speed is applied, and the Djuration is reset if reused while already in effect.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_TEHIS_DESC.text: Shoots an arrow forward. The Hero deals #physical damage# equal to [200/300/500]% of attack power according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_TEHIS_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
The targets of 3-chain Ranged Shot take additional #physical damage# equal to 444% of attack power for 15 seconds when they are hit by Thehyss’ block skill.
When the Hero's block skill is triggered 5 times, the Hero summons a shadow that deals #physical damage# equal to 4444% of attack power and applies Hit and Run to the target (Cooldown: 1 second)
Hit and Run: Changes the block skill into Flash Assault, which deals #physical damage# equal to 444% of attack power 3 times for 8 seconds. This effect cannot be dispelled or interrupted.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_TEHIS_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The targets of 3-chain Ranged Shot take additional #physical damage# equal to 444% of attack power for 15 seconds when they are hit by Thehyss’ block skill.
When the Hero's block skill is triggered 3 times, the Hero summons a shadow that deals #physical damage# equal to 4444% of attack power and applies Hit and Run to the target (Cooldown: 1 second)
Hit and Run: Changes the block skill into Flash Assault, which deals #physical damage# equal to 444% of attack power 3 times for 8 seconds. This effect cannot be dispelled or interrupted.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ANIMA_DESC.text: Throw [1/2/3] fish that inflict #physical damage# equal to 150% of attack power depending on the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ANIMA_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
The aggressive cat, ‘Siro,’ clings to the enemy who has been damaged by ‘Today's Treats!’
Siro: Deals sustained #physical damage# equal to 400% of Anima’s attack power for 8 seconds. Djuration is reset if reactivated while in effect, and can be stacked up to 3 times. This effect cannot be dispelled or blocked.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ANIMA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The aggressive cat, ‘Siro,’ clings to the enemy who has been damaged by ‘Today's Treats!’ 
The lethargic cat, ‘Nero,’ also clings to the enemy.
Siro: Deals sustained #physical damage# equal to 400% of Anima’s attack power for 8 seconds. Djuration is reset if reactivated while in effect, and can be stacked up to 3 times. This effect cannot be dispelled or blocked.
Nero: Reduces armor by 500 and critical resistance by 10% for 8 seconds. Djuration is reset if reactivated while in effect, and can be stacked up to 3 times.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ANNE_DESC.text: Shoots a soul bullet to deal @magic damage@ equal to [100/200/400]% of the hero's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ANNE_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using an ally block skill 2 times, the Hero becomes Soul Linked for 5 seconds. The duration of this effect is refreshed whenever it is triggered.
Soul Link: Increases the Hero's critical chance by 15% and resistance penetration by 15%. Applies Cursed Brand to the victims of Soul Bullet. Cursed Brand deals @magic damage@ equal to 2500% of attack power and disappears when Anne uses her 3-chain skill or receives damage from the 3-chain. Every time an ally presses 2 blocks, Anne's next Block skill is used as her 3-chain skill power.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ANNE_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using an ally block skill 2 times, the Hero becomes Soul Linked for 5 seconds. The duration of this effect is refreshed whenever it is triggered.
Soul Link: Increases the Hero's critical chance by 30% and resistance penetration by 30%. Applies Cursed Brand to the victims of Soul Bullet. Cursed Brand deals @magic damage@ equal to 5000% of attack power and disappears when Anne uses her 3-chain skill or receives damage from the 3-chain. Every time an ally presses 3 blocks, Anne's next Block skill is used as her 3-chain skill power.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ATHOS_DESC.text: Athos rolls forwards and loads and shoots his gun to deal #physical damage# equal to [300/150/50]% of his attack power in accordance to his range. Athos' evasion is increased by 50 when he rolls.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ATHOS_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Athos' movement speed is increased by 25%. Upon pressing his own block, he generates 1 ally leader block (activated once per 3 sec)

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ATHOS_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Athos' movement speed is increased by 25%. Upon pressing his own block, he generates 1 ally leader block (activated once per 3 sec) When using Shot Gun on an enemy in the melee range, Athos attacks one more time to deal #physical damage# equal to [7,000/4,000/1,500]% of his attack power and knock back the hit enemy.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_JET_LV3_SUBDESC.text: The enemies hit by a block skill enter into the Wanted state for 5 seconds. The enemies in the Wanted state receive 50% more damage for the duration of this skill. The enemies in the Wanted state inflict AoE $neutral damage$ equal to 5000% of Jet’s attack power when they die.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_LIME_DESC.text: A slime appears to deal #physical damage# equal to [240/340/440]% of the hero’s attack power to the enemy unit with the highest HP in range.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_LIME_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Enemies damaged by ‘Boing’ become ‘Soaked’. Soaked enemies have their evasion reduced by 50 for 4 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_LIME_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Enemies damaged by ‘Boing’ become ‘Soaked.’ Soaked enemies have their evasion reduced by 50 for 4 seconds. Whenever the hero attacks a ‘Soaked’ enemy with ‘Boing,’ she heals 20% of her maximum HP.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_LIMITED_BRSK_08_DESC.text: Throws Vacuum Blade dealing @magical damage@ equal to [200/400/800]% of attack power according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_LIMITED_BRSK_08_LV2_SUBDES.text:
Activates Sylph’s Blessing when his block skill is activated 5 times, and moves by flying to the front when no enemy is within range.
 
 Sylph’s Blessing: Increases his motion speed by 20% and resistance penetration by 500 for 5 seconds, and becomes immune to all damages 2 times. (Duration reset upon reactivation)

TEXT_SKILL_HU_LIMITED_BRSK_08_LV3_SUBDES.text:
Activates Sylph’s Blessing when his block skill is activated 3 times, and moves by flying to the front when no enemy is within range.
 
 Sylph’s Blessing: Increases his motion speed by 20% and resistance penetration by 500 for 7 seconds, and becomes immune to all damages 2 times. (Duration reset upon reactivation)

TEXT_SKILL_HU_LUCA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon shooting 2 ‘Liquid Bullets,’ the hero summons a swarm of insects that penetrates enemy units 3 times, dealing #physical damage# equal to 1000% of the hero’s attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_MILADY_DESC.text: A member of the Mafia fires a bullet that deals #physical damage# equal to [280/340/420]% of the hero’s attack power at the enemy with the highest armor penetration.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_MILADY_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When the hero uses her block skill, members of the Mafia arrive at the scene, dealing #physical damage# equal to 3500% of the hero’s attack power per hit. (Cooldown: 3 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_HU_MILADY_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When the hero uses her block skill, members of the Mafia arrive at the scene, dealing #physical damage# equal to 3500% of the hero’s attack power per hit. (Cooldown: 3 seconds) When ‘Vendetta’ is activated, place a bounty on the enemy with the highest armor penetration. The target with the bounty will take damage in place of their allies. Every second, or whenever the hero activates her block skill, ‘Bounty’ gains a stack. Bounty can stack up to 10 times, and each stack increases the target’s damage taken by 6%. If the afflicted target is a boss monster or a leader hero, they are immediately given max stacks.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_NENE_DESC.text: Nene draws and fires her weapon, dealing #physical damage# equal to [300/600/900]% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_NENE_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using her block skill, Nene summons her deerdog, Vivi, for 5 seconds. Once summoned, Vivi swings its bat every second to deal #physical damage# equal to 400% of Nene’s attack power. (Cooldown: 6 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_HU_NENE_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using her block skill, Nene summons her deerdog, Vivi, for 5 seconds. Once summoned, Vivi swings its bat every second to deal #physical damage# equal to 800% of Nene’s attack power. (Cooldown: 6 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_HU_RB_NORA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Fires 'Heart Grenade' to deal #physical damage# equal to 1000% of attack power up to 3 times upon using her own 3-chain after using another ally's block.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_RB_NORA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Increases accuracy by 60 for 5 sec upon using her own 3-chain. Afterwards, she fires 'Heart Grenade' to deal #physical damage# equal to 1000% of attack power up to 3 times upon using another ally's block.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_SILVER_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The Special Skill changes to Ultimate Weapon.
Ultimate Weapon: Silver transforms into a giant cannon for 10 seconds. In this state, his attack power and critical damage are increased by 125%, his resistance penetration is increased by 100, and he becomes immune to stuns. His block skills are changed to Prism Shot, which deals @magical damage@ equal to [120/220/500]% of Silver's attack power, according to the chain number used. Upon reactivating Ultimate Weapon, the skill's duration is renewed and Silver uses Star Cannon.
Silver deals @magical damage@ equal to 250% of his attack power every 0.3 seconds for 8 seconds, at the cost of 30% of his movement speed. Upon reactivating Star Cannon, the skill's duration is renewed.
Additionally, upon using his 3-chain, Silver generates 40 SP for himself. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_ATHENA_DESC.text: Inflicts @magic damage@ equal to [750/1300/2000]% of resistance, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_EVGENEIA_DESC.text: Evgenia raises her shield and charges forward for [3/4/5] second(s). Enemy units who make contact with the shield take #physical damage# equal to 250% of the hero’s attack power every 0.2 seconds. The hero is immune to push effects during her charge. (Duration of the skill is refreshed upon repeated use)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_EVGENEIA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When ‘Commanding Wind’ strikes enemy units 7 times, the hero’s maximum HP is increased by 50% for 5 seconds. (Duration is refreshed on repeated use)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_EVGENEIA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When ‘Commanding Wind’ strikes enemy units 3 times, the hero’s maximum HP is increased by 150% for 5 seconds. (Duration is refreshed on repeated use)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_HEIM_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using his block after another ally's 3-chain, Heim summons ice shards from the earth to deal @magical damage@ equal to 500% of his resistance.
The land over which the icicles are summoned turns into Land of Ice and Snow for 3 seconds, increasing all allies' resistance by 150% and critical chance by 15%.
Enemies on the Land of Ice and Snow receive @magical damage@ equal to 100% of Heim's resistance every 0.1 seconds, and an evasion debuff of 10.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_KUMORI_DESC.text: Inflicts @magic damage@ equal to [200, 400, 600]% of resistance depending on the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_KUMORI_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Summons the sun and clouds for the frontmost ally over 5 seconds when using the block skill. (Cooldown after the effect: 6 seconds)
All attacks from the heroes within the range of the Dance of the Sun and Cloud ignore evasion. This effect cannot be silenced or disabled. In addition, the allies within the range enter the ‘Refreshed’ state and the enemies within the range enter the ‘Wet’ state.
Refreshed: Casts a shield equal to 700% of Kumori's resistance and grants 'Hot' state to allies.
Hot: Deals #physical damage# equal to 5% of Kumori’s attack power every 0.5 seconds. This effect cannot be silenced or disabled. 
Wet: Debuffs enemies by decreasing their resistance by 20%.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_KUMORI_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Summons the sun and clouds for the frontmost ally over 5 seconds when using the block skill. (Cooldown after the effect: 6 seconds)
All attacks from the heroes within the range of the Dance of the Sun and Cloud ignore evasion. This effect cannot be silenced or disabled. In addition, the allies within the range enter the ‘Refreshed’ state and the enemies within the range enter the ‘Wet’ state.
Refreshed: Casts a shield equal to 1500% of Kumori's resistance and grants 'Hot' state to allies.
Hot: Deals #physical damage# equal to 5% of Kumori’s attack power every 0.5 seconds. This effect cannot be silenced or disabled. 
Wet: Debuffs enemies by decreasing their resistance by 50%.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_KUMORI_SUBNAME.text: Dance of the Sun and Cloud

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LEILING_DESC.text:
Upon using a block skill, Lei Ling gives the enemy a different effect according to the chain number.
[1-chain - 'Chop' : Lei Ling rapidly chops bundles of leek at the enemy. Each leek is divided into 5 parts, each dealing #physical damage# equal to 20% of Lei Ling's attack power. Hit enemies receive 30% increased damage for 3 seconds.]
[2-chain - 'Dredge' : Lei Ling throws a bag of flour at the enemy, dealing #physical damage# equal to 200% of her attack power. Hit enemies cannot be healed for 3 seconds.]
[3-chain - 'Deep-Fry' : Lei Ling throws cooking oil forward, dealing #physical damage# equal to 400% of her attack power. Hit enemies receive 50% more damage for 3 seconds.]

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LEILING_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon pressing each block for 3 allies regardless of order, Lei Ling pulls out a gigantic wok, which she smashes down to deal #physical damage# equal to 300% of her attack power and stun hit enemies for 1 second.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LEILING_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon pressing each block for 3 allies regardless of order, Lei Ling pulls out a gigantic wok, which she smashes down to deal #physical damage# equal to 300% of her attack power and stun hit enemies for 1 second. Afterwards, Lei Ling uses her wok to flip the enemy up and down 3 times, stunning them for 3 seconds with the last toss.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIGHTMAKER_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Stanya is immune to all debuffs for 5 seconds after using a chain-3 skill. When hit during this effect, she dashes forward and deals #physical damage# equal to 322% of her attack power. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIGHTMAKER_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using her 3-chain, Stanya receives all damage targeted at the entire party for 5 seconds and becomes immune to 5 hits, while the entire party becomes immune to debuffs. If she receives a hit from the enemy during this time, she charges forward to stun the enemy for 1 second and deal #physical damage# equal to 1000% of her attack power. (Cooldown: 1 second)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_BRSK_05_DESC.text: Charges and deals #physical damage# equal to [300/600/1,000]% of attack power to the enemy in the front, according to chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_BRSK_05_LV2_SUBDES.text:
When entering combat, he enters in the Apostle Zodd state.
If the enemy is within range when using blocks, the block skill takes the same motion as the normal attack. With every 4 attacks excluding special skills, he uses One-Horned Demonic Beast dealing #physical damage# equal to 1,200% of attack power and knocks back enemies in the front.
The special skill is changed to Nosedive.
Nosedive: Uses Nosedive, which deals #physical damage# equal to 2,000% to the enemy in the front after spreading his wings and soaring up into the sky.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_BRSK_05_LV3_SUBDES.text:
When entering combat, he enters in the Apostle Zodd state.
If the enemy is within range when using blocks, the block skill takes the same motion as the normal attack. With every 4 attacks excluding special skills, he uses One-Horned Demonic Beast dealing #physical damage# equal to 2,000% of attack power and knocks back enemies in the front.
The special skill is changed to Nosedive.
Nosedive: Uses Nosedive, which deals #physical damage# equal to 4,000% to the enemy in the front after spreading his wings and soaring up into the sky. When using Nosedive, his attack power increases by 200% and critical damage by 400% for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LIMITED_BRSK_05_SUBNAME.text: The Descent of the Demonic Beast

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LUCY_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
For every 5th block skill of an ally, Knight in Shining Armor is triggered for 8 seconds. (Cooldown: 3 seconds)
Knight in Shining Armor: Increases defense by 600 and damage reduction by 20% for the caster.
During Knight in Shining Armor is active, all damage to allies is redirected to the caster. (Cannot be canceled)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_LUCY_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
For every 2nd block skill of an ally, Knight in Shining Armor is triggered for 8 seconds. (Cooldown: 3 seconds)
Knight in Shining Armor: Increases defense by 900 and damage reduction by 50% for the caster.
During Knight in Shining Armor is active, all damage to allies is redirected to the caster. (Cannot be canceled)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_NICO_DESC.text: Inflicts #physical damage# equal to [200/400/600]% of Nico's attack power by punching the refrigerator, according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_NICO_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Earns ‘Caffeine Dependency’ state after battle starts. Also, activates ‘Caffeine Courage’ with energy drink intake when using her block. ‘Caffeine Courage’ does not reactivate unless canceled.

‘Caffeine Dependency’: Increases attack power by 7500. However, Nico’s attack power decreases by 1000 every 2 seconds, and the decrease effect can be stacked up to 20 times. This effect cannot be silenced or canceled.
‘Caffeine Courage’: Applies to the entire ally a shield effect that absorbs all damage equal to 4000% of Nico’s attack power and decreases inflicted damage by 50%, at initial activation and every 2 seconds thereafter.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_NICO_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Earns ‘Caffeine Dependency’ state after battle starts. Also, activates ‘Caffeine Courage’ with energy drink intake when using her block. ‘Caffeine Courage’ does not reactivate unless canceled.

'Caffeine Dependency’: Increases attack power by 15000. However, Nico’s attack power decreases by 2000 every 2 seconds, and the decrease effect can be stacked up to 20 times. This effect cannot be silenced or canceled.
‘Caffeine Courage’: Applies to the entire ally a shield effect that absorbs all damage equal to 8000% of Nico’s attack power and decreases inflicted damage by 50%, at initial activation and every 2 seconds thereafter.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_OZMA_DESC.text: Ku-Klip chops enemy with her twin ax in turn to inflict #physical damage# equal to [500/700/1000]% of Attack Power 2 times according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_OZMA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Ozma mounts on Ku-Klip as she enters combat. Ozma's HP is increased by 1.5 times immediately as she mounts on Ku-Klip.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_OZMA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Ozma mounts on Ku-Klip as she enters combat. Ozma's HP is increased by 1.5 times and the damage taken by her friendly units is redirected to her immediately after she mounts on Ku-Klip. Increases SP of all friendly units by 10 as Ozma presses on her own block while in Ku-Klip.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_RB_PYRRHA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Increases [attack power/armor/magic resistance] by [50/50/50] for 10 sec every time she evades an attack. (Activated once per 0.1 sec). Adds 5 stacks when using her own block after using another ally's 3-chain. The effect stacks up to 25 times.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_RB_PYRRHA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Swings the javelin to deal #physical damage# equal to 1500% of attack power every time she evades an attack. (Activated once per 2 sec). Also increases [attack power/armor/magic resistance] by [60/60/60] for 10 sec. (Activated once per 0.1 sec). Adds 15 stacks when using her own block after using another ally's 3-chain. The effect stacks up to 50 times.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_SHINE_SMASH_LV2_SUBDESC.text: After Roland's skill block is used, he heals the entire party for 40% of his resistance up to 5 times whenever he is attacked by an enemy for the next 5 secs.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_SHINE_SMASH_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using a block, Roland, for the next 5 seconds, receives all damage targeted at the entire party and heals the entire party by 220% of his resistance while increasing their SP by 30 every time he receives a hit (maximum 8 times). With every 5th heal, he immediately stuns all enemies for 2 seconds, deals #physical damage# equal to 195% of his attack power to the frontmost enemy, and generates 1 block for himself. (Cooldown: 1 second)

TEXT_SKILL_PA_SKADI_DESC.text: A wave of shadows rises in the front and sweeps enemies. Inflicts $neutral damage$ equal to [300/500/800]% of attack power according to the number of chains..

TEXT_SKILL_PA_SKADI_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Hero’s special skill changes to ‘Mirror Image’.
Mirror image: Grant ‘Mirror Image’ to the enemy with the highest attack power for 5 seconds. If used again while in effect, the target remains the same and only the duration is reset. (Cannot be canceled or blocked, cooldown: 1 second)
The enemy in this state receives $neutral damage$ equal to 200% of its attack power 1 second after it inflicts damage on the Hero's ally. This damage ignores evasion, critical damage, and the effect of taking damage for others.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_SKADI_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
At the start of battle, the Hero increases SP by 80, and cannot be pushed back.
Hero’s special skill changes to ‘Mirror Image’.
Mirror image: Grant ‘Mirror Image’ to the enemy with the highest attack power for 5 seconds. If used again while in effect, the target remains the same and only the duration is reset. (Cannot be canceled or blocked, cooldown: 1 second)
The enemy in this state receives $neutral damage$ equal to 500% of its attack power 1 second after it inflicts damage on the Hero's ally. This damage ignores evasion, critical damage, and the effect of taking damage for others.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_SNORRI_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon activating Snorri’s block skill, the hero receives all damage targeted at the team for 5 seconds and generates 30 SP for all allies. Snorri is always in the state of the ‘Living Dead,’ and this state cannot be blocked or dispelled. On death, Snorri’s soul explodes, dealing $neutral damage% equal to 1000% of the hero’s attack power and generates 30 SP for all other allies. After death, the hero is revived with 100% HP when an ally defeats an enemy unit.
‘Living Dead’: The hero receives 80% more damage and cannot receive heals or shields.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_SPECIAL_LIMITED_BRSK_05_SP.text: Uses Nosedive, which deals physical damage to the enemy in the front after spreading his wings and soaring up into the sky.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_UZUME_DESC.text: Spins once in place to swing the fan at the enemy to deal @magic damage@ equal to [400/600/800]% of attack power depending on the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_UZUME_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Using an ally's 3-chain, the Hero pulls all the enemies in the area towards her and activates 'Dance Time' for 20 seconds. The duration resets if re-activated within duration. (Cooldown: 5 seconds)

Dance Time: Uzume starts dancing. Reduces received damage by 35%, and captivates the audience to reduce all enemies' resistance by 35% within the concert area and then increases damage to the enemies by 30%. The block skill pulls all the enemies in the concert area towards her, and is changed to 'Behold!' to deal @magic damage@ equal to 321% of resistance 5 times. This effect cannot be canceled or blocked.

TEXT_SKILL_PA_UZUME_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Using an ally's 3-chain, the Hero pulls all the enemies in the area towards her and activates 'Dance Time' for 20 seconds. The duration resets if re-activated within duration. (Cooldown: 5 seconds)

Dance Time: Uzume starts dancing. Reduces received damage by 35%, and captivates the audience to reduce all enemies' resistance by 35% within the concert area and then increases damage to the enemies by 50%. The block skill pulls all the enemies in the concert area towards her, and is changed to 'Behold!' to deal @magic damage@ equal to 321% of resistance 5 times. This effect cannot be canceled or blocked.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_ANTHON_DESC.text: Chows down on a delicious meal, healing all allies by [130/250/370]% of Anton’s attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_ANTHON_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When Anton activates his block skill, he throws his eating utensils at the enemy. All enemy targets hit by Anton’s utensils are afflicted with ‘Hunger’ for 5 seconds. ‘Hunger’ reduces the afflicted targets’ resistance penetration by 500 and magical damage by 3%. This effect can stack up to 3 times. At max stacks, applying hunger will simply refresh the duration of the debuff.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_ANTHON_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
When Anton activates his block skill, he throws his eating utensils at the enemy. All enemy targets hit by Anton’s utensils are afflicted with ‘Hunger’ for 5 seconds. ‘Hunger’ reduces the afflicted targets’ resistance penetration by 1000 and magical damage by 5%. This effect can stack up to 3 times. At max stacks, applying hunger will simply refresh the duration of the debuff.

Targets afflicted with max stack of ‘Hunger’ also becomes afflicted with the ‘Hungry for Stew’ debuff.
‘Hungry for Stew’: for 5 seconds, the target afflicted with this debuff takes #physical damage# equal to 200% of Anton’s maximum HP every second and have their animation speed reduced by 30%. Duration of the debuff is refreshed on repeated use.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_ASHLEY_DESC.text:
Recovers all ally Heroes' HP by [100/170/280]% of her attack power according to the number of chains, and then uses ‘Elegant Tea Time’ for [3/4/6] seconds.
When ‘Elegant Tea Time’ is activated, she recovers all ally Heroes' HP every second by 30% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_ASHLEY_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
When Ashley’s Block Skill is activated while ‘Elegant Tea Time’ is still active, Ashley falls and spills what she is holding in front of her.
Oops, my bad! : Pushes aside all enemies that were attacked at first, and then inflicts $neutral AoE damage$ equal to 200% of her attack power every 0.3 seconds for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_ASHLEY_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
When Ashley’s Block Skill is activated while ‘Elegant Tea Time’ is still active, Ashley falls and spills what she is holding in front of her.
Oops, my bad! : Pushes aside all enemies that were attacked at first, and then inflicts $neutral AoE damage$ equal to 500% of her attack power every 0.2 seconds for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_BAHARHA_DESC.text: The Hero heals his HP and the ally with the least HP by [150/300/450]% of his attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_BAHARHA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When an ally is attacked, Baharha charges at the nearest enemy and inflicts #physical damage# equal to 100% of attack power. After that, damage to allies is redirected to Baharha for 5 seconds. (Cooldown: 7 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_BAHARHA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When an ally is attacked, Baharha charges at the nearest enemy and inflicts #physical damage# equal to 100% of attack power. After that, damage to allies is redirected to Baharha increasing the defense and resistance of all allies by 50% of his defense and resistance for 5 seconds. (Cooldown: 7 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LACRIMOSO_DESC.text: Heals the entire ally by [100/125/150]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LACRIMOSO_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Water Serpent' every time the ally leader hits an enemy. (Cooldown: 3 seconds)
Water Serpent: Deals $neutral damage$ equal to 50% of attack power to the enemy with the highest Max HP. The 'Water Serpent' ignores effects that take damage in place of others and Evasion.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LACRIMOSO_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Water Serpent' every time the ally leader hits an enemy. (Cooldown: 1 second)
Water Serpent: Deals $neutral damage$ equal to 50% of attack power to the enemy with the highest Max HP and heals the entire ally by the amount equal to the damage dealt. The 'Water Serpent' ignores effects that take damage in place of others and Evasion.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LANI_DESC.text: Heals the ally with the least remaining HP by [80/100/125]% of the Hero's attack power, depending on the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LANI_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Additionally recovers the ally leader's HP equal to 100% of attack power when using the block skill.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LANI_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Additionally recovers the ally leader's HP equal to 150% of attack power when using the block skill.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LIMITED_BRSK_06_DESC.text: Becomes resolved and recovers the HP of all allies by [250/275/300]% of attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LIMITED_BRSK_06_LV2_SUBDES.text: When the allies including herself are hit, she dashes forward and slashes the sword to deal @magical damage@ equal to 500% of attack power. (Cooldown: 3 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LIMITED_BRSK_06_LV3_SUBDES.text: When the allies including herself are hit, she dashes forward and slashes the sword to deal @magical damage@ equal to 500% of attack power, and recovers the ally with the lowest HP by 500% of attack power. (Cooldown: 3 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LIMITED_DM2_DESC.text: Uses the Magic Bottle to grant a protective shield that absorbs the surrounding damage equal to [100/200/300]% of attack power, according to chain number.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LIMITED_DM2_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When Echo or the leader of the ally is attacked with a critical hit, she recovers the physical strength of the leader equal to 100% of Echo's attack power by playing the piano. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_LIMITED_DM2_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When Echo or the leader of the ally is attacked with a critical hit, she recovers the physical strength of the leader equal to 100% of Echo's attack power by playing the piano, and the attack power, armor, and spell resistance of the entire ally increase by 10% of Echo’s attack power, armor, and resistance for 8 seconds. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_PR_RAI_DESC.text: Rie taps the drum to heal friendly units by [120/250/380]% of their Attack Power according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_RAI_LV2_SUBDESC.text: 'Dum Dum Drrum!' Stuns all enemy units for 1 second when triggered.

TEXT_SKILL_PR_RAI_LV3_SUBDESC.text: 'Dum Dum Drrum!' When activated, stuns all enemies for 1 second. When another ally activates a 3-chain skill, additionally recovers 200% of attack power of all allies except self.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_ASMODEUS_DESC.text:
Deals @magical damage@ equal to 100% of the attack power to all enemies within range according to the chain number used, and uses [Lovely Hearts/Magical Blessings/Bright Stars].
Lovely Hearts: Generates 10 SP for the entire ally.
Magical Blessings: Dispels debuffs for the entire ally. (Cooldown: 3 seconds)
Bright Stars: Generates a block for all allies. (Cooldown: 5 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_ASMODEUS_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
The Special Skill changes to 'Aura of Charms'.
Aura of Charms: Generates an Aura of Charms around the self. All enemies within the aura have motion speed increased by 5% while evasion and accuracy decreased by 15 each. (Every second)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_ASMODEUS_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The Special Skill changes to 'Aura of Charms'.
Aura of Charms: Generates an Aura of Charms around the self. All enemies within the aura have motion speed increased by 5% while evasion and accuracy decreased by 15 each. (Every second)
Enters 'Exhausted' when stayed inside 'Aura of Charms' for 5 seconds. 'Exhausted' enemies have motion speed decreased by 20% and their rate of decrease in evasion and accuracy increases by 2 times.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_BRISEIS_DESC.text: Charges forward and deals #physical damage# equal to [100/200/400]% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_BRISEIS_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Inflicts a stack of 'Paralytic Poison' to the attacker when pressing Block right before getting attacked.
Paralytic Poison: Decreases the target's accuracy by 5 and critical chance and attack speed by 5% for 10 seconds. This effect cannot be removed or blocked. (Stacked up to 5 times, duration resets upon reuse)
The special skill changes to 'Unexpected Being. 
Unexpected Being: She disguises as Zodiac Army Aquarius and takes a leap at the surrounding enemies to deal #physical damage# equal to 0.25% of the current HP of the target every 0.1 seconds for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_BRISEIS_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Inflicts up to 3 stacks of 'Paralytic Poison' to the attacker and increases the caster's SP by 60 when pressing Block right before getting attacked.
Paralytic Poison: Decreases the target's accuracy by 5 and critical chance and attack speed by 5% for 10 seconds. This effect cannot be removed or blocked. (Stacked up to 10 times, duration resets upon reuse)
The special skill changes to 'Unexpected Being.
Unexpected Being: She disguises as Zodiac Army Aquarius and takes a leap at the surrounding enemies to deal #physical damage# equal to 0.5% of the current HP of the target every 0.1 seconds for 3 seconds and applies 2 stacks of Paralytic Poison.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_BRISEIS_SPDESC_LV1.text: She disguises as Zodiac Army Aquarius and takes a leap at the surrounding enemies to deal #physical damage# equal to 0.25% of the current HP of the target every 0.1 seconds for 2 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_BRISEIS_SPDESC_LV2.text: She disguises as Zodiac Army Aquarius and takes a leap at the surrounding enemies to deal #physical damage# equal to 0.5% of the current HP of the target every 0.1 seconds for 2 seconds and applies 2 stacks of Paralytic Poison.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_CHUNMA_DESC.text: The hero hops on her flying blade for [3/4/5] seconds, attacking and dealing #physical damage# equal to 400% of her attack power per hit. (Skill duration is extended on reuse)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_CHUNMA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: If Tian Mo is the leader when ‘Reigning Blade of Tian Mo’ is activated, and she has the highest attack power out of every other unit, the hero activates ‘Greatest of All’ for 2 seconds. The hero’s armor penetration is also increased by 2000 for the same duration. Reactivating the skill during its duration will further extend its duration. This effect cannot be dispelled but is removed if stunned.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_CHUNMA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: If Tian Mo is the leader when ‘Reigning Blade of Tian Mo’ is activated, and she has the highest attack power out of every other unit, the hero activates ‘Greatest of All’ for 2 seconds. The hero’s armor penetration is also increased by 5000 for the same duration. Reactivating the skill during its duration will further extend its duration. This effect cannot be dispelled but is removed if stunned. Whenever the hero’s block is pressed during the duration of ‘Greatest of All’, the hero fires [1/2/3] ‘Tian Mo Desu Beam(s)’ towards the enemy, dealing #physical damage# equal to 4000% of the hero’s attack power. (Cooldown: 0.1 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FALCON_ATTACK_DESC.text: Upon using a block, Rochefort, according to the chain number used, deals #physical damage# equal to [100/150/250]% of his attack power, and has a 50% chance of blocking attacks for the next 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FALCON_ATTACK_LV2_SUBDESC.text: If Rochefort succeeds in blocking or evading an attack within 5 seconds of using a block skill, he counterattacks to deal #physical damage# equal to 400% of his armor. (Maximum 10 times) Using a block after Rochefort's counterattack will summon 3 'hawks' that each deal #physical damage# equal to 400% of his armor. (Activates 1 per second)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FALCON_ATTACK_LV3_SUBDESC.text: If Rochefort succeeds in blocking or evading an attack within 5 seconds of using a block skill, he counterattacks to deal #physical damage# equal to 800% of his armor. (Maximum 10 times) Using a block after Rochefort's counterattack will summon 3 'hawks' that each deal #physical damage# equal to 5000% of his armor. If this attack deals a critical hit, Rochefort will generate 1 block for himself. (Triggered once every second)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FLECK_DESC.text: Swings Magic Balloon to deal @magic damage@ equal to [150/210/300]% of attack power depending on the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FLECK_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Enters 'Majestic Arts' state for 5 sec when using ally's block. (Cooldown: 7 seconds)
Majestic Arts: Takes damage on behalf of all allies and reduces received damage by 20%. 'Majestic Pride' is activated for 3 seconds upon receiving additional damages 1 time. The effects of taking damage on behalf of all allies and damage reduction do not get blocked or disabled.
Majestic Pride: Increases critical chance, armor, and resistance by [20/40/40]%. (Cooldown: 5 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_FLECK_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Enters 'Majestic Arts' state for 5 sec when using ally's block. (Cooldown: 7 seconds)
Majestic Arts: Takes damage on behalf of all allies and reduces received damage by 40%. 'Majestic Pride' is activated for 3 seconds upon receiving additional damages 1 time. The effects of taking damage on behalf of all allies and damage reduction do not get blocked or disabled.
Majestic Pride: Increases critical chance, armor, and resistance by [40/80/80]%. (Cooldown: 5 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_GWEN_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon activating the 3-chain skill of another ally leader, her next block skill will activate with the power of a 3-chain once.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_GWEN_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon activating the 3-chain skill of another ally leader, her next block skill will activate with the power of a 3-chain two times.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LEONIA_DESC.text: Inflicts $neutral damage$ equal to [200/350/500]% of attack power according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LEONIA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Guide of Starlight: When pushing the Hero’s block within 5 seconds after an ally pushes a block, inflicts $neutral damage$ equal to 200% of the Hero’s attack power every 0.1 seconds for 1 second. (Cooldown: 1 second)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LEONIA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Guide of Starlight: When pushing the Hero’s block within 5 seconds after an ally pushes a block, inflicts $neutral damage$ equal to 200% of the Hero’s attack power every 0.1 seconds for 1 second. (Cooldown: 1 second)
When using Guide of Starlight, transforms to ‘Avatar of Ananda’ by fusing with Dragon Jade - Nanda. (Cannot be canceled) Takes damage for allies after the transformation, receives 10% more damage, and becomes immune to stuns.
Avatar of Ananda: Cannot receive the heal effect because the law of the world does not apply, and receives #physical damage# equal to 5% of attack power per second.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_01_DESC.text: Charges to the enemy in the front and deals $neutral damage$ equal to [200/300/650]% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_01_LV2_SUBDES.text: When receiving a debuff, the debuff is disabled and the damage received is decreased by 20% for 3 seconds. When activated, deals $neutral damage$ equal to 1,000% of attack power, and the target of the damage is stunned for 1 second. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_01_LV3_SUBDES.text:
When receiving a debuff, the debuff is disabled and the damage received is decreased by 20% for 3 seconds. When activated, deals $neutral damage$ equal to 3,000% of attack power, and the target of the damage is stunned for 1 second. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)
Whenever Guts uses his normal attack and block skills, his attack power increases by 7% every 5 seconds. Can be stacked up to 10 times. This effect cannot be dispelled or interrupted.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_02_DESC.text: Charges forward and thrust down the sword to deal #physical damage# equal to [3,200/3,300/3,400]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_02_LV2_SUBDES.text:
Mounts on the White Horse upon entering combat. His movement speed increases by 50% while on the White Horse.
His special skill changes to Soul. When Soul is activated, his critical resistance increases by 25% for 5 seconds. (Duration reset upon reactivation)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_02_LV3_SUBDES.text:
Mounts on the White Horse upon entering combat. His movement speed increases by 80% when on the white horse, and does not retreat.
His special skill changes to Soul. When Soul is activated, critical resistance increases by 25%, attack power by 40%, and damage received decreases by 25%, all for 10 seconds. (Duration reset upon reactivation)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_04_DESC.text: Deals #physical damage# equal to [5,00/1,000/1,500]% of attack power according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_04_LV2_SUBDES.text:
Mounts the warhorse when entering combat. 
The Knight of Skeleton's special skill is changed to Sword of Actuation.
Sword of Actuation: The weapon is changed to the Sword of Actuation. The Knight of Skeleton's attack power increases by 100%, and the block skill is changed to $neutral damage$.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_04_LV3_SUBDES.text:
Mounts the warhorse when entering combat. 
The Knight of Skeleton's special skill is changed to Sword of Actuation.
Sword of Actuation: The weapon is changed to the Sword of Actuation. The Knight of Skeleton's attack power increases by 150%, and the block skill is changed to $neutral damage$. 
When Sword of Actuation is reactivated, he cuts the space and deals $neutral damage$ equal to 200% of attack power every 0.1 seconds. (Lasts 1.7 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_RB2_02_DESC.text: Raven teleports to the front and swings the Black blade to deal #physical damage# equal to [500/700/1000]% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_RB2_02_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Enters 'Iaido Stance' state for 5 seconds when activating the block skill. (Cooldown: 5 seconds) 

The following abilities are added during the 'Iaido Stance' state:
Swings the Red blade to deal #physical damage# equal to 1500% of attack power when using the goddess. This attack ignores the effect of taking damage on behalf of allies.
Swings the Green blade to deal $neutral damage$ equal to 1500% of attack power when the Hero is healed (Life Steal is excluded). (Cooldown: 1 second)
Swings the Yellow blade to deal #physical damage# equal to 1500% of attack power and stuns for 1 second when the target evades an attack. This attack ignores the target's evasion. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_RB2_02_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Enters 'Iaido Stance' state for 5 seconds when activating the block skill. (Cooldown: 5 seconds) 

The following abilities are added during the 'Iaido Stance' state:
Swings the Red blade to deal #physical damage# equal to 3000% of attack power when using the goddess. This attack ignores the effect of taking damage on behalf of allies.
Swings the Green blade to deal $neutral damage$ equal to 3000% of attack power when the Hero is healed (Life Steal is excluded). (Cooldown: 1 second)
Swings the Yellow blade to deal #physical damage# equal to 3000% of attack power and stuns for 1 second when the target evades an attack. This attack ignores the target's evasion. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RB_BLAKE_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon receiving fatal damage, Blake uses 'Shadow Clone.' (Activates once every 15 seconds). Upon activating 'Shadow Clone,' Blake retreats, leaving behind a shadow of herself and heals 100% of her HP. She becomes invulnerable for 2 seconds afterwards. Additionally, Blake's attack power and evasion increase by 150% and 150 respectively for 10 seconds after the skill's activation.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SEO_DESC.text: The next two auto attacks will inflict additional #physical damage# equal to [100/200/500]% of attack power according to the number of chains, and the motion speed of the attacked enemy is reduced by 75% for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SEO_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
The auto attacks ignore evasion and the enemies' abilities of receiving all damage dealt to their party. The weapon is enhanced when two ally blocks are used. This effect cannot be silenced or disabled.
Weapon Upgrade: Increases one’s attack power by 50% and slightly increases the range. Reduces one’s attack speed by 25%.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SEO_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The auto attacks ignore evasion and the enemies' abilities of receiving all damage dealt to their party. The weapon is enhanced when two ally blocks are used. This effect cannot be silenced or disabled. (Max. upgrade: +2)
Weapon Upgrade 1: Increases one’s attack power by 100% and slightly increases the range. Reduces one’s attack speed by 25%.
Weapon Upgrade 2: Increases one’s attack power by 250% and significantly increases the range. Reduces one’s attack speed by 50%.
The damage received by the entire ally is reduced by 50% while the weapon is being upgraded.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SHALLOT_DESC.text: Charlotte quickly claws the front with her fingernails 2 times, each inflicting #physical damage# equal to [500/700/1000]% of attack power according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SHALLOT_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Every time she uses her block skill, Charlotte gains the 'Little Red Riding Hood Squad' effect that increases critical damage by 3% and attack power by 500 for 6 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times and the duration is reset when reused.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SHALLOT_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Every time she uses her block skill, Charlotte gains the 'Little Red Riding Hood Squad' effect that increases critical damage by 5% and attack power by 1000 for 6 seconds. This effect stacks up to 10 times and the duration is reset when reused.
In addition, when the 'Little Red Riding Hood Squad' effect is stacked 5 or more times, the motion speed increases by 30%.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SPAWN_MANTEAU_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Reflects all damage taken within 1 second after using a block by 100% and then reflects 50% of all damage taken as $neutral damage$ to the target for 2 seconds. 1 time: Increases critical chance by 20% and resistance penetration by 1500.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0001.text:
..Huhu.
Sebuah jiwa yang terang dan murni

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0002.text:
Aku adalah Noa
Aku berasal dari Kelompok Aliran Dewi

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0003.text:
Aku rasa kamu telah banyak membuang waktumu 
untuk menungguku.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0004.text:
Aku minta maaf akan hal itu.
Wahai Ksatria Wanita

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0005.text:
Ah. Tidak apa-apa!
Tidak ada hal yang harus dimaafkan , Nona Noa

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0006.text:
Aku Lednas,
ksatria yang bertanggung jawab akan keamanan wilayah ini

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0007.text:
Ini adalah {PLAYER_NAME},
pimpinan Tentara Bayaran kota ini

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0008.text:
Sebuah kehormatan dapat bertemu dengan kalian semua.
Dimana letak lembah dari Kota Pahlawan ?

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0009.text:
Aku telah menunggu lama.
Untuk melihat tempat yang kamu sebut sebagau rumah

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0010.text:
Ah, ya . Kota ada diarah sini.
Uh Nona Noa

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0012.text:
Sebelum kita memasuki kota , 
mungkin kamu dapat menyembunyikan sayapmu

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0014.text:
Maria juga telah memperingatkanku,
namun aku lupa saking gembiranya.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0015.text:
Aku rasa keberadaan ku harus tetap dirahasiakan
sampai saat yang tepat tiba

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0016.text:
Mohon tunggu sebentar, 
sementara aku menyembunyikan sayapku

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0019.text:
Hmm.. Baunya enak sekali. 
Aku merasa lapar

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0003.text:
Orang dari Kelompok Aliran Dewi!
Siapa namanya…oh Nona Noa!

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0004.text: Nona Noa tiba-tiba pingsan dan tidak mau bangun

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0005.text:
Aku baru saja menerima sekarton buah Apel dan sedang 
mempersiapkan untuk membuat pai apel

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0006.text:
Nona Noa penasaran akan apa yang aku lakukan. Lalu 
aku memberikannya sepotong dan …

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0009.text:
Nona Noa. 
Kamu tidak apa - apa ?

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0010.text:
…. 
Rasa manis dan tekstur yang lembut.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0012.text:
Gula - 350 gr, Apel - 900 gr
tekanan, adonan, pembakaran

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0013.text:
Selesai dari panas oven
Nama dari substansi tersebut adalah … Pai Apel

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0017.text:
Di Kelompok Aliran Dewi, semuanya diajarkan untuk bisa
menahan diri

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0018.text:
Semua makanan berwarna putih dan hambar… maksudku
sehat

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0019.text:
Aku tidak pernah tahu bahwa makanan dapat memiliki 
rasa seperti ini. Kupikir mereka semua tida ada rasanya

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0020.text:
Namun, pai apel nona Chocolat …. 
Rasanya sangat luar biasa

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0021.text:
Aku telah mempermalukan diriku 
ditengah keterkejutanku

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0022.text:
…. Aku sangat bahagia
kamu sangat menyukai roti buatan ku seperti ini !

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0023.text:
Lain kali, akan aku buatkan 
kue coklat yang sangat enak !

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_2_0024.text: Oh, aku akan nantikan saat itu .

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0003.text:
Aku…
Kenapa aku diciptakan seperti ini….

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0005.text:
Mohon jangan terlalu dipikirkan tentang hal 
yang sebelumnya terjadi

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0006.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} juga mengatakan tidak apa-apa. 
Kesalahan yang mudah dilupakan

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0007.text:
A..aku memutuskan untuk mengatakan pada Pendeta
Maria tentang apa yang terjadi

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0008.text:
Dia mengirimkanku air suci ini setelah membaca 
laporanku

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0009.text:
Aku berharap untuk membantu, tidak ingin menyinggungmu. 
Mohon maaf karena aku melakukan tugasku

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0011.text:
Kamu memaafkanku dan menolongku…
ketika aku mungkin saja terluka {PLAYER_NAME}

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_3_0012.text:
disaat dimana tidak bisa disembuhkan. 
Terima kasih

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0002.text:
Seperti yang kamu saksikan…
Ada kegelapan didalam diriku

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0003.text:
Kegelapan yang ingin menghancurkan semua yang menghalang
menyebarkan kematian kepada siapa saja yang mendekat

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0004.text:
Nama dari kegelapan itu 
yang telah diketahui oleh kelompok aliran dewi ….

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0007.text:
sebuah kegelapan suram ditimpakan padaku,
ditakdirkan padaku demi kehancuran dan perang

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0009.text:
aku takut suatu saat tidak bisa mengendalikan diriku
dan tenggelam dalam sisi gelapku..

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0010.text:
… dan pada akhirnya 
membahayakan orang-orang yang kusayangi

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0011.text: ini adalah ketakutan yang selalu membayangiku

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0013.text:
Ya. Pertempuran dengan kegelapan ini …
adalah pertempuranku

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0014.text:
Namun, bantuabnmu akan akan memberikanku kekuatan
yang besar {PLAYER_NAME}

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_4_0015.text:
Aku memintamu untuk memberkatiku, mewakili 
Orang Suci Maria

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_5_0004.text:
.. Aku akhirnya menemukan jawaban
atas pertanyaan dan keraguanku.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_5_0007.text:
Keinginan dan hasratku tidak untuk melukaimu, 
bertentangan dengan sifatku,

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_5_0008.text:
memenangkan pertempuran dengan kegelapan di hatiku
semua berkat bantuanmu sehingga aku dapat menang

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_5_0010.text:
Aku merasa belum sempurna. 
Namun aku akan berkonsentrasi dalam latihanku

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_5_0011.text:
inilah cara yang mungkin bisa kulakukan untuk 
membalas kebaikanmu

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_5_0013.text:
aku akan datang menyelamatkanmu, apapun resikonya
inilah sumpahku padamu atas nama Egelan

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_11_.text:
Lebih cepat dari dugaanku. Maafkan atas kelancanganku, 
{PLAYER_NAME}.

Aku telah mendengar tentangmu sebelumnya bahwa 
kamu adalah Komandan yang hebat

Aku hanya ingin memastikan apakah kamu orang yang 
bisa diandalkan atau tidak

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_12_.text: Kamu adalah perwira yang cemerlang dan dapat dipercaya

Baiklah, sampai bertemu lain kali. Mungkin tanpa 
menggunakan topeng

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_1_0.text:
Adalah keadaan yang menguntungkan ketika musuh 
dalam keadaan kelelahan juga. Kerja yang bagus

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_3_0.text:
Aku lega kamu menemukan mereka. 
Apakah mereka baik-baik saja?

TEXT_COMPLETE_BATTLEFIELD_EPIC_QUEST_4_0.text:
Wow. Banyak sekali! Haha.. 
Yah kami tahu bahwa kamu sanggup melakukannya

Kenapa kamu tidak berangkat duluan?

yang telah kita lakukan kalau begitu?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_16.text:
Untung menghidupkan kembali keluargamu! 
Kita terkadang harus melakukan apa yang diperlukan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_17.text: Ramah dan sopan. Diperlukan untuk meningkatkan image mu

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_18.text:
…apa yang sedang kamu lihat?! 
Apakah kamu mendengarkanku?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_2.text: Oh ya ampun.. Hallo. Prajurit muda!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_20.text: Kenapa kamu menjadi seperti anak - anak?! Apa ini?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_21.text: ..Seperti anak - anak?!! Aku bukan anak kecil!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_23.text: Ugh, anak kecil itu.. Kapan dia akan dewasa?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_24.text:
Apa kamu lihat gadis itu? 
Apakah dia secantik apa yang dikatakan orang - orang?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_26.text: Dia sebenarnya lebih cantik dari itu.. Tapi..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_28.text:
Seorang ksatria hitam berdiri di sampingnya menatap ke..
Sebenarnya kami tidak tahu dia menatap kemana

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_29.text: Aku merasakan tatapannya.. Itu sangat menakutkan..!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_3.text: Ngomong - ngomong, apa yang membawamu kesini?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_31.text:
Rumor tentang ksatria hitam muncul ketika seseorang 
memandang pada gadis berambut perak dari valencia itu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_32.text: Ksatria telah jatuh cinta pada teman lamanya.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_33.text:
Tapi, mengapa dia bertingkat seperti itu..? 
Dia tidak pernah tahu jika dia tetap bertingkah seperti itu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_4.text:
Ah! Yuria, pemimpin tentara kamu telah mengirimku untuk 
 mengantarkan surat ini pada kapten aliansi dari Valencia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_5.text: Terima kasih prajurit muda. Apakah kamu mau secangkir teh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_18_7.text: Ayo lah.. Ini hanyalah secangkir teh!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0002.text: Apa? Ada apa? Bernapaslah dan beri tahu aku.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0003.text:
Aku masuk!! Aku masuk!! 
Aku telah diterima menjadi pasukan succubus!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0006.text: Siapa lagi yang menjadi bagian dari pasukan succubus?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0007.text: Kapan kamu mulai bergabung dengan pasukan?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0009.text: Minggu depan! Aku akan pergi ke kota labu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0011.text:
Ya, karnaval sedang berlangsung jadi mereka 
mengadakan pertunjukan disana!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0012.text: Mereka bilang aku dapat bergabung dengan mereka disana.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0013.text:
Uh, benarkah? Kalau begitu kenapa kita 
tidak pergi kesana lebih cepat dan menikmati karnavalnya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0015.text: Bagaimana, Rachel? Apa kamu suka karnivalnya?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0016.text: Aku suka karena aku bersamamu! Aku sangat menyukaimu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0018.text: Sepertinya kita sudah cukup melihat - lihat. Ayo pergi ke pasukan succubus.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0019.text: Um.. Aku masih ingin bermain bersamamu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0020.text:
Kita bisa pergi nanti! Kamu tidak boleh 
terlambat di hari pertamamu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0021.text: ayo  tanya orang itu dimana pasukan succubus berada!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0023.text:
Halo penyihir kecil.
Apa kamu tahu dimana pasukan succubus berada?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0025.text: Terus lurus dan belok kiri. Kamu akan melihatnya disana.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0027.text: Rachel,! Jam berapa sekarang? Tidakkah kamu terlambat?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0028.text: Ya, aku masih punya sedikit waktu! Terima kasih vivian!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0029.text:
Aku pikir aku akan terlambat karena kita tersesat. 
Tapi terima kasih padamu aku tepat waktu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0030.text: Kamu adalah seorang navigator yang baik! Haha

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0032.text:
Rachel, kita akan berpisah untuk sementara.. 
Tapi aku percaya padamu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0033.text: Tentu saja! Aku akan menjadi pasukan succubus yang terbaik!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0034.text: Rachel! Kamu mungkin terlambat. Ayo masuk.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0035.text:
Jangan lupa untul menelponku jika seseorang 
mengganggumu

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0036.text:
Ya, terima kasih telah datang kemari bersamaku! 
Hati - hati di jalan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0037.text:
Kalau begitu sekarang.. 
Penyihir itu memberitahukan Rachel jalan yang salah..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0038.text:
Beraninya dia berbohong pada Adiku yang manis..? 
Kamu tidak akan bisa kemana - mana dengan itu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_19_0041.text: Mengganggu iblis yang sedang tidur.. Beristirahatlah dengan damai..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_001.text: AH.. Bagaimana bisa aku menjaga saintess berikutnya..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_002.text: Wow, kamu telah datang. Aku benar - benar menantikan bertemu denganmu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_004.text: Lednas! Aku telah mendengar banyak hal tentangmu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_006.text: Yippee!! Aku sangat senang bertemu denganmu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_007.text: AH, karena kamu sudah disini, ayo pergi ke suatu tempat!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_008.text:
ini akan baik - baik saja jika aku pergi bersamamu, kan? 
Lewat sini!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_009.text:
Sebelumnya, aku benci hal seperti ini. 
Namun, gadis ini sangat bersinar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_010.text:
Jadi aku berjanji akan melindungi gadis ini dengan sebaik 
mungkin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_011.text: Maria ada dimana tadi. Dasar jahil..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_014.text:
Ini untukmu, Maria. 
Berhentilah berpergian dengan Lednas.. Jika tidak..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_015.text:
Ada apa? 
Dia kesatria yang hebat,Dia bisa menjagaku!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_016.text:
Maria. Kamu adalah Orang Suci berikutnya. 
Tunjukan sedikit martabatmu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_020.text: Setelah kejadian itu, aku berhenti jadi penjaga Maria.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_1_021.text:
Itu mungkin terdengar seperti alasan, tapi itulah caraku 
untuk menjaganya.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0001.text: Y-yas, semuanya sudah siap. Aku akan berdoa untukmu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0004.text:
K-Kamu pulang kerumah dengan cepat hari ini. 
Aku.. Aku merindukanmu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0006.text:
Aku sedikit kesepian tanpamu.. 
Tapi aku bermain dengan teman hantuku.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0008.text:
Te-temanku … akan pulang menemui keluarganya.
Jadi kukatakan padanya … aku akan berdoa untuknya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0010.text:
Aku tahu sekarang adalah waktu yang sulit bagi kita. 
Tapi ini waktunya untuk melihat kenyataan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0011.text: Apa kamu mengerti? Hantu itu tidak nyata.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0013.text:
Teman - temanku.. Ketika kamu tidak disini dan aku 
harus melakukan semuanya sendiri,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0016.text:
Oh..okay. Benar? 
Apakah.. Apakah itu benar - benar tidak apa - apa?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0017.text:
Apakah kamu dan bonekanya akan baik - baik saja jika
kamu merasuki boneka violet.?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0018.text: ..! Jika itu membuat violet percaya padaku..!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0020.text: Tu-Tuan Hantu! Apa kamu baik - baik saja?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0021.text: Hiks.. Syukurlah kamu baik - baik saja.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_20_0027.text:
Aku heran kenapa dia tdk mau percaya pd adik nya sendiri 
ketika dia sendiri berhadapan dengan boneka sihir.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0001.text: Ya, kami telah menemukan orang yang tepat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0002.text: Mm, ijinkan kami menuntun jiwa itu ke alam baka

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0004.text:
Aku- aku akan membuang sampat pada tempatnya mulai 
sekarang!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0008.text:
Lihat apa yang telah kamu lakukan Bihyeongrang!! 
Vaisravanamu membuat semua orang lari ketakutan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0010.text:
Hmmph, terserah. Aku akan menuntun jiwa - jiwa ini 
sendirian, jadi jangan ikuti aku!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0011.text:
Jadi.. Kamu disini, Bihyeongrang. 
Raja Yeomra dari alam baka mencarimu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0012.text:
D-dan.. Seperti kemarin.. 
Aku minta maaf karena bicara sangat kasar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0013.text:
Aku tahu kamu hanya mencoba untuk membantu.. Jadi.. 
Maafkan aku akan hal itu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0014.text:
Tidak.. Aku tidak menyadari kalau orang yang telah mati 
akan bergitu takut pada Vaisravana.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0016.text:
..aku meminta Hanee Baram untuk mencari cara untuk 
membuat Vaisravana terlihat lebih.. Bersahabat..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0022.text:
Oh, aku tertawa terlalu keras, ya? 
Tapi Vaisravana sangat imut..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0023.text: Ah, tidak. Syukurlah kalau itu sangat.. "imut"

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0024.text:
Haha, kita hrs mencari jiwa berikutnya utk dituntun ke alam
baka. sptnya tdk ada yg akan lari krn Vaisravana sekarang!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0025.text:
Itu hal yang bagus. Aku juga merasa sedikit bersalah 
pada Vaisravana..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_21_0026.text: Tidak apa - apa, itu imut, jadi aku pikir tidak masalah.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0001.text:
Mengerti, Alice? Oz ku adalah kucing terbaik di hasla, 
tidak peduli apa yang dikana orang - orang.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0002.text:
Lihatlah kemewahan bulu hitamnya & ekspresi yg ceria, 
dan topi penyihir kecilnya yang sempurna!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0003.text:
Dia adalah peliharaan penyihir yang terbaik - tidak, 
dia adalah kucing terbaik di dunia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0004.text: Hmmph! Ekpresi apa? Bulunya terlalu gelap untuk dilihat!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0006.text: Senyumya yg menawan dan kilau giginya - tidak hanya itu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0007.text:
Cheshire bahkan mengingat tipe -tipe kartu yang berbeda! 
Dia adalah kucing genius yang cocok untuk ratu spade!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0008.text:
Apaka ini kota labu meow? 
Aku dengar disini ada banyak kucing-meow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0009.text: Aku ingin bertemu dengan semua kucing penyihir-meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0010.text:
Ah! Master kucing Mew! Aku telah mendengar namamu - 
dan ketenaranmu sebagai seekor master kucing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0011.text:
Oz ku dan Cheshire Alice! 
Beritahu kami siapa kucing terbaik!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0014.text:
Jadi namamu Oz -nya! Oz punya telapak tangan yang pink 
mirip jellybean-nya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0015.text:
Mereka terlihat sangat kenyal dan lembut-nya. 
Dia sangat - sangat lucu-nya!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0016.text:
Dan kamu adalah Cheshire-nya! 
Hidung Cheshire terlihat sangat lembut-nya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0017.text:
Dan ujung dari telinganya sangat runcing dan indah-nya. 
Juga sangat-sangat lucu-nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0018.text:
Oz & Cheshire sangat sehat & lucu-nya! Sangat jls mrk 
mendapatkan cinta yg byk dr pelay.. Um.. pemiliknya-nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0022.text:
Aku.. Aku selalu berpikir kalau Oz sangat lucu tapi aku 
tidak mengira dia akan begitu..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0024.text:
Aku- aku secara diam-diam pikir kalau Cheshire juga 
sangat menggemaskan..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0026.text:
Itu terlihat seperti obsidian yang berkilau ketika dia 
bermain dibawah sinar matahari..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0028.text:
Aku.. Aku selalu ingin mengelus wajahku menggunakan 
telapak Oz yang kenyal setiap kali aku melihatnya.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0029.text:
Hangat dan enak dan lembut.. 
Bukankah ini akan menjadi sangat indah?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_22_0032.text:
Ya.. Semua kucing - kucing itu lucu. 
Dan begitu juga penyihir mereka.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0003.text:
Kalau dipikir - pikir, aku telah bekerja beberapa kali 
sebagai pelayan para ksatria.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0005.text:
Ah! Tp aku harus tdk boleh lupa misi utamaku - untuk 
membunuh Victoria. Bukan tetap menjadi pelayannya.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0006.text:
Putri Victoria sangat jarang sendirian.. 
Tapi aku akan berhasil dalam misiku.. Suatu hari nanti.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0007.text:
Tapi tunggu! Ini bercak debu! 
Aku harus membersihkannya sekarang juga!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0009.text: I-ini.. Ini! Bukankah ini the hitam kesukaan putri victoria!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0010.text: Ah, Tia. Rajin sekali hari ini seperti biasa.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0013.text: Hmm… aku tidak tahu kenapa kamu terburu - buru, tap..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0014.text:
Aku melihat cangkir teh putri Victoria dan sebuah tempat

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0015.text:
Huhu.. Apa ada masalah? "apa ada masalah?" 
Apa kamu tidak lihat masalahnya?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0017.text:
Teh hitam terbaik, diracik oleh pengrajin Grancia 
menggunakan daun teh muda yg dipetik para peri.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0019.text: Apa kamu tidak melihat sesuatu yang janggal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0020.text: Aku- harus aku akui aku tidak melihat itu

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0021.text: Teh hitam yang diminum putri Victoria setiap hari!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0022.text:
teh hitam "spesial", dibuat dr daun teh muda terbaik yg 
dipetik oleh peri & diracik oleh pengrajin terbaik di Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0023.text:
Sebagai kepala gudang dari Knighthood, kamu 
melewatkan sesuatu yang tidak termaafkan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0024.text:
Apa kamu pikir kamu dapat memenangkan rumah 
Pelancia dengan keteledoran?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0025.text:
Lap kakimu di keset!  Dan jangan pernah masuk kembali 
sebelum membersihkan pakaianmu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0026.text:
Rapihkan kembali mejanya stlah menggunakannya! Dan 
jgn nodai sofa dgn apapun kotoran ksatria yg tertinggal!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0027.text:
M-maafkan aku. …erm. Aku akan memesan 
ulang daun tehnya sekarang.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0030.text: Ahem, Tia, apa kamu perlu sesuatu lagi?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0031.text:
Aku akan memesan apapun yang kamu inginkan sekalian 
dengan daun tehnya - khusus untukmu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0034.text:
Karena kamu telah mengatakannya. Aku ingin tempat teh 
"wedding blue antique" edisi terbatas dr Grancia

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0036.text:
Pergi ke Atelier dan minta sebuah cangkir teh yang 
dibuat berbentuk kelopak bunga biru.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0037.text:
Itu mungkin akan sedikit mahal & langka tapi itu sangat 
sesuai dgn keangguan & kecantikan putri Victoria!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0039.text:
Baiklah, aku harus pergi sekarang, 
untuk mempersiapkan waktu minum teh putri Victoria~

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0040.text: Dia benar - benar pelayan kelas kakap..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_23_0041.text:
tp sdh lupakan semua itu.. Aku penasaran seperti apa rasa 
teh hitam terbaik Grancia itu?

Ugh. Jumlah stok hampir habis. Toko kita akan

Kalau begitu kita harus lebih hemat lagi. Dimulai dari

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0003.text:
Dan aku harus mengingatkan semuanya agar lebih

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0004.text:
Kalau begitu aku akan menghitung ulang pengeluaran
dan sumber daya kelompok ksatria kita

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0005.text:
Ugh. Lembur lagi. Walaupun aku sangat menyukai

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0009.text:
Siapa yang terakhir memasuki tempat penyimpanan?
Katakan padaku

Tidak ada yang memasuki ruang penyimpanan, kecuali

Ya. Setiap dia keluar dari sini membawa emas

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0014.text:
dan mengatakan padaku untuk mencatatnya sebagai biaya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0015.text:
Jika David mengatakan seperti itu.. Baiklah. 
Kamu boleh pergi sekarang

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0017.text:
Hmm… David bukanlah orang yang suka berbohong. Tapi 
ongkos pemeliharaan senjata juga tidak begitu mahal…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0018.text:
… Aku akan mengikutinya
dan melihat maksud dari semua ini.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0019.text: Oh. Aku merasa seperti palu. Sayang sekali. Maafkan aku

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0020.text:
Oh tidak.
Aku pernah merasakan hari seperti ini. Aku yakin itu.

Apakah kamu membuat senjataku seperti baru dengan 
satu cincin dari palu milikmu tempo hari ?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0022.text: Haha.. Itu Cuma sedang beruntung saja

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0023.text:
Ini.. Aku bawakan kamu cukup emas dan perhiasan. 
Kupercayakan penanganan senjata kami padamu

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0024.text:
Haha.. Kalau begitu aku tidak punya pilihan. 
Aku akan berusaha lebih keras lagi

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0025.text:
Ah..senjatanya terlalu banyak. Aku memerlukan Besi

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0026.text:
Hmmm… Ada cadangan besi di tempat penyimpanan.. 
Aku akan pergi dan memeriksanya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0028.text:
Fergus dikenal sebagai pandai besi yang hebat tapi untuk 
beberapa alasan tertentu sering melakukan kesalahan

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0029.text: … dan alasan utamanya adalah palu tua itu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0030.text:
Dan tidak ada cara lain selain mengganti palu tua itu dgn 
yang baru

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0031.text:
Dan aku dpt menghemat pengeluaran pada persenjataan

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_24_0032.text: Haha, itu adalah ide yang bagus
