I've been giving them all my love ever since I received them.
I won't back them this time, not even to you, Zeus!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_01.text:
... Fine. Then... Could I borrow one of those plants
for a little bit? That's okay with you, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_02.text:
Borrow? Hmm... Zeus, for all your talk of burning
it down, you really like this plant, don't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_03.text:
Nonsense. I... Uh... Well, a friend…
I mean a soldier of mine...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_04.text:
He loves growing plants...
But, uh, his favorite one withered away recently.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_05.text:
He's very upset, and I hear that his favorite plant
looked just like yours?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_06.text:
If you could lend him one of your plants until he gets a
new one, I'm sure it'll help him get, erm, over his grief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_07.text:
I don't know... Is it okay to lend someone
a present that you received from someone else?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_08.text:
It's only for a few days.
I'll even say please, huh? With a cherry on top?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_16_01.text:
... Okie! He must feel terrible
to have lost his favorite plant like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_16_02.text: Promise to return them once your friend gets better!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_16_03.text:
Fine, fine. Oh, and here's the report for today's
conference. Look it over once you feel well enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_16_04.text: Then I'll be seeing myself off.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_18_01.text: I knew it. My lightning has grown noticeably weaker.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_18_02.text:
But that plant. What kind of plant is barely affected
by a bolt of lightning, regardless of its strength?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_18_03.text:
So that strange aura I felt in the room...
was caused by the plants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_19_01.text:
A plant that restrains the power of the rings...
I've never heard of such a thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_19_02.text:
And to continuously send such plants only to Hera...
Is that why she's been falling ill more frequently?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_19_03.text:
... Darn it. That kid is too stubborn for her own good.
I'll have to send this sample to be investigated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_1_01.text:
Mm... Oh!
When did I fall asleep?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_1_02.text:
I know I was listening to Zeus telling me about
tomorrow's schedule… And then I suddenly fell ill...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_20_01.text:
A plant that weakens the power of the rings of Roman?
I hadn't known such a thing existed in this dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_20_02.text:
Anyway, those spikes on that plant...
Don't you think they look familiar, somehow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_2_01.text:
... and I guess an entire day has passed since then?
Oh, no. Zeus's efforts have been for nothing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_2_02.text: Why do I always cause him so much trouble? Sigh...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_2_03.text:
As my temperature has fallen,
I should go and apologize! Better late than never!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_3_01.text:
Huh? A parcel, addressed to me...
... Can it be?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_4_01.text:
Hee hee, I thought so.
Another delivery of a flowerpot!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_4_02.text:
Ooh, it's a pretty purple flower this time.
And a letter, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_5_02.text:
I hear that you are taking good care of the flowers I sent
you. I am happy that you find them to your liking.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_5_03.text:
I can imagine how well they're doing
under your benevolent care.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_5_04.text:
Today, I send you an iris. It's a new variety, and I hope it
brings you some well-deserved peace of mind and body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_5_05.text:
Please look at the enclosed manual for further instructions.
I am sure the flower will help you greatly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_5_06.text:
I'll send you another present soon.
Sincerely, your caring friend.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_6_02.text:
Whoever they are, this mystery friend always writes so nicely... 
I wish I could keep the letters so I can look at them again and again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_6_03.text:
Hmm, at least the instruction manual
doesn't disappear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_7_01.text:
I'm here to deliver the agenda
discussed at today's conference.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_7_02.text:
Oh, Zeus! Come in! Oh, I've been meaning to go and
find you, not the other way around -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_8_01.text:
Well, you seem to be doing better today.
How are you feeling?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_8_03.text:
Haha... Yes, thanks to everyone's help.
B-but I did miss today's meeting, as you said.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_8_04.text: I really need to go and apologize to the other Senators...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_8_05.text:
The other Senators are fully aware of your situation.
So stop worrying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_9_01.text:
Hera.
When did you buy a new plant?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_9_02.text:
I'm sure the last time I visited, you weren't in possession
of that slightly twitching plant over there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_9_03.text:
Oh, a mystery friend has been sending me presents
since last month!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_9_04.text:
Apparently, they've been cultivating new flowers just for
me! They asked me to take care of them with love!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_9_05.text:
Strange. I don't remember receiving any reports
of multiple plants being delivered to the Council.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_9_06.text:
Hmm? But I always find them lying
right there on my desk when I wake up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_9_08.text:
Hee hee, isn't it curious?
It could be real magic!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_10_0001.text:
HEE HEE ... Orang bodoh menciptakan aktor terbesar.
Sekarang saatnya untuk rencana berikutnya: 
Melepaskan Segel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_11_0001.text:
Apa yang bisa Loki rencanakan?
Apakah kamu tidak ingin tahu tentang motif tersembunyinya?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_1_0001.text:
Hari demi hari dan tidak ada yang berubah menjadi lebih baik ...
Ini bukan yang saya inginkan! Saya tidak pernah 
menginginkan kehidupan yang membosankan ini!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_2_0001.text:
HAW HAW! Kamu di sana, tuan muda,
Saya punya cerita hanya untuk ANDA!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_3_0001.text:
Sebuah cerita? Apa ...
Tunggu! Kamu siapa?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_3_0002.text:
HAW HAW! Aku hanya seorang badut biasa, 
bepergian ke daratan dan membawa kegembiraan 
dengan kisah-kisahku.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_4_0001.text:
Tapi siapa aku? Siapa kamu? Siapa siapa?
Hanya masalah bahwa cerita saya dimaksudkan 
untuk Anda dan Anda harus mendengarkan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_4_0002.text:
Apa ...
Dan mengapa saya harus mendengarkan badut yang 
baru saja saya temui?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_4_0003.text:
Oh, tuan muda penuh dengan ketakutan dan keraguan.
Tidak heran hidupnya suram! Membosankan! PUTUS ASA!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_5_0001.text:
A-apa! Apakah kamu baru saja memanggilku, 
Heim yang pemberani, putus asa?
 Kamu beruntung 
aku dalam suasana hati yang baik. 
Mari kita dengarkan kisah Anda ini!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_5_0002.text:
HAW HAW! Bagus, bagus!
Kalau begitu, apakah kamu pernah mendengar 
tentang 'Harta Karun Tempat Suci?'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_5_0003.text:
Saya lahir dan dibesarkan di Nosgard, tapi ini pertama kalinya
Saya pernah mendengar sesuatu tentang harta karun di sekitar 
tempat suci

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_6_0001.text:
Oh, hanya sedikit yang tahu itu: bangsawan, 
tokoh-tokoh penting, bla bla bla.
 RAHASIA NASIONAL! 
Dan sekarang kamu tahu! HAW HAW!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_6_0002.text:
B-benar? Lalu bagaimana kamu tahu 'harta' ini?
Tampaknya aneh bahwa seorang badut biasa 
akan tahu sesuatu yang penting ...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_6_0003.text:
HAW HAW! Tuan kita penuh dengan keraguan! 
Orang bodoh ini hanya menceritakan kisah
 untuk membawa 
sukacita bagi orang lain dan menerima kesenangan 
belaka sebagai imbalan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_6_0004.text:
Kisah-kisah yang saya miliki ratusan dan ribuan!
Kisah yang mungkin benar, jika Anda menginginkannya.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_6_0005.text:
B-baiklah! Aku akan ... Aku akan mendengarkan 
apa yang kamu katakan.
Jadi, apa 'harta' ini? 
Mungkinkah itu peti harta karun?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_6_0006.text: HAW HAW! Itu tergantung pada KAMUU Tuan Heim!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_7_0002.text:
Saya mengatakan apa yang saya maksud 
dan saya maksud apa yang saya katakan! HAW HAW!
Harta bisa berarti kekayaan dan kekayaan. 
Itu bisa berarti sesuatu ... lagi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_7_0003.text: Maksudmu ... Itu bisa digunakan untuk tujuan lain?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_7_0004.text:
HAW HAW! PRIA YANG CERDASR TUAN HEIM!
Sifat 'harta' ini tergantung pada kemampuan pemiliknya.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_7_0005.text:
Siapa yang tahu? Mengapa berhenti di emas dan perak? 
Mengapa tidak seluruh benua?
Itu bisa menjadi apa pun yang Anda inginkan! HAW HAW!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_8_0002.text:
HAW HAW! Terserah pada tuan Heim, Tuan Heim 
yang pintar dan pemberani!
 Tidak ada kehidupan 
yang membosankan untuk Anda! 
Oh, kebosanan adalah hal yang buruk, ya itu, HAW HAW!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0001.text: Ha ha! Baik! Saatnya untuk mengucapkan selamat tinggal pada kehidupan lama saya yang membosankan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0002.text:
HAW HAW! Ya, ya, Tuan Heim yang baik!
Tidak ada kehidupan yang membosankan 
untuk Anda. Tidak, tentu saja!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0003.text:
Tapi ... ini adalah tempat kudus yang sedang kita bicarakan.
Sudah terlarang bagi kebanyakan orang untuk masuk. Mungkin ada penjaga ...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0005.text:
Oh, apakah Tuan Heim seorang pengecut? 
SEORANG PENGECUT!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0006.text:
Rumors and tales bear ghosts where there are none.
 Mountains out of molehills, dragons out of grass snakes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0006_1.text:
#For a snake to be the tales of dragons, 
it must cut the dragon and take whatever it is the most precious to him.#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0007.text:
Y-ya ... Kamu benar.
Saya hanya berhati-hati.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0008.text:
Oke! Setiap pahlawan membutuhkan kru yang terpercaya. 
Saya akan mulai mencari di  Tempat Suci. Segera 
dengan teman-teman saya! Selamat tinggal, kehidupan lama!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_1_001.text:
I shall never forgive...
I will make them pay...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_1_002.text:
I will break this seal
that took everything away from me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_2_001.text:
HAW HAW! He is right, he is right!
What did he do to suffer so? Tragic, tragic!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_2_002.text:
He only sought to earn money
to buy his ailing daughter some medicine!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_2_003.text:
And yet he was punished, encased in the ice for years.
And all for love! All for NOTHING! HAW HAW!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_2_004.text: What would she have thought, waiting for her father who'd never come back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_3_001.text:
How - how dare you speak of my daughter thus!
I'll rip out your eyes! Your face!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_3_002.text:
HAW HAW! How will you do so?
I am not the one trapped in the ice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_3_003.text:
Are you not angry? Do you not boil within?
Do you not loathe the Goddess, who burdened you with this fate?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_3_004.text:
What if I gave you a chance of...
retribution? To pay back what she has given you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_3_005.text:
What...? Who are you?
How do you mean to break this seal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_4_001.text:
What importance does it have to know who I am?
I am I, I am myself, I am here and there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_4_002.text:
What is important is YOUR hatred towards the Goddess!
And that you are not alone in your loathing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_4_003.text:
Now, Bjorn, Guardian of the Sacred Ground.
Will you not give me the 'Key to the Seal'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_4_005.text:
Yes, yes. It cursed you, it did!
The very bane of your fate, HAW HAW!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_4_006.text:
You, a Guardian, shall be able to resist the will of the Goddess
and give the key to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_4_007.text:
HAW HAW! Think of your daughter. Remember her face!
Remember the RAGE! THE TEARS! THE DEATH!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_5_002.text:
Finally... Finally!
Hundreds of years and this accursed thing did not even budge...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_5_003.text:
Now I will only have to wait
before this seal breaks open and I am FREE!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_6_001.text:
It has been a long time, Cora.
I have finally returned, and you must wait!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_6_002.text:
For I shall go hunting with my sharpened fangs -  
the jaws of Utgard shall pierce your throat before long!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_7_001.text:
So that clown was actually in disguise the whole time.
... Now that I think about it, I've heard that name before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_1_001.text:
Brr! It seems even colder inside!
If only there wasn't a blizzard raging outside...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_1_002.text:
Hmm, this block of ice seems peculiar.
Something seems to be inside...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_1_003.text: Haha, it almost seems like there's a human being inside...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_2_002.text:
I-is she alive?
Hey, erm, are you alright?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_001.text:
... The Sacred Ground...?
I... I remember the ice falling, and...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_002.text:
Thou saved me from the accursed ice.
... I offer thee my deepest thanks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_003.text:
I am Lakias,
Chieftain of the Tribe of the Winter Wind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_004.text: May I ask my savior his name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_005.text:
Er, m-my name is Sasquatch.
Did you say, the Tribe of the Winter Wind?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_006.text: I've never heard of such a tribe before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_007.text:
Thou jest, sir. Surely thou have seen my kinsmen
guarding these traitorous grounds?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_008.text:
And yet - thy attire is strange upon my eyes;
... Sir, what year is it by Snorri's Reckoning?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_009.text:
Snorri's Reckoning? What's that?
It's the 34th year of King Thor's reign.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_001.text:
Loath shall be the First Great King to hear such words!
The regnal year has changed without my knowing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_002.text:
...By the gods! How long have I tarried here,
locked within the ice? How many years?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_003.text:
... The Seal of the Sanctuary.
Can it be...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_004.text:
Master Sasquatch,
to thine good heart I do supplicate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_005.text:
Thou must aid me out of this cursed place
and take me to where I guide thee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_006.text:
Only the swiftness of our feet shall save
the fate of these lands, our kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_007.text:
Huh? Fate? What?
Argh, I really have a bad feeling about this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_008.text:
We must make haste!
Thine arms - quickly!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_5_001.text:
Snorri was the first sovereign of Nosgard.
How long has Lakias been sleeping in the ice, I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_2_001.text:
Odin! I have been looking for you.
You know well why I have come.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_2_002.text:
We of the Einherjar stand on your side of the rebellion
only in light of our pact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_2_003.text: We have kept our side of the promise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_2_004.text:
Our warriors are eager to taste the blood of our foes.
Every preparation is complete.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_2_005.text:
Why do you hesitate?
Surely your heart has not grown weak with caution?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_3_001.text:
Haha... I see that the warriors of Einherjar 
are sharper than the northern wind and hastier than the short spring.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_3_002.text:
Some battles must be fought with patience.
As not all wars can be won with pure valiance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_3_003.text: Haste shall only ruin what fate has promised us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_3_004.text:
My soldiers are searching for Freyja, your captain,
even as we speak. I too thus remain true to the pact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_3_005.text:
You are dismissed, Randgrid.
... And one more thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_3_006.text:
Show more respect to the man
who shall be the next king of Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_4_001.text:
...Ha! Then we shall be waiting.
Yet remember this, Odin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_4_002.text:
The Einherjar only swear fealty
to the glory of the battlefield, and nothing else!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_4_004.text:
Any longer, and we shall take matters into our own hands
and seek our lost honor by ourselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_5_002.text:
Slay the coward who disgraced the Einherjar
 And insulted the honor of our Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_6_002.text:
You were always so kind, my brother... And thus weak.
Yet the greater good always requires some sacrifice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_6_003.text:
Look at these lands! Our ancestors had to battle ice and snow
to claim these beautiful lands for their descendants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_6_004.text:
Our lands are proof of our people's might and glory!
The heritage that remains shining, brilliant and true!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_6_005.text:
And yet you! You, my weak-hearted brother, only grovel under the words 
of that Southerner Alexander. What honor is there to be found here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_7_001.text:
Remember the glory of the gods that blessed our people of Nosgard!
The undying flame that lights the skies to the north, the hearts of our kin!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_7_002.text:
I, Odin, heir of the divine bloodline that conquered the North Wind,
shall reclaim this honor! This glory! The rightful heritage for our people!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_8_001.text:
So Odin is planning a revolt.
Against his brother, no less...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_8_002.text: It seems blood will soon be shed in the northern lands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_10_002.text:
But... What can be the experiment
that Lyudmilla mentioned, I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_1_001.text:
It has been several years
since I escaped from Neth Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_1_002.text:
Yet once a traitor, always a traitor,
as the saying goes...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_1_003.text:
I hadn't thought they would chase me all the way deep into the mountains
of Nosgard, even after changing bases so many times...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_1_004.text:
... but I suppose it is my fault
for underestimating my former colleagues.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_1_005.text:
They must deem me a danger
as I remain the only fugitive who has knowledge of the experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_1_006.text: If only I can continue to remain here... Just like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_1_007.text:
Ahhh! Get away from me! 
I didn't do anything wrong!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_2_001.text:
Scanning complete. Results show signs of recent interaction
with traitor. Entering Interrogation Mode.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_3_003.text:
Argh... Thanks for saving me.
Normally I wouldn't have too much trouble with those invaders, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_3_004.text:
I'm embarrassed to admit it, 
but I was caught unawares while taking a nap.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_4_001.text:
But thanks to you, I'm okay now!
It's a relief you were where you were.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_5_001.text:
You mean to say that it's my fault.
It's my fault that you almost died today... and the countless times before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_5_002.text:
I will repeat once more:
you can leave me anytime, Sasquatch.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_5_003.text:
I... You helped me realize the crime I was committing in working for them.
I'm now trying to make up for my past, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_5_004.text:
I can't force you to stay with me any longer.
It will become only more dangerous from now on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_6_001.text: Lyudmilla, you really are an idiot, you know that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_6_002.text:
I told you over and over that
it was you who saved my life back then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_6_003.text:
And with you by my side,
I'm not lonely anymore. Not like before I met you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_6_004.text:
So stop blaming yourself, Lyudmilla.
It's time to go home. Together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_7_001.text: - Wait, or will we have to move again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_7_002.text: Aww, what a pity! I really did like our cottage this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_8_001.text:
But camping is always fun, don't you think?
We should try going deeper into the mountains this time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_9_003.text:
Then we need to hurry, Lyudmilla!
We have to find a place to sleep before the sun goes down!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_1_001.text: Daddy always used to say to me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_1_002.text:
If I want to travel to Mommy's home when she was a little girl
and see the northern lights like she did, I need to get better.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_1_003.text:
And if I want to get better, I need to go to bed
and sleep whenever I grow tired.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_1_004.text:
But tonight,
I don't feel like going to bed at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_2_001.text:
The winter wind is rattling all the windows...
It's been three days since the storm came.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_2_002.text:
I'm scared of the blizzard.
I'm scared of the night when I can't see anything...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_2_003.text:
But I'm most scared that Daddy hasn't come home yet
after he left to get my medicine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_3_001.text:
He's never been away
for this long...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_3_002.text:
Could something have happened?
When will he come back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_3_003.text:
I... I don't know what to do.
What should I do? I'm so scared, Daddy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_4_001.text:
Ines. My jewel, my sweetheart...
Whenever you grow scared or sick, remember this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_4_002.text:
Even if you grow scared of the dark or the harsh winds,
remember that, in the end, the winds will die down and the sun will rise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_4_003.text:
Someday, you will get better.
I promise you that, Ines.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_4_004.text:
Until then, you must be brave.
Do you remember the stories I used to tell you at bedtime?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_4_005.text:
If you keep brave, just like in those stories,
winter will end and spring will come.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_5_002.text: I'm the one who needs to be brave this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_5_003.text:
Just like the heroes in the stories
Daddy used to read to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_5_004.text:
I'm twelve years old today.
I'm not a little girl anymore!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_5_005.text: This time... I'll be the one who helps Daddy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_7_001.text:
The 'Cold Dream'... Today it amounts to no more than a bad cold,
but it was a highly feared disease back in the day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_7_002.text:
Winter nights in Nosgard
can be cruel beyond imagination.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_7_003.text:
I hope spring comes
to the brave girl and her father.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_001.text: I have kept you waiting for too long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_002.text: Many things have happened since then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_003.text:
Had it not been for the druid of your tribe,
the war would have continued for many more days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_004.text:
I know... You wouldn't have liked what I had done, back then.
Yet I couldn't stop myself in that moment, seeing you like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_005.text:
... But the war is now over. 
Peace has come to our people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_006.text:
There are many tasks yet ahead of us,
but our people will soon be joined as one,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_007.text:
under a single alliance...
As we have been hoping for such a long time, Alisha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_008.text: Roaming together the icy peaks and snowy fields of these lands...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_009.text: I only wish... You were here with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_001.text:
Oh... my sincerest apologies, Chief.
I... shouldn't have interrupted you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_002.text:
It's just...
Master Nazrune is looking for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_003.text:
He said it was an urgent matter...
I thought it best to bring it to your attention right away, Chief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_004.text:
And after all, it's a feast celebrating the peace treaty
between the two tribes! All thanks to you, Chief!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_005.text:
And we're all missing you out there.
But... I 'll come back later, Chief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_006.text: ... No. I was about to head back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_007.text:
I only came out for a breath of fresh air.
... It seems I was gone for too long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_008.text:
I'll follow soon.
Go on ahead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_009.text: Yes, Chief! I'll get going now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_4_001.text:
I think you should have this.
...Do you remember?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_4_002.text:
The first present I gave you after becoming one of the Wolf Guard.
A cheap little trinket... And yet you never took it off,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_4_003.text:
It was returned to me
after... after you left.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_4_004.text:
Keep it safe, Alisha...
Until we meet again, someday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_5_001.text:
That's a familiar-looking mask. The Wolf Tribe...
This story must have taken place a long time ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_5_002.text:
There are many tragic memories
buried in the snow-covered fields of Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_10_02.text:
He sounds angry.
Perhaps King Thor is paying a visit?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_10_03.text:
Perhaps, but it sounds more serious than that.
Let us go and see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_11_01.text: Do not make me repeat myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_11_02.text:
This is holy ground, not meant to be tread by filth like you.
If you do not retreat at once...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_11_03.text:
You shall be charged on the grounds of invasion and offences
against the royalty of Nosgard. I shall see to your punishment myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_11_04.text:
Our prince here can be a tad sensitive, but he's not wrong.
I too have no patience for rude intruders barging into our kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_11_05.text: It will serve you well to explain the meaning of your actions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_12_01.text:
Don't feign ignorance! 
Everything has already been confirmed by King Thor himself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_12_02.text:
Hand over the villain this instant,
and there will be no further reason for conflict!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_13_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, a villain?
I'd sooner call Prince Odin timid.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_14_01.text: What is the meaning of this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_15_01.text:
Yes. The dogs of Grancia seem to think
that they have every right to trespass on our kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_15_02.text:
Apparently, they are demanding {PLAYER_NAME}
for heinous crimes against the peace and safety of the continent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_16_02.text:
Heinous crimes?
Against the peace and safety of the continent?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_16_03.text:
Isn't {PLAYER_NAME} a hero
who saved the continent on numerous occasions?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_17_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} has already finished their business here
and departed some time ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_17_02.text: Lower your weapons. There is no need to resort to violence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_18_01.text:
So, you choose the hard way.
What proof do you have that you are not lying?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_18_02.text:
The official arrest warrant for {PLAYER_NAME}
will soon be delivered to King Thor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_18_03.text: Cooperate now, or you too will be branded as an accomplice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_18_04.text:
I return your question to you: 
what proof do you have that we are lying?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_18_05.text:
Seeing as you have already made up your mind,
I fear it will be a waste of everyone's time to repeat myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_18_06.text: As I will say this only once, listen to me carefully.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_18_07.text:
What you claim of {PLAYER_NAME} are mere allegations.
How are we to believe you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_18_08.text:
No other evidence currently proves their wrongdoing.
Why would we betray a friend of our kingdom?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_18_09.text:
We answer to our king alone.
And if you insist on demanding otherwise...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_19_01.text: We of Nosgard shall show you the fury of the north.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_1_02.text: We must usher in new beginnings with proper renovations to the city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_20_01.text:
G-Grancia...
Grancia will not stand for this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_20_02.text: Your king will soon receive the official warra-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_20_03.text:
Then you can request our cooperation then, in a manner
expected of an envoy from a neighboring kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_20_04.text: We will not tolerate such incivility as you have shown us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_20_05.text:
She is right, for once.
We have no reason to listen to invaders!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_20_06.text:
Raise your arms!
The time has come to prove your worth in honorable battle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_20_07.text: Do you enjoy making things more complicated, Prince?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_21_02.text:
Once you receive His Majesty's decree,
you will have to cooperate with the investigation!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_21_03.text: We shall cross that bridge when we come to it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_22_01.text: ... Why would Grancia do such a reckless thing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_22_02.text:
I've heard that Emperor Alexander can be unpredictable at times,
but he has never been known to act with such animosity towards his allies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_22_03.text: Did I not tell you? Nothing good shall come out of relying on foreigners.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_22_04.text:
That weak, bald fool of a brother...
I warned him we should remain wary of the south!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_22_05.text: Watch your words! I won't tolerate any insult to His Majesty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_23_01.text:
I may not know exactly what Grancia is planning,
but their intentions must be impure if they wish that hero captain harm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_23_02.text:
... Remember that not so much time has passed since you yourself
attempted to capture and kill {PLAYER_NAME} for your own needs.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_24_01.text:
... Ahem. I must look into this matter.
Wolfgang! We leave for the castle right away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_24_02.text:
Haha, you can't storm out whenever you're at a a loss for words!
Lady Lakias, please look after Elder Edda in our absence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_25_01.text:
If there are soldiers nearby, S-Sasquatch may be in danger as well.
Lakias, I must go and check on him!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_25_02.text: Yes, I will follow you soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_26_01.text: What can be the meaning of this? ... I fear a new storm brews in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_26_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}...
May the Winter Wind keep you safe from harm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_2_01.text: As I have said, I remain skeptical.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_2_02.text:
These new roads may provide better transport and communication,
as you've said - as well as an easy route for enemy use.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_2_03.text:
I still do not see why blizzards should be of any consequence to a true
Nosgardian. Why can we not maintain the structure of the old city -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_2_04.text: Not again! We've heard this before!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_2_05.text:
Traditions are important! I know it better than anyone.
But we can't linger in the past if we wish to look to the future.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_2_06.text: Argh, I don't understand why you refuse to listen, Prince.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_3_01.text:
And I refuse to believe your crass attitude towards your prince.
As for this blueprint, we shall discuss it again after some deliberation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_4_01.text: Lakias! I brought back the herbs you asked for.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_5_01.text: Ah, this is more than enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_5_02.text:
The weather has been rough of late.
Thank you for your trouble, Lyudmilla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_5_03.text:
Not at all. It's for Sasquatch, after all.
I'm grateful for your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_5_04.text:
It's only right that I look after you two.
He is the only family I have left.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_6_01.text: Did you not see for yourself before your departure, Lyudmilla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_7_01.text:
A-a whole day has passed since then. A lot can happen in a day...
He could fall ill again, especially in this cold weather -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_7_02.text:
You have nothing to fear. Sasquatch is my heir,
the true descendant of the Winter Wind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_7_03.text:
The winds of the north will only help him heal.
And you forget that we of Nosgard are hardier than we seem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_7_04.text:
He is recovering visibly, as you have seen.
He should come to his senses in a matter of days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_8_02.text: Then, seeing as there's time, I'll go check on Sasqua-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_10_01.text:
Ahem, ahem! I must go see check if - ahem!
If Wolfgang is seeing to his duties!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_11_01.text:
This is a shelter for victims of the last blizzard! People
here can take refuge from both their hunger and the cold.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_11_02.text:
They may have survived, but from the look of things, not
for long. Wolfgang, how far are we from the barracks?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_11_03.text:
Barracks? What barracks?
Prince Odin ordered for you to manage this shelter!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_01.text:
This shelter... with these weaklings? It can't be. Why would
His Highness...? No, you must be mistaken!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_02.text: I know for a fact that I'm not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_03.text:
No, no...
Prince Odin would have never sent me here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_05.text:
No! I wouldn't call it doubt… I'm simply finding it hard to
accept this order, that's all...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_06.text:
Oh, then this must be a case of insubordination.
You can return to Nosgard on your own, then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_08.text:
See. You know how difficult it will be for a dishonorable
traitor of the Royal Guard to survive in Snorri Edda.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_09.text:
Even if King Thor forgives you,
others won't be so merciful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_10.text:
Ha! For all the years we've known each other, 
Wolfgang, I never took you for a cruel man.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_11.text:
Hear me out, my friend. Can't you see that the Prince
means well? He has given you... a special mission!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_13.text:
Now look at these people, my good man,
and tell me what you see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_14.text:
They're refugees who failed against the never-ending war
against winter! Failures who cannot survive on their own!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_15.text:
No, look closer! Their potential! Men who could have become
true warriors but never found the proper helping hand...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_16.text:
... until now! Prince Odin recognized your gift, Hrolf,
and set you as their mentor, their chief, their captain!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_17.text:
You are the only man for this job, get it? Remember your
own past. You too were once a lumberman!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_12_18.text:
And what about now? One of the strongest, bravest
warriors in all of Nosgard!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_13_02.text:
Yes! Prince Odin must be secretly planning to raise an
army and strike Thor - with me training his troops!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_13_03.text:
Yes, yes, all is well!
I knew I was right to swear fealty to Prince Odin!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_13_04.text:
He can count on me! I will train these men into strong
warriors! Nobody and nothing will stop me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_15_01.text:
Listen up! I am Hrolf! And I am here to turn all of you bums
into strong warriors that the kingdom can be proud of!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_15_02.text:
On your feet!
We begin training - NOW!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_16_02.text:
Oh, by the grace of Snorri…
What new ordeals have found us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_16_03.text: I should have let myself be buried under that avalanche...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_17_01.text: Can't you hear me, you lazy louts? Follow me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_17_03.text:
Just... Kill me here... I do not have long to live. But
please give my portion of the rations to that child...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_17_04.text:
O old gods of the mountains...
Is this cruel fate truly what you wish upon us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_18_01.text:
Hrolf will need to adjust if he wants to embrace this new
future that he stumbled upon. How will he change, I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_1_01.text:
Well, it seems that Elder Edda is well on its way
to recovering its former glory!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_1_02.text: It won't be long before these lands are teeming with life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_1_04.text:
The road yet stretches far ahead of us.
We must be patient in our endeavors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_2_02.text: It's been awhile. How've you been?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_2_03.text:
I hear you no longer serve as the Captain of the Royal
Guard. How did you get here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_2_04.text:
Ha, news travels fast. Though I'm glad to see you, 
for now I've come to see His Highness, Prince Odin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_2_06.text:
I value our friendship,
but I can't let you simply meet him like that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_3_01.text:
No, I need to speak with His Highness myself!
Let me ask this favor of you, Wolfgang!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_4_01.text: You wished for my audience, and now you have it. Speak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_4_02.text:
Your Highness! I won't waste words. I'm the one who
led you to victory during the last civil war!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_4_05.text:
It was I who created confusion among the regiments
so that you, Your Highness, could enter the capital.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_4_06.text:
Had it not been for me, the Einherjar would have
fallen easily to the Royal Guard, sire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_4_07.text:
And why did you do that?
Were you not their Captain?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_4_08.text:
If I dare say so...
We didn't get along, the King and me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_4_10.text:
I couldn't bear to see the leader of Nosgard,
the honorable and powerful head of our kingdom,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_4_11.text:
grovel before others for petty supplies. What kind of
king is that? My heart followed him no longer!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_4_12.text:
I thought, if only Prince Odin led our kingdom! He
would restore Nosgard to its former glory!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_4_13.text:
I thought that we would become a mighty nation
that other kingdoms would fear to cross!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_5_01.text:
I lost to Thor. I have been vanquished.
That is why I am here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_5_02.text:
What business can a former Captain of the Guard
have with a powerless prince?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_5_03.text:
You are not powerless! The essence of strength
never changes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_5_04.text:
I only serve the strong! Strength is the only
important value worthy of pursuit!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_5_05.text: And what is your idea of strength?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_5_06.text:
Not letting weaklings obstruct your path!
And that is the reason I respect you, sire!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_5_07.text:
Please accept my services! Hrolf the 'Huscarl'
swears his allegiance to Prince Odin!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_6_01.text:
Wolfgang, lead him 'there'...
His old acquaintances will greet him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_7_01.text:
He may have an ulterior motive
for committing himself to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_7_02.text: He is genuine, if misdirected. I can see it in his eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_7_03.text: His obsession with strength... was not unfamiliar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_7_04.text:
Yes. We both have witnessed such unrestrained passion before.
And quite recently as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_8_01.text: I saw my past self in him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_8_02.text:
I couln't let him run headlong into committing the mistakes
that I once made. And I know he will, if no one helps him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_8_03.text: You are both still children, in that aspect.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_9_02.text:
Huhu, I'm merely jesting. You have changed, Odin.
You can now face the error of your past ways.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_9_9_03.text:
I can now genuinely say that I am happy to be
rebuilding Elder Edda with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_END_1_01.text:
Mommy...
Why are you taking {PLAYER_NAME}'s side?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_END_1_02.text:
How many times do I need to tell you? I'm not your mom!
Go back to your world!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_END_2_01.text:
S-stop staring at me with those eyes!
I-I didn't do anything wrong!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_END_3_02.text:
Mommy wants to protect me from danger.
That's why she's pretending to be so mean.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_END_3_03.text: ... Okay, you're really making me feel like the bad guy here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_END_3_04.text:
You're evil, {PLAYER_NAME}...
Why are you so strong...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_END_3_05.text:
You wait and see. I go for now, but soon I bring more powerful friends... 
and finally get what's mine!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_END_4_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}...
Sorry for the mess I made. Even if it wasn't my fault, exactly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_END_4_02.text:
Do you have any spare boards, by any chance?
I need to seal up this dimensional crack.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_END_4_03.text:
An Ent calling me 'mommy'...
Once is enough to feel scarred for life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_END_4_04.text:
Ugh. I only hope this barrier is enough
to stop them from coming over...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_1_01.text:
I am Anesidora. 
Once a fragment born of Pandora's darker emotions...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_1_02.text:
I was able to escape from the madness that controlled me
with {PLAYER_NAME}'s help and become a true being of my own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_1_03.text:
Yet a voice still haunts me...
Whispering that I must conquer Hasla and become its true ruler.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_1_04.text: Where can this voice be coming from?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_1_05.text:
I couldn't do anything but direct my steps towards the voice...
finally arriving at this place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_2_01.text:
...
Who knew there would be a place like this in the basement of the Library?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_2_02.text:
Hmm, a rift in the dimension...
It seems to be connected to another world...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_2_03.text: Can the voice be coming from beyond?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_3_01.text:
It opened...
W-what is this awful aura?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_3_02.text: This darkness... far surpasses that of Apostles...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_5_01.text:
...? Excuse me?
I-I'm not your mom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_5_02.text:
Me, called... #Apocalyptic Ent of Chaos#!
Me Monster Captain!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_5_03.text:
Mommy said, want to rule Hasla!
So, for Mommy's dream...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_5_04.text:
I conquered everything in my Hasla!
Now it's time to work on this Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_5_05.text:
My Hasla?' Can it be that when I separated from Pandora...
the world of Hasla too split in half?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_5_06.text:
A world that formerly existed as a mere possibility...
has become an alternate reality?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_6_01.text:
Mommy? Why look so sad?
{PLAYER_NAME} make you sad?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_6_03.text:
Erm, Apocalyptic... What was your name again?
Conquering Hasla isn't really my goal now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_6_04.text: So, erm. would you please return to the place you came from?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_6_05.text:
Mommy so nice, like in my dreams.
Mommy worried for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_6_06.text:
Don't worry! Many friends help me!
They follow me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_7_02.text: Say hi to my friends, Mommy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_7_03.text:
It's a pleasure to meet you, Ms. Ent.
I've heard so much about you from your son.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSRUSH_INTRO_7_04.text: You must be so proud of him!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARVE_RESULT.text:
Aku telah selesai memberi lambangnya. Sekarang, mau 
coba test senjata baru yang lebih kuat ini?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CARVE_SLOT_RESULT_SUCCESS.text:
I successfully added a Slot! Put in more materials
and fill up the progress bar to add a second Slot to the weapon!

I've added both Slots to the weapon!
All it needs now are Sigils to draw out its true potential!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_1_001.text:
Sudahkah kamu dengar {PLAYER_NAME}? Tamu Istimewa akan
datang dari Chen

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_1_003.text: Ah, Selamat Datang. Aku Lednas, dan ini adalah {PLAYER_NAME}

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_1_004.text:
Mohon maaf atas ketidaksopananku, tapi … 
siapakah yang bernama Lu He ?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_1_006.text:
dan ini adalah adikku
Lu Dongbin

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_1_007.text:
Guru kami sering memanggil kami Lu He,
singkatan dari nama depan kami

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_1_009.text:
Aku pikir… Tuan Lu
akan lebih tua darimu, Nona He

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_1_010.text:
Tampilan hanyalah sekedar topeng bagi Eternal Saints, 
apalagi bagi yang sudah mendekatinya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_1_011.text:
Adik He lebih tua dari saya, walaupun dia tampak lebih muda
dari saya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_1_012.text: Hohohoh, kami sering dianggap Guru dan Murid

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_1_013.text: Ah, kalau begitu … Apakah kamu mewakili Eternal Saints Chen …?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_1_014.text:
Ah, kami masih dalam pelatihan.
Kami belum menjadi Eternal Saints…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_1_015.text:
Akan lebih mudah untuk dimengerti bahwa kami adalah 
'Half Saints'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_1_016.text:
Kedatangan kami disini adalah bagian dari latihan kami.
Kami berharap kita dapat bersama sementara waktu ini

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_1_017.text: Ya! Selamat Datang sekali lagi, Nona He, Tuan Hu

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_2_002.text: Aku lihat kamu juga bermain Go

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_2_003.text: Ah benar, bermain Go adalah bagian dari pelatihan kami

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_2_005.text: Huhu, sepertinya cukup sulit untuk kamu pahami…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_2_006.text:
Guru kami mengajari kami untuk memperoleh kebijaksanaan 
tertinggi dengan bermain Go

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_2_007.text:
Untuk itulah kami berkelana ke penjuru negeri, bermain Go 
dimanapun kami berada

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_2_008.text: Manusia biasa tidak akan memahami tujuan kami

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_2_009.text: Baiklah .. Sepertinya perjuangan yang cukup berat

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_2_010.text:
Ya benar. Benar-benar sangat sulit, Sebuah ujian yang hanya 
bisa dilakukan oleh orang  yang suci dan bijak

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_2_011.text:
Manusia biasa… akan mengalami kesulitan. 
Memahami dunia spritual yang aku dan Adik He telah capai

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_2_012.text:
Kami juga harus mengalami perjuangan dan mengatasi 
berbagai ujian untuk mencapai kebijaksanaan yang kami miliki 
saat ini

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_2_013.text:
Butuh waktu seratus tahun latihan agar kami bisa menjadi 
seperti sekarang ini

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_2_015.text: Huhu… tidak semuanya dapat menjadi Eternal Saint

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_2_016.text: Selamat Tinggal!. Kami harus mencari lawan yang lain

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_001.text: Sepertinya tidak banyak orang yang bermain Go

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_002.text: Aku lihat kamu juga bermain Go

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_003.text: Ya.. Sepertinya tidak ada lagi orang yang bermain Go

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_004.text: Apakah ini saat bagi Kakak Lu dan aku untuk pergi

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_006.text: Ya. Masih banyak tempat yang harus kami tuju untuk berlatih

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_007.text:
Ah.. Sayang sekali. Aku berharap dapat belajar gerakan dari 
kalian berdua

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_008.text: Oh, nona Lednas. Kamu juga bermain Go?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_010.text: Tapi aku tidak begitu jago dalam hal itu

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_011.text:
Huhu.. Kalau begitu kami akan meluangkan waktu untuk 
satu pertandingan sebelum kami berangkat

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_012.text:
Oho.. Sebuah gerakan yang tidak umum yang kamu lakukan,
Nona Ksatria

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_014.text: Huhu… Kamu bermain lebih baik daripada yang kamu katakan

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_016.text:
Oh, itu bukan apa apa .. 
Itu Cuma keberuntungan pemula

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_019.text: Gerakan ini … lahir dari kebijakan terdalam dari Eternal Saints!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_022.text:
Mengagumkan, Lednas!
Aku tidak pernah kalah selain dari guru kami, sampai kamu..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_023.text: Bisakah aku meminta pertandingan ulang kapan-kapan ?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_3_024.text: Ah.. Tentu saja. Kapan saja kamu suka

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_001.text:
Sebuah permainan yang dimainkan dengan baik.
Terima kasih

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_002.text:
Saudaraku dan aku …
telah kalah 50 kali dari mu

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_003.text:
Bisa kukatakan bahwa itu adalah jumlah permainan yang
SANGAT banyak

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_004.text: Apa rahasia dari kemampuanmu? Aku harus tahu

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_005.text: Aku tidak tahu jika ini bisa disebut 'rahasia', tapi…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_006.text: Aku hanya memikirkan 1 hal didalam pikiranku

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_008.text:
Aku coba untuk tidak memikirkan kemenangan dan kekalahan
dan fokus pada tujuan utama dari permainan

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_009.text:
Bagaimana kamu tidak memikirkan kemenangan dan kekalahan?
Apakah Go bukan 'permainan' seperti yang kamu katakan ?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_010.text:
Aku rasakan setiap kali memainkan Go sebagai permainan 
menang dan kalah. Aku hanya melakukan gerakan menang pada setiap langkah

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_011.text:
Dengan setiap langkah untuk menang, aku terbutakan oleh 
makna sebenarnya dari permainan ini

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_013.text:
Dengan setiap langkah untuk menang, aku terbutakan oleh 
makna sebenarnya dari permainan ini

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_014.text:
Kenapa aku bermain? Untuk apa aku bermain? Aku tidak dapat 
berhenti untuk berpikir

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_015.text: Apa menurutmu arti sebenarnya dari Go nona Lednas?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_016.text:
Dengan setiap langkah, setiap pertandingan.. Entah kalah atau 
menang, aku bermain untuk belajar

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_017.text:
untuk belajar… untuk menerima hasil yang akan diterima,
dan mencapai kedamaian di jiwa dan pikiran

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_018.text:
tentu saja, aku paham semua orang memiliki tujuan 
yang berbeda saat bermain Go

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_020.text: Sepertinya kami telah melupakan sesuatu yang sangat penting

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_4_022.text:
Hohoho…
Kami telah belajar sesuatu yang luar biasa darimu, nona Ksatria

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_001.text:
Huhu .. Disini rupanya kalian berdua.
Kami mencari kalian berdua

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_003.text:
ini setelah pertandingan GO terakhir kami.
Kakak Lu dan aku mendapatkan pencerahan

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_004.text:
Tunggu.. Aku berpikir, guru kita … telah memberikan ujian 
baru kepada kita untuk kita lewati

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_005.text: Hohoho.. Ya.. Kami dulu adalah manusia, adik He

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_006.text:
Namun terbutakan karena menjadi 'Half Saints' membuat
kami tidak dapat melihat kebenaran

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_007.text: Sepertinya guru kami memiliki rencana untuk kami

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_009.text:
Huhu.. Dan guru kami berharap kami dapat melihat diri kami 
yang dulu.. Dan menemukan kebijakan yang kami butuhkan

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_010.text:
dan kakak Lu dan aku, dibutakan oleh kesombongan, telah 
bertarung untuk kemenangan semu selama bertahun-tahun belakangan ini

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_011.text:
Tujuan sebenarnya dari Go…. Sama seperti dengan tujuan 
kami menjadi Eternal Saints

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_012.text: Untuk mengetahui jalan kebijakan, tapi tidak mengungkapnya. Menerima kedamaian dan menjadi satu dengan aliran air

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_013.text:
Air termurni yang berada di atas aliran…. Ya itulah jalan untuk 
menjadi Eternal Saints

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_014.text:
Lednas, {PLAYER_NAME}
Aku berterima kasih kepada kalian berdua

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_015.text: Selamat karena kamu menemukan apa yang kalian cari

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_016.text: Kami harus kembali pulang kepada guru kami sekarang

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_017.text:
Dan kami masih berat untuk pergi…
Karena kami masih butuh latihan lagi

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_019.text:
Ya, tidak ada namanya berlebihan didalam Go. Terutama 
denganmu, nona bijak Lednas

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHAMP_CHEN_5_020.text:
Apakah tidak apa-apa jika kami tinggal lebih lama lagi?
Dan juga masih banyak langkah yang belum kami tunjukkan padamu

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHCOLA_EVENT_HELP_001.text:
Hi there! Feel free to ask me any questions
about the bakery!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_01_01.text: That's it, we've run out of ingredients for the day! Ouch.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_01_02.text:
I love that business is booming,
but baking bread all day does prove to be exhausting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_02_02.text:
Awww! But you must be tired too, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Thank you for your concern!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_03_02.text:
Heroes who fight real battles aren't fazed by baking, huh?
Your stamina and endurance are amazing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_03_03.text:
I wish I could be strong of both body and mind -
like you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_03_04.text:
I've been suffering muscle pain all week -
to the point that I haven't been sleeping much...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_03_05.text:
That's the reason I haven't been able to act my perky
self lately, even before the customers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_04_01.text:
Hee hee! I'm still happy that business is better than it
has been for weeks! Look! No leftovers today!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_04_02.text:
Thanks again! Let's continue doing our best for the
next few days as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_05_02.text:
Does that really help increase stamina?
Okay, if you say so.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_06_01.text:
Ouch! I think I just pulled a muscle. I've been having
pain in my back and arms for a few days now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_06_02.text: I guess that old saying is right: 'no pain, no gain.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_06_03.text:
Do you think I can become more athletic like you,
{PLAYER_NAME}, if I continue to exercise?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_07_01.text: Hee hee, really? I'm so happy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_07_02.text:
If it's okay with you, {PLAYER_NAME}, could you
teach me a few exercise routines I can do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_07_03.text:
I need to keep a bright face for my customers!
And for that, I need to train harder.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_08_01.text:
Another hard day's worth of work.
I can't wait to turn in.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_09_01.text:
Oh, tomorrow's ingredients have arrived.
How will I move all this to the storage?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_09_02.text: It's too late to call anyone...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_09_03.text:
... No! You have to be strong, Chocolat! You promised
yourself that you'd train harder, starting today!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_1_10_01.text:
... Huh?
I remember this box being heavier.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_01_01.text:
That reminds me,
the event at Chocolat's Bakery ends today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_01_02.text:
We have some free time on our hands -
just enough to pay them a visit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_02_01.text:
Were you cleaning up the store, {PLAYER_NAME}?
Let me help you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_02_02.text:
For some reason, you seem to have grown more...
muscular since I last saw you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_02_03.text:
I heard that baking employs your arm and core muscles.
In other words, baking is no easy business.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_03_01.text:
... But where's Chocolat?
Is she out on other business?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_04_02.text:
Do you guys work here?
Where's your boss? I need to see her, right away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_05_01.text:
I... don't.
Chocolat will be back soon, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_05_02.text: Can I help you with anything?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_05_03.text:
Well, YOU can't, because I have a bone to pick with HER!
That lying two-faced idiot who broke our pact!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_06_02.text: I'm ending this once and for all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_06_03.text:
YOU CAN'T HIDE, CHOCOLAT!
I'M GOING TO WAIT HERE UNTIL YOU COME OUT -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_06_04.text:
Please calm down. I... haven't grasped the full situation
yet, but shouting like that won't solve any problems.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_06_05.text:
Now, why don't you take a seat
and we can wait for Chocolat toget-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_07_02.text:
Why are you carrying around
that ridiculously large loaf of bread...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_07_04.text:
I'm sorry, but the shop is closed for the day
and I can't receive any more orders!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_07_05.text:
Ooh, but I can give you a sample of my newest recipe!
I tried out a new way of making dough...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_07_06.text:
... and look how it turned out! I wanted to see how big it
would grow, but I seem to have taken it a little too far.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_08_01.text:
No, thank you.
I've only come to see how you're doing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_08_02.text:
... However, that is a huge loaf of bread. Gigantic, even.
I never knew you were so strong, Chocolat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_08_03.text:
What do you need to do to dough
to end up with bread that size...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_08_04.text:
Huhuhu...
Don't underestimate the muscles of a baker!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_08_05.text:
The event helped me improve my baking skills and my
fitness as well! I have {PLAYER_NAME} to thank for this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_08_06.text: They taught me various exercise routines to do after work!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_09_01.text:
... I must see those exercises for myself. They must be
effective indeed for you to have made such progress.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_10_01.text: T-that was the only training you undertook...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_10_02.text:
... I remember now. Your father was the previous Champion
of the Colosseum, was he not?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_10_03.text: The family resemblance must run strong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_11_01.text:
... Whew.
I almost lost it back there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_11_02.text:
I don't care about ridiculously oversized bread!
Chocolat, I demand an explanation!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_11_04.text: I was under the impression that we had an agreement!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_11_05.text:
You sell sweet dessert; I sell savory bread!
And no infringing on the other's field of expertise!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_11_06.text:
In short, you're copying me
and MY bakery's healthy eating trends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_11_07.text: This is NOT what we agreed on!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_12_01.text: Oh, Demeter! Stop making such a fuss!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_12_02.text:
If you express your anger without inhibition like that,
your body releases stress hormones.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_12_03.text:
And if your body is subject to stress hormones for too
long, your muscles will start to weaken!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_12_04.text:
As a fellow baker, I can't let you
undergo such a terrible experience!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_13_02.text:
Come on,
we can talk while jogging.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_13_03.text:
A fresh breath of air will do you some good - relieve all
that stress AND build our stamina while we're at it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_13_05.text:
No, I'd rather not -
Eek! Let me go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_14_01.text:
Anyway... Back to the important stuff!
I was about to call you, Lednas!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_14_02.text: I have something to show you both.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_15_01.text:
Erm... I had an epiphany, you see.
Two weeks filled with endless waves of customers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_15_02.text:
My hands on fire with kneading and baking...
Countless nights of aching muscles and lack of sleep...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_15_04.text:
... and followed {PLAYER_NAME}'s advice
to start my training anew...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_16_03.text:
If I continue my training,
it'll be no time before I can fight

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_16_04.text:
like the great Lion Mask
and other countless heroes of the Colosseum!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_16_05.text:
Hee hee...
I'm also much more energetic when I work!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_16_06.text:
I never knew good posture, strong core muscles,
and regular training were so important!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_17_03.text:
I may have added some variety to my recipes
through this event, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_17_04.text:
They're still very sweet and - as much as I hate to
admit it - they're not the healthiest food in the world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_17_05.text: Now that I've come to this realization,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_17_06.text:
I can't continue to sell bread that even I don't want to
eat for all three meals of the day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_17_07.text:
I've decided that I want to continue widening my horizons
- discover new ingredients, make new recipes...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_17_08.text:
And... Whom to better share my adventures than you
and the Heroes of Hero Town, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_18_01.text:
Considering your current prowess,
I see no reason to keep you from joining us, Chocolat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_19_01.text:
Mm. As long as you don't venture out
to the more dangerous regions...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_19_02.text: I suppose the answer is yes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_20_01.text: YAY! Thank you for accepting me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_20_02.text:
I still have a long way to go,
but I'll do my best to be helpful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_20_03.text:
From this day on, Lednas and {PLAYER_NAME},
I look forward to being BOTH your baker and Hero!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_20_04.text:
I look forward to working with you,
Chocolat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_21_01.text:
... Don't make me stand around while you deliver your 
oddly touching speech over which I did not shed a tear!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_21_03.text:
I hear that rye bread is healthier than white bread
because it's a complex carbohydrate?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_21_04.text:
You're the greatest expert on rye bread I know.
That's why I wanted to ask for your advice, Demeter!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_21_05.text:
Why don't we go on a walk and we can have a deep and
meaningful conversation about our favorite subject: bread!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_21_07.text:
As I told you, healthy rye bread
is MY turf -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_21_08.text:
Then {PLAYER_NAME}, Lednas,
thank you for your help! I'll see you soon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_ENDING_1_21_09.text: Will you please listen to me?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_1_01.text:
Once you open the bakery, customers will come and
place their orders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_1_02.text:
You can earn lots of Bakery Coins and Stars
by baking and selling bread that fits the order!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_1_03.text:
Of course, failing to meet the customer's order
could result in no Coins and Stars.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_1_04.text:
The bakery will close after a certain number of customers.
You can receive a limited number orders per day!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_1_05.text:
Don't worry, you can resume business the following day.
You can use Jewels to reset the order limit once a day!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_2_01.text:
Oh, the actual baking process?
That's the most important question, actually!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_2_02.text:
After a customer places an order, you can bake bread by
cutting, kneading, selecting ingredients, and baking.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_2_03.text:
Press the red bar right in the middle of the dough
to cut it for a new loaf of bread. Simple, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_2_05.text:
connect all the lines in the indicated order
within the time limit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_2_06.text:
Hold down as you knead. Letting go will reset the lines.
Connecting the wrong buttons will result in the wrong answer!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_2_07.text:
To select the ingredients for your bread,
simply pick the ones you need from the list.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_2_08.text:
Please note that ingredients cost Coins
and you will be charged accordingly!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_2_10.text:
After these four simple steps - voila!
Your bread is done!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_2_11.text:
The amount of Bakery Coins and Stars you earn will be
decided by the accuracy with which you met the order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_2_12.text:
Wouldn't it be sad if you ended up with less Coins than
you started with? So try to bake the best bread possible!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_3_01.text:
Bakery Coins and Stars are an important aspect of your
business!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_3_02.text:
You need Bakery Coins
to purchase baking ingredients.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_3_03.text:
If you do not have enough Bakery Coins, the shop will
close for the day as you won't have enough ingredients.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_3_04.text:
There are 3 different ways to earn Bakery Coins: first,
you have the ones I gave you when you first opened shop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_3_05.text:
Second, sell the bread you bake! Keep in mind, though,
that you won't get paid for every single order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_3_06.text:
Third, clear Event Quests! Quests are reset every day,
so remember to check them out regularly!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_3_07.text: Stars indiciate the popularity of the bakery.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_3_08.text:
As you acquire more Stars, you'll unlock more ingredients -
which you can use to make even more expensive bread!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_4_01.text: You can't receive any more customers once the event ends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_4_02.text:
Instead, I'll exchange the Bakery Coins you've earned
for items you want from my shop!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_4_03.text:
Please spend all your Bakery Coins
and receive your rewards

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_4_04.text:
before the Reward Period ends
and the event closes for good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_01_01.text: 23... 17... And merely three customers this week...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_01_02.text:
I knew I wasn't mistaken!
What do I do with all this leftover bread?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_02_02.text: You don't seem to be doing so well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_02_03.text:
Hey, Bridget...
Business is bad these days, don't you think?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_02_04.text:
Sales have been declining,
and I can't figure out why...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_02_05.text: Oh? Erm, I didn't notice. Not for me, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_02_06.text:
Winter's on the horizon,
so sweaters and have been selling quite nicely.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_02_07.text:
Do you mean to say...
that I'm the only one having trouble?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_02_09.text:
Well, customers don't abandon a store without a reason.
Maybe you did something differently that they didn't like?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_02_10.text:
Of course not! I made sure my ingredients were of the
highest quality, I followed my recipes to the letter...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_02_11.text:
and I stocked the same bread
that I've been stocking every day since I took charge!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_03_03.text: If your business has been perfectly consistent up to this point

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_03_04.text:
and you've never changed any of your recipes or
ingredients, but sales continue to decline anyway...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_03_05.text:
Could your problem be the fact that your business has
been TOO consistent, without any changes whatsoever?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_03_06.text: So NOT changing is my problem?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_03_07.text: Well, nobody can go without food. You need to eat every day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_03_08.text:
However, if you had to eat the same kind of food, with the
same taste and same shape every day for every meal...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_03_09.text: wouldn't you grow tired of it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_04_01.text:
B-but... Chocolat's Bakery is beloved for its timelessness!
My recipes are old classics that haven't changed for years!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_04_02.text:
All my regulars love my bakery exactly for that reason:
the fact that they can eat the same recipe every day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_04_03.text:
Hmm... Why don't you try conducting a survey
on customer satisfaction, then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_04_04.text:
Alright! I'm still convinced that everyone loves the
timelessness of my bakery, but I'll do it just to make sure!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_04_05.text:
My customers probably have some problems of their own
that prevent them from coming... But I'll ask them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_05_01.text:
Oh, dear...
I hope the truth doesn't hurt her too much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_06_01.text:
'Grow tired of my bread'...
That's preposterous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_06_02.text:
Mr. Farmer from the neighboring village...
Mr. Gardener whom I've known for years...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_06_03.text:
Everyone complimented me
on the consistently soft and sweet flavor of my bread.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_06_06.text:
Hey there, Mr. Gardener.
Is it lunchtime for you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_07_01.text:
That's... one of my regular customers.
I don't recognize what he's eating...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_08_01.text:
Ooh, looks tasty.
What is it, though? I don't think I've seen it at the local bakery.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_08_02.text:
Oh, there's a new business that will deliver
freshly baked bread all the way from Pumpkin City.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_08_03.text:
Rainbow... something. Doesn't matter.
This is a 'walnut cream cheese bun,' and it's delicious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_08_04.text:
Weren't you watching your weight?
Cream buns aren't exactly thinning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_08_05.text:
Well... I tried cutting down completely,
but that didn't work out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_08_06.text:
The bread from this new bakery
is made of rye and full of nuts,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_08_07.text:
so all in all,
it's a much healthier food choice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_08_08.text:
Oh, is that so?
Looks delicious - you don't have to tell me twice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_08_09.text:
What was the name of the place again? I'm growing tired
of eating the same menu every day. Bloated, even.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_08_10.text:
Of course!
The name of the bakery is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_09_02.text:
I can't believe it. He always said my bread was the best
in the world!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_10_01.text:
Rye bread, schmye bread. I don't see what's so great
about grainy bread that will catch in your throat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_10_02.text:
It must be the novelty. I'm sure it'll be only a few days
before my regulars return and everyone's happy again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_12_02.text:
Oh, Chocolat... Good afternoon.
How can I help you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_12_03.text:
Hear me out, I just saw Mr. Gardener -
a regular at my bakery - eating -...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_13_03.text:
That, in your hand.
That bread... Where did you get it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_13_04.text:
Oh, I ended up working overtime today.
I bought a sandwich to save myself some time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_13_05.text:
It's quite yummy, considering it's supposed to be a quick
meal. Chock full of sausage and vegetables and cheese...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_14_02.text:
Huh?
Why are you staring at me like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_14_03.text:
Are you hungry? You can have a bite if you want - just
don't eat too mu-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_15_01.text:
That sandwich... ISN'T FROM MY BAKERY!
I-I can't believe it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_15_02.text:
You're just like the rest of them, Svenja!
All of you are liars, every single one of you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_17_01.text:
... That's why... I ended up losing my temper and
screaming at you. I-I'm sorry I yelled, Svenja.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_17_03.text:
However - rest assured! I still think that your desserts
are the most delicious in all of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_17_05.text:
Well... I hate to admit it, but I'm not growing any younger.
I can't fill myself up with sweets and carbs every day

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_17_07.text:
Sweet breads make for good dessert,
but sometimes I need a little more for a full meal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_18_01.text:
A-are you saying that my bread...
is lacking...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_18_03.text:
It's just that...
Maybe you could increase the variety of your wares.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_18_04.text:
Like pecan pie...
Or cream cheese buns. Yeah, those are my favorite.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_18_05.text:
But other bakeries are already selling those kinds of bread.
They even provide delivery service, to boot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_18_06.text:
What difference would I make
by hopping on the bandwagon?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_18_07.text: My bakery is doomed. I know it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_18_08.text:
Of course not! You've been baking delicious bread
for a long time, Chocolat. You have 'know-how.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_18_09.text:
I'm sure anything you do
will be special, in your own way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_18_10.text:
You never know. Maybe you could start with a few
different kinds of bread and then -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_18_11.text:
Different kinds of bread...
Wait a second!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_19_02.text:
I was suddenly struck by a great idea!
Svenja, listen to this...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_21_01.text:
Ah, yes. Everyone is especially lively today in Hero
Town - and for a good reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_21_02.text:
Chocolat is hosting
a special event at her bakery.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_21_03.text:
Apparently, she's receiving custom orders
for freshly baked bread straight out of the oven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_21_04.text:
Everyone seems to be excited about the wide variety
of the menu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_21_05.text:
I was about to pay her a visit.
Will you accompany me, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_22_01.text:
She'd be happy if you drop by,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_23_01.text:
How much longer do I have to wait?
I've been here for more than thirty minutes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_23_02.text:
Hey!
Don't cut in line! I can see you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_24_01.text:
There are more customers than I expected!
I wonder how Chocolat is managing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_25_01.text:
Eek, excuse me!
Here you go: one cream chestnut bun!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_25_02.text:
And you ordered a sausage chestnut bread, right?
Hope you enjoy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_25_03.text:
Please wait in line!
Oh, this way, please! Could you wait in order, please?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_26_02.text:
She seems to have too many customers
for her to handle alone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_26_03.text:
Lednas! Oh, and {PLAYER_NAME}, too!
Did you come to try some of my bread? I'm so happy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_26_04.text:
Hee hee, it's been a long time since this bakery had so
many customers. I am happy, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_27_01.text:
Hey!
When are you going to take my order?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_27_03.text:
If it's not too much trouble - and only if! -
I wanted to ask... erm...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_27_04.text:
whether there's anyone in Hero Town
who can give me a hand until the end of the event?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_28_01.text:
I won't lie. The job will be hard, and I need someone
who is strong enough to work from dawn to dusk

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_28_02.text:
and can withstand the heat of the kitchen. Oh, and also
friendly enough to impress the customers,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_28_03.text:
but not so friendly as to be considered a pushover.
My standards are a little high, but I'd appreciate the help!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_29_01.text:
Hmm. It does sound like a lot of work...
... Are you sure, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_30_01.text:
... I'll provide not only THE original chocolate donut recipe
that made my bakery famous...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_31_01.text:
... but also half of the profits I make every day!
Oh, and three free meals a day as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_31_02.text:
If you need anything else,
