we can make a deal!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_31_03.text:
Pretty please, with a cherry on top! Everything would
be better with your help, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_32_01.text:
R-really? You'll really help me?
Hooray!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_32_03.text: So it seems you've made up your mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_32_04.text:
Chocolat will greatly appreciate
your help, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_START_1_32_05.text:
I'll return to place my own order soon.
Good luck, both of you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_S2_EP2_CH3_6_10.text:
Aneh sekali. Aku ingat jelas bahwa kita mengusir mereka ...
Namun tidak ada informasi sesudahnya.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_S2_EP2_CH3_6_11.text: Perasaan ini ... Seolah-olah ingatan saya telah ...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_S2_EP2_CH3_6_12.text:
Saya minta maaf atas kelancangan saya, {PLAYER_NAME}, 
tapi anda harus
 pergi . Saya ingin berpikir

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_S2_EP2_CH3_6_2.text:
Ya ... Kalard.
Saatnya untuk memberi tahu anda siapa mereka.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_S2_EP2_CH3_6_3.text:
Aku sudah bilang bahwa mereka adalah Dewi
yang dibuang ke benua selatan seratus tahun yang lalu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_S2_EP2_CH3_6_4.text:
Mereka berbeda dari Elard yang kamu tahu karena 
kekuatan mereka tidak dibangkitkan oleh Elanuma.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_S2_EP2_CH3_6_5.text:
Kami gembira, berpikir bahwa kedatangan mereka adalah 
berkah Cora,
 kehendak Cora menghiasi tanah Hasla ...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_S2_EP2_CH3_6_6.text:
... tapi Kalard menolak untuk berperang melawan 
para Utusan Kegelapan

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_S2_EP2_CH3_6_7.text:
Mereka ingin 'melindungi' kemurnian pemberian Cora -
kemurnian cahaya, dengan mengorbankan segalanya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_S2_EP2_CH3_6_8.text:
Elanuma & Dionne sangat marah, 
Namun terlepas dari semua protes kami, Cora tetap diam.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_S2_EP2_CH3_6_9.text:
Kami tidak punya pilihan selain mengusir Dewi
yang kami anggap sebagai pengkhianat & munafik, dan ..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHRONOS_S2_EP2_CHALLENGE_.text:
Ar'rat ...
Dia adalah salah satu murid paling berbakat Elanuma.

Kekuatan besar yang harus diperhitungkan di medan perang,
terutama setelah kepergian Dionne yang tiba-tiba ...

Adalah Ar'rat yang menangkap Sylunis jahat karena 
mencuri Batu Jiwa

... Namun dokumen ini ...
 Apakah Anda bilang 
Anda menemukannya di Kuil Ilusi?

Jelas itu adalah perbuatannya, Ar'rat seharusnya 
tidak punya waktu
 untuk urusan semacam di saat itu

Bagian yang hilang dari teka-teki ini ... Mungkin bagian itu 
tersembunyi diantara kabut ingatanku ...

Sangat disayangkan bahwa tidak ada cahaya yang menuntun 
kita pada kebenaran … Sampai sekarang, itu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO01_1_01.text:
Ah, welcome. You must be the new Captain.
I've heard many great things about you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO01_1_02.text:
First things first: you must sign your contract, as procedure dictates.
I only need your signature - here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO01_2_02.text:
Ever since a few days ago, the monsters of the nearby forest
have turned more aggressive than usual.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO01_2_03.text:
I sent a scout to investigate,
but he still hasn't returned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO01_2_04.text: Please help me look for him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO02_1_01.text:
Hmm... The forest seems somehow different from usual.
I have a bad feeling about this. Let's hurry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO02_2_01.text: Yes... There's the scout I sent out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO02_2_03.text: Yet... Something seems off. We must be careful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO02_2_05.text:
We... follow... the Apostle's command...
Disappear... into darkness...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO02_3_01.text:
Be careful! Something's wrong with him!
Everyone, on guard!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO02_5_01.text:
Is he trying to escape?
Let's go after him!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO02_7_01.text:
She's still breathing.
Luckily it seems that she's only passed out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO02_8_02.text:
The soldiers are injured,
and we cannot leave a young girl alone, in this state.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO02_8_03.text: We must return to the village for the time being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO03_1_01.text: ... Who can she be, this girl?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO03_2_01.text: Gasp! W-where am I? A-and who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO03_2_02.text: A-are you corrupted as well? D-don't come near me, I-I...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO03_3_01.text:
Do what you will! I'm the next Goddess of the Forest,
and I won't go down without a fight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO03_4_01.text: ... Huh? I don't feel any darkness from you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO03_5_02.text:
My name is 'Sera.' I'm a Goddess -
well, I'm training to become the next Goddess of the Forest!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO03_5_03.text:
I am Lednas, the Captain of Hero Town.
And this is... {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO03_5_04.text:
Lednas and {PLAYER_NAME}!
Thank you for rescuing me back there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO03_6_01.text:
Wait, I remembered just now...
The Goddess of the Forest is in danger! Please, you must help me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO03_6_02.text: Goddess of the Forest? What do you mean?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO03_6_03.text: I-I don't have time to explain! We have to go right now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO03_7_01.text:
I'm not sure what exactly happened to that girl,
but she seems to need our help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CH_1_TUTO03_7_02.text:
Let's go after her.
Before we do so, let's first reorganize our troops.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_1_01.text:
Since Nyanma left, this Novel World
seems to have returned to normal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_1_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, Lednas!
You guys did a wonderful job!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_1_03.text: Although we couldn't feel anything change...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_1_04.text:
True, it does seem like there's some kind 
of blessing, protecting you guys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_1_05.text:
Well, thanks to that, we were able to enlist
your help, so everything worked out, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_2_01.text:
That seems so. I'll have to check in to see
if Fenrir and Fireaxe have returned to normal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_2_02.text:
Anyway, what will the Eto Rangers
being doing now...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_2_03.text:
Since we've accomplished our mission here,
it's time to return to Mugen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_2_04.text: I guess we've gotta start saying our farewells.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_2_05.text: We just became friends, too, moo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_2_06.text:
Yeah, it's sad, but {PLAYER_NAME} has
{PLAYER_NAME}'s own story to tell.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_2_07.text: Let's just pray for each other's well being!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_2_08.text:
It was too short, but I will never 
forget our time together, everyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_2_09.text:
If Jyarei Monsters ever return to Hasla,
you can count on us to return, Nyorori~!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_2_10.text:
Yeesh, Nyorori!
Don't jinx it with that Jyarei Monster stuff.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_3_01.text:
Then we'll be heading off now.
Everyone, stay strong and safe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_3_02.text:
Yes, please stay safe out there,
Eto Rangers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_4_01.text:
H-hey... this invoice...
It's not disappearing...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_4_02.text:
Yes...? No way, that invoice...
So it wasn't the doing of the Jyarei Monsters...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_4_03.text:
I, uh, kinda drank too much the night before... 
so...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_ENDING_4_04.text:
Huh? That means...
I really have to pay for this?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_1_01.text:
Dear Eto Rangers. A new fairytale has appeared in the
Novel Pillar that connects Mugen with heaven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_1_02.text:
But before we could figure out what it was,
Nyanma dashed into it and is now hiding.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_1_03.text:
If we leave it alone, that world may be destroyed
and the Novel Pillar might collapse.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_1_04.text:
You are our only hope. Please go into this world, defeat
Nyanma and her monsters, and return everything to normal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_2_01.text:
Oooh~! I'm fired up!
A new Novel World? I wonder what it's like!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_2_02.text:
Well regardless, I, Bakumaru,
will handle all the Jyarei Monsters!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_2_03.text:
What are you so happy about? And why didn't
the other six of us come, too?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_2_04.text:
Correct.
This isn't the time to fool around, Bakuma-ryu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_3_02.text:
This Novel World is a strange place where 
many stories are intermingled, ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_3_03.text:
So, Princess Aura has kept half of you back in Mugen
just in case, ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_4_01.text:
Jyarei Monsters as well as Nyanma?
This isn't going to be easy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_4_02.text:
Eeeh, I get the feeling this isn't going to be
as simple as I thought...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_4_03.text:
Don't worry, Bakumaru!
If we combine our powers, we can overcome anything!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_4_04.text:
Alrighty everyone, the long journey is over!
We have arrived at the destination, ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_5_01.text:
The name of this place is~
The world of 'Crusaders Quest,' ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_5_02.text:
Cru... what was it?
That's a pretty hard name, moo...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_5_04.text:
According to research, Crusaders Quest is a place
where Goddesses and Apostles are fighting over Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_5_05.text:
And a certain, {PLAYER_NAME}, is the main character 
of this story, ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_6_01.text:
But because of the Jyarei Monsters, the Heroes here
are starting to think that THEY are the main characters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_6_02.text:
You must meet this {PLAYER_NAME}, cooperate with
them, and find all the Jyarei Monsters, ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_6_03.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}... huh?
That's a pretty strong sounding name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_6_04.text:
We'll end the briefing here...
Shall we choose who will join the expedition, ryu?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_7_01.text:
The members for this round is~!
Bakumaru! Hols! Gao! The three of ryu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_INTRO_7_02.text: Alrighty then~ have a safe trip~!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_1_01.text:
Flamethrower for sale~!
Please buy a flamethrower! It'll keep you warm!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_1_02.text:
See this firepower? Matches are no match.
The times call for flamethrowers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_1_03.text:
But why is nobody buying a one from me?
I've already ordered 1000 of them...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_1_04.text:
This unfair world...
I will burn it down!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_1_05.text:
P-please calm down, Fireaxe!
Please don't point that this way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_2_01.text:
Ugh... oww~ my butt!
Darn Kirinda, couldn't he have set us down gently?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_2_02.text:
The Eto Rangers...! They've arrived already.
Looks like I should avoid them for now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_3_01.text:
Huh, I was sure there was someone here
a second ago... am I seeing things?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_3_02.text:
Who are you all?
What were you doing, falling from the sky...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_3_03.text: Oh, us? Fufu... don't be too surprised when we tell you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_3_04.text:
We are!
Twelve Warriors Explosive! Eto Rangers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_4_01.text: I... well... if you don't know, it's okay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_4_02.text:
Just know that we are defenders, here
to protect this Novel World!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_4_03.text:
We've come to fix stories that have been twisted up. Have
you seen any Heroes acting out of character recently?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_4_04.text:
Out of character... well, just now, the one that left...
Maybe Fireaxe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_4_05.text:
She started telling people to buy flamethrowers
and is currently on her way to burn everything down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_4_06.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} and I have been trying
to stop her but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_5_01.text:
Oh, what luck!
We've found one right off the bat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_5_02.text:
The Little Flamethrower Girl...
Is this a twisted version of The Little Match Girl?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_5_03.text:
Possibly. Also, did you just say you're {PLAYER_NAME}?
Kirinda said that's the name of this world's protagonist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_5_04.text:
Then if we follow these two,
They'll lead us to the Jyarei Monsters, moo~

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_6_02.text:
No no, don't worry about it!
Right. So... Fireaxe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_6_03.text:
Alright, we'll help you return this Fireaxe fellow
back to normal!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_6_05.text:
The truth is, {PLAYER_NAME} and I,
we've been looking for some help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_1_6_06.text:
It's nothing, we appreciate your help if anything!
Okay, let's go chase down these Jyarei Monsters!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_2_2_01.text: Your true identity has been revealed, Jyarei Monster!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_2_2_04.text:
We won't forgive those who want to destroy
peaceful Novel Worlds!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_2_4_01.text:
Ugh... where am I?
How did I get...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_2_4_03.text:
I feel like I had to sell something.
Ah, maybe it was a dream...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_2_5_01.text:
Invoice... for... 1000 flamethrowers...
WHAT IS THIS?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_2_5_02.text: Huh? Strange... everything should be returning to normal...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_2_5_03.text:
Ah! What if it's because Nyanma and other Jyarei
Monsters are still in this world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_2_5_04.text:
We've got to find and defeat them quickly
before Fireaxe goes bankrupt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_2_5_06.text:
Don't worry! We will protect this world and
your personal finances!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_2_6_01.text:
Bakumaryu, so you've taken one
Jyarei Monster out?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_2_6_02.text:
I've detected the other Jyarei Monsters.
Please ryuturn to the ship's bridge for now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_2_6_03.text:
Got it. Then, {PLAYER_NAME} and Lednas!
We'll see you in a bit!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE1_2_6_04.text:
Very well. We will also be looking for any
other suspicious movements.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_1_01.text:
Ryu have returned, Bakumaru.
Job well done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_1_02.text:
Great job Bakumaru!
You were amazing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_1_04.text:
Kirinda!
So where's the next Jyarei Monster?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_1_05.text:
Your next destination is~
A place called "Grancia" in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_1_06.text:
Now, why don't we decide who will go on this one?
Drumroll~~~

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_2_01.text:
This round goes to~!
Bakumaru! Cream! Drago! Nyorori! The four of you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_2_02.text:
What, I'm going right back out again?
I didn't even get to rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_2_03.text:
Hahaha, Bakumaru.
That is just the responsibility of a leader.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_2_04.text: Don't be such a wuss, nyorori~

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_2_05.text:
Please cut the chatter and go already.
See you all later, ryu~!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_3_01.text:
Huh? It's Lednas and {PLAYER_NAME}!
How'd you get here before us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_3_03.text:
We were looking around, and bumped into Fenrir. 
We're currently looking for Faust.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_3_04.text:
We should have just stuck with you guys,
it would have been faster than going back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_4_01.text:
I'm telling you, it's not Faust, it's my grandma!
I'm only trying to visit my sick grandma!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_4_02.text:
... As you can see, Fenrir seems to think that
she's someone in a certain fairytale.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_4_03.text:
This scenario...
It must be the Little Red Riding Hood, Nyorori!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_4_04.text:
Ooh, I know that story.
Little Red is on her way to visit grandma...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_5_02.text:
A jiangshi? 
Isn't it a wolf that chases Red Riding Hood?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_5_03.text:
Speaking of which, this Red Riding Hood
IS a wolf person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_5_04.text: I have no idea what is going on, nyorori!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_5_05.text:
Guuuh... Red Riding Hood...
Faust... Eat...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_6_02.text: It has to be heading to grandma's house!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_6_03.text: Although it's Faust, not someone's grandma.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_1_6_04.text:
Tch, regardless of who, if anyone gets eaten,
this Novel World will fall into chaos!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_10_01.text:
You've defeated the second Jyarei Monster!
Great job everyone, ryu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_10_02.text:
Also, Bakumaru!
We've located Nyanma, ryu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_10_03.text: Come back to the bridge and we'll strategize!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_10_04.text:
Really? Awesome, this will be the final battle!
Lednas, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_10_05.text:
We'll head to Kirinda for a bit,
please wait for us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_10_06.text:
Yes, the final battle...
 We will be preparing for it, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_1_02.text: Whew, that was a difficult opponent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_1_04.text:
Still not giving up?
You're pretty tough!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_1_05.text: This is the final blow! Take this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_2_01.text: Sw-sweetie! Oh no, what is all this?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_2_03.text:
What is that supposed to mean?
This jiangshi is your wife...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_2_04.text:
What? You ruffians! What's it to you
whether my wife is a jiangshi or not!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_2_05.text:
Something isn't right... if that jiangshi isn't
the Jyarei Monster, then who... hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_3_01.text:
No way...
"Red Riding Hood... Faust... Eat..."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_3_02.text:
Was she saying that Red Riding Hood
was the one trying to eat Faust?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_3_03.text:
Bah, better safe than sorry.
Take this, Revealing Mirror!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_4_01.text:
A-ha!
You've been revealed, Jyarei Monster!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_4_02.text:
Trying to get us to harm the other characters
by disguising yourself as Red Riding Hood!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_4_05.text:
We won't forgive those who want to destroy
peaceful Novel Worlds!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_6_01.text:
Urgh... where, am I?
What happened...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_8_01.text:
Where are those guys going now?
Did everything not return to normal yet?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_8_02.text:
Phew, it seems like Faust and Sien
have returned back to normal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_8_03.text:
That's "back to normal?"
Hrm... they must have a complicated relationship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_8_04.text:
How could this be, grandma is following
a jiangshi around...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_9_01.text:
It looks like there are still some things
left a little out of place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_9_02.text:
Then... must be defeat this "Nyanma" 
that was mentioned a while back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE3_2_9_03.text:
Hrm, Nyanma is no pushover.
We have to be prepared for anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_1_02.text:
Bakumaru, great deduction! I never would have 
thought the Red Riding Hood would be the villain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_1_04.text:
Now only one enemy is left.
... Nyanma!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_1_05.text:
She's going to be on another level
compared to the enemies up until now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_1_06.text: Will we really be able to win...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_1_07.text:
Don't worry! If we work together
Nothing can stand in our way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_1_08.text:
I mean, we even have reliable allies like 
{PLAYER_NAME} in this world!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_1_10.text:
Hoho, seems like everyone is fired up.
Then, let's decide who will deploy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_2_02.text:
Bakumaru, Hols, Gao, Cream, Drago, Nyorori!
The six of ryu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_2_04.text:
Since your opponent this time is strong,
shouldn't everyone go?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_2_05.text:
It makes sense, and while we're at it,
we should defeat her here, once and for all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_3_01.text:
Mm... there's no doubt about it, nya. The scent of
a cat washed in darkness is right here, nya.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_3_02.text:
It was definitely a good idea to get Mew's help.
To think someone was hiding here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_3_03.text:
Fufu, no cat can escape the great
Cat Master Mew, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_3_04.text: So, Nyanma is supposed to be here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_3_05.text:
That's right, nya. Well, my job is done,
so I will head out meow...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_5_01.text: Eh? I thought I just saw a green cat run by...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_5_02.text:
Ah... nothing to worry about.
That cat was about to go back home anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_5_03.text:
Huh... is that right? Anyway, it seems like
you guys are always here before us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_5_04.text:
As expected from the Heroes protecting
this Novel World, awesome!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_5_06.text:
That's right, it's the final battle!
Is everyone ready?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_5_07.text:
I can already feel Nyanma's
terrible darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_5_08.text: She must be dug in just up ahead!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_5_10.text:
Fufufufu... you annoying Eto Rangers.
You've finally arrived.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_6_01.text: I see you've taken good care of my Jyarei Monsters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_6_02.text: But I grow tired of your meddling.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_6_03.text:
Let's end our ill-fated relationship here and now,
Eto Rangers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_7_02.text:
Destroy the Eto Rangers and
lay waste to this Novel World!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_8_01.text:
The Jyarei Monsters have revived!
We're in trouble, nyororo!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_8_03.text:
Don't falter! We're not alone,
Lednas and {PLAYER_NAME} are here, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_8_04.text: We'll fight with everything we've got!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_1_8_05.text:
Yes, even though I'm lacking, I will 
fight with everything I have!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_2_1_01.text:
This is the end, Nyanma!
Give it up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_2_2_01.text: Ugh, how dare a whelp like you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_2_2_02.text:
Such arrogance,
just because you have some half-decent allies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_2_3_01.text:
What!? {PLAYER_NAME} helped us a bit,
but the Eto Rangers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_2_3_02.text:
Hah, your weak little ego is precisely why
you're nothing but a whelp! Take this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_2_4_03.text: u...ugh... I... I let my guard down...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_2_5_01.text:
Hmph, it'll be a million years before you can
lay a finger on Commander Nyanma!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_2_5_02.text:
I will look forward to putting an end to you
next time, Eto Rangers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_2_6_01.text:
Nyanma is running away!
How could this be...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_2_6_02.text:
That aside, is Bakumaru okay?
Oi, Bakumaru!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_2_6_03.text:
I'm okay... sorry.
We lost Nyanma because of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_2_6_04.text:
What are you saying, you saved this world from the 
Jyarei Monsters and Nyanma. Give yourself some credit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ER_STAGE5_2_7_01.text:
Eto Rangers.
Where Nyanma was just standing, a light...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH2_1_002.text:
And just in time, woof!
It was difficult reaching this hotshot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH2_1_003.text: Now, can we start the ritual, meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH2_1_004.text: Yes. I wrote the, erm, spell necessary for the ritual.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH2_1_005.text:
This spell... is a code that will connect us to the coordinates
of the being stuck in the Rift of the Dimensions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH2_1_006.text:
Throw that tool into the magic circle,
and the preparations will be complete.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH2_1_008.text: Should we start the ritual now, woof?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH2_2_002.text: Did the ritual just fail, woof?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH2_2_003.text:
No.
The ritual was a success.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_10_001.text:
Wow, you guys are a MESS.
And aren't you quoting the wrong franchise?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_10_002.text:
That dialogue is a p...'s,
but your based on St... W... and As... Cr... .

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_11_001.text:
Ah...! The For....! 
It is guiding me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_12_001.text:
The Sigil will... guide you.
Find the Shaman.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_13_001.text:
Wrong genre to the end, pathetic.
... And what's this thing about a shaman?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_14_001.text:
Hmm?! Were there more?
Today my wooden sword will feast on blood...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_15_001.text:
W-we aren't like them, meow!
Erm, I mean, woof!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_15_002.text:
No, we aren't woof! I mean, meow!
We're 'original,' meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_16_001.text:
But I think the other people of Hasla
are being affected, meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_16_002.text:
It seems that their consciousness
is mixing with something from the beyond, woof.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_16_003.text:
Other beings who seem very similar to them,
but come from other worlds and dimensions...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_1_001.text: But why is that giant face still up in the sky, woof?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_2_001.text: Ugh... My head feels like it's going to break apart...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_3_001.text:
Yes...
This isn't me. This isn't who I really am.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_3_002.text:
I feel as if... 
my true appearance has been stolen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_3_003.text:
My head wasn't this... ugly steel pot
just a few months ago!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_4_001.text:
Whew! Finishing that sentence
would have shaken Hasla to the core.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_5_001.text:
Yeah, me too...
This isn't my true identity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_5_002.text:
I remember now!!
I'm your friendly neighborhoo-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_6_001.text:
W-what is all this?
What's up with everybody?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_7_001.text: I... I can hear its whispers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_7_002.text:
Fight, Space Swordsman!
Do not let 'it' consume you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_7_004.text:
He has corrupted the K...! Your nerve cords
chain you to its will. They must be removed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_8_002.text: This body, all p...; are mine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH3_9_001.text:
I will shatter this corrupt cycle...
You shall not stand against me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_1_001.text:
Then... Is there no other way
to stop those 'other beings'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_1_002.text:
There's not much we can do here, woof.
We have to find the root of the problem, woof.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_1_003.text:
Hey, don't you feel like wearing special suits
and maybe... I don't know, go to a parallel universe, meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_1_004.text:
Meow! We could use... some like of particle...
And oh! We could decide on a team name, like the Ave-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_1_005.text:
... Watch yourself, woof. All these references
are REALLY going to cost Hasla, woof. Literally.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_2_001.text:
Oh! Now that I think about it,
we do have a lead to follow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_2_003.text: Remember what Keyab told us, woof?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_2_004.text:
I need your help, Lupeow, woof.
We need to find a person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_3_001.text:
... I see.
So that is why you came searching for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_3_002.text:
Through my powers, I will attempt 
to connect to that divine being in the sky.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_3_004.text:
What's the matter, woof?
Is there something you need?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_3_005.text:
... Some space, if you please.
I need more space to perform my rites of spiritual manifestation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_3_006.text:
Alright, meow!
We'll back off, meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_3_007.text:
And please be quiet.
I cannot concentrate...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_3_008.text: Okay! We'll shut up too, woof!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_3_009.text:
The being that has suddenly appeared in the heavens of Hasla
to fill human hearts with fear and dismay...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_3_010.text: I shall now attempt to connect to it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_4_002.text: Eew!! That's disgusting! And scary, meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_4_003.text:
T-there's nothing we can do about it!
Hang in there, woof!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_5_001.text:
Erm, is anyone there?
Can you hear me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_5_003.text:
Oh, what a relief. I thought this green circle would go on forever.
I'm the PD of Secret Company LC, Sung...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_5_004.text:
Oh, no. No.. It's already here!
No, no, no, no, nooooo!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_6_002.text: What's happening all of a sudden, woof!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_6_003.text:
Stop your foolish struggling
and accept your fate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_6_004.text:
I am the one who shall
soon become lord over all of this dimension...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_6_005.text:
With the power of the PD of LC...
This power to change everything in this world...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_6_007.text:
We still don't know who you are, but...
Do you think it'll really be that easy, meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_6_008.text:
Then struggle -
struggle all you want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_7_001.text:
So it wasn't the being in the sky
who was the problem, woof!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_7_002.text:
Seems there's another evil mastermind
behind this whole mess, meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_7_003.text: I'm still not really sure what 'PD' or 'LC' means, woof...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_7_004.text:
But it seems that someone is trying to conquer Hasla
while he's trapped in the Rift of the Dimensions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH4_7_005.text:
Grr... We can't just stand around doing nothing, meow!
We have to stop them, whoever they are!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_1_002.text: Will it solve everything at last, meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_2_001.text:
How dare you...!
How dare you ruin my plans!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_3_001.text:
That dazzling light...
I think we did it! We saved Hasla, meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_3_002.text:
The handsome visage in the heavens
is shining brilliantly to dazzle my eyes, woof!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_3_004.text:
Here's a tip: sometimes it pays to sneak in a little compliment
here and there to the admins, 'kay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_3_005.text:
Ahem. I-I mean,
it was a slip of the tongue, woof!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_3_006.text: So, did we stop it? Is it gone, meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_4_001.text: Did you really think that you stopped me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_4_002.text: Did you think... that you 'defeated' me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_4_003.text:
Not at all.
It's simply time for me to show my true self.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_4_004.text:
Was it you, woof?!
Reveal yourself, woof!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_4_006.text:
I am Anesidora.
And yes, it was a trap!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_5_001.text:
Another warp in the dimension...
Leave here to me and my wooden sword.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_5_002.text:
Go, Jim...
Er, I mean, Dox... Go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_5_003.text: I started working on this plan from five years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_5_004.text:
Out of the hundreds who attempted
to conquer this dimension since then...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_5_005.text: I'm the only one who came this far.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_5_006.text: How was I so successful, you ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_5_007.text:
In the Great Pumpkin War, I crushed those whales
who spent all their Markers on territory already captured 100%...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_5_008.text:
I kidnapped Popo and Toto over and over to prevent 
potential Colosseum winners from buying too many tickets...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_5_009.text:
I caught those shameless ones who cheated the server
in order to hoard all the good Sigils for themselves...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH5_5_010.text:
... and I deleted them ALL.
And where's MY Hero Selection Ticket? Huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_1_001.text:
The presence in the sky...
I can't sense him any longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_1_002.text:
I was using all my strength
to stop him from overstepping into Hasla...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_1_003.text: ...and couldn't help you at all. I'm sorry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_1_004.text:
Anesidora... is another version of myself.
Or rather, myself as I could have been...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_1_005.text:
Myself as I would have been in another dimension,
if I had been lost to my deepest and darkest emotions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_1_006.text:
Under normal circumstances,
she should have existed only as an unrealized possibility.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_1_007.text:
It was the chaos we just experienced
that materialized her into a separate entity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_1_008.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. If it's okay with you,
could she stay with you in Hero Town?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_1_009.text:
Huhu, thank you. Under your care, she'll affect
the laws of causality of this dimension to the minimum.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_1_011.text:
Oh, no. Look at the time...
I can't interfere in this timeline any longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_1_012.text:
A moment more and the one closing the Rift of Dimensions
may discover us, and we don't want that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_2_001.text:
Ah. I almost forgot to say goodbye,
like I always do in the Library.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_2_002.text:
Please send my gratitude to the two 
who helped us clean up this mess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_2_003.text:
As for us, {PLAYER_NAME}...
There's no need for farewells, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH6_2_004.text:
I'll always be waiting in the Library of Dimensions,
wherever or whenever you are.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_1_001.text: Hmm... I'm sensing another shift among the dimensions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_1_002.text:
It could be another visitor to Hasla from another world.
... Don't you think there's been too many 'guests' for some time now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_2_001.text: ! This... This is no ordinary dimension transference!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_2_002.text:
Whatever it is, it's strong enough to cause cracks
in the boundaries between the dimensions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_2_003.text: Its presence alone emits a formidable power...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_2_004.text:
As soon as he sets foot into Hasla,
this world will be gone as we know it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_2_005.text: I must use the power of time and dimensions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_4_001.text:
Ugh...!
This strength... far outpowers mine...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_4_002.text: Who - or what - could be wielding such power?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_4_003.text:
I barely succeeded containing it
in the Rift of the Dimensions, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_4_004.text: ... my powers won't be enough to keep it there for good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_4_005.text:
The slightest break in my concentration
will free the being to rampage throughout Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_5_001.text:
I found you at last, woof!
You cat thief!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_6_002.text:
As if I would!
I'm never letting you go free again, woof!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_7_002.text:
T-this is no time to be fighting, woof!
That seems to be a case on our hands!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_7_003.text:
You there. Let's call a truce for the time being and cooperate.
... Woof!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_7_004.text: ... Did you almost forget to say 'woof' just now, meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_7_005.text:
Well! I suppose I can play the good cat 
just this one time and work together!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_7_006.text:
Actually, I know just the person
for this kind of trouble, meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT5TH_INTRO_7_007.text:
You mean {PLAYER_NAME}, right, woof?
Alright, let's go and find them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_2019_FOOLSDAY_END_2.text: I dream of becoming a beloved star.
Yet here I stand, alone and small,
If I only had an audience, near or far...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_2019_FOOLSDAY_END_3.text: Transform him from man's best friend to a real man!
Huh? How do we do that, you ask?

Well, if werewolves are humans who turn into dogs,
why not the other way around?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_2019_FOOLSDAY_OP_1.text: Once upon a time, in the lands of Hasla far, far away...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_2019_FOOLSDAY_OP_2.text: Before the discovery of Books of Inheritance, we monsters lived in happiness and harmony.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_2019_FOOLSDAY_OP_3.text: Yet this happiness did not last for very long...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_2019_FOOLSDAY_OP_4.text:
For greedy Heroes, seeking to steal Books and other treasure,
began to invade your - no, our! - territory and attack us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_2019_FOOLSDAY_OP_5.text:
Now, rise, O Champion of Monsters!
No longer shall we suffer under the tyranny of humans!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_2019_FOOLSDAY_OP_6.text:
Go forth and drive out the monstrous Heroes blinded by their greed
and recover peace to the world of Monsters!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_2019_FOOLSDAY_OP_7.text:
Keep a brave front!
The fate of the world of Monsters lies in your hands!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_2019_FOOLSDAY_OP_8.text:
May you, O Champion, finally bring peace to our chaotic world
and save us all from doom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_2019_FOOLSDAY_START.text: I only seek to dance my life away...
It is my one and only joy in life,
To dance beyond sorrow and strife!
I dream of dancing before you all,
Anubisis only hopes the best for you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Then how can we account for his poor behavior?

Always barking at people and making a mess…
He really can be a nuisance, that Anubisis.
What should we do in such a situation? There's a simple solution.
The old regime has given way to revolution.
Press a block to pay respects.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_01_1_1_0.text: ... Huh. I suddenly had a very bad premonition.

Let's see... Today's date is...
Ah, the Chrona Heroes will be visiting today.
Sigh... If only people were as easy to deal with as books...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_01_1_2_0.text:
H-how is this possible?
The last time I came through this back alley, there was nothing here!

The Library of Dimensions is situated in a crack between dimensions.
The entrance usually can't be seen by ordinary people.

I too only discovered it after
inheriting Goddess Elanuma's memories and strength.

You weren't 'visiting' as so much as 'trespassing on private property,'
but I'll let that slide.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_01_1_3_0.text:
Ever since she accidentally stumbled into my library some years ago,
she's been coming back to replay images of her sleeping #sister#.
Y-you said you'd keep it a secret!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_01_1_4_0.text: So. What business brings you here?

Oh, we were told that you could show us records of the past,
Ms. Librarian!

We wanted to see who contributed the most
towards our victory in the Apostles War one hundred years ago!
... Really? You're putting me through all this trouble for a bet?

Well, going through past archives usually doesn't do any harm,
as they don't affect the timeline of the dimension.

However, the Apostles War is an exception. It can't be read -
an #unknown stronger force# seems to be interfering with it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_01_1_5_0.text: Then is there no way to find out the truth of the past?
We could view the memories of everyone here instead.

You all lead different lives now,
but in the past life you were the Chrona Heroes.

To the extent of my knowledge,
you still have your memories of your former lives intact.

I can display them for everyone in a visual representation.
Simply compare them, and we should have the truth - or a version of it.

Oh~ I get it now.
Then let's start with Oren's memory!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_01_1_5_1.text: ... Why do I always have to take the lead?

It could hurt - or it could be embarrassing to the verge of being painful.
Go set an example for the rest of us, 'Captain'!

... Sigh... Fine, fine.
It would be better to get this over with, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_01_1_6_0.text:
What are you, a kid?
I thought you called yourself a hero.

Never mind. Let's begin. I want you to think of the time
when you were Oren, one hundred years ago.

One hundred years ago... One hundred years ago...
I'm not Leon... I'm Oren...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_01_2_1_0.text: Wow, I wasn't expecting past life regression therapy to be like this.

Everything felt so real - almost as if I'd been taken back in time
to the day of the Apostles War -

Real? If that was 'real' to you,
you might need real therapy, Leon.
Does everything appear like that in your eyes...? Even now?
Wh-what did I do wrong this time?

And you only seem to remember your own actions in battle.
What about the rest of us?

And 'Manacar'?
When did we ever fight a living statue?
What about Destalos? That was our 'thing.'

I - I was really tired when I fought Destalos!
I'd spent up the last of my strength and was doing everything not to faint!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_01_2_1_1.text: I can't accept such a disoriented memory as the truth!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_01_2_2_0.text:
Huh... So, deterioration and storage of memory depend on
the subject's perception of themselves and the world.
What is that supposed to mean?

Simply put, the same events may be remembered
differently by different people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_01_2_3_0.text:
If that's the case, then we Elves should have the best memory,
since we live the longest. Why don't we look at my memories next?

Oh, but if you live longer, wouldn't that rather mean
that it's possible that you... tend to forget more things?
What are you implying? Are you calling me senile?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_01_2_4_0.text:
Stop fighting.
I'll get to all of you in time.
I'll start with the memory of whoever wants to go first, so come here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_03_1_1_0.text:
That was Sigruna and D'Artagnan's memory.
What do you think?

I don't even need to hear everyone else's answer.
This representation of the Apostles War can't get any more accurate.

Hmm... My own feats in battle went slightly less noticed
than how I remember them, but I approve.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_03_1_2_0.text:
'Can't get any more accurate'? 
When did we ever fight against the Ratmen?

Dalton, your more recent memories in Trista
must be mixed up with those of the Apostles War!

And the Apostle who appeared in your memory
was El Thalnos, not Destalos.
Then again, Sigruna never did get far enough to face Destalos.

You gave me a hard time for THIS?
I guess you all don't remember what you looked like back then!
Were those squiggly drawings supposed to be us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_03_1_3_0.text:
It is time to examine the memory of the one who stood by Goddess Chronos
and watched the battle unfold with precision: Archana.

You seem confident.
But will you prove any different from the rest of us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_03_1_4_0.text:
You forget that I was the first one
who remembered our original identities as the Chrona Heroes.

Does it not follow that I should have the best memory among us?
Shall we start?

... Then I'll begin the process.
Lean forward, and put your head here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_03_2_1_0.text: Why are you looking at me like that?
Archana... Do you not realize what's wrong?

Erm, why were there three Destaloses
in your memory?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_03_2_2_0.text:
One hundred years ago, I witnessed our victory against Destalos,
as well as the sacrifice we had to make to gain it.

However...
There was one thing I still could not understand.

How can it be that the great Goddess Elanuma and Vice Captain Oren
struggled against a -single- Apostle, as powerful as they may be?

And if we consider the fact that we had the Deadly Gunner Dalton
and the Great Sorcerer Roxanna - no, no, it doesn't make sense at all.

The numbers simply don't add up. And so I pondered - and pondered.
With my infallible powers of deduction, I finally arrived at the truth.
There were two more Destaloses that day on the battlefield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_03_2_3_0.text:
Erm, thank you for thinking so highly of us, Archana,
but that's a... a very disturbing conclusion you've arrived there.

Destalos was only #one# of the #first three Apostles#.
They weren't all three.
But that is the only logical conclus-

Archana... I thought she was the most normal one among us.
I was wrong. She's the most insane.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_03_2_4_0.text:
It seems that nobody here
remembers what truly happened that day.

Then there is nothing to be done... but to show you my memory,
which remains perfectly intact without deterioration.

...Yours, too? Hmm... I don't know...
I'm not sure how I feel about looking into a Goddess's memory...

I know why you hesitate. Perfect memory is one of our powers
as a Goddess - we remember everything, no matter how trivial.

When I first inherited Goddess Elanuma's memories -
which were worth hundreds of years - I almost fainted under their weight.

... No, that's not it. It's just that in the past,
Goddesses tended to say a lot of corny things.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_03_2_5_0.text:
But I suppose this is the only way I will get you all out of my library.
Now, come here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_05_1_1_0.text:
Now then...
How did you find Goddess Elanuma's memory?
Hmm, I have to admit, it was much clearer than the rest of ours.

It was great! I liked how you - I mean, she was so brave
before the oncoming darkness!

Did you see how Destalos couldn't say anything?
Boy, he looked stupid!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_05_1_2_0.text:
Look - your 'light' is such a frail, weak thing.
And yet you seek to fight the darkness. With what hope?

Uh, okay!
I'm really sorry for all the trouble!

An Apostle who only chases after shadows
wouldn't be able to understand...

Light... Light is... erm... It raises - no... supports - no...
Anyway, it's why we could come so far!

It is the will of me, my comrades, and... everyone else?
Erm, that's light! And that's the end of my speech!
I didn't know that! Thank you for your insight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_05_1_3_0.text:
And THEN - I raised my big and beautiful crystal sword 'Danan'
and with a single strike, destroyed Destalos! And we won!

Well, everyone except Goddess Elanuma, who had to sacrifice her soul
and being due to the Apostle's last ditch attempt to live.

I see... I'd already been knocked down then,
so it is the first time I'm hearing about this.

Hmm... Then the person who contributed the most in the war...
is Goddess Elanuma.
As loath as I am to admit it... You were right all along, Goddess.

No. As I have been telling you from the very beginning,
judging each other like this serves nothing.

We only won the war because everyone was here, fulfilling their duty.
Had a single person been missing, we wouldn't have been able to fight.

So that was your intention all along...
To teach us a lesson of true comradeship.

Sylunis... I didn't know you were so deep.
I should have never doubted your true intentions of bringing us here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_05_1_3_1.text:
... I have had enough.
It is one thing to suffer defeat, another to suffer such defamation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_05_1_4_0.text:
Librarian! What is the meaning of this?
You shall pay for hiding an Apostle in the depths of your lair!

No, no, let's not start accusing each other. That is just a 'record'
of Destalos. It can't cause any harm to the real world.
However... This is an interesting turn of events.

My records have never 'expressed' themselves
in that way... They are usually bound to the memories of their existence.

Then again, this is the record of the one of the first three Apostles.
It still manages to exceed my expectations.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_05_1_5_0.text:
You dogs of light...
History may be written by the victors, but...

I am sick and tired of your distorting and revising the past,
as if your version of events is the one and only absolute truth!
Look closely... and know the truth of that day!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_05_2_1_0.text: This... So this is the true power of darkness! That being -
So you have come. The ones who struggle against the inevitable void...

The ones foolish enough to think this feeble light will save them,
when the only path that remains is to submit to the truth of darkness.
You shall not have your way, Darkness!

Look - your 'light' is such a frail, weak thing.
And yet you seek to fight the darkness. With what hope?

'Insult'...
Then tell me. What is light?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_05_2_2_0.text:
I guess an Apostle who only chases after shadows
could feel that way.

Light... Light is the reason to live. It raises us up and supports us
in times of darkness. It is the reason why we could come so far!

It is the will of me, my comrades, and all living beings
who have vowed to resist the darkness and continue to face the future!
That is the true meaning... of light!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_05_2_3_0.text:
Do you know how painful it is to live
with an embarrassing memory like that?

And when Oren suddenly started making that speech in the middle
of the battlefield... I just wanted Destalos to kill me there and then.

The real reason why Chronos didn't come today?
Because she didn't want to be reminded of... of THAT!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_05_2_4_0.text: You can't blame me for something like that!
Well... Oren did have a dramatic flair that bordered on the ridiculous.

Now that you mention it, I do recall other Heroes mentioning
a certain 'poem' by Oren in his #Book of Inheritance#.
Is that so? I must get my hands on a volume, then.

Fine! Tease me all you want! You can't embarrass me!
I refuse to be embarrassed for being true to myself in poetic expression!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_05_2_5_0.text:
Yes... Then that is enough. What is truly important is to overcome
the shameful memories of one's dark past and look to the future...
Now I can finally acknowledge you as the Hero who overthrew me.

In the far future... When I am revived in the 'real world'...
I shall enjoy our fated battle.

Oh, erm. {PLAYER_NAME} already DID defeat you in the future
surprisingly easily, but - okay! Whatever you say!

... What? Wait, someone else already DEFEATED me? Then what am I -
w-wait! Give me a minute here to deal with an existential crisis! Argh -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_05_2_6_0.text: ... So... Should we head back now?

Stop looking so glum, Leon.
As you kept insisting, you were the star of the show.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_05_2_7_0.text:
Haha, today's records were especially enjoyable.
This is why I can't stop reading stories from Hasla.
The folly of one man is the fortune of another, as the saying goes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_1_01.text:
Hey, everyone! It's been a long time!
How've you been?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_1_02.text:
Thanks for attending the first-ever 'Chrona Heroes Reunion'!
Well... Everyone except Goddess Chronos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_1_03.text:
Goddess Chronos is busy with imperial affairs at Impalis.
She told me to send her regards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_1_04.text:
And also Goddess Elanuma, who - as you all know...
erm, died in the last battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_1_05.text:
Oh, stop ruining the mood.
It's not like all of us gathered often in our past lives.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_1_06.text:
I - I'm not Goddess Elanuma herself, but as I've inherited
her memory and powers, I will do my best to alleviate her absence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_1_07.text:
Yes... The war... I remember... Back then it was common for a comrade
to be standing by your side one day... Buried in the ground the other...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_2_01.text:
Oh, lighten up, everyone.
And Kuhilim, this is not the time nor place for sorrowful reminiscences!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_2_02.text:
I apologize.
It hasn't been long since I recovered my former memories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_2_03.text:
Anyway, Oren.
Oh, is it 'Leon' now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_2_04.text:
You haven't aged a day since we last saw you.
Or rather, you seem to have grown younger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_2_07.text:
Oh, really? It seems I'm the older one in this life.
Huhuhu... Why don't you try calling me 'Elder Sister'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_2_09.text:
Why? She isn't wrong;
you should treat your seniors with some respect.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_3_01.text:
It still feels like a dream to be laughing and enjoying ourselves like this.
Is our duty to the Goddess finally complete?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_3_02.text: Since, you know, all Apostles in Hasla have been defeated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_3_03.text:
No, there are still those who remain corrupted
under the Apostles' influence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_3_04.text: Hasla still needs us, the Chrona Heroes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_3_05.text:
Archana is right.
Our journey is only beginning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_3_06.text:
Yeah! As a team, nothing will stop us!
We'll get through every obstacle and battle - together!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_3_07.text:
Except that final battle with Detalos, which my faithful crystal sword
'Danan' and I won. Single-handedly. So - together most of the time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_01.text:
... You might have dealt the finishing blow,
but we did most of the work.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_02.text:
Without Dalton and me,
you would have been dead before ever facing Destalos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_03.text:
Yes. You'd do well to remember that the crack in Destalos's armor
through which you pierced your sword... was made by my bullet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_04.text:
... And we would have never faced the actual battle
if the rest of us hadn't fought the endlessly charging monsters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_05.text:
Yes. All those monsters from all over Hasla...
They still appear in my nightmares.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_06.text:
Had it not been for Goddess Chronos, we would have all died
then and there. And we would have never reincarnated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_07.text:
'Reincarnated'... Wasn't it me, not Goddess Chronos, who cast
the most reincarnation spells in battle? You're all indebted to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_08.text:
Wait... All of you, stop.
Today is supposed to be a reunion. A day of comradeship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_09.text:
All of you are heroes of legend, praised by the people of Hasla.
And you still manage to fight over such a trivial thing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_10.text: I can feel Goddess Elanuma disapproving inside me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_5_01.text:
... This war would have never been possible
had it not been for the Goddess's blessing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_5_02.text:
It is no use arguing over each other's accomplishments...
They are all equal before the Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_5_03.text:
Hey! Don't think you can trick us into believing something like that!
You're not even Goddess Elanuma herself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_6_01.text:
Sigh... There is one way to find out
who made the most contributions to the war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_6_02.text: Have you ever heard of the #Library of Dimensions#?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_6_04.text:
Yes. Legend has it that the Library of Dimensions holds
all the records of Hasla's past and present, and perhaps even its future.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_6_05.text:
We could ask the librarian #Pandora#
for the true account of things.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_6_07.text:
Why the sudden lack of faith?
Are you afraid that the truth may not be what you claimed it to be?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_6_08.text:
I - I never thought that!
Let's go right away! To the Library of Dimensions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SHOP_COMPLE.text:
Do you need anything else? The shop will close after the
event period, so make sure you spend all your Coins!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SHOP_DEFAUL.text:
I'll exchange the Bakery Coins you've earned

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_02.text:
Wait. I recognize her. She's a wanted criminal! Guards,
time to prove that your paychecks aren't going to waste!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_03.text:
What are you talking about, Yuna?
You shouldn't be so rude to the hero of Neth Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_05.text:
Well, you heard wrong. Chasing after all those criminals
made you susceptible to fake rumors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_08.text:
Previously, live broadcasts were known
to be impossible outside the Neth Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_09.text:
Can you explain the technology that allows today'
 broadcast to be transmitted throughout the continent?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_10.text:
The real question is, even if I explain the whole mechanism,
would you understand it? Stop asking useless questions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_11.text: Now, shut up and get on with the event!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_12.text:
Neth Empire's celebrated scientist said I have just asked
a useless question! She exudes intelligence AND charisma!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_13.text: Just between you and me, she seems a bit of a nutcase.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_5_01.text:
Now that introductions are over, we'll meet the contestants
who will compete in the first round of the festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_5_02.text:
Introducing the pinnacle of Neth Empire's high technology,
the first android group in the history of Hasla:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_5_03.text: Team #Do Androids Dream of Electric Pop Stars?#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_01.text:
Ooh! R-0, look!
I've seen them on TV before!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_02.text: They look so different in real life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_03.text: I admit I cannot see the difference.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_04.text:
Can it be alikened to the difference between viewing an
image through the camera lens and on screen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_06.text: We're also excited to see you in person!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_07.text:
Curious what these androids, said to be capable of taking
out entire brigades on the battlefield, will sing? Stay tuned!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_09.text:
Oh,
we already know who they are!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_10.text:
It's {PLAYER_NAME}, former partner of Jeomrye! And
their new parter, Caroline from Team #Ride Zero#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_02.text:
(And those androids!
Were they the 'pleasant surprise' she mentioned?)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_06.text:
Haha, you seem nervous! I understand! I asked how you
feel about your first time participating in the Festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_07.text:
Oh. Erm... Hmm...
I'll give it my best!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_08.text:
Yes, that's the spirit! Our new rookie answers confidently
in the manner of the previous champion, Jeomrye!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_09.text:
We saw you practicing for the contest, Caroline, and
decided to enter ourselves. We had nothing to do, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_10.text:
This should be the battle of the century: your human vocal
cords against our superior, latest version vocal system!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_11.text:
You have grown much better at lying, V. I remember
your CPU usage peaking since several days ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_12.text: Hey! I said that in confidence!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_13.text: Oh... Haha. I'm glad to see you, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_14.text:
Is everyone already acquainted?
What an interesting turn of events!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_8_01.text:
Now, let's turn the sound up to Team #Ride Zero# and Team
#Do Androids Dream of Electric Pop Stars?#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_01.text:
It was sweet.
To the point that all my teeth almost fell out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_02.text:
I don't know how to feel about your costume...
I deducted some points; it felt too, er, couture.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_03.text:
Caeneus, I love love, and your song was lovely.
But at the end of the day, my vote goes to Jeomrye and Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_06.text:
Do not despair, beautiful Caeneus.
Life holds many more opportunities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_07.text:
You will have a chance to show your lady
your noble heart of love.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_08.text:
Sigh... Alright.
I accept defeat and will withdraw from the tournament.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_1_01.text: The victors of the 1st round of the Hasla Music Festival are...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_1_03.text:
What! Are you all malfunctioning?
Our performance was flawless!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_1_04.text:
Hmm... Well,
let's see what the judges have to say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_2_01.text: I liked the song in itself, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_2_02.text:
You just played it on the speaker in your neck!
You can't call that singing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_2_03.text: You could have at least pretended to lip sync.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_2_05.text:
I thought humans' different renditions of the same song
indicated poor performance... I see I was mistaken.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_2_06.text:
How old are you two? Not more than ten, right? You two
androids are too young to know anything about real music.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_2_07.text:
Come back AFTER you study at least the difference
between heavy metal and R&B, kiddos!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_2_09.text:
Grr... Grr...!
Just you wait, you stupid humans!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_01.text:
Congratulations on your first victory!
How do you feel about winning the first round?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_02.text:
Hmm...
I'm not sure whether to call that a real victory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_03.text:
Oh, luck is a skill.
Don't be so humble!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_04.text:
If you want 'real' competition,
then our next contestants will give a good fight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_05.text:
What do machines and musical instruments have in
common? They both require a delicate hand!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_06.text:
And graduate students and soldiers? They follow their
superiors! Here are the two you never expected to team up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_07.text:
It's Stanya and Spiny
of Team #Spatynyany#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_08.text: ... Hmm? Is this really your team name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_4_01.text:
Yes, ma'am! It is! We just couldn't think of any better team
name than mashing up our own names together!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_4_02.text:
... No, I disagreed. I still feel like we could have come up
with something better.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_4_03.text:
Stanya, Spiny… I didn't know you were competing in
the Festival as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_4_04.text:
Something is off. Where are the real musicians?
Levine - ...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_4_05.text: Wait a minute! What are you doing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_01.text:
What? O-oh, we're old acquaintances,
and I wanted to ask whether -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_02.text:
Levine Ludovico is a national hero of the Neth Empire!
She deserves your utmost respect!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_03.text: Lack of manners... I'll have to factor that into your score...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_04.text:
Yeah. From now on, any disrespect towards Levine
Ludovico will be considered an attack on me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_05.text:
Curioser and curioser. Why is everyone so
emotionally attached to you, Levine?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_06.text:
Yes, my own popularity astounds me. Still, it's a music
festival. Hence, we should compete with music.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_08.text:
As expected of the gracious Levine Ludovico! A razor-sharp
intelligence, a gracious heart that holds no grudge...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_09.text:
She's a paragon to be upheld by all!
And with her wise words, we begin Round 2!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_01.text:
Congratulations on your first win!
How do you feel right now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_02.text:
Hrrmph, of course I won! I refuse to waste my time
on people who don't deserve it. Let's get on with it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_03.text:
Oh... Now that's confidence!
Then, without further ado...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_04.text:
Oh! Our next contestant
is reported to be the very subject of Caeneus's love song!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_05.text:
She's the Captain of the Central Knights and Grancia's beloved hero,
but today she's the leader of...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_1_01.text:
Aaaand the winners of the second round
of the 4th Hasla Music Festival are...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_1_02.text:
... the rather unamiable but highly talented
Team #Ride Zero#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_1_05.text:
Dead men tell no tales.
Get off my stage!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_1_06.text:
I couldn't have phrased it better myself!
Team #Spatynyany#, please step off the stage!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_2_01.text:
Huh. Shouldn't there be more... formalities, considering
that this is the biggest music festival in Hasla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_2_02.text:
Oh, is Caroline upset
over the fast and efficient pace of events?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_2_03.text:
Should we have ended with something like: the results for
the round of the century! Will be revealed in ONE! MINUTE!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_2_04.text:
Oh, let's speed things up.
Even the interviews were getting a bit repetitive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_2_06.text:
She's a small giant with the entire Neth Army resting on her
shoulders, but she used to dream of joining an idol group!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_2_07.text:
With a real idol pop star by her side, is she one step
closer to realizing her childhood dream?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_2_08.text:
Give it up to Commander Yuria of the Neth Army and top
pop star Cano of Team #Even Commanders Can Be Stars#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_3_01.text:
Music is love!
Cano's here, everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_3_02.text:
G-Greetings, soldiers. I am Commander Yuria of the
Neth Army. My hobby is bullseye shooting, and my major…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_3_03.text:
Haha, Commander Yuria!
There's no need to be so nervous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_3_04.text:
Cano, Commander Yuria...
Everyone here played a part in my past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_4_01.text:
It's about time you give me a proper explanation.
What are you up to?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_4_02.text:
Huhuhu... Still in the dark, Caroline?
I'm almost disappointed in you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_01.text:
The ultrasonic weapon Ms. Ludovico invented, when set
to a particular frequency, was found to cause

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_02.text:
an unexpected side effect:
mind control.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_03.text:
Everyone on stage
is already under mind control.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_04.text:
Including the camera crew. We're currently on a
commercial break, though, so don't worry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_05.text:
Even the oh-so-mighty {PLAYER_NAME} is under my
control now. Isn't it great?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_06.text: This is complete travesty. I-I don't believe this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_07.text:
I agree; my level of genius IS truly hard to believe. Who
knew my invention could be used as a mind control device?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_08.text: So, what do you think of my surprise gift? Mesmerized?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_09.text:
Now, play your part and win the competition.
Remember, we're using D-CAT to conquer Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_10.text:
During the finals, with all of Hasla watching the broadcast,
I will play the recording of D-CAT...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_11.text:
... and just like that, Hasla will fall into our hands,
and we'll no longer have to continue this silly charade.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_13.text:
Yes, yes, I understand your disbelief.
Or is it disappointment? TOO easy, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_14.text:
Well, that's the way of the world.
Now, do your part and go compete!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_01.text: I see you were done for, Sir Caeneus...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_02.text:
It's not surprising,
as he's the weakest among us, the musicians of Grancia...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_03.text: It's still dishonorable for a knight to lose to a bassist!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_04.text:
Don't be too harsh on him. He fought well, considering the penalty
of the most ridiculous costume I've seen in my life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_05.text: Are you sure they're on his side?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_1_01.text:
Yay~ That was a great performance, Caroline!
You win!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_1_02.text:
I... I don't know.
Cano and Yuria's performance seemed better...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_1_03.text:
Well, I wouldn't know; I don't waste my time listening to
music. Judges, have you reached a decision?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_2_01.text:
OF COURSE Team #Ride Zero# wins the round!
We all agree with you, Ms. Levine Ludovico!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_2_03.text:
And Yuria? Pfft! She's a nurse-turned-commander!
What does SHE know about music?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_2_04.text:
Yes… They both know... nothing about music…
Never did...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_2_06.text:
Oh, great. We broke Meri.
... Do you really need our commentary?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_2_07.text:
No, if everyone agrees
that victory goes to our Caroline.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_2_08.text:
Now, now!
Losers, get off the stage!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_3_01.text:
What's your problem, Caroline?
Everything is going as planned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_3_03.text:
I  wanted to compete fair and square, with my own songs...
I wanted to be judged for the musician that I am.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_3_04.text:
Your own songs? I don't think so. If it hadn't been for my
intervention, you would have never reached the finals.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_3_05.text:
You're me, and I'm you. And we both know that among
our many talents, music isn't one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_3_07.text:
But what?! Wake up, Caroline! Tsk, this is the reason
I wanted to keep you from going to Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_3_08.text:
Never mind. I'll listen to all your silly talk of dreams and
whatnot later. Help me tie up {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_3_09.text: I hate to think what could happen if they wake up now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_4_01.text:
W-wait a minute.
What was that? Did they just... move?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_02.text:
No human has ever broken free of
my ultrasonic weapon's brainwashing sound waves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_03.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}...
You're unlike any other person I've ever met.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_04.text:
With you by my side, I feel that I can finally become
what I've always wanted to be!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_05.text: What? What are you talking about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_06.text:
I'm sorry, Levine, but meeting {PLAYER_NAME}
reminded me of my long forgotten dream.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_07.text:
I...
I've always wanted to start my own rock band!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_08.text:
And who said you couldn't?! You can start a hundred
rock bands AFTER you conquer Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_09.text:
No, I no longer wish to live
a life of violence and destruction.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_10.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} and I am going to defeat you, once
and for all, and free everyone from under your control.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_11.text:
Did you forget that D-CAT is useless against me?
Fine, have it your way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_12.text:
Everyone and everything on stage is on my side.
It's time for you to exit, stage left.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_13.text:
Yes. For daring to rebel against our national hero, I'll make
sure you spend the rest of your lives in social death!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_01.text:
Jeomrye, wasn't it? I enjoyed your music.
Caeneus's defeat was understandable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_02.text:
We, the 'Grancia Imperial Band,' are of different class altogether.
Why don't you see for yourself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_1_01.text:
N-No... No!
I-I was on the verge of dominating the world...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_1_02.text:
... only to be stopped by a complacent idiot who claims
she wants to be a musician, of all things...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_1_03.text:
An idiot?
Levine, a person who dreams can never be an idiot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_1_04.text:
Realizing one's dreams...
requires willpower... and physical force!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_1_05.text:
... ...
You know what? I don't even feel like trying anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_1_06.text:
Send me back to prison.
Do whatever you want. I surrender.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_01.text:
Hmm...?
Why does it feel like I've been sleeping standing up?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_02.text:
Ugh... I had a very, very bad nightmare. A pink-haired
woman was controlling my every action...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_03.text:
Yeah, someone who looks just like… Huh? Levine
Ludovico? Isn't that person a wanted criminal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_04.text:
... Cano isn't old news.
She's still the best popstar in Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_05.text:
Stop it, stop it, stop it, stop it, stop it,
stop it, stop it, stop it, stop it, stop it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_07.text:
O-okay, okay! I'll stop whatever it is you want me to!
J-just - stop!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_08.text:
I see everyone has broken free of Levine's mind control
and come to their senses. I was worried for a moment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_10.text:
It was Levine Ludovico
who used her sonic weapon to control you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_11.text:
I too... originally assisted her in her plans
as an accomplice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_12.text:
Not any longer. {PLAYER_NAME} helped me see the
error of my ways, and we defeated Levine together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_13.text:
I-I don't remember anything...
which is rather terrifying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_14.text:
Then what happens to the festival?
It seems the finals are already over and done with...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_15.text: S-should we skip ahead to the award ceremony?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_16.text:
No, we should start over - from the preliminary rounds.
This trophy means nothing if it isn't won fairly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_3_01.text: Oh, no... This can't be good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_4_01.text:
What's activating the teleporter? It shouldn't work without
my biometric authentication!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_4_03.text:
Oh, foolish, foolish Caroline.
All art and science are born of darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_4_04.text: And I am the very essence of darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_4_05.text:
Did you truly believe that I would be ignorant
of the petty tricks you call science?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_5_01.text:
Bow down to your lord, your master, the great captain of
all monsters, the harbinger of doom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_6_01.text:
Why did you betray me?
And I expected so much more of you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_6_02.text:
Had you completed this mission, I would've rewarded you
with all the riches and glory your heart could desire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_6_03.text:
I've seen the treatment your loyal underlings get when you
tire of them: banishment beyond the dimensional portal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_6_04.text:
You won't fool me any longer. I'll help {PLAYER_NAME}
defeat you, and then pursue my dreams. My true dreams.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_7_01.text:
... How disappointing. So you prove yourself no different
from any other human, hurrying your own death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_7_02.text:
Ha, what? What are you going to do now? Even you can't
fight both me and {PLAYER_NAME} at the same time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_7_03.text: ... I am never so imprudent as to act on conviction alone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_7_04.text:
I admit that {PLAYER_NAME} is strong enough
to be considered a true #ordeal#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_7_05.text:
However... Do you truly wish to risk the damage that will be
caused by our battle? The inevitable casualties?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_7_07.text:
That is why I propose a battle in the spirit of the Music
Festival: a competition on this very stage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_8_02.text:
Did you not hear what I just said?
All art and science are born of darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_8_03.text: Let me show you the true diabolic power of music.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_8_04.text:
Oh, look! Team #Ride Zero# has been challenged by
the Ent from the dimension beyond!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_8_05.text:
I... have no idea what's actually going on, but it seems that
the fate of the entire world rests on this round!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_8_06.text:
Which team shall emerge victorious?
Tune in for never-before-seen musical madness!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_10_01.text:
T-the Chaotic Apocalypse Ent...
Where did he go?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_10_02.text:
Ugh. Please tell me that this is the LAST time that we're
knocked unconscious. I'm getting too old for this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_10_04.text: ... My ears hurt, for some reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_11_01.text:
I knew it! {PLAYER_NAME} and Caroline!
You were the ones who defeated the music monster!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_11_03.text:
Cha... Apo...
Whatever it called itself.
