TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_11_04.text:
Odd that I can't recall how he went away.
Maybe he got bored and left?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_12_01.text:
Yes, I'm not sure about that part, either. I vaguely
remember someone singing away the monster...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_12_02.text:
That wasn't you?
Was it {PLAYER_NAME}, then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_12_03.text:
Yeah, I remember bits and pieces of the melody...
It resembled the song of Team #Ride Zero#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_12_04.text:
Yes! It must be! I knew you were the true heroes of the 
Festival! You saved everyone here - everyone in Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_13_01.text: So... That's it? We're not double-checking what happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_13_02.text:
What use is there for double-checking?
Who else would have accomplished such a feat?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_13_04.text:
D-did we?
Well... If you say so...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_13_05.text:
Now, then. It looks like the winners
of the 4th Hasla Music Festival have been decided!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_13_06.text:
The winners are... Caroline and {PLAYER_NAME}
of Team #Ride Zero#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_14_01.text:
Fine, I'll accept the trophy - this time.
I still refuse to believe that I won fairly, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_14_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
This is only the beginning for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_14_03.text:
At the next Hasla Music Festival,
I'll show everyone that I have real music in me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_1_01.text:
Huhuhu... What is the matter?
Can you bear it no longer?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_1_02.text:
Ugh... This can't be...
I'm the composer of D-CAT.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_1_03.text:
This version... is even more dreadful,
and I didn't know that to be possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_1_04.text:
Caroline, you were useful for a mere human… but you
cannot and shall not know the true resonance of D-CAT.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_1_05.text:
Even this is not the 'original' song of dread. I too am merely
repeating the echoes from behind the dimensions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_2_01.text:
E-even that... was mere 'echoes'?
That terrifying performance you just rendered?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_2_02.text:
Yes. Nothing is known about
the demonic voice who first sung that song...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_2_03.text:
... but they must indeed be
a monstrous god of both terror and beauty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_2_04.text:
Even I, the lord of all darkness of Hasla,
have no wish to meet that horrible deity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_2_06.text:
Has she passed out? Whew… The first and original Hasla…
has finally fallen into my hands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_2_08.text: I can hear voices... Is somebody out there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_3_01.text:
Oh, finally! I've been looking everywhere for someone who's
awake. Everyone else was passed out... It was scary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_3_02.text:
But where am I? Is this a broadcasting station?
Looks like there's a festival of some sort.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_4_01.text:
What... are you?
How can you still be awake?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_4_02.text:
I played D-CAT myself. It should have resonated
throughout the entire building.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_4_04.text:
Is this the first time you're seeing an Ent?
But enough of that. Answer me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_4_05.text:
Erm... I don't know what D-CAT is. All I did was follow this
familiar tune... and I found myself here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_4_06.text:
Familiar tune? Tsk, tsk...
A hearing impaired human, I see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_4_07.text:
Unfortunately, the vibrations of D-CAT can affect
even the deaf at so close a distance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_4_08.text: Curse your own foolishness as you submit to your fate!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_5_01.text:
Oh, so I wasn't wrong.
I thought I heard the #Donut Cat# melody.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_5_02.text: I've always wanted another friend to harmonize the chords.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_5_03.text:
Alright, then...
Do-do-do-do-do~ Do do do~ Do~nut cat~!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_6_01.text:
Ahem, ahem!
It's been awhile, so I need to warm up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_6_02.text:
Those piercing high notes...
Y-you must be... the owner of 'the voice'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_6_03.text:
Ah. Mic test! Ahem.
Have a sip of blueberry so~da!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_01.text:
Well, that was rude. You shouldn't scream to other
people's singing, you know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_02.text:
Yes... This is pure evil
that shakes the very foundations of one's soul...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_03.text:
O Terrible Creator,
the One Who Sings the 'Donut Cat'...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_04.text:
Ever since the very first note of your song crossed my ears,
questions have been relentlessly tormenting my soul...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_05.text:
Why... How... WHAT do donuts and cats have to do with
each other? What do the lyrics mean? Why?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_06.text:
And what does the ghost donut with legs mean?
Why is the soda blueberry-flavored?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_07.text:
And the fish bones that suddenly burst through the surface
of the earth? Tell me! I must know the secret meaning!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_08.text:
What secret meaning? The lyrics are pure nonsense.
They aren't supposed to mean anything!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_10.text: I didn't write the lyrics, you know. I just sung them, because they told me to. The things I do for a paycheck...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_11.text:
Because they... told you to...? A paycheck...?
Haha... Hahahaha...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_8_01.text:
The song that completely transformed my existence into
what I am now... was but a simple whim of a foolish mortal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_8_02.text:
This is... I... You know what? I've had enough. I don't
understand any of this, and I don't want to. I'm done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_9_01.text:
Huh? Wait, what is this?
Something's dragging me away -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_9_03.text: I-it's been so long since I've been out of my dungeon… Let me at least get the bread I bought from - NOOOOO!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_10_03.text:
... that I'm still serious about this competition,
even if I'm your second choice to Jeomrye!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_10_04.text: Don't think for a moment that I won't give it my all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_10_05.text: Got it? Good! Then let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_1_01.text:
The time has finally come...
for the annual Hasla Music Festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_1_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}!
Ready to rock the stage with me one more time?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_2_01.text:
Good, good!
Time to start our special training!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_2_02.text:
I've already planned our schedule. First, we should
meditate under the local waterfall so that -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_2_03.text:
Jeomrye, there you are.
I've been looking everywhere for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_3_02.text: A letter has arrived, addressed to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_3_03.text:
It's from...
Huh, the Hasla Music Festival Secretariat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_3_04.text:
Ooh, maybe I'm being asked to deliver the speech
for the opening ceremony as the last festival's champion!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_4_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, I'm sorry,
but I can't be your partner this year.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_4_03.text:
Why? For what reason?
You couldn't have been banned from entering.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_4_04.text:
Oh, it's nothing like that!
This letter is from Cano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_4_05.text:
Seems like she has some business to attend to
and can't judge this year's Hasla Music Festival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_4_06.text:
And without Cano,
they're short of one judge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_4_08.text:
Yup, there's no musician more worthy than me
to judge THE Hasla Music Festival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_4_09.text:
Anyway... That's why you'll need to go find another partner,
{PLAYER_NAME}. Sorry about the last minute timing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_5_01.text:
Oh, you're in a predicament. There's only a few days
left until registration is closed...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_5_03.text:
As this year's festival is being held in the Neth Empire,
I have quite a lot of free time on my hands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_5_04.text:
I will bravely enter the competition
as your partner this year, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_5_05.text:
I knew that my time would come one day.
I've been practicing my guitar solo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_6_01.text: What do you think? I poured my heart and soul into -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_6_02.text: ... What? What do you mean, I have no sense of rhythm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_6_03.text:
My soldiers all said
that my performance was divine...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_6_04.text:
That's because you're their superior, Lednas.
They were only being polite.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_6_05.text:
Ugh, all that rigid discipline
is the exact reason why I never cared for the army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_7_02.text:
I met Jeomrye at the town gates
and she told me the news.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_7_03.text:
You're looking for a partner
for the Hasla Music Festival, aren't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_7_04.text:
I don't have a partner, you don't have a partner… The
solution to both our problems is self-evident, don't you think?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_8_03.text:
What's unbelievable is your complete lack of musical talent, Lednas.
Do you even know what a beat is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_9_01.text:
But... Seeing that {PLAYER_NAME} agrees,
I have no choice but to admit defeat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_9_02.text:
Huhu, I'll bring back souvenirs and local treats.
Neth Empire has some great dessert cafes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_9_03.text:
I hope the patisseries I knew in my dimension
still exist in yours...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_1_01.text: The winner of the second round of the Hasla Music Festival...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_1_02.text:
... is, once again, 'Jeomrye and Captain'!
What an amazing performance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_1_03.text:
I don't understand! We were perfect, as we always are!
This is unacceptable - losing to a street musician with no background!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_1_05.text:
I never knew the Ode to Alexander
had four verses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_1_06.text:
I think your repertoire lacks a little appeal
to people who are, erm, not from Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_2_01.text:
As I thought... We should have included the 'Nyan Cat' song 
to our medley to cater to the viewers' tastes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_2_02.text: I'm not sure that would have made a difference, Lady Victoria!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_2_03.text:
Ahem, if you don't mind,
please get off the stage so that the next team can prepare.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_2_04.text: I will reclaim my honor... Someday...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_3_01.text:
You easily won the second round,
but will the third time be the charm? Are you ready?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_3_02.text:
I was born ready.
The next opponents better be as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_3_03.text:
Huhuhu... Then you'll be pleased with the next round.
Introducing the next contestants!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_3_04.text:
They'll chase you to the ends of hell!
The thrill of the hunt is their entire life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_3_05.text:
Their leader endlessly burns in the fires of metaphorical hell:
Dullahan's #Marauders#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_02.text:
Mr. Dullahan! Could you give us a comment?
What did you think of 'Jeomrye and Captain's music?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_05.text:
Big Brother Dullahan... doesn't speak.
He has a speech disability.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_06.text: If you have any questions, toss them to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_07.text:
Ah, then Mr. Wilhelm.
What did you think of your opponent?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_08.text:
I didn't think anything.
I only think of... 'you know who.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_09.text: Oh, I see... Er, 'you know who' as in the wizard...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_10.text:
NO! I mean the one who stole my left eye!
Grr, the phantom pain is too much!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_11.text:
... Okay. Let's go meet the other contestants.
Oh? Here we have Shasha, the Witch of Fire!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_13.text:
You seem to be on a different plane than the other two contestants.
What do you seek in your music?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_14.text:
Hmm... My message to the world, I guess?
Gonna be the world's flyest hipster, yo!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_5_01.text:
Huh, I'm not sure I understood all that, but...
You're the only one who properly answered my question.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_5_02.text: Are you sure they can perform on stage?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_5_03.text:
Rude.
I'll enjoy dealing with you before 'you know who.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_1_01.text:
The 'Marauders' dazzles the stage with their performance,
but the judges vote in favor of 'Jeomrye and Captain'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_1_02.text:
Jeomrye and Captain' takes the third round as well -
which leads them at last to the finals!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_1_03.text:
This isn't happening!
We had the better 'wow' factor AND received a bigger applause!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_1_05.text: Yeah! Give us a good reason, yo!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_2_01.text:
I liked the show, but... I didn't understand
Dullahan's sign language solo at the climax.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_2_02.text:
And for a full minute at that.
I must remind everyone that we're broadcasting live.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_2_03.text:
I love and support the message you're trying to put out there,
but your views were a little too progressive for today's music festival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_2_05.text:
You don't mess with Big Brother Dullahan!
You've made him mad!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_2_06.text:
Erm, to be honest, yo, I kinda thought it a little lame as well.
Toldya we should've given my freestyle rap a chance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_2_07.text:
For the last time, adding 'yo's to the end of your sentences
does not make them freestyle rap!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_3_01.text:
Uh... As the 'Marauders' make their exit,
the next contestants arrive at the stage!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_3_02.text:
Our next contestant is the winning team
of the Second Hasla Music Festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_3_03.text:
They're rumored to have made a pact with a demon
to gather only the best members from time and space!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_3_04.text:
They're here to steal your ear:
the #Shrieking Destroyers of the Lone Abyss of Death#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_4_01.text:
I sense a familiar presence.
Was Wilhelm here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_4_03.text:
Kee kee kee... I am the one whom Wilhelm seeks...
For I consumed his left eye!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_4_04.text:
Gasp... So you're 'you know who'!
Is that why you can feel his presence...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_4_05.text:
I'll answer that question: no. He saw your interview from the screen
in the waiting room and thought it would be funny to play a prank.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_4_07.text:
Hrrmph! I was minding my own business. He was the one who tripped
on my axe and hurt himself, and he wants revenge?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_4_08.text: Music was my only safe place from all this chaos...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_4_09.text:
We have time for small talk later.
Let's get over this quickly; Alisha is waiting for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_4_10.text:
Oh, that's adorable! You guys are such a cute couple.
So you aren't coming to the barbecue after, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_4_11.text:
Woompapa... A pity. I brought hippo meat,
a traditional Woopa delicacy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_4_12.text:
I've never had hippo meat before!
What does it taste like?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_5_01.text:
Am I the only one here who's serious about this festival? You call
yourselves musicians and all you can talk about is your stupid barbecue!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_5_02.text:
You think you can keep looking down on
me and {PLAYER_NAME} like that, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_5_03.text:
Well, I'll show you real music!
So listen and learn!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_5_04.text:
Ooh! Contestant Jeomrye bursts forth onto the stage in rage,
signaling the start of Round 4!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_1_01.text:
Is this...
the power of the music of Ludwig Metal Bach Jeomrye...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_2_02.text:
Gasp! Are you getting this? 
Jeomrye's music... has detonated a human being!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_2_03.text:
Oh, he self-destructed himself.
Bit of a drama queen, you see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_2_05.text:
That song... was an eye-opener.
We humbly admit defeat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_2_06.text:
You were on another level back there. Hey, if you're ever looking
for a band, we'll always leave an open spot for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_2_07.text:
I too take away from this festival a valuable lesson, woompapa...
The world is wide and holds much raw talent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_2_08.text:
Hey, we're holding a party later tonight. Do you want to come?
And please play a song for us at the Succubus Theater later!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_2_09.text:
Hello? Darling, it's nothing like that...
The festival's running a little late, I'll be home before dinner.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_2_10.text:
Honest, I'm on the stage right now!
Turn on the TV! No, I'm only shouting because it's so noisy in here -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_3_01.text:
I know I won this round,
but I loved your music too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_3_02.text:
Let's keep in touch.
Call me up after the competition, okay? I'm under 'Metal Bach'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_4_01.text:
Huh, interesting... They decided the results of the match
for themselves without the judges' comments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_4_02.text:
That leaves us with the winner of
the Third Hasla Music Festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_4_03.text:
The winner is...!
Jeomrye and Cap -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_5_01.text:
Cano... As I swore at the beginning of the festival,
I'm going to beat you and take the title of Hasla's greatest musician.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_5_02.text:
Come down to the stage.
I'm challenging you to the true final round of the competition!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_6_01.text:
The nerve... Hello? What about me? I have just as much right as Cano
to be challenged to a secret final round!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_6_02.text:
You have no musical talent whatsoever, Yuna.
This is where I co -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_6_03.text: Will you two please be quiet for a minute?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_7_01.text: Miyu... No. Ludwig Metal Bach Jeomrye.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_7_02.text:
I knew things would turn out like this
ever since you returned to the stage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_7_03.text: It's my honor to rise to a challenge from a fellow musician!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_5_8_01.text:
Let's go and show everyone...
the true power of Cano☆Revolution!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_1_01.text:
What an unexpected turn of events! But both the pop champion
Cano and challenger Jeomrye give an amazing performance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_1_02.text:
As we wait for the viewers' votes to come in,
let's hear what the judges have to say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_2_01.text:
I vote for Jeomrye.
It's about time Cano steps down from the throne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_2_02.text:
I give Cano my vote. I admit Jeomrye was good,
but Cano☆Revolution remains unmatched.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_2_03.text:
The judges seem to be in disagreement!
That means... the viewers' votes will decide the winner!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_3_01.text: Ladies and gentlemen... We have the results!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_3_02.text: The winner of the Third Hasla Music Festival is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_4_01.text: I... I won...? I beat Cano?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_4_02.text:
Congratulations on your successful debut, Jeomrye!
I knew you could do it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_4_03.text:
During the match, I felt not only your soul,
but all the hard work you put in to find your voice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_4_04.text: Cano, you didn't go easy on me or anything, right...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_4_05.text:
Not at all, what makes you think I would do such a thing?
I promise you that I gave it my all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_4_06.text: I look forward to hearing more great music from you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_5_01.text:
Jeomrye, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Congratulations on winning the festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_5_02.text: Would you like to say a few comments for your fans?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_5_03.text:
I... I....
Erm, I first want to thank my parents for supporting my dream...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_5_04.text:
And... {PLAYER_NAME} for being the best partner
you can ask for, and...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_6_01.text:
Argh! I'm not going to pretend to be good at what I'm not.
Who cares for words when there's music?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_7_01.text:
This festival was just one marker in a lifelong road of music.
And I'll continue to walk my own path!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_7_02.text:
All of Hasla will hear what I have to sing.
You'll cheer me on, won't you, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_END_8_01.text: Awesome! Here's to us and a future full of music, partner!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_10_01.text:
To my knowledge, {PLAYER_NAME} has never played
a musical instrument or shown an interest in singing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_10_02.text:
Bah, stop worrying about such petty details!
What's important is the SOUL! How well we connect to each other!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_10_03.text:
Real music isn't about technique;
it's about the soul and forming a real connection with the audience!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_10_04.text:
Hmm... I don't know too much about music,
but I have my doubts...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_10_05.text:
Urgh, I was never good at speaking.
Just listen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_12_01.text:
I... I did it! I poured my heart and soul... the essence of rock
into this performanc -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_12_02.text: Oh no, I forgot to hook up the amp!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_12_03.text:
... was inaudible,
but I could feel the passion of the performance nonetheless.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_12_04.text: {PLAYER_NAME}, did you feel it as well?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_13_02.text:
... Hmm. I must be more talented than I thought
to have unwittingly transcended the sound spectrum...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_13_03.text:
So, {PLAYER_NAME}, what do you say?
You'll be my partner, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_14_01.text:
Yes, just as I expected of my soulmate!
I knew you'd say yes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_14_03.text:
I just know we're going to be the greatest duo Hasla has ever seen.
Great, let's go and sign ourselves up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_1_01.text:
What can this be?
The Empire has sent us a message.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_1_02.text:
On a closer look, it's from Emperor Alexander His Majesty.
What can he want of this small town in the countryside...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_2_01.text:
Greetings, Lednas. Yes, it is your king, the Emperor of Grancia,
Alexander. We met at the coronation, as I am sure you remember.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_2_02.text: I write in order to ask a favor of you and the people of Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_2_03.text:
Do you know of the Hasla Music Festival? It is an audition program
held by the popstar Cano to discover new musicians and celebrities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_2_04.text: I confess that I am a fan of hers, and...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_2_05.text: I have personally arranged for this year's festival to be held in Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_2_06.text:
Everything has been going smoothly...
except that I have forgotten to reserve guards for the event.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_2_07.text:
That is why I am seeking the assistance of Hero Town,
as you are the closest to the location of the festival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_2_08.text:
I know how competent you are from your previous reports,
and I trust that you will do the same for my sake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_2_09.text: I have attached details of the event on the back of this letter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_3_01.text:
Ah... This is not good.
The festival begins the day after tomorrow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_3_02.text:
Considering the minimum number of guards required in town,
I'm not sure we have enough people for His Majesty's request...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_4_01.text:
You'll help us, {PLAYER_NAME}? I know how busy you are
with your other duties, and I don't want to add weight on your shoulders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_4_02.text:
... If you say so.
I give you my sincerest thanks, Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_4_03.text:
Now then, we must begin to make the preparations.
Thank you once again, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_5_01.text:
Attention! Captain,
all guards have been stationed to their respective places!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_5_02.text:
At ease, soldier. Thank you for your effort; it was a hasty call.
Take ten minutes of rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_6_01.text:
Thank you for reinforcing the guards with your Heroes, {PLAYER_NAME}.
We will take care of the rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_6_02.text:
The festival will begin soon.
Why don't you at least take a look?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_7_01.text:
Is that... {PLAYER_NAME}?
At last! I found someone with whom my soul resonates!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_8_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! You there!
Join my crew! I mean, team!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_8_03.text:
I'm a rising super rookie, #Ludwig Metal Bach Jeomrye#!!!
... You still don't know who I am, do you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_8_04.text:
What if I told you that I'm 'Miyu,'
the bassist of 'Cano☆Revolution'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_8_05.text:
Oh! I recognize you now.
Aren't you busy these days preparing for your concert...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_8_06.text:
I quit some time ago.
I realized that I wanted to do something different with my music.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_8_07.text:
Oh... I see. Then why do you want
{PLAYER_NAME} as your partner?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_9_01.text:
Erm, the truth is,
I wanted to make a grand debut at the Hasla Music Festival...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_9_02.text:
... but I have a problem.
They aren't accepting any solo contestants this year.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_OP_9_03.text:
So... I remembered being impressed by {PLAYER_NAME}
back when I was still in Cano's band and asked around for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_SHOP_COMPLET.text: Thank you for your purchase. It will greatly help with our funds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_SHOP_DEFAULT.text:
Are you enjoying the Hasla Music Festival?
Our Hero's Association has set up a Mileage Store for visitors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_STOCK_SHOP_COMPLETE.text:
Thank you for your purchase!
Please keep in mind that the Token Store will open only for a limited time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_STOCK_SHOP_DEFAULT_.text:
Welcome to the Token Store! Guaranteed satisfaction for all customers!
You can trade your Bridget Tokens for various prizes here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_STOCK_SHOP_LOCK_01.text:
Oh... We're still making the necessary preparations here!
Please come back later!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVNET_MAZE_INTRO_1_02.text: Have you come to participate in the Maze Event?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVNET_MAZE_INTRO_1_03.text: ... I'm guessing no, judging from the expression on your face.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVNET_MAZE_INTRO_1_04.text:
Ah, I see...
It must be the first time you're seeing a festival like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVNET_MAZE_INTRO_1_05.text:
Every so often, the villages of Grancia
hold special festivals hosted by the imperial court.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVNET_MAZE_INTRO_1_06.text:
I've volunteered to guide this year's Maze Event,
held here in the forest of our Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVNET_MAZE_INTRO_1_07.text:
If you're interested, why don't you participate as well?
We've prepared some small prizes that might interest you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVNET_MAZE_INTRO_1_08.text:
The rules are simple:
you must collect 3 Keys and find your way to the goal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVNET_MAZE_INTRO_1_09.text:
As for the other rules... They are rather self-evident.
You'll see for yourself as you make your way through the Maze.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVNET_MAZE_INTRO_1_10.text:
If you still want to review them in detail,
please check the Maze Guide.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVNET_MAZE_INTRO_1_11.text:
If you succeed in reaching the Goal, you will receive additional prizes.
Keep in mind that you won't be allowed back in the Maze once you leave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVNET_MAZE_INTRO_1_12.text:
Remember, the fun of any maze is in exploring it -
every nook and cranny.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_01_01.text: Kucing yang aneh, aku penasaran dia mau apa?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_01_03.text: Ah, selama datang, Tuan Kucing pemancing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_01_08.text:
Aku tidak menyangkan kamu dapat berbicara dengan sangat
fasih..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_02_01.text:
Dia ini tempat yang luas, Meow. Tentu saja ada kucing 
yang fasih berbicara.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_02_02.text:
Aku minta maaf. Aku Lednas. Ksatria dari Grancia, 
penjaga kota pahlawan

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_02_03.text: Ini {PLAYER_NAME}. Pemimpin dari para pahlawan kita

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_02_04.text: Apa yang membawamu kemari, Tuan Kucing pemancing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_02_05.text:
Aku hanya berkunjung ke kota - kota besar, dengan 
penduduk yang banyak. Meow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_02_06.text:
Ini desa yang bagus, meow. Ceria, semangat dan banyak 
teman..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_04_03.text:
Ya! Saat kemari, aku melihat banyak orang dengan hobi yang 
berbeda. Tapi tidak ada yang memancing, meow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_04_04.text:
Itu benar.. Aku tidak pernah melihat seseorang yang pergi
memancing sebagai hobi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_04_05.text:
Baiklah, semuanya salah paham, meow. Ada banyak 
keseruan dari seni memancing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_04_06.text:
Kegembiraan saat tiba di tempat pemancingan, 
membayangkan ikan apa yang akan kamu dapat!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_04_07.text:
Perbedaan antara ketenangan dan ketegangan setelah 
kamu melempar pancing dan menunggu tarikan ikan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_04_08.text:
Keseruan saat kamu bertaruh dengan ikan! Antisipasi dan 
rasa penasaran tentang spesies dan ukuran!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_04_09.text:
Tapi yang terpenting dari semua, momen kemenangan 
dimana kamu menarik ikan dari air. MEOW-ZER!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_04_10.text:
Lihatkan? Ada banyak kesenangan dari memancing! 
Itu adalah fakta terpenting, aku sampai mengucapkan 
dua kali

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_04_11.text:
Sangat disayangkan bagi para penduduk Hasla, betapa
mereka tidak menyadarinya, meow

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_04_12.text:
Aku datang kemari untuk menyebarkan kesenangan
akan memancing, semua aspeknya! Meow

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_05_01.text: Ya.. Kamu benar. Memancing sangat menyenangkan

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_05_02.text:
Aku ingat waktu kecilku, aku biasa menemani para 
tetua dari desa memancing di kolam terdekat

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_05_03.text:
Bagaimana, meow?
Kamu ingin memancing bersamaku?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_05_04.text:
Terima kasih atas tawarannya,
aku harus menjaga kota sebagai kewajibanku

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_06_01.text: Lalu bagaimana denganmu? Kamu tampaknya tertarik.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_06_03.text:
Kamu pasti lelah dari pertempuran tiada henti
Kamu harus menghabiskan waktu menikmati ketenangan

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FISH_OPENING_07_02.text:
Ada lokasi memancing yang bagus dekat sini 
Aku akan ajarkan dasarnya padamu disana

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_ENDING_1_001.text:
Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}! You saved my smithy! The town!
The future of all heroes who will come wanting to forge their weapons!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_ENDING_1_002.text:
I'll stay behind and clean up the mess. Well done, chap.
You can go now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_ENDING_2_001.text:
Master Fergus, about the rewards you promised us
for taking care of the defective robots -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_ENDING_3_001.text:
What! You want MORE after taking that much from me?
Have some pity! And a conscience!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_ENDING_3_002.text:
My workshop got nearly destroyed today!
I have much to do without you nagging at me so greedily!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_ENDING_4_001.text: This experiment was a success as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_ENDING_4_002.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} and Lednas...
They're too trusting for their own good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_ENDING_4_003.text:
Who knew it would be so difficult to hire test subjects
for my Ent Robot's new state-of-the art skills? Hrrmph.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_ENDING_4_004.text:
Now, on the other hand, our good little Hero Captain...
Hardy and indefatigable - they're the perfect lab rat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_ENDING_4_005.text:
Now, time to return and analyze the test results!
Hahahahaha!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_10_001.text:
Thank you! Then let's get going!
Fergusroid is stronger than it looks, so be careful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_1_002.text: Master Fergus? What is it - again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_1_003.text:
S-some defective robots have turned berserk
and are trying to kill me! HELP!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_2_001.text: Thanks for giving me a hand back there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_2_002.text:
W-what is all this?
What exactly is happening, Master Fergus?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_2_003.text: Ahem. Well, I suppose I should start from the beginning...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_3_002.text: To neglect this masterpiece would be a waste of genius.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_3_003.text:
I must safely store it away at once.
It'll keep nice and cozy in my secret storage...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_4_001.text: Pant, pant! That was too close for comfort!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_4_002.text: When did this place get so crowded?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_4_003.text: Hmm... This place really could use some cleaning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_6_001.text: Hmm? What's a robot doing here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_6_002.text:
And a robot in the likeness
of my handsome old face, no less.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_6_003.text:
Let's see... Made of Old Weapons...
Danan's Fragments... Aha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_6_004.text:
I remember now! The Fergusroid I designed
in hopes of inventing an automated domestic servant!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_6_005.text:
I'd abandoned it after discovering it wouldn't turn on.
Who knew it would start moving of its own accord?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_6_006.text:
Whew... This frightening genius of mine... 
It's almost a curse, this inability to fail.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_7_001.text:
Pant... Pant...! What's wrong with them?
They've gone completely bonkers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_7_002.text:
This is a disaster!
I must alert {PLAYER_NAME} at once!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_7_003.text:
Ow ow ow, I'm dying!
Help me!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_9_001.text:
Master Fergus, THIS is why I kept telling you
you must clean your workshop from time to time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_9_002.text:
Your blatant refusal to clean is the reason why you continue
having to deal with this mess, both literal and metaphorical!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_9_004.text:
But now's not the time!
You must help me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_9_005.text:
My smithy! My workshop! Even as we speak it's being destroyed!
There's not a moment to waste!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_9_006.text:
If you help me get rid of
the defective Fergusroids...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_9_007.text:
I'll specially let you take whatever you want
from my storage, no questions asked.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_9_008.text:
I'll even throw in
some bonus rewards!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_9_010.text:
Sigh... I suppose we can't allow 
the town's only smithy be destroyed by robots.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_FUGUROID_INTRO_9_011.text:
As the situation at hand seems urgent,
we will help you this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_1_01.text:
Ah ah... how scary. I'll have to be careful once we get back
to our own world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_1_03.text:
I'm going to erase everything you've gone through in this world
before you go back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_1_04.text: ... If you have a problem with that, try and stop me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_1_05.text:
My, using my own words against me.
That's going a little too far, no?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_2_02.text:
And... Sol Badguy.
I'll be waiting on the other side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_3_02.text:
Who knows... but it's something you all will have to deal with
once you get back to your world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_3_05.text: Yes. It's time for you to go back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_4_01.text:
Finally going back.
By the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_4_02.text:
What you said to Happy Chaos just now -
that applies to us too, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_4_04.text: Because of Happy Chaos, your timelines are all tangled.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_4_05.text:
In order for there to be no issues once you go back...
I'll have to erase your memories from this world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_4_06.text:
And... when you said when we first met this time
that this was my 'fourth time.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_4_07.text:
You're also saying that every time we came here,
we had our memories erased?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_4_08.text:
... You're sharp. That's right. Although, this was the first
time Happy Chaos appeared.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_5_01.text:
It was a short amount of time, but I owe you one.
{PLAYER_NAME}, Lednas, and lil' lady.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_5_02.text:
Thanks for taking care of us.
Although we'll forget all of this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_5_03.text: You guys will have to remember for us! Alright?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_5_04.text:
Don't mention it. It was an honor and a fun time for us
thanks to you all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_5_06.text:
Yeah, thanks.
Where are the rest?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_5_07.text:
Don't worry.
I opened a dimensional rift in town too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_5_08.text:
... The townspeople are going crazy about it, but
nothing to worry about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_5_09.text:
There's always something happening huh...
Then, we'll be on our way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_6_03.text: I wonder what they'll be up to in their own world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_6_04.text:
Who knows.
Even I can't tell what happens in other dimensions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_6_05.text:
But if it's them, they will follow their beliefs and forge
their own paths.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_6_06.text:
Either way, their stories are theirs alone.
Let's just worry about our own here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_6_09.text:
Does the #Book of Hasla# really contain everything
that happens?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_6_11.text:
W-Would it be okay if I look at it a little bit...
Like to see who my future spouse would be, or...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_1_01.text:
Heh, to think this kind of world existed.
How interesting, the Backyard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_1_02.text:
Hmm.
Looks like it's a space that exists between dimensional warps.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_1_03.text:
Moreover, there's a Library of Dimensions here that
records all things...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_2_01.text:
As expected it looks well-guarded.
What a bother. What to do...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_3_01.text:
... HAHAHA!
I just got a good idea!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_4_01.text:
Greetings, {PLAYER_NAME} and Sera.
Are you on a walk?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_4_02.text:
Yes, Lednas! The weather is so good today!
Are you on a walk too?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_4_03.text:
Indeed. The sunlight looked too good for me to be
sitting in my office all day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_4_04.text: Hehe, I wish everyday was as peaceful as today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_4_05.text:
Agreed. Today feels especially nice.
Almost a little too nice...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_4_06.text: Usually something always happens when it's like this, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_5_01.text: ... It seems I spoke too soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_5_02.text:
L-Look over there!
A hole in the sky!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_6_01.text: P-People are falling from the sky!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_6_02.text:
Ugh, where are we?
I was definitely just in the Illyria Castle...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_6_03.text:
Calm down, Frederick.
This doesn't look like Illyria, or even a city at all?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_6_04.text:
Ah, you're right.
What in the world happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_01.text:
Hello.
My name is Lednas. I am the Captain of Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_03.text:
As expected... it seems you came here from
another dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_05.text:
And Hero Town is part of the Grancia Empire, located
in the center of the continent of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_06.text:
Another dimension?
What kind of idioti---

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_07.text:
I mean, besides that lady, no one else seems bothered.
Do things like this just happen here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_08.text: ... Well, it doesn't happen too often.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_09.text:
Visitors from other worlds like you tend to drift through
Hasla every now and then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_10.text:
And every time that happens, we try to help them get back
to their own worlds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_11.text: I know someone who can help, would you follow me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_8_01.text: ... Doesn't sound like a lie she made up on the spot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_8_02.text:
Lead the way. I don't fully trust you, but staying here
isn't going to do anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_8_03.text:
Very well. Then, {PLAYER_NAME}, Sera. Let's head over
to the Library of Dimensions with them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_8_04.text: I am certain that Pandora is already aware of the situation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_1_01.text:
Welcome, {PLAYER_NAME}, Lednas.
You're 5 minutes later than I predicted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_2_01.text: You were watching as we expected, Pandora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_2_02.text:
Well, usually when weird things happen in Hasla,
they happen close to you guys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_2_03.text: I've been waiting since I felt the dimensional warp.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_2_04.text:
These people are...
Ah, they're here 'again' from that dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_3_01.text:
Is this sleepy-looking lady the one who will save us?
She doesn't look like the reliable type.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_3_02.text:
Hmm. This is your fourth time now,
but of course you don't remember.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_3_04.text:
Don't worry about it.
It's fine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_4_01.text:
So... what do we know?
Why is there a dimensional rift this time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_4_02.text:
First... this dimensional rift was caused by #another being#
from your world this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_4_03.text: I don't know who it is, but it seems they are quite powerful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_4_04.text: They're the ones in control of his dimensional rift this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_4_05.text:
So in conclusion, in order for you guys to get back home...
That being is the only way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_4_06.text:
Would you happen to know anyone from your world who
could possibly be behind this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_4_07.text:
There are tons of bastards who would think things like this.
But on this scale... maybe just one or two of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_5_02.text:
Hmm... Anyway, I've figured out the coordinates of the others
that came over here with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_5_03.text:
You should find and bring them back here. Surely, the pieces
will start falling into place sooner or later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_6_01.text:
Tch. I don't know who this person thinks they are,
but when I catch them, they're dead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_6_02.text: Hand over the coordinate. I'll go bring the others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_6_04.text: I, I want to come too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_6_05.text:
Hmm... Sera, could you let the other Goddesses in the town
know about the current situation?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_6_06.text:
Since we're dealing with a powerful being that can control
this dimensional rift, it's best they be prepared.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_6_07.text:
I wanted to go with you...
*Sob,* understood.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_7_01.text:
Lednas, right?
Looks like I owe you one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_7_02.text:
Don't sweat it.
I'm just fulfilling my duties.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_7_03.text:
... Ah, there's one more thing before you go. Dimensional rifts
can also warp space-time too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_7_04.text:
That means that though everyone that came here may be from
the same world, they may not be from the #same time#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_7_05.text:
Even if you know them, they may be completely different from
how you know them. Take care.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_7_06.text:
... I'll keep that in mind.
Then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_8_01.text:
My... they left without even knowing where to go.
{PLAYER_NAME}, let us make haste the follow them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_10_01.text:
Wow, are those Zepp's mechanical soldiers?
Although they look a little different.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_10_02.text:
Those are Steamers...
Looks like they came from the past with the rift opening.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_10_03.text:
This is what I meant when I said troublesome things earlier.
Let's take care of these right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_11_01.text: Oh? These don't look so bad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_11_02.text:
Good timing, I was starting to get restless.
Perfect for a quick workout.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_11_04.text:
While we're at it, why not place bets on who can
take more of them down?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_11_05.text: Fine by me. I'll go first!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_1_02.text: ... You guys came back faster than I thought you would.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_1_03.text: Did you find the rest of them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_1_04.text:
Ah, they're all gathered outside.
I recognized all of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_1_05.text: But we couldn't find any clues about who's behind all this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_1_06.text:
All I could figure out was that they came from a time that was
before my #current# time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_1_07.text:
... That shouldn't be possible. There were 13 traces of passage
through the rift... hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_2_01.text:
... New presences are coming through to this world.
This time, three people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_2_03.text:
Unlike the first time, they're scattered throughout Hasla.
What are they after?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_3_01.text: ... I think I figured out what they want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_3_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, Sera, Sol Badguy. Please go and bring
back the drifters again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_3_03.text: But this time, go together with this world's goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_3_04.text:
If it's what I'm thinking... We should be able to uncover 
the real intentions of whoever caused this rift.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_4_01.text:
Looks like you have some sort of plan.
Since I'm not from around here, I'll follow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_4_02.text:
L-Leave it to us!
I'm an apprentice goddess too, so...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_4_03.text: Then... I'll leave it to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_5_02.text: All I remember is trying to chase down that #samurai#...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_6_01.text: Oho, so you were here, as expected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_6_02.text:
There's no doubt about this aura.
It's even stronger seeing you face to face.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_6_04.text: Finding them in such a vast place!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_6_05.text:
Don't say too much of it.
As the Snow Goddess this should be easy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_6_06.text:
Nah, this is definitely amazing.
I sometimes get lost in my own desert.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_6_07.text: That's just because you're so stupid!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_7_01.text:
Huh? Sol Badguy...?
What are you doing in a place like this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_7_02.text: Who are these people next to you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_7_03.text:
Huh?? Who are you?
You know me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_7_04.text:
We saw each other at the White House, no?
How rude to forget the person who saved your life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_7_06.text:
Ah, I see. This is what that library meant by
a 「warped space-time」 huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_7_07.text:
Hmm. It seems the me you know is the me
from the future.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_01.text:
But, the White House?
What would future me be doing there getting saved?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_02.text:
Hmm, well...
It's a bit of a long story...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_03.text: Stop! Let's leave things at that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_04.text: Huh, are spoilers forbidden here or something?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_05.text:
From my personal experience... it's better not not
meddle with other time periods.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_06.text:
It's not enough to cause a time paradox, but...
Troublesome things can still happen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_08.text:
Seeing you didn't try to run after seeing me,
we must not be on bad terms.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_09.text:
We're trying to gather everyone who fell into this dimension
in order to get back to our own world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_11.text:
... Yeah, sure.
There's not much I can do here alone anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_1_02.text: I just remember being sucked in by something...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_2_01.text:
I can't reach anyone from here... I didn't expect much but...
Hmm, so what happened...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_3_02.text:
Stop talking like that. Anyway, to think you were
wandering around in a place like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_3_03.text:
Are you here to find me? I was lost without a way to contact
anyone and it was rough. Not that it matters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_3_04.text: Well, I'm in the same position as you in this world right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_3_05.text:
Is that so... well, whatever.
By the way, who's with you right now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_3_06.text:
They're locals here.
I was able to find you thanks to them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_01.text:
Even though I can't see, I can still feel it.
This energy, it's not that of a normal person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_02.text: ... We are goddesses of this world of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_03.text: We're here to help you all get back to your own worlds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_04.text:
It seems like if we can't find out who made this mess then
it'll be impossible for you to return.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_05.text:
But do not worry.
{PLAYER_NAME} is looking for a way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_06.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}? I'm not sure who that is but
it seems like they are quite trusted around here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_07.text:
Sol Badguy is traveling with them right now.
I think it's okay to trust them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_08.text:
Millia, if that is what you think,
then I have nothing to worry about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_09.text: Very well, I'll go with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_5_03.text:
Shadow Demons...!
{PLAYER_NAME} should've already taken care of them...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_5_04.text:
Were they hiding in the sewers?
But why are they showing up now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_5_05.text:
I see.
I knew they gave off a similar energy to Eddie's.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_5_07.text:
Seems they came out feeling a familiar energy.
What a shame, we can't talk in peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_5_08.text: Since we're in a rush here, let's settle this quickly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_1_01.text: The bleeding has stopped. Rest easy now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_2_01.text:
Ah! {PLAYER_NAME}!
A, a monster is attacking the goblin!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_2_02.text:
My, Sera. You must not judge a book by its cover.
I think that's a person?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_2_05.text:
Oh my~ so different from what I heard about you from
other people!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_3_02.text:
I'll explain what's happening later, but won't you
come with us for now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_3_03.text: Everyone is gathered in this place called Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_3_04.text:
I can't go right now.
Patients come first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_3_05.text: By patient you mean... that goblin?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_4_01.text:
Their body structure is different from ours.
We must take extra care.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_4_03.text:
Helping even monsters, you must be a really
kind person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_4_04.text:
*Sob* I'm sorry I thought you were scary when I first
saw you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_4_05.text: It happens all the time, don't worry about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_5_01.text:
Kek!!! Oi, human!
Help me out here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_5_02.text:
This monster of a human here,
He ain't helpin'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_5_03.text:
I just told him to pay the toll for passin',
but he beat me up and is treating me eh!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_5_04.text: He told me to stay calm and he won't even let me go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_6_01.text: He's saying something... can you guys understand him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_6_02.text:
How embarrassing. For as long as I've lived...
I can't understand goblin...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_6_04.text: Sounds like he wants a toll payment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_6_05.text: Faust is treating him right now, what an ungrateful goblin!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_7_01.text:
Even I understand 2 languages, what are you guys!
You got it all wrong here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_7_02.text: Ah, ah, someone please help me out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_8_03.text: I. Protect. The. Monsters. Of. The. Forest. !

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_8_04.text:
Everyone, watch out!
This is a formidable opponent!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_8_05.text:
Hmm~ so this really is a fantasy world.
That's a golem?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_8_06.text:
Yes... it's made of very sturdy rocks, so it's very hard to 
take down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_9_01.text:
Ya dumb humans better be ready!
Golem! Take it away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_1_01.text:
Oi, librarian! We're back.
What, she ain't here? Where'd she go?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_2_01.text:
As far as I know, Pandora has never left her spot in the
library...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_2_03.text: D-Do you think she went to the bathroom?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_2_04.text:
Higher beings like her just imitate human habits.
She doesn't need to use the bathroom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_2_05.text:
Instead of creating a misunderstanding, let me show
myself right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_3_01.text: Nice to meet you. It seems you are {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_3_02.text:
You're a lot more capable than I thought. I purposely sent you
far away, but you came back quickly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_3_03.text:
And... Flame of Corruption and Scales of Juno.
We haven't met yet, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_3_05.text:
This won't mean much to you but...
My name is #Happy Chaos#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_3_06.text:
The one you've been looking for, the one controlling
this dimensional rift. That's me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_4_02.text:
Let's hold on that conversation for a bit.
My host is waiting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_5_03.text:
You... what are you after?
What are you doing this for?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_6_01.text: I just wanted to read a page of this book.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_6_02.text: Eh? Book? All you have to do for that is ask...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_6_03.text:
... The book he wants to read, the #Book of Hasla# is
not just any book.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_6_04.text:
It is the ultimate book that has all of this world's past and future
written directly in it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_6_05.text: Th-that kind of book exists? Who wrote that book?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_6_06.text: I wrote it. Well, I will be writing it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_7_01.text:
I'm the librarian that records everything about Hasla.
The context of time is irrelevant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_7_02.text:
That book is to be written in the future,
and it exists within this library.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_7_03.text:
But... it existing, and reading it 'now' is a completely
different issue.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_7_04.text:
Because then it will be confirmed that someone will read
what is written in the Book of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_7_05.text:
For you who came here from another world,
No, to anyone - no one has the right to that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_7_06.text:
I know that.
That's why I'm here to force it to be seen by me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_7_07.text:
If you have a problem with that, try and stop me.
Guardian of this world, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_1_001.text: I do not see any Goblins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_1_002.text:
Huh.
Can it be that Longears was wrong?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_1_003.text:
What? This is the only path!
You know this as well as I do!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_1_004.text:
You aren't wrong.
There are definitely traces of Goblin here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_2_002.text: Be careful. It does not seem an ordinary object.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_3_003.text: Everyone, look! There are Goblins beyond this mirror...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_4_001.text: Fortunately, it seems they can't see us from their side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_4_002.text:
Wait, Orcbolg.
Look at that Goblin. Isn't that Goblin Lord, the one you spoke of?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_4_003.text:
Yes.
That is a Goblin Lord.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_4_005.text:
Maybe the Goblins used the mirror somehow
to teleport to that place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_4_009.text: Sigh... I thought you might say that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_5_001.text: Will we chase after them at once?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_5_002.text:
No. We don't know our way around the forest,
and we cannot be too sure of our surroundings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_5_003.text:
And more than anything...
There are too many Goblins right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_5_004.text:
We are not the Hero
nor are we Platinum Ranks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_5_005.text:
We will not be able to fend off
that many Goblins in the forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_7_001.text:
The Goblins of your world indeed sound different from those of Hasla,
for them go commit such atrocities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_7_003.text:
There are good Goblins in our world of Hasla, who live in harmony
with others. You should not be too quick in judging the-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_7_004.text:
Did you see these peaceful Goblins with your own eyes?
I think you are the one who is quick to judge on a mere rumor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_8_001.text:
Haha… I apologize on his behalf. 
He can be a little... strange, sometimes…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_8_003.text:
I understand that the Goblins of your world are dangerous.
I will warn the nearby towns to prepare against any possibility of attack.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_8_004.text:
Thank you.
We too will prepare the best as we can.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_1_001.text:
Ugh… with this many,
the situation can get tiring very quickly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_1_002.text: Milord Goblin Slayer too found it a little overwhelming.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_1_003.text: I must ask... How did you come all the way here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_1_004.text:
I received a quest to bring you all back.
As an adventurer, I have a responsibility to see all my quests through.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_2_001.text:
Goblin Riders!
Move to the designated location!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_2_002.text:
Don't forget - Wolves will jump to dodge attacks.
Hold until the last moment!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_4_001.text: Good, let's now take care of the rest!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_4_002.text: By the way, Beardcutter is nowhere to be seen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_4_003.text: Have you already forgotten what he's like?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_4_004.text: Milord Goblin Slayer will have gone to slay more Goblins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_5_001.text: If you have time to chat, come and help us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_5_002.text:
Hoho, he's right.
Let us quickly defeat these Goblin scum!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_1_1_002.text:
I had enough soldiers...
Weapons, Wolves, strategy... Nothing was amiss...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_1_1_003.text: How can my plans have failed so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_1_1_005.text: But as long as I survive... There will be a next time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_1_1_006.text:
I will learn from my mistakes... 
I will do better next time…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_1_1_007.text: I will not be outwitted again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_1_1_009.text:
Fool.
I already know what you are thinking.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_1_2_001.text:
You no longer have a home,
and you cannot return.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_1_001.text: Hee hee hee... And here you were, so full of yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_1_002.text:
These wounds are nothing. I have suffered the likes of them many times.
But look at yourself at death's door!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_1_003.text:
I will not let you die so easily...
I will make you suffer until you beg for mercy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_2_001.text:
... Hrrmph! You take the fun out of this.
Prey must quiver in fear for their slaughter to be enjoyable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_2_002.text:
I will end you here
and take the first step of my new beginning!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_4_002.text:
please protect us, the weak, with the powers
of the earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_5_003.text: I will never... Do anything bad... Ever again...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_5_005.text: Forgive me...! Pity me and let me go...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_6_001.text: Like hell that's going to work…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_6_002.text:
Lord? How foolish.
You are just a Goblin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_6_003.text:
Just a filthy... little Goblin.
And as I said before…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_6_004.text: You will die right here, right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_8_001.text:
Goblin Slayer...!
Your wounds are deep...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_8_003.text:
Please place your gentle hand upon 
this being's wounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_9_003.text: Please… Please try… to be more careful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_9_004.text:
I'm sorry.
It's because... I trusted you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_9_005.text:
You…
You really are a helpless person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_9_006.text: But I suppose we can go back now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GRADE_UP_QUEST_0003_2.text:
We need someone with fresh taste!
{PLAYER_NAME}! Do you want to try Promoting a new Hero?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_1_03.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, excuse me.
There seems to be a letter tucked in your pocket...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_2_01.text:
Congratulations! You have been chosen to compete in
the 'Glorious Knight Melee' as an honorary member of the 'Steel Knights'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_2_03.text:
... I can almost see your expression while reading this letter. I apologize
for whacking... I mean, employing some necessary methods of persuasion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_2_04.text:
B-but! You must admit that you wouldn't have agreed
to participate if I hadn't!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_2_05.text:
Even if it's only a mock battle, it must be done properly -
with the accurate number of troops in the Empire. Which includes you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_2_06.text:
Just... play along to my whims this one time, won't you?
And you'll get some good rewards if you win: an emperor's promise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_2_07.text:
Then I take it that you are participating.
I will see you soon on the battlefield!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_3_01.text:
... What did he do this time...
Sigh... I need a holiday...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_3_02.text:
Oh. Did I say that out loud?
I apologize, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_3_03.text: It seems... His Majesty... has been up to one of his "good ideas."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_3_04.text:
I would like to help you return right away, but I fear I too am caught
between a rock and a hard place - the Order needs the subsidies, you see...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_3_05.text:
If it is not too much trouble, could you help our Order
rightfully claim victory in this battle?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_3_06.text:
My knights will learn much from fighting together with an honorable
Hero Captain such as yourself, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_4_02.text:
It may be but a mock battle, but I still find it a great honor
to fight by your side, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_4_03.text:
I ask for much guidance.
Let us now prepare for battle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_1_01.text:
Oh, is that you, {PLAYER_NAME}?
I hadn't been expecting you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_1_02.text: And with such a pretty letter tucked in your pocket...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_1_03.text:
Are you the 'present'
Uncle Alexander mentioned?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_2_01.text:
Congratulations! You have been chosen to compete in
the 'Glorious Knight Melee' as an honorary member of the 'Central Knights'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_3_01.text:
Uncle can be... unpredictable at times, but he means well.
You must be feeling somewhat bewildered, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_3_02.text:
I must admit, all the knights were rather taken aback
by Uncle's insistence on this... mock battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_3_03.text:
... Well, my knights could use some extra training.
Nothing can fool an emperor's eyes, it seems.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_3_04.text:
As things have come down to this...
I swear on the honor of the Central Order that we will be victorious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_3_05.text:
You will help me, won't you,
{PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_4_01.text: Huhu, I knew I could trust you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_4_02.text:
It is destined for the Central Order to claim victory -
especially with your help, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_4_03.text: Now, shall we begin planning our strategy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_1_02.text:
I-I'm a big fan! Oh, wait. Not now, Gwen...
W-what are you doing here, Captain {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_1_03.text: Oh, and a letter just fell out of your pocket!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_2_01.text:
Congratulations! You have been chosen to compete in
the 'Glorious Knight Melee' as an honorary member of the 'Lion Knights'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_3_02.text:
I... I understand... His Majesty doesn't trust me,
not yet...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_3_03.text:
He thinks that I need your help, {PLAYER_NAME},
in order to fight on equal footing with the other better knights...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_3_04.text: Ugh... My stomach hurts from all the pressure...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_3_05.text:
I need to do a good job...
If I want to reclaim honor for our Lion Knights...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_4_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}... That look in your eyes...
Do you mean to say that you... will trust me, despite everything?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_4_02.text: ... Thank you! And I just learned something from you, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_4_03.text:
A true knight always tackles her troubles head-on,
no matter how difficult they may seem!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_4_04.text:
I'll do anything to prove my worth
and restore glory to the Lion Knights!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. Do you have any questions about the tournament?
You want Knight Tokens? You can have them! But you'll have to find them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_1_001.text:
Ahem. ... It was my idea to hold this mock tournament.
I thought up of everything - the rules, the restrictions, the rewards...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_1_002.text:
You've heard already? Hrrmph, you could have shown me some respect
by pretending otherwise. I must say, you wouldn't last too long in court...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_1_003.text:
Anyway... This contest will help me choose the best Knight Order
of Grancia, and so should be a matter of real pride for my knights.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_1_004.text:
Winning is a simple matter, however. By the end of the Melee,
whoever holds the most 'Knight Tokens' will be declared victorious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_2_001.text:
Tokens can be acquired in Scenarios, Dungeons, Raids, 
and the Colosseum - in proportion to the value of the used resources.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_2_002.text:
Hmm? Why take so much trouble, you ask?
I see that in our friendship you've forgotten that I am an emperor!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_2_003.text:
'Knight Tokens' are symbols of honor and chivalry.
Only knights who overcome strife at their lord's command will earn them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_2_004.text:
While 'chivalry' is something that cannot be easily measured...
The more Tokens a knight has, the better I'll know them to be. Easy, eh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_3_001.text:
There are three ways to use 'Knight Tokens.'
The first is to add them to strengthen your own Order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_3_002.text:
But it wouldn't be any fun if that was all, would it? Nothing but tedious,
repetitive work. Therefore, I have prepared a second rule:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_3_003.text:
You can add 'Knight Tokens' to opponent teams and subtract their score
by that number. Running blindly for first place will make you an easy target.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_3_004.text:
It doesn't seem too 'knightly,' you say? Not at all. It is quite
the knightly value to be able to eliminate one's rivals and rise to the top.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_3_005.text: I will explain the third and last way of using 'Knight Tokens' next time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_4_001.text:
Now, for the third and last way of using 'Knight Tokens'! During the Melee,
the three Orders must make me a certain amount of Token 'Offerings.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_4_002.text:
Come to my 'Castle' to find out how much you have to offer me.
You'll want to check frequently: at the beginning and end of each round.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_4_003.text:
It does not matter who makes the most Offerings. I will only check the 
total number of offered 'Knight Tokens' to see if it meets the requirement.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_4_004.text:
Hmm? Rewards for making Offerings? What more could you want
than the honor of serving my Empire? Fine, fine, rewards you will have!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_4_005.text:
However... If you fail to meet the required number of Tokens, all Orders
will pay for their indolence at the end of that round. I will see to it myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_4_006.text:
Oh, and while I'll let you know the required number of Offerings, you won't
know how many Tokens each Order has offered until the end of the round.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_4_007.text:
It wouldn't be a proper tournament if the three Orders just... cooperated.
No, not worth watching at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_001.text:
At the end of each round, I will bestow both 'Victory Rewards' and
'Defender's Rewards.' Yes, they will be real rewards: quite the incentive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_002.text:
Round Rewards' are given to all Orders at the end of every round.
The Order that scores first place in each round will receive a better reward.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_003.text:
'Defender's Rewards' are, as you can imagine, given to an Order
that succeeds in defending their first place for successive rounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_004.text:
For instance, if your Order is victorious for 3 consecutive rounds,
you will receive a 'Defender's Reward' at the end of Round 3.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_005.text:
But if another Order takes your place in Round 4, your victory in Round 5
will not count towards earning a 'Defender's Reward.' You must start again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_006.text:
You can find out more about each Reward
at the 'Headquarters' of the Order to which you belong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_007.text: Try your best to earn 'Defender's Rewards.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_008.text:
One last thing… only those who get at least 1 Knight Token are rewarded.
 You didn't think I'd reward those who lounge around all day, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_1_01.text:
Attention! There you are, Captain {PLAYER_NAME}!
I've been looking everywhere for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_1_02.text:
Ahem. Hear ye! Hear ye!
An imperial order from His Majesty, Emperor Alexander of Grancia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_1_03.text:
Erm, never mind about the 'hear ye'. His Majesty ordered for this letter
to be read by your eyes and your eyes only.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_1_04.text:
It must be quite important. ...Then I'll be on my way.
Attention!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_2_01.text:
How are you, {PLAYER_NAME}? It's been some time since you graced
my court with your presence. Have you grown used to life in Impalis?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_2_02.text:
I write in hopes of gaining your good advice
on a new tournament I will be holding soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_2_03.text:
It is, of course, to be a confidential matter, and you will come
immediately to my palace after you read this letter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_2_04.text:
Necessity has dictated me to make this letter explode within 30 seconds
of opening... Actually, why don't you just go and save me the trouble

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_2_05.text:
by throwing it away yourself?
I will be waiting, as always, on my throne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_3_01.text:
Welcome to my palace, {PLAYER_NAME}!
It is getting more and more difficult to see your face these days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_3_02.text:
Well... I do suppose the busier you are,
the safer it becomes for the continent of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_3_04.text:
Is it not... too peaceful these days, in the Empire?
After the war a few years ago, I am finding everything to be a bore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_3_05.text:
Peace is a much valued asset, of course,
but it does prove rather detrimental to the discipline of my soldiers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_3_06.text:
And that is not good. What would we do, how would we fight
if another Apostle came invading Hasla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_3_07.text:
And that is why I have thought up of a remarkable festival
to train my soldiers AND have fun while doing it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_3_08.text: I present to you... The 'Glorious Knight Melee'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_4_01.text:
Do you not wish to know which Order,
among all the knights of Grancia, is 'the best one'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_4_02.text:
Glorious duels! Sieges among the most valiant knights in the Empire!
And of course, beautiful uniforms for the Knight Captains!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_4_03.text:
After a blood-boiling, intense battle, I will decide on the best Knight Order
and bestow them a fortune of rewards!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_4_04.text:
... Or at least, that was what I'd been planning
before all my ideas were cruelly vetoed by my Knight Captains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_4_05.text:
The Glorious Knight Melee will only be a mock battle.
Of course, the rewards will be real.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_4_06.text:
Hmm? Why am I telling you all this, you ask?
While you're not even a knight of the Empire?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_5_01.text:
...
Sometimes I disapprove of how observant you can be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_6_01.text: ... The... The Captain is not dead, sire?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_6_02.text:
Of course not. A meager blow like that won't kill off a Hero Captain
who faced countless Apostles and other heinous foes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_6_03.text: Now, take them away before they wake up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_6_04.text: And tell the next person waiting outside to come in.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_AD_DISCOUNT_KURENAI.text: The smoke in your eyes makes looking at that flyer difficult, nya! As a reward, I'll give a good price for this, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_AD_DISCOUNT_S2_EP1_.text:
Seseorang telah sangat sibuk membuat gambar yang berbeda dan 
mengirimkan pesan setiap hari. Hmm, aku akan berikan harga 
yang murah, meow !

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_DEFAULT_KURENAI.text: Greetings, nya! This place is scorching, don't you think, nya? But that means more items are on hot sale, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_DEFAULT_S2_EP1_1.text:
Ahem.. Selamat datang meow! Pakaian ini membuatku 
serasa menjadi aristokrat, meow! Aku menyediakan beberapa
