TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_061_START_004.text:
Even in the time of my people, Skrymir was believed to be
a mere metaphor to describe the rough storms of winter...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_061_START_005.text: But now I see that the wolf really did exist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_061_START_006.text:
On our next meeting, I must find out
why the Sacred Being's wolf is attempting to stop us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_062_END_001.text:
Humans forget a lot of things
in so short a time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_062_END_002.text:
I thought I knew it well,
but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_062_END_003.text:
It is still saddening to see 
that the heirs of Olaf have forgotten our long friendship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_062_START_001.text:
Snorri Edda...
It's been some time since I last lingered here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_062_START_002.text: How long has it been? A hundred years?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_062_START_003.text:
Olaf Snorrison was the king of Nosgard back then...
A spirited fellow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_062_START_004.text:
The shield that symbolizes the alliance of the northern 
kingdom was created at his suggestion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_062_START_005.text:
Huhu... Perhaps I shall go and review his
accomplishments, after everything is over.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_063_END_001.text:
Those idiots! Even if their opponent was myself,
it's still no excuse to be defeated so easily!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_063_END_002.text:
That battle just now
was unworthy of the name of Einherjar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_063_END_003.text:
I'll make sure they receive
extra training when I get back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_063_START_001.text: Pride means everything for a warrior.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_063_START_002.text:
Without pride in one's values,
a warrior is nothing more than a butcher with an axe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_063_START_004.text:
How could you make me retreat so dishonorably -
me, the strongest warrior of the Einherjar!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_063_START_005.text:
I can't be caught here,
if only to reclaim my honor and clear my name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_063_START_006.text:
Don't you think even for a moment
than I'm cooperating for your sake!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_064_START_002.text:
It's our most advanced missile weapon
invented by one of our warriors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_064_START_003.text:
I've been requesting for one for a long time.
Now I finally see it in action!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_064_START_004.text:
... Even though I hadn't expected
for myself to be its main target.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_065_END_001.text: I think we've beaten almost all of them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_065_END_002.text:
And seeing that
she still hasn't appeared...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_065_END_003.text: I guess the captain's gone off somewhere!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_065_END_005.text:
And she was attacking us
from the beginning?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_065_START_001.text:
Great, now the Night Ravens are on our tail...
This is NOT good. Not good at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_065_START_002.text:
Their captain is famous - in a bad way.
'The Unseen Killer'... That's what they call her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_065_START_003.text:
From what I hear, she doesn't reveal herself
even to her subordinates.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_065_START_004.text:
If she marks us as her new victims,
we're bound to be dead meat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_065_START_005.text:
Be careful, okay?
She may appear out of nowhere sooner or later!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_066_END_001.text:
Seems the coast is clear.
Thanks, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_066_END_002.text:
Now,
to continue what I was saying...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_066_END_003.text:
The truth is, Odin was the original
successor to the kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_066_END_004.text:
But Odin abandoned his place,
saying that he wasn't interested in a hollow throne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_066_END_005.text:
King Thor His Majesty
rose to the throne in his place...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_066_END_006.text:
... and worked day and night for his people,
until his head turned as barren as the plains in winter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_066_END_007.text:
And now that the kingdom's finally beginning to flourish,
Odin thinks he can march right in and take back the throne!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_066_START_002.text:
First a blizzard, now a revolution -
things have really gotten out of hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_066_START_003.text:
That blasted Odin...
Can't believe he would do something like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_066_START_004.text:
What, he suddenly wants the throne back?
He shouldn't have thrown it away in the first place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_066_START_005.text:
What do I mean, you ask?
Ah, well...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_066_START_006.text:
But here come the pursuers.
Ready to fight, no doubt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_066_START_007.text:
They won't wait for us to finish talking.
Fight first, talk later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_067_END_001.text:
... I can't believe I just destroyed
my ancestor's statue with my own hands...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_067_END_003.text:
But did you just see the statue
moving and swishing its blade?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_067_END_004.text:
Isn't it... Isn't it just so cool?
Protecting the kingdom even in death!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_067_END_005.text:
Oh, someday I'll become a warrior just as great
and get my own stone statue!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_067_START_001.text:
I haven't come out so far from the Capital
in a long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_067_START_002.text:
Soon we'll see
the Hall of Fame in our midst.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_067_START_003.text: Huhu... The Hall of Fame, you ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_067_START_004.text:
It's where the statues of the greatest of the Einherjar
stand in eternal glory!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_067_START_005.text:
I too am working hard to raise a statue of my own
in the Hall of Fame, someday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_067_START_006.text:
... Although right now, I'm not much more
than a shameful fugitive, but... Anyway!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_068_END_001.text: ... It is a day for mourning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_068_END_002.text:
I had not thought that I would witness
the fate of my people like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_068_END_003.text:
... Can it truly be Loki's doing,
out of fear of Freyja's spear?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_068_START_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
May I borrow some of your time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_068_START_003.text:
Despite her status...
I suspect that she knows too much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_068_START_004.text:
I do not doubt the authenticity
of the inheritance of the Einherjar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_068_START_005.text:
Yet I find it strange that she talks of Loki
as if she has confronted him before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_068_START_006.text:
We may want to be careful around her,
just yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_069_END_001.text:
Agh... My arms and legs
still refuse to move properly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_069_END_002.text:
And it feels as if the enemy
are targeting only me and no other.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_069_END_003.text:
If what Freyja said is true, then shouldn't
the enemy be attacking her instead?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_069_END_004.text:
...Say, doesn't Freyja
seem to be doing a little too well...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_069_END_005.text:
... Almost as if she alone
is safe against their attacks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_069_END_006.text:
Hmm? Haha, perhaps I need to rest...
I'm talking nonsense.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_069_END_007.text: Forget what I have just said.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_069_START_002.text:
Just now,
did you not feel that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_069_START_003.text:
It felt as if all strength suddenly left me.
I couldn't move at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_069_START_004.text:
... I've been experiencing such symptoms
ever since Freyja joined us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_069_START_005.text:
Do you know anything about this,
{PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_070_END_001.text:
So you really brought it back!
... I did not judge you for such a rogue.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_070_END_002.text:
...
Are you going to open it any time soon?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_070_END_003.text:
A-ahem.
Please do not look at me like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_070_END_005.text:
Running shoes for women...
And here is a letter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_070_END_007.text:
... A brother's gift to his sister,
sadly unclaimed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_070_START_002.text:
Those letters written
on that package he is holding.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_070_START_003.text:
SIGYN... Unbelievable.
That package must contain the fabled running shoes of old.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_070_START_004.text:
It is a legendary brand, said to have been crafted
by only the best artisans of Ancient Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_070_START_005.text:
It is said that walking in them
feels as if you are floating on air.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_070_START_006.text:
... {PLAYER_NAME},
why do you look at me so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_071_END_001.text:
Well done.
Let's open it now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_071_END_004.text:
Is this it? 
Hmm... No, I have never...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_071_END_005.text:
It seems to have been
a personal memorabilia of sorts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_071_START_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME},
do you see that figure, in the distance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_071_START_003.text:
From her elegant bearing
and refined style of dress,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_071_START_004.text:
I believe she may have been
an important figure of the Frost Elf tribe, long ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_071_START_005.text:
She seems to be wearing
a necklace of some significance,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_071_START_006.text:
which may provide us
some indication as to her identity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_071_START_007.text:
Could you bring us back that necklace,
as you did with the running shoes?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_072_END_001.text: We will reach the Sanctuary soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_072_START_002.text:
Freyja… What does she mean to do when
she arrives at the Sanctuary?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_072_START_003.text:
She hurries for some reason she is not revealing,
and that worries me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_073_END_002.text:
I knew her before
we came to Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_073_END_003.text:
And yet - I've forgotten her existence
until now that I see her again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_073_END_004.text: And it was the same for Jeraphim as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_073_END_005.text:
I do not understand.
What is happening to me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_073_START_001.text:
Freyja...
She emits a strange presence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_073_START_002.text:
She seems...
almost a different person from when I first met her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_073_START_003.text:
... And yet,
she feels strangely familiar, somehow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_073_START_004.text:
My memory fails me.
Where have I felt this presence?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_074_END_01.text:
Jeraphim, Gullveig...
They came to Hasla to... 'purify' it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_074_END_02.text: I don't recall Master Arart mentioning anything of the sort to me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_074_END_03.text: Perhaps she thought I didn't have to know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_074_END_04.text:
No... There must be a misunderstanding.
For all of these records as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_074_END_05.text:
Humans forget everything so easily, in time.
Right? Haha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_074_END_07.text:
... When everything is over, I'll go to the Temple of Illusions
and see for myself - just in case.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_074_START_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
You came straight from Nosgard, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_074_START_02.text: You seem tired... You're not injured anywhere, are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_074_START_03.text:
W-what! I am NOT worried about you!
Stop thanking me for things I've never done!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_074_START_04.text:
You were telling me in the Laboratory about the things you saw
in the Temple of Illusions and the Sanctuary of Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_074_START_05.text:
Tell me more.
If it's related to Master Arart, I must know everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_075_END_01.text:
Sigh... It looked so good from afar.
Our battle ended up revealing its flaws, though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_075_END_02.text: What can I say? Haste makes waste.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_075_START_01.text:
Oh, crap...
{PLAYER_NAME}, are you seeing that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_075_START_02.text: That energy cannon that defies all safety measures!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_075_START_03.text:
That hydraulic drive system watched by a full-time engineer
since it may implode at any moment!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_075_START_04.text:
Now that's the tank of my dreams!
Wowie... I wish I could just... touch it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_075_START_05.text:
Okay, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Please help me sneak one away - just this once!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_076_END_02.text:
Oh. You never mentioned that the dog was...
a robotic one, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_076_END_04.text:
I'll now proceed to have a bonding moment
with this good boy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_076_END_05.text: There, there, boy! Everything's alright now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_076_START_01.text:
Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}!
How is the mission coming along?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_076_START_02.text:
What? I can't hear you...
You're afraid of the hounds?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_076_START_03.text:
Haha! {PLAYER_NAME},
you can be surprisingly soft for a Hero Captain!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_076_START_04.text:
They may have been trained for warfare, but dogs are always men's 
best friend! I'm sure they'll become warm and loving with affection!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_076_START_05.text:
Why don't you rescue the dogs from the Neth Army?
They'll be happier with a more loving owner, I think.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_077_END_01.text: A tank renovated with magical engineering technology...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_077_END_02.text:
Had machinery like this been used in the last war,
history may have turned out very different.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_077_END_03.text:
Well, I suppose you would have stopped them anyway,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_077_START_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, can you hear me?
We confirmed some of the rebels heading your way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_077_START_02.text:
The pursuing party might have been hastily improvised,
but their commander is a force to be reckoned with.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_077_START_03.text:
Pursuit Commander Svenja. She is a young genius,
infamous for her reckless victories in the past Neth War.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_077_START_04.text:
She was imprisoned as a war criminal,
but it seems the House of Nobles stole her out for their own uses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_078_END_02.text:
Huhuhu... I can't wait to return to my workshop
and upgrade my babies using this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_078_START_02.text:
We came all the way to the Neth Empire,
and I haven't obtained even one weapon to upgrade my babies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_078_START_03.text: I'll regret it for the rest of my life if I return to Nosgard like this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_078_START_04.text:
Sooo... Could you get me some of those weapons
used by the Neth pursuers? Pleeeease, with a cherry on top?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_079_END_01.text:
Ouch, I haven't been doing this
for some time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_079_END_02.text:
I'm sorry. I'm actually a spy working for N.D.D.
Well, I used to be, anyway. I've been forgetting about my mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_079_END_03.text: The organization hadn't forgotten about me, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_079_END_04.text:
Still, I tried my best,
and they should know it as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_079_END_05.text:
I need to return now.
My patients are waiting for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_079_START_02.text:
Erm, I have something I want to talk about in private...
Could you follow me for a moment?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_080_END_02.text:
This android's system is based on R-0's emotion module -
but distorted, so as to produce the more extreme passions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_080_END_03.text:
There may be even more androids
that copy human emotions through their system.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_080_END_04.text:
The scientists at Road Industry... Are they not afraid that
their creations may one day awaken and know what it is to be human?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_080_START_02.text:
That android called 'V.'
Her 'passion code' module interests me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_080_START_03.text:
If you can get your hands on one,
bring it back to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_081_END_01.text:
Pssh... I'd hoped that you might find the battle difficult.
A fool's hope it was.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_081_START_01.text:
Pssh... {PLAYER_NAME}...
I regret our previous confrontation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_081_START_02.text:
If you wish to infiltrate the premises... pssh...
I could give you some useful information, as repayment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_081_START_03.text:
The private soldiers guarding the Headquarters used to be a troop
of N.D.D, organized to test out new weapons, pssh...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_081_START_04.text:
Their equipment has been upgraded with Road Industry technology.
They will be a difficult foe... pssh.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_081_START_05.text:
In addition, it is highly probable that they have used your data collected
in the last war to further enhance a defense system... Be careful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_082_END_02.text:
What's in the parcel, you ask?
It's a present for Commander Spyro!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_082_END_03.text:
Look, rainbow boxers for each day of the week!
I know he's been wearing only the ones that come in the army support kit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_082_END_04.text: Huh? Why are you staring at me like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_082_START_02.text: I... I have something to ask you, sir!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_082_START_03.text:
If you're going to the Headquarter Offices,
could you retrieve a parcel addressed to me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_082_START_04.text:
Well, I... had set my address as the Headquarters,
and I hadn't expected to, erm, resign so soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_082_START_05.text: Thank you for your help, sir!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_083_END_01.text:
Pssh... You returned safely this time as well,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_083_END_02.text:
How did you... pssh...
penetrate Blood Hound's camouflage?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_083_END_03.text:
You... pssh... demolished the entire floor?
Almost... pssh... barbaric...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_083_START_01.text:
Pssh... {PLAYER_NAME}...
So you arrived at the Research Hall.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_083_START_02.text:
Blood Hound should be guarding the premises, pssh...
He is a former mercenary, almost as famous as the legendary Viper.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_083_START_03.text:
Recently, he has upgraded... pssh... his optical camouflage device
that he developed himself with the technology of Road Industry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_083_START_04.text: Be careful of... pssh... the enemies you cannot see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_084_END_01.text: Thank you for helping me obtain the module.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_084_END_02.text:
However, this is a language module;
I recall specifically asking for R-0's emotion module.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_084_END_03.text:
I do not understand.
What do you mean when you say, you got it on purpose?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_084_END_04.text:
They may not have been perfect, but I do not think
my previous speech habits were defective.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_084_START_01.text:
Confirmed identity: {PLAYER_NAME}.
Requesting conversation. Confirm request?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_084_START_03.text:
Replayed battle data of R-0 and V on loop.
Results of simulation: unsatisfactory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_084_START_04.text:
Requesting version upgrade for: Monte, version 001.
Analyzed recent upgrade trends. Noted lack of emotion module.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_085_END_01.text:
Huh. You found it strong...
but you didn't find its appearance pleasing at all?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_085_END_02.text:
Hmm, how strange. I remember reading from the latest issue of the
Neth science journal that the design itself was an innovation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_085_END_03.text:
It was supposed to provide an ironic commentary
on the female android fad. Well, I guess you can't please everyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_085_START_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, have you heard the rumors
surrounding Doctor Gunther's newest weapon?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_085_START_02.text:
Apparently, Doctor Gunther has been bragging about it
at the recent conferences...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_085_START_03.text:
After the latest experiment, it was classified as dangerous
and locked away in the top floor of the Headquarters!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_085_START_04.text:
If you ever fight it,
please tell me how it went!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_086_END_01.text: Thank you. You won't regret helping me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_086_END_02.text:
Sigh... I just hope she doesn't find out the particle
has gone missing any time soon. I can see her going nuts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_086_END_03.text:
She thinks she can own all my work because she funded it.
With money that's not even her own. Hrrmph.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_086_END_04.text:
... Hmm?
How do I know Levine, you ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_086_END_05.text:
Oh, she's my older sister.
I know... I'm embarrassed about it, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_086_END_06.text:
I try to keep it a secret in Edenberg -
it's bad enough as it is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_086_START_01.text:
It's been awhile, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I see you're still alive and well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_086_START_02.text:
I heard that you recently invaded Road Industry.
It's all over the news. I laughed so hard when I first heard it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_086_START_03.text:
Since you're already there,
could you do me a favor?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_086_START_04.text:
I want my IC Particle back.
Levine Ludovico stole it from me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_087_END_01.text:
Officer Benjamin...
Who would have guessed that he was a clone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_087_END_02.text:
Does this mean that there are many geniuses like him
in the land of Heaven?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_087_END_03.text:
The thought is horrifying.
That pure genius - coupled with such bad temper - in such vast numbers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_087_END_04.text: Oh, that's not the case? Well, that in any case is a relief...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_087_START_01.text:
I had thought Heaven to be a mythical sanctuary for the gods,
a mere legend without much truth to it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_087_START_02.text: I had never expected it to be a real place. Fascinating.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_087_START_03.text:
So the rumors claiming Officer Benjamin is a divine being come down
from the heavens... I suppose they are true, to an extent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_088_END_01.text:
Did you defeat him? ...
Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_088_END_02.text: The Tyrant would be grateful as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_088_END_03.text:
Look at his face... To have changed so horribly
under the brunt of such cruel experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_088_END_04.text:
Had he retained some intelligence,
he would have taken his own life. I am sure of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_088_START_01.text:
What is the matter, {PLAYER_NAME}?
Hmm? An anomaly among the enemy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_088_START_02.text:
An entity that has undergone muscle enhancements...
It may come as a surprise to you, but he is the same 'version' as myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_088_START_03.text:
Project Tyrant...
They have succeeded, if rather crudely.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_088_START_04.text:
Be careful, {PLAYER_NAME}.
A single strike, and you won't be recovering soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_089_END_01.text:
Whew, what a relief!
We found him!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_089_END_02.text:
Different colored hair... Bad temper...
Yes, this is our Benjamin, alright.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_089_START_02.text:
The one we've been following...
He was just a clone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_089_START_03.text: Where did the real Benjamin go?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_090_END_01.text:
It hadn't been so obvious due to his hood, but -
I see now that he is worse off than the Tyrant we faced earlier.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_090_END_02.text:
... Alright. I will say no more of this matter.
So stop looking at me like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_090_END_03.text:
Please refrain from preaching
for a few hours, will you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_090_START_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
Do you not feel that? Those electromagnetic waves... They hurt my head.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_090_START_02.text:
All clones of Galatea possess some psychic ability...
But that one is special.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_090_START_03.text:
He seems to be the result of an experiment
maximizing psychic potential.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_090_START_04.text:
However...
I cannot sense any consciousness from him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_090_START_05.text:
Perhaps his psychic abilities are too strong
to the point of impeding the rest of his brain functions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_090_START_06.text:
Which would mean that he is extremely volatile.
Be careful when facing him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_091_END_02.text: Only a single line recording his existence remains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_091_END_03.text:
A pity.
I wished to converse with him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_091_START_01.text:
Now that I have returned 'home,'
I am reminded of a kinsman I met back on earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_091_START_02.text:
I do not know what sin he committed in Heaven - 
only that it was enough for him to lose his head before being banished.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_091_START_03.text:
What truly surprised me was the fact
that his body remained 'alive,' in a sense, even without its head...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_091_START_04.text: Quite recently I have seen him move and act of his own accord.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_091_START_05.text: The head could still be in Heaven somewhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_092_END_01.text:
Mast - No... Arart.
What is her ulterior motive?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_092_END_02.text:
If she's against the Kalard,
can it be that she's a possible ally?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_092_END_03.text:
... No. I can't forgive her for the atrocities that transgressed
both in the Temple of Illusions and Heaven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_092_END_04.text:
As her former student,
it's my duty to stop Arart!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_092_START_01.text: I never even dreamt of my master being alive, after all these years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_092_START_02.text:
I... I dug her grave myself.
With my own hands...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_092_START_03.text:
I don't understand.
When did she betray us and join the Kalard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_092_START_04.text:
...
I must receive an answer. Whatever it is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_END_02.text: … Umrat asked you to buy me a present in her place…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_END_03.text:
… but you didn’t have the time to do so,
and are giving me the #sparkling stones# instead?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_END_05.text: … Hmm? The value of #these sparkling stones#?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_END_06.text:
They’re pieces of merged plastic and glass, so they aren’t
worth very much. It must be industrial waste from Neth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_END_07.text:
However… The care and thought that Umrat put into
this present is what makes it truly valuable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_END_08.text:
I’ll string a necklace out of them
and show it to Umrat the next time we meet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_END_09.text: Thank you for bringing them to me, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_START_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}…
Do you have a moment to spare?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_START_03.text:
You see, I wanted to give a gift to Haerang. I hear
that’s what humans do to express their gratitude.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_START_04.text:
For some reason, I’m finding it rather embarrassing
to hand it to her in person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_START_05.text:
All those years at the bottom of the sea didn’t exactly help…
Despite my many eyes, I seem to lack one for presents.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_START_06.text:
If it’s alright with you, 
could you deliver Haerang my present for me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_START_07.text:
For your trouble, I’ll give you all the #sparkling
stones# that I collected in the depths of the sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_START_08.text:
Aren’t they pretty? I don’t know their worth in human money,
but such beautiful stones should be very valuable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_START_09.text:
Sell them in Han and buy a pretty hairpin. Pick out something
that brings out the color of Haerang’s hair, will you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_093_START_10.text:
You can keep all the spare change!
Thank you! I’m counting on you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_094_END_01.text:
At times, I can barely believe the cruelty of humans. They let
the homes of their mountain burn.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_094_END_02.text:
Perhaps the reason why there has been
no human mountain saint to date…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_094_END_03.text:
…is because humans are still conceited enough to believe
that they are above and separate from nature.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_094_START_01.text:
The mountain saints of Han are mystical beings: it’s 
said that they are animals that have long absorbed

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_094_START_02.text:
the energy of the mountains, and so have acquired 
self-awareness over the years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_094_START_03.text:
On the other hand, no human has ever been recorded
to have become a mountain saint… I wonder why.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_094_START_04.text: Perhaps our journey to Han shall reveal to us the answer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_095_END_01.text:
The animals hate them, huh?
I told you, they’re well-made.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_095_END_02.text:
If you need any more, come by any time,
you hear?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_095_END_03.text:
Tell me one thing before you go, though.
Are you on good terms with that kid?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_095_END_04.text:
Ah, well… He didn’t use to have a lot of friends, you see.
I was just wondering how you all met.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_095_END_05.text:
What? You don’t know him well enough yet?
Does that mean that you don’t know who he really is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_095_END_06.text:
Oh, yes. He is a tiger patron saint. Tsk, tsk… So everyone’s
onto the secret! Stupid kid, I told him to be more careful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_095_END_07.text:
I was only worried that you would abandon him
once you found out about his true identity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_095_END_08.text:
Well, if you promise it doesn't bother you… I guess
that’s one less thing to worry about, then. Sigh…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_095_START_02.text:
Care to buy some useful supplies
in battling those mountain beasts?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_095_START_03.text:
These are tteok bullets used for hunting.
Very popular stuff among the local hunters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_095_START_04.text:
I developed them for one obese tiger,
but… I have no use for them now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_095_START_05.text:
I’ll give you some free samples.
Come back and tell me how they are.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_096_END_03.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}…
D-do you promise to keep me safe if they come back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_096_END_04.text: O-okay… I trust you won't go back on your word.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_096_START_01.text:
Sob… Everything hurts and I just want to go home…
I’ll never get used to this tiny body!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_096_START_02.text:
Before the start of my troubles, I used to be the 
biggest tiger throughout this mountain range.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_096_START_03.text:
If only that forest fire hadn't burnt down my
mountain… I would still have my powers with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_096_START_04.text:
You look as if you don't believe me. I have lots of 
friends who remember my true form!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_097_END_01.text:
Oh? Is that not face powder?
And it happens to be the brand I use.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_097_END_02.text:
How did you come across it 
so deep in the mountains?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_097_END_03.text:
It fell from the pocket
of a Hwarang you fought in battle?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_097_END_04.text:
Er, judging from your description,
I think he may have been one of my troop’s archers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_097_END_06.text:
Well... Every man for himself,
as the saying goes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_097_START_02.text:
I wanted to ask you…
whether you had any face powder.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_097_START_03.text: O-oh, I see. No, no, please don’t bother.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_097_START_04.text: Ah, I was afraid you would ask me why I required it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_097_START_05.text:
The truth is…. We men of Hwarang are required by code to
always maintain a neat and beautiful appearance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_097_START_06.text:
During our hasty escape, however,
I seem to have left my powder pouch behind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_097_START_07.text:
… I am sweating profusely,
and I fear my foundation will melt away soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_097_START_08.text:
Even my fair Yeowoodong has never seen my face uncovered…
I confess that I feel quite nervous without it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_098_END_01.text:
They heard stories about me…
and had the masks specially ordered in my honor?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_098_END_02.text:
Kaksi masks are traditional masks of Han that symbolize a
newly-wed bride. Oh, those maegu make me blush!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_098_END_03.text: I-I was only fortunate enough to find true love...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_098_START_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, have you seen the masks worn by the maegu?
Back in the days when I lived in the mountains,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_098_START_02.text:
we nine-tailed foxes did not care so much about fashion. It has
been a while since I've ventured out here into the human world...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_098_START_03.text:
I would love to know where and how they acquired their 
kaksi masks, if it isn't too much trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_02.text: Arona? What are you doing here…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_04.text:
I failed you, Mondrian. I approached Sworden 
to punish B. Hakdo and so take my revenge by my own hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_05.text:
I should have never let you go.
Alas! It is too late!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_06.text:
... No, Arona! It is my fault that you could not trust me.
I was weak and powerless. How could I ever reproach you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_07.text:
And yet... if I only had another chance to recover your love,
I would spend the rest of my life in bliss by your side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_09.text:
... I am still here, you know.
And I refuse to listen to any more of this rubbish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_10.text:
My wife says she married me out of necessity and not love;
my best friend says I was crass enough to steal his girlfriend.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_11.text:
I never meant to 'steal' anyone's girlfriend - Arona was the one who
proposed that we pretend to be in a relationship,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_12.text:
as a part of a plan to arrest my father. But I see the pretense has gone
longer than I had expected. Husband? Married?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_13.text:
If you two are still in love, you can marry each other instead!
I will see myself out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_14.text:
S-Sworden! Don’t be angry! Wait! 
Don’t go! We were joking!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_15.text:
Old flames can be an awkward subject, but he already knows
that I’m in a good place with someone back in the capital!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_16.text:
Let him be, Mondrian. He always comes back home in time
for supper if you give him some alone time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_17.text:
Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}. Were you surprised? I’m sorry that
you got caught up in a reunion between old friends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_18.text:
We just wanted to tease Sworden. My husband can become a
little too serious at times. It seems we’ve gone tooo far, though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_END_19.text:
We meant well.
Thank you for guiding me here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_START_02.text:
I came to see if there really is a #magistrate# stationed in the
Taebaek Mountains, carrying out some government operation...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_START_03.text: Would you happen to know anything?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_START_05.text:
I understand - you are being chased by him...
May I accompany you on your way?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_099_START_06.text: There is something I must tell him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_1.text:
Goblin dan Ogre bekerja sama untuk menyerang 
manusia. Kalahkan mereka dan lindungi manusia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_10.text:
Mata-mataku di Shadow Rose mengirimkan 
laporan. Seorang petinggi organisasi akan lewat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_END_01.text:
Ah, I see. So he finally found the Legendary Berry
to break his curse… I mean, lesson...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_END_02.text:
… Oh? You found them?
I specifically told him that he had to work for it himself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_END_03.text:
And he left behind a girl named #Lenny# with you?
He still hasn't learnt his lesson!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_END_04.text:
I should pay him another visit very soon. Hmm... If bunny ears
don't do the trick, what other animal ears would he appreciate?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_END_05.text:
Anyway... You must have spent a long time in Hero Town
indeed to be acquainted with Arjuna.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_END_06.text:
Oh? Denying any knowledge of him, are we?
Well, if you say so...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_START_01.text:
Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Did you not say that you came from Hero Town?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_START_02.text: There was something I meant to ask you…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_START_03.text: Have you ever met a young man named #Arjuna#?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_START_04.text:
He is quite the eye-catching type,
even without the bunny ears on the top of his head.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_100_START_05.text: You'd remember him if you've ever seen him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_END_01.text:
What's all this?
Boo! Where did you find these chicken skewers? They smell delicious!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_END_02.text:
I found a food vendor that was still open.
I remembered you saying that you had a craving for these.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_END_03.text:
Thank you so much! They look delicious!
Let's share them with the rest of the group. Snack time, everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_END_04.text:
... {PLAYER_NAME}. Um, did you see the face of the vendor
from whom we bought the chicken skewers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_END_06.text:
Erm, never mind.
Thank you for all your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_START_02.text: Could you do me a small favor?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_START_03.text:
Rebecca had been looking forward to the night market.
She was so disappointed to hear that it was closed...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_START_04.text:
I thought that I could buy her some chicken skewers to cheer her up.
There should be at least one food vendor around here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_101_START_06.text:
... What? You found one in that alleyway?
Please show me where!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_END_01.text:
Sob... They're so cruel... Tell me the truth, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Am I really no better than a piece of luggage?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_END_02.text:
Sob... If they don't need me, I'll just run away.
I've done it once; who says I can't do it again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_END_03.text:
... Huh? Are you sure? They... wanted me out of danger?
That's why they scolded me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_END_05.text:
You may be right,
especially when I consider Clan Brother's temperament.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_END_06.text:
Fine, fine. I'll trust them one more time.
With any luck, the next time we meet, I'll be a little stronger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_END_07.text: Thank you for your help. Good luck on the battlefield!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_START_01.text:
Sigh... It's a relief that you agreed to help me,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_START_02.text:
Although I had come runnning to the capital in search for
Master and Clan Brother Luhe, I hadn't known what to do after that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_102_START_03.text:
Oh, we're not THAT close! Hee hee!
All Ethereals are bound by close ties of mutual trust and respect!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_END_02.text:
… That was too close for comfort.
Was that a real gun back there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_END_03.text:
‘Diao Chan the Fairest,’ huh… 
She's rumored to be the most beautiful lady in all of Chen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_END_04.text:
I knew it. The answer to all of the world's problems...
is pure brute strength!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_END_05.text:
I'm confident of my own strength, so I have no problems there.
I've had my fists compared to bullets - that's how good I am!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_END_06.text:
Okay, I'm going to find Altair, point my Flower of Ten Thousand Roots
at him, tell him that I love him, and demand an answer! Like a real lady!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_01.text:
Hey, {PLAYER_NAME}. 
Can I ask you something?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_02.text:
Even by your standards,
I’m not really ‘ladylike,’ am I?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_03.text:
Oh, you can tell me the truth! I can see you trying to come up
with a lie on the spot. It's true, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_04.text:
Sigh... I was always scolded by my parents for being so
'unruly' all the time... But I was born this way! I can't help it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_05.text: And I never wanted to change who I am, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_06.text:
Buuuut... After meeting my boo, I'm a little scared
that he'll prefer someone more... girly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_08.text: I've made my decision! I'm going to become a 'real' girl!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_103_START_09.text:
I'll become a real lady or die trying!
By my honor as a warrio- I mean, a lady of Chen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_104_END_02.text:
My Book seems to have found their parents difficult to approach,
when all they had to do was 'talk' to them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_104_END_03.text:
They always complain that they do not wish to return yet,
that they want to see more of the outside world before they did...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_104_END_04.text: Perhaps it is time to pay a visit to the Abyss.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_104_START_02.text:
My #Book# tells me… that they sense from you the reaches
of the #Deepest Abyss#...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_104_START_03.text: Do you too serve the Abyss?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_104_START_04.text:
...
You’re… friends with the Deepest Abyss?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_104_START_06.text:
I had heard that they were a lonely being... The only 'pure' being
in all of Hasla, in fact, who had reached perfection in their solitude.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_END_01.text: Hey, you're the famous {PLAYER_NAME}, aren't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_END_02.text:
Don't bother to figure out who I am.
I'm not worth the trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_END_03.text:
Maybe we can meet under better circumstances,
one day. Strictly non-business, of course.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_START_01.text: Ugh... Since when has there been a curfew in the capital?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_START_02.text: I'm tired enough as it is from my last mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_START_03.text:
And then it turns out that the idiots from the Army of the Armored Ghosts
never received the secret agents' password. Must I wait until the morning?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_START_04.text:
Huh? What are you doing on the streets at night?
You know what? It doesn't matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_105_START_05.text:
Because you can now take me to the Imperial Palace!
Don't worry. I can pay - and generously, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_END_01.text:
Sigh... Both General Hansheng and General Zilong
don't appreciate me for what I'm worth...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_END_02.text:
They always leave me out of the most important missions!
From their planning to their execution!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_END_03.text:
They still think I'm the baby of the group!
When I'm clearly not!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_END_04.text:
It's been years since I was appointed a Tiger General! It's
embarrassing to be treated like a kid when you're 30 years old.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_START_01.text:
Now that we've arrived at the Imperial Palace, it's more than
likely that we'll meet another Tiger General soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_START_02.text: {PLAYER_NAME}... Let me give you a piece of advice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_START_03.text:
All the Tiger Generals are a force to be reckoned with,
but Zilong, you should be especially careful of.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_START_04.text:
I personally don't trust that man at all.
I'd even go so far as to say that I outright dislike him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_106_START_05.text:
What do you mean, why I hate him?
He just... gets on my nerves, that's all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_END_04.text: You were almost hit by my fan?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_END_05.text:
So what, want me to call an ambulance?
And you call yourself a Hero!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_END_06.text: Huh? What about that stone statue?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_END_07.text:
Hmm... Something's lodged in it...
... Erm, is that my fan?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_END_08.text:
That's weird...
I wonder what it's doing there...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_START_03.text:
Where did you come from?
It's not easy to meet visitors to the Palace these days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_START_04.text:
Well, it doesn't matter.
Do you have some free time, by any chance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_START_05.text:
I recently choreographed a new dance for the imperial banquet,
and I need an outsider's perspective.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_107_START_06.text:
Oh, come on. You don't need to be an expert or anything.
And it won't take up too much of your time, I promise!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_01.text:
I understand now. He always seems very angry towards me,
so I had not suspected his true feelings:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_02.text:
that he trusts me much more than what he reveals,
and that he felt left out by General Hansheng and me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_03.text: Hmm. Thank you; that was helpful information.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_04.text:
The next time I talk to Mengqi,
I will try to make the necessary improvements.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_05.text:
What are you two talking about?
Having a secret chat now, are we?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_06.text: Mengqi. We were discussing our relationship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_07.text: I apologize for not noticing your discomfort sooner.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_08.text:
I promise to suggest to General Hansheng
to include you in our discussions from the very beginning!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_END_09.text:
... {PLAYER_NAME}.
We're going to have a little talk now, just between you and me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_START_02.text: I had a question I wished to ask you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_START_03.text:
I saw you having a conversation with Mengqi a little while ago.
It seemed that you two were on quite good terms.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_START_04.text:
It has been ten years since I first met Mengqi,
but he still remains quite wary of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_108_START_05.text:
You seem to know some secret way
of becoming better friends with him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_END_01.text:
Oof... Yide would be proud of his son,
if he could see him now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_END_02.text: I will have to teach him his manners again, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_END_03.text:
Zhang Bao must learn how to respect his elders,
not attack them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_02.text: Ah, so you are curious about Zhang Bao and Guan Yin Ping’s fathers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_03.text:
What can I say? They were simply the strongest warriors
in the history of the Kingdom of Chen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_04.text:
Their spears fell mountains and cracked open the earth,
and no man could best them in strength.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_05.text:
Yet they were also the best tacticians in Chen -
both of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_06.text:
His Majesty was especially close to them among the Tiger Generals,
and the three even took an oath of fraternity to become sworn brothers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_07.text:
It was also openly acknowledged that they were the primary reason
Chen was able to occupy the largest territory

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_08.text:
among the three Eastern Kingdoms over the past thirty years.
Everyone agreed on that, at the very least.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_09.text:
And when, one day, the two went missing...
Utter confusion ensued.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_10.text:
Where and why had the heroes of Chen disappeared? Rumors spread
that they had become Ethereals and departed for paradise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_11.text: Oh, what I just told you is strictly confidential.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_109_START_12.text:
Be careful not to let out a slip of your tongue,
or chaos will spread like wildfire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_10_2.text:
… Tentu kamu punya hal yang lebih penting 
daripada berkeliaran disini …

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_11.text:
Shadow Rose menculik orang tidak bersalah.
Kita harus selamatkan mereka.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_01.text:
The truth is, I have come a long way
to avenge my family.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_02.text:
But now, with the Throne Room before me,
my heart only feels empty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_03.text:
I have dedicated the past few decades of my life
to revenge...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_04.text: The end of everything came near, once...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_05.text:
I lost my reason for living
after being intercepted by an anonymous court dancer, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_06.text:
I understand everything, now that I have returned to the Imperial Palace
and am steps away from facing the Emperor again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_07.text:
Back then, I hadn't lost the meaning of my life.
I had gained an opportunity to find a new purpose.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_END_08.text:
... I will return now.
I hope you too understand the value of your life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_START_01.text:
Not this room... Not that one either... Ah!
It's been some time since I came upon another person!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_START_02.text:
Hmm? What do you mean, who am I?
Haha… I don’t believe it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_START_03.text:
People usually recognize me by my mask. And why should I hide? 
I am the lord of bian lian, the master of masks: Wang Dao!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_START_04.text:
Still don’t recognize me? Maybe it's time for me to return to the stage.
It doesn’t matter anyway; I’ve already thrown away that old name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_START_05.text:
I came to the Palace
to request an audience with the Emperor His Majesty...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_START_06.text:
But I haven't seen a single courtier,
let alone the emperor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_110_START_07.text:
Besides, it feels like I am walking around in circles...
Could you help me find my way back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_111_END_01.text:
The Kalard of Oblivion... Lethe.
Her powers were terrifying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_111_END_02.text:
That fearful sensation of your memory and experience
being pulled out of your entire being...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_111_END_03.text: I never want to experience such sense of loss ever again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_111_START_01.text: We've reached the Throne Room at last, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_111_START_02.text: What truth awaits us within those gates?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_111_START_03.text:
I admit that I feel a little frightened...
It's a good thing you're by my side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_12.text:
Jadi mereka menunjukkan jati diri sebenarnya! 
Kita harus hentikan Shadow Rose!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_13.text:
Dan ditengah kekacauan, seekor iblis telah muncul
Tolong alihkan perhatian iblis itu sementara para warga
dievakuasi

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_14.text:
Anggota Shadow Rose yang aku culi.. tolong tempo 
hari mengatakan seorang pendeta akan lewat hari ini.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_15.text:
Kota dalam kekacauan karena serangan mendadak
dari iblis dan Heaven Cavalery. Kita harus hentikan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_16.text:
Lebih banyak iblis yang kuat bermunculan.
Tolong ulur waktu untuk kami.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_17.text:
Aku menerima laporan bahwa iblis yang telah 
kita kalahkan bangkit kembali. Kita harus kembali!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_18.text:
Aneh. Sepengetahuanku Ratmen tidak memiliki 
kecerdasan… Kita harus berbicara dengan mereka

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_19.text:
Kita harus berada disini untuk sementara. 
Jangan menarik perhatian dari Ratmen yang murka

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_2.text:
Goblin menebang pohon untuk membuat ketapel 
Hentikan mereka dan hancurkan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_20.text:
Aku menemukan jejak misterius. 
Mungkin jejak salah satu pengejar

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_21.text:
Itu Ratmen yang besar! Mungkin dia ada kaitan
dengan agresi mendadak dari Ratmen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_22.text:
Oh dia adalah Ratman. Dia mungkin tahu sesuatu 
yang tidak kita ketahui. Ikut dia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_23.text:
A, aku kira semua Ratmen akan sebaik Rata!
Ternyata tidak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_23_2.text:
Jahat, Ratmen aneh yang selalu mengganggu 
Ratmen baik! Kita harus hentikan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_24.text:
Endus,endus .. Ada manusia di sini, cit! 
Jika mereka bukan temanmu, kita harus tangkap!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_25.text:
Heheh, aku temukan Ratman Besar dan lucu!
Mahluk lembut & berbulu tidak mungkin orang jahat kan ?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_26.text:
Ada orang suruhan dari Rudrat! Bantu aku 
hentikan dia menyerbu selokan, cit !

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_27.text:
Kita harus hentikan Rudrat mencemari air dengan
limbah mana! Jika tidak semua Ratmen akan terancam

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_28.text:
Kita dalam masalah! Sepertinya Rudrat telah 
menggali jalur baru! Kita harus hentikan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_29.text:
Uh? Ada garpu dan pisau berterbangan! 
Dan seluruh isi lemari melayang! Kenapa bisa?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_3.text:
Goblin Champion telah muncul! Kalahkan mereka
dan musnahkan ancaman terhadap hutan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_30.text:
Iblis di kota ada disini juga. Kita harus kalakan 
mereka sebelum mereka melukai warga.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_31.text:
Ada orang asing yang menyelinap ke dalam istana. 
Kita harus periksa apakah dia bekerja untuk Kardinal

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_32.text:
Orang asing itu melakukan kegiatan yang mencurigakan. 
Yang lainnya telah kabur membawa dokumen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_33.text:
Kita harus menemukan sumber kebocoran mana 
sebelum bocor ke kota.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_34.text:
Daerah yang akan kita telusuri adalah daerah asing.
Berhati-hatilah - Kita tidak tahu apa yang menunggu

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_35.text:
Orang-orangku melaporkan kejadian aneh terjadi 
ketika menyegel Istana. Kardinal pasti …

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_35_2.text:
Bisakah kamu berpatroli di Istana sekali lagi?
Aku akan berikan kompensasi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_4.text:
Ahli botani yang sering keluar masuk hutan telah 
menghilang. Tolong temukan dia

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_5.text:
Kami mendapati Goblin Head di garis depan. 
Kalahkan dia agar pasukannya kebingungan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_6.text:
Oh tidak! Goblin Chief baru telah muncul! 
Kita harus kalahkan sebelum jumlahnya bertambah!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_7.text:
Impalis - Ibukota Grancia. Jika kita mendatanginya 
apakah bisa memulihkan ingatan Ellie.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_8.text:
Order Of Shadow Rose membuat warga resah. 
Kamu bisa membantuku dengan menghajar mereka.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_9.text:
Tidak ada habisnya ulah pasukan dari Order Of Shadow 
Rose. Kamu harus beri mereka pelajaran.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_NAMECHANGE_1_1_01.text: Hello, Captain. I hear that you plan to change your name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_NAMECHANGE_1_1_02.text: What shall we call you from now on?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_NAMECHANGE_1_2_01.text: {PLAYER_NAME}... Your new name suits you perfectly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_NAMECHANGE_1_2_02.text: Let's continue keeping the peace together, Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0001.text:
Hmm, I'm sure it was around here somewhere...
These small country towns are sure hard to find.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0002.text:
Hey there, Lady Knight! Is this Hero Town?
Where a captain by the name of {PLAYER_NAME} lives?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0003.text: Yes, it is. And... you are?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0005.text:
An airship pilot...?
I'm afraid you won't find much work around our town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0006.text:
We did have a small airship port built by a wealthy man named Arjuna,
but it fell into disuse some time ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0007.text: Hee hee, of course I know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0008.text: I used to be Arjuna's personal airship pilot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0009.text:
That silly rabbit thought he could simply pull the plug on a decent business 
just because he completed his 'original mission'.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0010.text: I was forced out onto the streets overnight...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0011.text:
... by my urge to go shopping with my new fortune
that I received as severance pay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0013.text:
But! I soon discovered that while you can never have too much money,
honest work is what makes life worth living.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0014.text: That's why I'm here, {PLAYER_NAME} to make you an offer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0015.text: Won't you lend some labor for my new business?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0016.text: I'll make it worth your while!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0017.text: Orchard...? Do you mean to grow Berries?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0018.text:
Yep! I managed to collect all kinds of magical seeds
on our previous explorations through Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0019.text:
I just need more people as I can't manage the whole farm on my own.
And I heard that you have the most Heroes at hand, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0020.text: I-I'm afraid {PLAYER_NAME} has more, er, important business at hand...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0021.text:
Hey, I just saw some of your Heroes loitering around on my way here.
They'll be happier working than doing nothing at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0022.text:
You know what, I'll show you around the Orchard right away.
Maybe this will persuade you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0023.text: Well... She seems a force to be reckoned with.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_ORCHARD_UNLOCK_0024.text: Let us at least hear what she has to say {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_2_01.text: For now... it looks like it's gone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_2_02.text:
... Looks like it saw the book being restored and came.
I'm sure it was related to why you were all here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_3_01.text:
Then... this time for sure we'll send you back to 
Orsterra. You'll forget ever being in Hasla...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_3_02.text:
It was a short while but it was a pleasure.
Right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_01.text: I thank thee for thine help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, this is our first and last time 
meeting... but may the Sacred Flame guide you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_03.text:
Ah, even if we'll forget everything from here...
If the fates will have it, I'll see you again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_04.text:
As a merchant, I wanted to see the shops here...
What a shame we have to leave just like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_05.text:
I understand where you're coming from Tressa.
Another dimension... that in itself...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_06.text: Stop there. Another lecture will start...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_07.text:
... Don't look so sad. We'll listen to all your...
theories or whatever, after we return.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_08.text:
I'm grateful for that.
But... won't we forget everything when we return?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_4_11.text:
Hehe, anyway, thank you.
Farewell, everyone from Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_5_01.text: They all got back safely right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_5_02.text:
Yeah. The book, their records, the dimensional rift...
Everything is back to normal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_5_03.text:
It was supposed to be a quiet day...
I'm tired from running around so much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_5_05.text:
Hehe. {PLAYER_NAME} and the others
took care of me well so I'm fine!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_5_06.text:
That's a relief. Then we should go back and get
some rest ourselves too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_5_07.text: I agree. It's been so chaotic since the morning...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_5_08.text:
Rest well everyone.
Good work again, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_6_01.text:
It will be erased from the other side...
But as a record keeper it would be a waste.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_ENDING_6_02.text: Let's see, where should we record this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_1_01.text: ... I don't remember leaving a book here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_2_01.text:
Wow~ I didn't know there was such a huge library
in this kind of place! So many books...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_2_02.text: Ah, Prestina! What book is that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_2_03.text:
Sera, you have to be quiet in the library.
I'll tell you later, so come this way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_2_04.text:
Ah, yes!
I got too excited seeing something like that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_2_05.text:
So, what is it?
Even calling {PLAYER_NAME} here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_2_06.text: You said it was important so I came.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_2_07.text:
Everyone's here... then, let's get started.
An incident only you all can solve happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_3_01.text:
To keep it simple, something #otherworldly#
was detected invading Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_3_02.text:
I don't know the cause... but I think something
caused an enormous twist in the dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_3_03.text:
If the dimensional rift is left open,
We don't know what will spill over into Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_3_04.text:
We have to solve this as quickly as possible,
which is why I called you all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_3_05.text:
I thought you would've already sensed some
foreign energy. No?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_4_01.text:
Ah, I had a headache this morning for some
reason... Maybe it's because of this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_4_02.text:
You idiot, that's probably because you hit your
head on that bookshelf yesterday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_4_03.text:
But I could sense the foreign energy too.
There was a lot of it coming from the west.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_4_04.text: I thought I was misreading... but I guess not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_4_05.text:
So, how can we help?
You called us here because you have a plan right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_5_01.text:
Here, this book. This is the key.
I found it when I found the dimensional rift.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_5_02.text:
Since its contents are from another dimension,
I can't fully tell you what it's about...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_5_03.text:
But I confirmed there are eight #pages# of records
that were torn out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_5_04.text:
Due to the shock from the rift, they 
scattered throughout Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_5_05.text: Since you all can detect otherworldly energies...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_5_06.text:
I'd like you to find the scattered pages with
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_5_07.text:
If we restore the book, we should be able to close
the dimensional rift and send the intruders back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_6_01.text:
Finding pages scattered throughout Hasla... Sounds
ridiculous but we're the only ones that can do it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_6_02.text:
It would be best if we all split up then. I'll head west
towards #downtown Trista#. Anut, what about you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_6_03.text:
Hmm... the #desert# sounds good to me!
I'll check there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_6_04.text:
I felt some energy coming from the #forest# area
so I'll check around there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_6_06.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} should check the #Tundra#.
There should definitely be a page there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_7_01.text:
Ah, if {PLAYER_NAME} is headed that way,
I'll go too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_7_03.text:
But if you go with {PLAYER_NAME} it shouldn't
be a problem, right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_8_02.text:
Come back to me once you find #pages#. Oh, also...
The pages might be with otherworldly people too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_8_03.text:
You should be able to recognize them right away.
They're very different... maybe how they look...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_INTRO_8_05.text:
You'll know it when you see them. Anyway, if you
find those people, bring them back with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_10_02.text: You're saying this is not the land of Orsterra?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_10_04.text:
Don't worry too much! If we bring these #pages#
back to Pandora, you'll be able to go back home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_11_01.text:
Eight scattered pages... that means the others
might be wandering around somewhere too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_11_02.text:
Sera, {PLAYER_NAME}, would it be okay
if I joined you in finding the pages?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_11_03.text:
If it's to help find my companions...
I cannot stand idly by.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_11_04.text: I would like to help in whatever way I can.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_12_01.text:
We'd love to have you come with us, Ophilia!
Right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_12_02.text:
Thank you both!
Then, let's get going.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_12_03.text:
Yeah! Let's go find the remaining pages,
{PLAYER_NAME} and Ophilia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_2_01.text:
This is troublesome, how did I lose consciousness
in a place like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_2_02.text: ...This will not do. I can't remember anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_4_01.text:
I've never seen these characters.
Is it enchanted? In a place like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_5_01.text: Are you okay? You're safe now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_5_03.text:
Ah, I'm Sera! And this is {PLAYER_NAME}.
Are you hurt anywhere?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_5_04.text: I'm okay thanks to you. Thank you for saving me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_6_01.text:
Ah, I didn't introduce myself. I am Ophilia.
Cleric of the Church of Flamesgrace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_6_02.text:
Church of Flamesgrace?
Mmm... It's my first time hearing that name...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_6_03.text:
You don't know the Church of Flamesgrace?
... Sorry, could I ask where we are right now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_6_05.text:
It's a pretty dangerous place...
What were you doing here, Ophilia?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_7_01.text:
Nosgard?
I've never heard of a place like that before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_7_02.text: Well, I don't know how I woke up in a place like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_7_03.text:
I think I just got lost... Could you point me in the
direction of the Frostlands?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_7_04.text:
Frostlands?
Mmm, I've never heard of that place either...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_8_02.text:
Paper?
...Um, are you talking about this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_9_01.text: Ah!! This #page#, where did you find it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_9_02.text: We came here to look for this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_9_03.text:
It was right next to me when I came to my senses.
As I thought... it's no ordinary piece of paper.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE1_01_9_06.text:
Hehe, don't worry about it.
Mmm... so what happened is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_10_01.text:
You little... who are you calling a kid...!
... No, this isn't the place to be like this... Sigh...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_10_02.text:
Look, this person is my friend from another town.
They just ended up wandering in here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_10_03.text:
Let's not make this tiring for either side, why not just
let him go?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_11_01.text:
This guy, that guy! It's my job to make sure NO ONE
gets in here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_11_02.text: Both of you come with me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_12_01.text: Argh, what do you not get!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_12_02.text:
Look, let's go quickly.
There's someone looking for you and that page.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_12_03.text:
Thank you, I owe you one.
But... can I ask what your name is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_12_04.text: I'm Bella. Who did you say you were earlier?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_12_06.text: Right, Cyrus. You look lost, so just follow me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_12_07.text:
This isn't your world. I'm taking you to someone
who can send you back home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_13_01.text:
I'll explain it to you slowly later, so let's get out of
here firs...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_13_02.text:
Hasla? First time hearing of it. Perhaps...
Another piece of evidence for my theory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_13_04.text:
I was thinking the buildings here look a little different,
and that guard's appearance was bothering me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_13_05.text:
The defined shapes of this stone and arch, and these
pillars might look like they're from the Flatlands...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_13_06.text:
The difference in how the bricks are stacked is
pretty clear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_13_08.text:
Furthermore the varnish on the exterior is also quite
different from that of the Flatlands. Additionally...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_14_02.text:
... is what I'm saying. To think I came to another
world! My, how astonishing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_14_03.text:
What a valuable experience! My apologies, but won't
you tell me more about this world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_14_04.text:
The name of this city? What land are we in? What
do you call yourselves? And...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_14_05.text:
That way! A guard is on the ground!
Arrest the intruders!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_14_06.text: Mm? Looks like colleagues of that guard from earlier.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_14_07.text:
Ugh, we can talk about this all you want later!
For now, run!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_2_01.text:
What a troublesome situation. Where am I?
My memory is hazy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_3_01.text: My my, looks like we have a new riddle here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_3_02.text: Then, we should survey our surroundings first...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_4_01.text:
(A familiar-looking building. At first glance, it
looks like architecture from the Flatlands...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_4_02.text:
(But the materials used to build this, and the
patterns on it... are not the same.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_5_01.text: This is... a page from a book?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_6_03.text:
Oh my, my apologies.
I'm Cyrus. A scholar passing by.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_6_04.text:
A scholar? Just wandering around here like this,
you got guts!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_7_01.text:
Trista? There must be a misunderstanding.
Mmm... Looks like this place isn't the Flatlands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_7_02.text:
Sounds like a buncha excuses to not get caught.
Flatlands? What's that? Give up and come with me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_8_01.text: Hmm, I definitely feel one around here somewhere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_9_02.text:
What, who's this child?
Where did you come from?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE2_01_9_03.text:
You a neighborhood kid? Don't get in the
way! We're taking away a criminal!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_2_02.text:
What do you mean where? You're in the middle of
the road. Don't just stay lying down here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_2_03.text:
Th-that's not what I meant... but is this somewhere
far from the Coastlands?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_2_04.text:
Coastlands?
Oi, you know what that is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_2_05.text:
Aye? In my 10 years of sailing I've never heard
of that kind of name aye?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_2_06.text:
Ehhh?!
Then where are we right now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_3_01.text:
(Was I... shipwrecked? What was I doing before
this...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_3_02.text:
Ughhh, what is this? My memory...
... hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_3_03.text: Paper? This looks like it was ripped out of a book...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_4_01.text:
Heh, what is this.
Just looking at it gives me a mysterious energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_5_03.text:
What, you guys know each other?
No no, just keep running! We don't have time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_01_5_04.text:
Why are you being chased?!
Hey! Cyrus!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_1_01.text: Great, looks like we can catch a breather now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_1_02.text:
Ha... ha... what a surprise...
Please explain what kind of situation this is!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_1_03.text: Ah, my apologies. It's a pretty long story...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_1_04.text:
Ah, but first, Tressa.
Do you have something like this paper too?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_2_01.text:
Ah! Yeah! I was gonna ask you about it.
It just appeared with me too when I woke up...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_2_02.text:
This piece of paper, is it important?
It looked important so I brought it with me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_2_03.text:
As expected, you have a good eye for these things.
Indeed, I think this paper... is quite important.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_2_04.text:
Surprisingly, it looks like we were dropped
into another world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_2_05.text:
And collecting these pages seems to be the
key back home to Orsterra.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_3_02.text:
Yes. And it looks like it's not just us here, but the
others are also scattered somewhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_3_03.text:
W-wait a minute! This story is so nonsensical, I
don't understand...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_3_04.text:
Wait! Are you gonna give another long lecture?
We can't waste time here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_3_05.text:
Talk while we're moving.
Let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_4_01.text:
... and for these 8 reasons we can conclude that
we ended up in this place called Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_4_06.text: N-nothing... I was just thinking how you never change...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_4_07.text:
It hasn't been long since I met you guys... but I think
I can get a feel for what your lives are like...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_5_01.text: So you're here. That was faster than I thought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_5_02.text:
Hello, I'm Pandora. And you...
must be Cyrus and Tressa.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_5_03.text:
Relax and rest for a while, since I have a lot of
questions to ask you after.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_6_01.text:
Oho, that's a welcome idea.
I also have a lot of things to ask about this world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_6_02.text: Yikes... I'm getting outta here before he goes off again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_6_03.text:
Then, I'll leave them to you.
I'm gonna go look for the other pages!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_6_04.text: ... Hmm? But the other Goddesses already...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_8_01.text:
Woah... amazing! Pandora, what's this book?
It's like it goes back hundreds of years!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_8_02.text:
You wouldn't think of selling it to me would you?
I'll make sure you get your worth!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_8_03.text:
Oooh... there are so many books here.
Let's see now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE3_02_8_04.text:
... Now I know why she ran away.
Hah... I hope {PLAYER_NAME} comes back soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_1_01.text:
The tracks are still here. That means...
It went this way towards these trees.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_2_01.text:
Mm. It's certain. This dry herb...
#It's# without a doubt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_3_03.text:
I'm Prestina. It got quite noisy so I came by...
It's good that you're okay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_4_01.text:
I'm Olberic Eisenberg.
Thank you for your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_4_03.text:
There are a lot of monsters in this forest making it
dangerous. I think it would be best to go to town...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_4_04.text:
Sorry, I cannot do that. I think one of my
companions is also in this forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_4_05.text:
Companion? Hmm...
Then let's look together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_4_06.text: Since I came here looking for something too...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_4_08.text: Well... it might sound weird but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_4_09.text:
I'm looking for a piece of paper.
A page from a book giving off mysterious energy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_5_01.text: A page... are you talking about this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_5_02.text: Oh yes! Where did you find it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_5_03.text:
When I came to my senses, it was floating next to me.
I thought it would be good to take it with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_5_04.text:
Floating next to you?
Ah, now that I look at you... are you...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_6_01.text:
... An outrageous story.
But if true... it explains a lot of things.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_6_02.text:
Yes. It might be confusing... but if we can collect all
the pages, you should be able to return.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE4_01_6_03.text:
Then let us hurry.
There are tracks this way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_1_04.text: Weird. I felt something this way...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_1_05.text:
The other Goddesses said they already found one or
two pages each, but why can't I find anything?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_1_06.text:
... Eh, why worry! Let's check one more time and go
somewhere else if it's not here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_2_01.text:
Ahh!
Who said you could just appear like that?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_OT_STAGE5_01_3_01.text:
Veil of the dark night,
fend off disaster!
