Have you upgraded yourself again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_01_05.text:
Benjamin. It is good to see you again.
It has been 2987031 seconds since our last encounter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_01_06.text: I apologize for the delay of 30 seconds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_02_01.text:
Ugh... R-0...! And even after I received the latest upgrade
to defeat you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_02_02.text:
Why can't I ever defeat you?
What makes you so special?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_02_03.text:
V. Why do you obsess over
defeating me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_02_04.text:
I don't know! When I look at you,
I just get this incredible urge to destroy you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_02_05.text:
V. Do you not wish to use your passion
to pursue some other meaning in life?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_02_07.text:
... Help? The only help you can give me
is to let yourself be destroyed at my hands!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_02_08.text:
I'll demolish you, no matter what it takes!
I must receive the next order!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_03_01.text:
Dammit... R-0...
Stop staring at me with pity in your eyes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_03_02.text:
... I am sorry, V.
Rest well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_04_01.text: I failed to save her. Again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_04_03.text:
The CODE-VV that we defeated just now...
is the fourth replica of the original V.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_04_04.text:
They do not know that their emotions too are mere shadows.
Their blind rage has led them to attack me continuously.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_04_05.text:
I wanted to help them escape
the confines of their rage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_05_01.text:
Benjamin. After receiving your advice,
I have been thinking for a long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_05_02.text: And yet I could not find the answer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_05_03.text:
We were created for battle.
Then why have we been equipped with emotion modules?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_05_04.text:
What is the meaning of our suffering?
Is there a true purpose to our being?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_06_01.text:
So that was the prototype of the personality chip
the old geezer was talking about...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_07_01.text:
She could have been a good companion, once.
Now - all this depressing talk...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_07_02.text: Fine. I will answer your question.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_07_03.text:
I destroyed your blueprint.
I had no intention of actually creating you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_07_04.text:
Do you understand? There is no true 'meaning' to an artificially
constructed personality. Your anguish, your pain... They are all illusions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_07_05.text:
So stop wasting the life that has been given you.
Do whatever you wish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_09_02.text: Hey, I told you to leave and do whatever you want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_09_03.text:
What I want to do is to accompany you.
Is there a problem?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_10_01.text:
What a temper... That was rude.
Now, R-0, was it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_10_02.text:
I don't know what your story is,
but why do you want to follow us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_10_03.text: ... I confess I do not know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_10_04.text:
... The highest possibility is...
His agitation interests me. It is an uncommon state for him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_10_05.text:
Hahaha!
Okay, that was really funny just now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_10_06.text:
You're right, it's more fun to tease someone
who's not used to being teased.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_10_07.text:
I like her!
{PLAYER_NAME}, she can come with us, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH1_ST6_11_01.text:
Good, then let's chase after that idiot
before something happens to him!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_01_01.text:
There's no one here.
It is safe to come out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_02_01.text:
So this is the Road Industry Headquarters.
Clean, bright - hmm, the opposite of Rapture Science.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_02_02.text:
It's thanks to you we got here without much trouble, R-0.
How did you find this hidden path?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_02_03.text:
Before it was closed down,
the passageway was used for delivering supplies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_02_04.text:
When my registration code was still R-9999, my sisters and I too 
were first delivered to the place of our mission through that passageway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_02_05.text: Oh, really? And where are your sisters?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_02_06.text:
All R-9999 models except for myself
have been destroyed after they failed our mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_02_07.text:
Oh, erm...
I'm so sorry to hear that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_03_01.text:
Sensing unidentified movement.
Something is headed our way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_04_01.text:
Gunther... Isn't that the passageway you built in
so that you could play with your precious dolls?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_04_02.text:
All that hard work of upgrading our security system - down the drain.
Or rather, down your stupid rabbit hole!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_04_03.text:
Pant... pant... I-I'm so sorry,
Director Ludovico!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_04_04.text:
It's alright. You can do better next time.
Three months of cut wages should teach you a lesson.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_04_06.text:
Hello, everyone. My name is Levine.
It is such a pleasure to meet all of you! You look much better in person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_04_07.text:
Would you like some tea?
I received a nice batch of oolong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_01.text:
No, thank you.
You seem in good spirits, Levine Ludovico.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_02.text:
Oh, Officer Benjamin, it's you. Does it show?
Of course I'm in good spirits.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_03.text:
Thanks to Yuria so easily taking the bait,
we can truly make her transitional government... transitional.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_04.text:
I can imagine her embarrassment, her despair...
Who'd known the tail of the snake would lead to the head of the dragon?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_05.text:
I only regret not seeing the expression
on her usually annoyingly calm face.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_06.text:
This confirms my suspicions... You really were the one who
spread the information about the Second Laboratory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_07.text:
Does your scenario go something like this? The evil company
Rapture Science, after years of immoral human experiments,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_08.text:
finally rebels against the Empire. Yuria, Commander of the interim
government, is killed in the ensuing chaos... There is no hope to be found.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_09.text:
Then amidst the tragedy comes forth the savior of the people: Levine 
Ludovico! Shall I start calling you Commander Levine from now on?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_10.text:
Oh, that would be nice. You could also do me another favor
by offering up your lives as the organizers of the rebellion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_11.text:
Our technology is now far more advanced than yours.
We have no use for you now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_12.text: Because you found use in something else.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_05_13.text:
Levine Ludovico.
Surely you haven't gotten your hands on... the #Gates of Heaven#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_06_03.text:
Haha... hahaha...
I've always wondered about your true identity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_06_04.text:
Here's one more reason to
get rid of you once and for all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_07_01.text:
As we're indoors,
I regret not being able to use my beloved bombs...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_07_02.text:
No matter.
I'll make good use of you as my latest test subjects.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_08_01.text:
I see you've been hiding
some crucial information from us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_08_02.text:
... Let's talk more after
we defeat the enemy before us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST1_08_03.text:
Sigh... Okay, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Let's make this quick!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_01_01.text:
Now that things have finally settled down,
explain everything. Now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_01_02.text:
I don't know what's going on with you,
but whatever it is, it better be persuasive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_01_03.text:
Yes. Before that...
I must first reveal my true identity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_01_04.text:
I am one of the Kindred,
banished from #Heaven# down to earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_02.text:
No, I am not. A few years ago...
I broke one of Heaven's laws and was banished for all eternity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_03.text:
I've been searching for a way
to return ever since.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_04.text:
After gathering information on the current situation, I predicted that
the hidden mastermind would be related to Heaven in some way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_05.text:
Judging from Levine's reaction just now,
it seems I was correct.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_06.text:
Heaven was a real place?
I thought it was just a thing of legends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_07.text:
You know, the land flowing with milk and honey...
With beautiful winged angels playing harps everywhere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_08.text:
... I'm not sure why and how people came up with that image,
but I can most definitely assure you, 'Heaven' is no such paradise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_09.text:
The Kindred... are a race of clones created from a single gene
by the scientist #Arart# decades ago, to use in various experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_02_10.text:
Heaven is, much like the Second Laboratory of Rapture Science,
a living hell created for her own dark objectives.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_03_01.text:
Wait...
Who did you just say it was?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_03_02.text:
#Arart#.
It seems the name is familiar to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_03_03.text:
No... It can't be.
It... must be someone with the same name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_03_04.text:
The Master Arart I know...
would never do anything like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_03_05.text:
And... She passed away
decades ago. I buried her myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_04_01.text:
You... You found records in the Temple of Illusions that
the Goddess of Judgement researched the forbidden magic of the Desert?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_04_02.text:
But if those records had been written one hundred years ago...
That would have been in the middle of the Apostle's War.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_04_03.text:
Can it be that Master Arart...
really dealt with the forbidden magic...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_04_04.text:
If we consider the period in which the Kindred were 'created'...
This would mean that she acquired forbidden magic

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_04_05.text:
from the Temple of Illusions one hundred years ago,
then continued her research on artificial gods in Trista and Heaven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_04_06.text: An ordinary human would have died in that time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_04_07.text: Just as I thought... She wasn't at all whom she claimed to be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_05_01.text: What do you mean by that, Benjamin?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_05_02.text:
Master Arart... She was the spiritual leader of the Elard.
This... this suspicion you have against her - it's literal blasphemy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_06_01.text:
It does not matter whether Arart was truly your old master
or an imposter who simply succeeded her name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_06_02.text:
I only seek to save 'Mother' from her clutches. 
Even as we speak... 'Mother' suffers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_06_03.text:
Aren't you the same? If you only seek to defeat the mastermind behind
the Neth experiments, our objective is the same. No use for arguing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_06_04.text:
If she really is the Arart you know...
Will you be able to forgive her for all her sins? Do you really wish to know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_06_06.text: Hey now, let's not get all riled up -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_07_01.text:
Benjamin... The scientist called Arart.
Is she in Heaven right now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_07_02.text: Yes. She was the one who banished me a few years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_07_03.text:
Then I'll go and judge for myself
whether this scientist of Heaven is the real Master Arart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_07_04.text:
If this Arart is truly my old master,
it's my duty to stop her myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_08_02.text:
A created being...
Benjamin, do you mean to say that you are the same as me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_08_03.text: Yes. I am not trying to make excuses for myself, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_08_04.text:
The things that I said to you...
They are the same words I continuously repeated to myself in the past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_08_05.text:
I believed that the purpose, the meaning of my 'artificial' existence...
only lay in freeing 'Mother.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_08_06.text: ... As someone who still cannot free himself from that belief...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST3_08_07.text:
I would like for you to... find your own meaning of the life
that has been given to you. Discover for yourself what you truly wish for.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_01_01.text:
Ugh... Goddess... {PLAYER_NAME}...
What have you been up to over the past three years?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_01_02.text:
This is out of my calculations...
According to the data, this shouldn't have happened...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_01_03.text: Hmm, let's just say - it's the power of reading and adventuring.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_01_04.text: Now, hand over the #Gates of Heaven#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_01_05.text:
As if I'd ever tell you!
I hid it in a safe place!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_02_01.text:
Found it! Yup, just as I thought.
Important stuff can always be found on the person themselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_02_03.text: Do you really think I would?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_02_04.text:
... Detecting approaching heat source.
Stanya, move out of the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_03_01.text:
Kee kee kee...
All that waiting pays off at last!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_03_04.text: So you've been hiding all this time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_03_05.text:
I - I wasn't hiding! I've been waiting!
As according to my genius plan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_03_07.text:
Levine Ludovico. A talented young lady,
but without much backbone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_03_08.text:
Don't worry. I'll go up to Heaven instead,
and make your dreams come true!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_03_11.text:
Stanya, they are not the heat source I warned you about.
Please be careful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_05_02.text:
Oh... Oh!! Yes, you detected the danger I'm in
and came to my rescue!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_05_03.text: What! Why would Sentinel be YOUR son?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_05_04.text:
Now, go! Sentinel!
Go and melt those buffoons with your deadly laser!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_06_03.text:
Uwoooo! Sentinel!
What is the meaning of this?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_07_03.text:
I didn't create you
to harm humans! Listen to your mom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_07_04.text:
Well... I think it's too late for that,
judging from what just happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_07_05.text: I'm sure he didn't mean it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_07_06.text:
Confirmed identity of maker. Doctor Stanya.
It is advised that you step to the side. It can be dangerous.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_07_07.text:
No! I mean, I hate that old geezer, but -
I don't necessarily want him dead!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_07_08.text:
Doctor Stein illegally converted me, an android designed
for the good of humankind, into a machine of war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_07_09.text:
I have watched him commit many atrocities against humanity:
conducting human experiments, manufacturing Steamers for war...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_07_10.text:
The cause of disease lies in the pathogens.
To fulfill my initial objective, I must eliminate Doctor Stein.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_07_11.text: That's a dramatic conclusion you've got there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_07_12.text:
R-0, does that android
also possess your personality module?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_07_13.text:
Affirmative.
... I sense strong signals of hatred and despair radiating from him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_07_14.text:
Argh... And after I took such care of you.
You ungrateful piece of machine - !

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_07_15.text:
Old geezer, if you don't shut up right this moment,
I'll just let Sentinel deal with you. Urgh... Benjamin!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_07_17.text:
Here... Pick up the Gates of Heaven
and activate the portal right now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_08_01.text:
But...
Stanya! You can't stay here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_08_02.text:
Hey, the purpose of my trip was to get Sentinel back
and kick my old professor's ass.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_08_03.text:
I'll hold him off for now.
You have to leave for Heaven right away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH2_ST6_09_02.text:
Yeah, you too!
I'll follow as soon as I show this robot some discipline!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_01_01.text:
So this is Heaven...
It's very different from what I imagined.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_01_02.text:
It resembles a laboratory, almost.
Much like Rapture Science or Road Industry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_01_03.text:
You are right. Heaven was made for the very purpose of
researching and developing forbidden magic and technologies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_02_01.text:
Halt! Confirmed one unit accompanied by two earthlings.
Scanning identification code.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_02_02.text:
I know you warned me beforehand, but this is creepier than I expected.
Three identical faces all staring at us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_02_03.text:
Wait. Identification code?
Do you have one as well?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_02_04.text:
I used to.
It was destroyed when I was banished.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_02_07.text:
Confirmed traces of code elimination.
Intruder alert!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_03_01.text:
Stanya stayed behind at Road Industry
to stop Sentinel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_03_03.text:
Results of analysis: female android with face resembling #Mother#.
Confirmed identity of previously unidentified target:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_03_04.text:
Code Benjamin - status: exiled.
Alerting central station.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_04_01.text:
They're increasing in number!
What are you going to do now?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_04_02.text:
What do you mean, what are going to do?
We are going to fight and pave a way for ourselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_04_03.text:
But... Aren't they your brothers?
Since you're the same clones...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_04_04.text:
While the Kindred may
seem no different from humans on the outside,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_04_05.text:
they are essentially more similar
to androids.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_04_06.text:
Without free will, without a soul,
they only follow the command given to them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST1_04_07.text:
... Alright. For the time being, anyway.
Let's go, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_01_01.text:
... Fighting people with the same face as your own
is proving much more stressful than I expected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_01_02.text:
I myself found it therapeutic.
I had a lot against you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_02_01.text:
That person in the tube - she's not one of the Kindred.
Can she be a test subject provided by Road Industry?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_02_02.text: Poor thing... Her body is in tatters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_02_03.text:
What did they do to her?
She's only a child, those bastards...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_03_01.text:
That girl... is Ellie?! But didn't you say
that she... at the Temple of Illusions...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_03_02.text:
Someone must have stolen away her body
moments before the explosion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_03_03.text:
It is highly likely that that someone was Arart.
... Something seems strange, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_03_04.text:
Didn't the Kalard called Jeraphim die there and then?
Why was she left behind, when the child was taken?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_03_05.text:
Let's figure out everything later.
What are you doing, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_03_06.text: Stop staring and take her out of there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_04_01.text:
Be careful, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Her life's on a thread there - you might just kill her if you're careless.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_04_03.text:
... Bella.
It's been a long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_04_04.text: How... How can you be alive?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_04_05.text:
I... I saw you return to your proper human age...
I saw you die... I buried you with my own hands...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_04_06.text:
More than that...
Is it true that you are the person behind all this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_04_07.text:
You tricked everyone! You committed atrocities from the shadows!
You - who were once honored as the Goddess of Judgment!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_04_08.text:
Please - please tell me something!
Make excuses! Anything!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_04_09.text:
... You were the last person I wished to involve in all this.
I can only say that I am sorry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_05_01.text:
Sorry? Arart.
I hadn't known you were so sentimental.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_05_02.text:
You - the witch who sacrificed countless souls for over a century.
Feeling 'sorry' for the sorrows of her student?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_05_03.text: Code B. Or rather, Benjamin, as you call yourself now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_05_04.text:
Not a very polite way to talk to one's creator, is it? I should have
cut off your head before banishing you, as I did with the other one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_05_05.text: Have you succeeded in making your mom's 'husk'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_05_06.text: Husk...? Benjamin, what does that mean?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_05_07.text:
Oh, Benjamin... She's sentient!
Have you given her a sense of identity?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_06_01.text: .... Hahahaha!! This is truly a masterpiece!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_06_02.text:
Well, well, well. If you have the guts to make up your mind as I did...
You may succeed in getting what you came for.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_06_03.text:
But - can you? Seeing that you've brought her all the way here...
You have a sliver of a chance, at least.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_06_05.text:
Good. I'm curious to know as to what choice you make.
Now that all the guests have arrived...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_06_06.text: I must introduce you to the heart of Heaven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_07_02.text:
... Everyone... I'm sorry for what I did back there.
I couldn't believe the truth that lay bare before me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_07_03.text:
Now that it's clear Maste - ... No. Arart's behind all these terrible crimes,
I must stop her as her old student.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST4_07_04.text:
Let's quickly deal with Benjamin's ugly brother
and chase after them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_01_01.text:
He returned, your child.
The one you gave a name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_01_02.text:
Along with my old student Bella...
and {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_01_04.text:
Yes. His return has forced me
to revise my plans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_01_05.text:
This is the biggest setback
since that idiot Jeraphim was caught red-handed in Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_01_06.text:
Arart.
Do you genuinely believe in the plan of the Kalard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_01_07.text: It is not too late to change your mind. You could -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_01_08.text:
... I have no intentions of being understood
by the current generation of weaklings who call themselves the Elard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_01_09.text: The true path of light... Hmm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_01_10.text:
So you've arrived at last.
Finally... It took you long enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_02_03.text:
Have you decided to omit my title, Bella?
I'm not sure how to feel about this hostility you're flaunting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_02_04.text:
How to feel? I'll show you how to feel, alright.
You'll be begging for forgiveness in a few moments!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_02_05.text:
Welcome home, Benjamin.
You have grown rather thin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_02_06.text:
Mother. I did everything I could to save you.
Please... Hold on a little longer...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_02_07.text:
Is that your... mother trapped in there?
She seems a little... transparent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_02_08.text:
Analysis complete. The subject within the lab
is composed of pure light energy. However...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_03_01.text:
Yes, it is true that you two share a strong resemblance.
Benjamin designed you after his mother, you see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_03_02.text:
That was your true purpose...
A husk for Galatea, the Sacred Being who lost her body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_03_04.text:
Sacred Being...! {PLAYER_NAME},
wasn't Loki of Utgard called a Sacred Being as well?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_03_06.text:
Sigh - so Gullveig failed as well...
which would truly render Heaven the last refuge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_03_07.text:
This was no time to be engaging in child's play.
It's time to destroy all toys... and carry out the true plan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_04_02.text:
You always were so dauntless, Bella.
But you and the other Elard are too weak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_04_03.text:
Do you not feel it?
You do not have the strength to follow the course of light and fate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_05_01.text:
Playtime's over, kids.
Everything ends here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_06_01.text:
Behold -the shell constructed from the remains of Galatea's body.
It's not much: the leftover scraps after creating Heaven...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_06_02.text: ...but it should be enough for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_07_01.text:
Oh, you'll remember seeing it,
{PLAYER_NAME}, in the Temple of Illusions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_07_02.text:
#Cora's Flame#...
And an artificial Goddess to hold it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_07_03.text:
As you've so inopportunely destroyed
#Avenir# an #Camilla Banoub#,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_07_04.text:
I had to look a little further to obtain the body of an artificial Goddess.
As you can see... This is her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_07_05.text:
A curious twist of fate, don't you think? The child who
sacrificed her life to save you... will now be used to end you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_08_02.text:
Galatea. You have no right to beg me for mercy.
You - the Watcher of the Skies... You watched everything and let it go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_08_03.text: Everything is for the greater good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_09_01.text:
It's time to end your adventure,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_09_02.text:
Put everything into my hands...
and rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_10_01.text:
Ah, so this is why they call you the Champion of Hasla.
I see now why Gullveig lost.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_10_02.text: As long as we have #Cora's Flame#, however...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_11_01.text:
If we don't stop that,
Galatea's husk will recover?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_11_02.text:
But how will we stop Arart...
W-wait! {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_12_01.text:
You have good sense.
Fool you twice, shame on you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_13_02.text:
Bella...! I see you've been keeping up with your training.
As for your manners, however... You all are starting to annoy me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_13_03.text:
Ack... Stop talking as if you're above me!
You're no longer my master, you traitor!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_13_04.text: Good. Show me how you've grown, little spitfire!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_14_01.text:
R-0, what are you doing?
Come back here this instant!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_14_02.text:
Benjamin. The decision Arart mentioned before...
Does it entail moving Galatea into the 'husk' - my body?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_14_04.text:
If we free her, the tides will turn in our favor.
Why do you hesitate?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_15_01.text:
If you accept my being into your body... The soul that has blossomed
as your own... Your memories... Your free will... Everything will disappear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_15_02.text: One must first empty before one holds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_15_03.text:
... Is that why, Benjamin?
You did not wish to sacrifice me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_15_04.text:
Yes. I knew everything from the beginning...
That is the reason why I destroyed your blueprints.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_15_05.text:
The idiots at Road Industry, however... retrieved them
and created a being doomed to be unhappy. ... You.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_15_06.text:
No, Benjamin. I was not unhappy.
There was pain at times, but... I was true to myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_15_07.text:
Benjamin.
You advised me... to discover for myself what I truly wish for in life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_15_08.text:
I only wish I could have
passed on this 'emotion' to V and the other androids.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_15_09.text: Thank you for the life you've given me, Father.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_16_02.text: No... The android sacrificed herself of its own will...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_16_03.text:
... Your resolve has been well received, R-0.
I can no longer linger in despair.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_16_04.text:
Arart. I will no longer enslave myself to your whims.
I will pursue... what I truly wish for.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_17_02.text:
It's a pity...
We were not such bad partners, you and I.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_17_03.text:
It may have been wiser
to continue cooperating with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_17_04.text:
That way, I would have at least saved the Kindred,
even if it means sacrificing all the lives of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_17_05.text: Yet I decided to trust my children.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_18_01.text:
Sigh...
I truly did not want to cause any damage to Heaven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_18_02.text:
As things have come to this,
I won't hold myself back any longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_18_03.text:
All of Heaven is convulsing.
Arart, the Goddess of Judgment... How can she possess such strength?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_19_01.text:
The hooded warrior...!
Why now, out of all times...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_20_02.text:
W-what? She's attacking Arart!
What's going on?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_20_03.text:
You, newcomer.
There must be a misunderstanding...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_20_04.text:
Do not pretend innocence, Arart.
We have already acquired evidence of your betrayal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_20_06.text:
By the will of Cora... Arart...
You shall now be punished.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_22_02.text:
This isn't the time, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Let's go after them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_23_02.text:
Sheer exhaustion.
They did fight a Sacred Being, after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_23_03.text: ... It's no use going after them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_24_02.text: Mother... You are free at last.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_24_03.text:
I've lived for only this day.
But this sorrow that fills my heart...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_24_05.text:
I am happy, Benjamin. I am happy that I am free,
but I am happier that you can now weep for another.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_24_07.text:
It is time to awaken from the dreams of youth...
and, as the true masters of Hasla, face 'her.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_25_01.text:
For life blossoms everywhere,
and embraces all light and darkness as one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_26_01.text:
... As for Road Industry, it has been completely shut down.
Director Levine Ludovico is nowhere to be found...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_26_02.text:
... and we have released to the public evidence that they have been
funded by the House of Nobles to conduct human experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_26_03.text:
Now, as for the identity of Ludovico's accomplice...
The Kalard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_26_04.text:
Purifying Hasla of all traces of darkness...
Is that what they wanted?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_26_05.text: It doesn't sound too bad, what they're trying to do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_26_06.text:
If you put it that way.
But when they say 'trace of darkness'...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_26_07.text:
... what they mean is, anyone who has ever had even the slightest contact
with dark energy. Which equals you, me - everyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_26_08.text:
The Kalard would be, in this light,
a fanatical group of mass murderers plotting the end of the world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_27_01.text:
Anyway, Yuria - where did everyone else go?
Where's Raven and Stanya? The office feels empty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_27_02.text: Ah, I apologize for not telling you sooner, Goddess Bella.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_27_03.text:
Raven and Lyudmilla returned to Nosgard not too long ago.
The wizard under their care suddenly took a turn for the worse.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_27_04.text:
They said he could only be healed
by the powers of the Winter Wind, found in the northern lands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_27_05.text:
Really? Tsk. And I didn't even get a thank you.
What about Stanya?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_27_06.text:
Doctor Stanya went after Doctor Stein,
who seems to have fled from Road Industry. Again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_27_07.text: She had an android by her side that I hadn't seen before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_27_08.text:
Did she? Hmm...
Maybe we should go and help her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_27_09.text:
Then again... {PLAYER_NAME} could do with some rest,
after all the injuries they received in Heaven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_27_10.text: What about you two? Where will you go?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_27_11.text: By 'you two,' I presume you mean R-0 and myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_27_12.text:
... I don't know. It has only been a day since
I achieved my life's greatest desire and objective.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_28_01.text: What if you help the interim government, Benjamin?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_28_02.text:
They must deal with the Heaven technology stored in Road Industry,
and I hear it's difficult to interpret even their most basic meanings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_28_03.text: I'm sure everyone here would love it if they could work with you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_28_04.text:
That sounds like a lot of work.
I won't be able to do it. Which translates to - I don't want to do it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_28_05.text: I think you should accept the request, Benjamin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_28_06.text:
You received much help from Commander Yuria
during the last mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_28_07.text: ... Weeellll... If you put it like that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_29_01.text:
Your help would be greatly appreciated.
Oh, and one last thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_29_03.text:
Ever since you returned through the portal,
everyone has been pointedly ignoring the topic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_29_04.text:
That... can be answered by the reason
we've all gathered at your office.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_30_01.text: It is good to see everyone again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_30_02.text: A young girl...? Who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_30_03.text:
Ah, you are Yuria.
I am Galatea, the Sacred Being of Heaven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_31_03.text:
When we fought Arart in Heaven, R-0 sacrificed herself
to free Galatea and win the battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_31_04.text:
So, in the end...
The freed soul of Galatea settled in Ellie's body. Am I right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_32_01.text:
Yes. It is a tragedy... but it was fortunate that
the body of an artificial Goddess lay so close at hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_32_03.text:
For I will...
return this body to Ellie.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_33_01.text: ... I'm afraid I'm not following this conversation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_33_02.text:
Her soul... It is still intact. It lies protected in veils of her own power...
Like an unhatched egg.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_33_03.text:
She is protecting herself, until she regains her strength.
One day, she will break out of her shell - reborn...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_33_04.text:
Until then, I will help her
from within this body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_33_05.text:
Mother. Then... what will happen to you?
Will you lose your body again, Mother?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_33_06.text:
My body remains in Heaven... With time, it will heal.
As my brother in the north, Loki, is reviving...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_33_07.text:
I too must stay in Heaven until my body is ready.
Ellie will return to your side someday, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_34_02.text:
I... don't understand everything that is going on,
but I am happy to see everyone happy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CH3_ST6_34_03.text:
I still have a lot of questions, but...
For the time being, let's enjoy our victory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_01_01.text:
Why did you do such a thing,
my child?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_01_02.text:
We Kindred were born
without free will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_01_03.text:
Now that I have discovered my life's mission,
I will no longer subject myself to your oppression!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_01_05.text:
It's fascinating how his free will arrived at the conclusion of worshipping
Arart, who has killed countless Kindred for her genetic experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_01_06.text:
Master Arart has promised us the Kindred
to make us the next rulers of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_01_07.text:
With Master gone,
Mother only seeks to persecute us, the Kindred!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_01_08.text:
You are discriminating us created beings
in favor of the lifeforms on earth!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_01_09.text:
... The humans of Hasla
are not ready to accept the Kindred.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_01_10.text:
They will fear you,
an entire species sharing an identical face and abilities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_01_11.text:
I have been planning to gradually reveal the existence of Heaven
to the people of Hasla, so as to prevent unnecessary warfare.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_02_02.text:
When Master Arart returns...
We will destroy every contaminated thing on earth...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_02_03.text:
We Kindred will become the new rulers and reign with glory!
If only you didn't exist... If only...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_04_01.text:
All of Arart's creations
meet a sorrowful end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_04_02.text:
... The Kindred are not the only lifeforms
brought to life by Arart in Heaven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_04_03.text:
Through the 'forbidden magic' she researched,
she created many new monsters and species.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_04_04.text:
The results...
You have already seen them for yourself:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_04_05.text:
Artificially created life, supernaturally strong but genuinely innocent.
Like this child whose body I am borrowing for some time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_04_06.text:
As you can see from the Three Kings of the Temple of Illusions
or the Cardinal of the Kingdom of Trista...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_04_07.text:
Arart will make contact with humans of power and authority,
luring them with the bait of ultimate strength, to proceed with her plans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_05_02.text:
I may not know the exact details
of that plan of yours you've been concocting over the past century,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_05_03.text: but I'll do whatever it takes to stop you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_05_04.text:
Huhu...
The Elard of this generation are all stronghearted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_05_05.text:
I remember another Elard who fought in Edenberg three years ago -
a child named Prestina.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_05_06.text:
I, Galatea, Sacred Being of the Wind and Sky,
bless you with my powers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_05_07.text:
May you stop the Kalard and their aspirations
from further blinding this world of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_06_02.text:
It's not the Gates of Heaven.
It might be Commander Yuria on earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_07_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
Someone has come for you from Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_07_02.text:
I told her
that she would have to wait awhile...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_07_03.text:
... but she insisted on seeing you as soon as possible for urgent business.
I had no choice but to bring her here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_07_04.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}!
I've been looking everywhere for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_08_01.text:
Lednas, it's so nice to see you!
How have you been?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_08_02.text:
It is nice to see you too, Goddess.
I... only wish our meeting weren't under such excruciating circumstances.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_08_03.text:
Hmm? Is something the matter?
You seem nervous, Lednas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_08_04.text:
As a knight of the Grancia Empire,
treachery is a crime of the highest order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_08_05.text: But I would rather betray the Empire than you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_08_07.text:
Emperor Alexander has issued a bounty for
{PLAYER_NAME} and our Heroes - all throughout Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ED_08_08.text:
You must flee at once.
Anywhere that will offer you sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_01_01.text:
Thank you for gathering here today, everyone.
I called this emergency meeting due to an urgent matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_01_02.text:
Yawn... What happened?
We still haven't recuperated from our latest battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_01_03.text:
It's true, what they say about the weary getting no rest...
There's not a peaceful day to be had in this country.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_01_04.text:
Levine Ludovico has reappeared in the city
with some private troops that belonged to Road Industry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_01_05.text:
It is highly probable
that she seeks to stage a coup.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_01_07.text:
In order to uncover her whereabouts,
we hired some former soldiers of the House of Nobles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_02_01.text:
Pssh... Debts are always better... pssh...
paid earlier than later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_02_03.text: According to the data they gathered...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_02_04.text:
Levine will attempt to flee out of the country
through the shipping docks of the Rapture Science Fourth Laboratory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_02_05.text: The Fourth Laboratory? That's a little far away...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_02_06.text:
This could be a trap.
There are many facilities more convenient for planning escape.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_02_07.text:
Pssh... Perhaps she had...
pssh... no choice in the matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_02_08.text:
I sent a troop to investigate.
Now, this way... pssh...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_03_01.text:
Ah... pssh...
Can the information really have been a trap?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_04_01.text:
Hullo there, everyone!
It's good to see you again so soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_04_02.text:
Just as I thought. If I spilled information that I was far away,
you would go unguarded and vulnerable in the city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_04_03.text: How does it feel to be bested at the very last moment?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_04_04.text:
Levine Ludovico.
Your struggle is useless.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_04_05.text:
Do you truly believe you can
defeat {PLAYER_NAME} with so few troops?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_04_06.text:
I agree with you. It's ridiculous. Completely inefficient... An entire army
unable to defeat an individual: it just doesn't meet the numbers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_04_07.text:
Now that I think of it, I shouldn't have wasted my time on wizards and 
clones. I should have just captured you in the first place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_05_01.text:
Well, this is enough. I only came out here to buy time...
for the 'traitor' to infiltrate the entirety of Heaven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_05_03.text:
Huhuhu... Oh, this is gold: clones not being able to tell each other apart.
Yes, a traitor. Or did you not notice due to everyone being identical?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_05_04.text:
He wasn't happy about his current situation.
He certainly had a lot to say against you and 'Mother.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_05_05.text:
He offered me the technology of Heaven
if I stalled you as long as I could.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_05_06.text:
... If I can get my hands on Heaven's technology, nothing else
matters anymore! Not Road Industry - not even the House of Nobles!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_05_07.text:
Just wait... I'll create an army unseen before in human history!
An army fit to rule entire continents and galaxies! Ahahahaha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_06_01.text:
Levine... She has always taken the road to her own ruin
rather than admit her wrongs.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_06_02.text:
Hrrmph. I call that foolhardiness.
I'll have to teach her a proper lesson this time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_06_03.text:
I'm more concerned about
the Kindred traitor that she mentioned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_06_04.text:
If a Kindred really did rebel against Mother
as Ludovico claims,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_06_05.text:
there is a high possibility that he is an anomaly like me:
a Kindred that has attained free will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP4_CL_ST1_06_06.text:
If the worst comes to the worst,
Arart may succeed in reclaiming Heaven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_01_02.text:
Arart, you thought of them as just a tool...
What about now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_01_03.text: The traces of the portal are linked to the Sacred Ground.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_01_04.text:
He is only one step away from reaching the truth
of this world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_01_06.text:
I'm sorry, I've been chased for a few days, so I didn't
get to sleep much. I dozed off.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_01_07.text:
If you don't want to answer, just say so.
No need to beat around the bush.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_01_08.text: Why are you getting mad? I was just kidding.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_01_09.text:
I admit I misjudged {PLAYER_NAME}.
But, that turned out to be for the better.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_01_10.text:
I'm sure now. {PLAYER_NAME} is the champion that
the #Goddess of Hasla# chose herself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_01_11.text: What...! They're the one that Cora herself...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_01_12.text: That's right. They didn't tell us everything, after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_01_13.text:
... That's very disrespectful. You better be careful
in front of other Kalards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_01_14.text:
Of course… You be careful, #Lethe#.
Their next destination will be where you are.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_01.text:
We barely left the Deep Sea, and we are walking
endlessly… How boring.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_03.text:
Hey mermaids. Master 'Deepest Darkness' is bored.
Show us some cute tricks!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_05.text: Hey, octopus head. You want to get beat up?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_06.text: Please bear with me. We are almost at the shore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_09.text:
…Huh? A Naga? They live near
the coast of Valencia… Why is one here…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_12.text:
Hmm...? Eek, w-who are you?
Huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_13.text:
E-elder Sister of the Sea!
Please help me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_16.text:
Maré, calm down. I don't think she's trying to hurt us.
But, who are you? What happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_18.text:
... We had an earthquake a few days ago and our
village was destroyed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_19.text: And some violent monsters appeared too…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_20.text:
I went to the humans to ask for help, but I
couldn't find the kind red-headed human… So...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_21.text: ... Talking nonsense. Who is the red-haired human?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_23.text:
I heard she made a peace negotiation through a Naga
she met by chance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_24.text: She must be the Naga from the rumors, #Seiren#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_25.text:
Oh, that peculiar human and Naga?
I've heard about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_28.text:
...
The situation seems to be worse than we expected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_29.text:
So? Should we go to the Naga's territory before
heading to the Eastern Kingdoms?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_31.text:
No, all of you go to the Eastern Kingdoms.
I'll help that Naga.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_32.text:
Now that the veins are weakening, we don't know
how much longer Habaek will be able to withstand it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_34.text:
Heh, I don't look reliable enough?
Don't worry, kid. I'm pretty good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_35.text:
Umrat? Why are you trying to help such a
lowly Naga...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_36.text:
The reason for the earthquake and the violent monsters
is because I went after Habaek's power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_37.text:
If it was the old me, I wouldn't care about mortals,
but I decided to help out {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_38.text:
Oh... Merciful Darkness. We have no way to express
our awe of your great and unlimited love!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_39.text:
Then what will happen?
Your minions will follow you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_40.text:
So it's just me, Haerang, the old man, Aubrey, and
{PLAYER_NAME} heading to #Han#?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_41.text:
Hmm. No.
I will go with them as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_42.text: Huh? Why? You have to come with us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_43.text:
I have an ill-fated relationship with that red-haired
kid.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_44.text:
There's no way she would have broken a promise
unless something happened...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_45.text:
If something happened to her, it means my
home was influenced as well… There's no helping it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_46.text: What? You said you would help us first!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_47.text:
You are going to talk to patron saints in the Eastern
Kingdoms where I've never been. How would I help?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_48.text:
Let's part ways here, and once everything is done,
we will get together for a drink.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_49.text:
Okay. If we've decided, let's hurry.
{PLAYER_NAME}! Be careful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_50.text:
What...
He's really just leaving like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_51.text:
Tsk, old man.
Alright, go away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_52.text:
... Maré. If you are that worried, go after him now.
It's not too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_53.text: I can meet the patron saints of Han by myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_56.text: O-okay. I'm called the Elder Sister of the Sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_57.text:
If it's not the mermaids, I should help the Naga
at least, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_58.text:
That's why I'm going.
I want to go with you guys too, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_60.text:
S-see you later then!
Let me know if you have any issues!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_62.text:
Maré… She really left because we told her. She's
the only one that can't tell it's obvious, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_63.text: Haha, it must be the first time she had a friend.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_64.text:
Maré had a hard time guarding the sea...
So this should be okay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_65.text:
... She's around the same age with a grandpa like that.
I'm over 100, but I really can't believe it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_OP_02_66.text:
Well, we are close to the coast.
Shall we get going?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_01_01.text: Hahaha! It's burning up so well! How satisfying!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_01_02.text: Now I can sleep in peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_02_01.text: A forest fire? W-what is going on?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_02_02.text:
Why are they just staring at the fire?
They even seem happy about it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_02_03.text: …They have some strange customs in the Eastern Kingdoms.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_04_02.text: What?! Kid! Move away, it's dangerous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_04_03.text: Wait. That tail and ears… It's the annoying patron saint!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_04_05.text:
You beast. You come out now since your house is
burning? Now you should understand how it feels!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_04_06.text: Why are you doing this… What did I do…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_05_01.text: No way, isn't that the #tiger mountain saint#, Halla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_05_03.text:
That kid is a patron saint?
Hmm… Alright.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_06_03.text:
Huh? Is it true that the secret agents of Chen
are scouting the borders?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_06_04.text:
Don't just stand there! Run away!
We have to report it to the government!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_07_01.text: Taoists and secret agents? What are they talking about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_07_02.text: Halla, are you okay? It's me, Haerang!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_07_04.text: Yes. I was away for too long, wasn't I?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_08_01.text:
Where have you been all this time?
Who are those foreigners?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_08_02.text:
This is the Goddess of the Deep Sea, Aubrey, and this is
{PLAYER_NAME}. We have some things to take care of.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_08_03.text:
Goddess?
Oh, you mean the kids who guard that strange stone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_08_04.text:
…Ahem. Nice to meet you.
I'm #Halla# of the Taebaek Mountains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_08_05.text: Nice to meet you. Seems like you are older than you look.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_08_06.text: T-this is because I lost some of my power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_08_07.text: I'm known as the largest tiger in these mountains...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_08_08.text:
We don't have time for this. The kids just now
went to report us, so...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_08_09.text: Let's go somewhere else before talking.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_08_10.text:
R-really? Hm… Alright.
I know a place. Follow me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_09_01.text:
Only wild beasts know this path.
This should be good enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_09_02.text:
Halla. What we just witnessed...
Did something happen in the country?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_09_03.text:
Oh, right! Ugh...
Haerang, humans burned down my forest!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_09_04.text: What? Why would Han residents burn down their base?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_09_05.text:
It wasn't them. Some soldiers came and
burned the mountains!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_09_06.text: I tried to stop them, but I couldn't use my power...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_09_07.text:
You saw, right? Humans are hostile towards patron
saints. I don't know why the are like that to us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_10_02.text:
Nati!
Did you also run away from the humans?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_10_04.text:
Y-yes. He takes care of the mountain next to mine.
We've known each other for a long time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_10_05.text:
But what's up with your eyes?
You look like you have rabies...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_11_01.text:
Wah! W-what are you doing?!
They are my guests!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_11_02.text: Halla, I don't think he can hear you! We must go...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_11_03.text:
What? Are you crazy? There's a bear in front of you,
and you are just standing there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_12_02.text:
You beast dare to yell at us!
Go away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_12_04.text:
Hm? The lad from before?
Don't just stand there, get into position!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_12_05.text:
I knew the wild beasts were acting strange. It looks like
they lost their minds after seeing the forest fires!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_12_06.text:
I-I don't think he meant to cause harm!
If we talk to him...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_13_02.text:
Well, your friend is calling you. I think that bear
is thinking of you as his dinner, don't you think?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_13_03.text: Nati, how could you be like this to me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_13_04.text: Halla. We must do as she says right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_13_05.text:
I have an idea why the patron saints got violent...
We'll see later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_13_06.text:
Ah... Okay. Don't hit them too hard!
They are all my friends!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST1_13_07.text: …I think I know why people don't like patron saints.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_01_01.text: Sigh… I don't understand why they are being like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_01_02.text:
Just as I thought… The power of patron saints 
weakened because of the weakened veins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_01_03.text:
And the consciousness as mystical creatures also
became faint, so they are more like animals now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_01_05.text:
Hm? I feel no energy and a little depressed.
That's all, though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_01_06.text:
I wonder if taking those medicines a long time ago
is helping me now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_01_07.text:
You were fine after eating the hard and spicy tteok
I made to kill you, so. That explains it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_01_08.text: Hm? What did you just say?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_01_09.text:
Hmm. Anyway. The blue-haired girl there. You seem to
know why this happened? Can you explain?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_01_10.text: ... We don't know the details either.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_01_11.text:
Just that something weakened the veins of this land,
and patron saints became violent because of it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_01_12.text: Hm… I asked the girl wearing the hanbok over there...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_02_01.text: Hmm. I guess I don't know much either...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_02_03.text:
We came thinking that the patron saints would know
the reason why the veins weakened...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_02_04.text:
Hm, the reason why I don't know is because I live
deep in the mountains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_02_05.text:
Maybe you should ask a patron saint that knows more
about the human world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_02_07.text:
#Yeowoodong#... She loved a man, so has been living
amongst humans for a long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_03_02.text: Yeowoodong! How did you find out and come here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_03_03.text: Hehehe. What do you think? How would I have found out?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_03_04.text:
That's not nice, Yeowoodong.
We should explain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_03_05.text: Oh well, it's been so long since I saw him…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_03_06.text:
And he looks so small and cute, you know?
I wanted to have some fun.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_04_01.text:
Nice to meet you, Halla.
I'm Giparang.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_04_02.text:
I see. You must be the human named Giparang.
I heard a lot about you from Yeowoodong!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_04_03.text:
But I didn't know you two were together...
Did you finally…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_04_04.text:
Yes. I found out she was not human by chance,
but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_04_05.text: That wasn't enough to get in the way of our love.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_04_06.text: G-Giparang! That's too embarrassing to say!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_04_07.text:
What's embarrassing?
I decided to be honest with myself now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_04_08.text:
Huh, unbelievable.
What an eye sore...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_04_09.text:
... Hmm. Yeowoodong and I actually found out why the
veins weakened by mere chance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_04_10.text:
One of the envoys of Chen in the capital was
carrying this around.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_05_02.text:
Yes. They have been installing these iron stakes
throughout the mountains of Han.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_05_03.text:
The energy from these stakes must be weakening
the veins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_05_04.text:
We found some on the way here, so we
took them out...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_05_05.text: They are not even trying to hide them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_05_06.text: …I feel a powerful energy. Don't tell me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_06_01.text: Yes. It has the energy of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_06_02.text:
But how can this mystical energy affect the veins
so negatively?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_06_03.text:
The powers you, and the #Elards# and #Kalards#
received from Cora…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_06_04.text:
Just like Umrat and the apostles, are from
a different world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_06_05.text:
The distinction between the powers of light and
darkness did not exist in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_06_06.text:
If a power like that permeates, the #master of this land#
would obviously reject it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_06_07.text:
…You mean 'Goddess Hasla'.
I would like to meet her if she really exists.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_06_09.text:
I just know through Habaek and the memories I
inherited as the Oracle of Water...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_06_10.text: But it's an undeniable truth that she exists.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_06_11.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} here is proof of that
The agent of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_06_12.text:
I remember Umrat said something like that. {PLAYER_NAME}…
When did you acquire that kind of power?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_07_01.text:
Why do you keep whispering amongst yourselves?
If you found out something, tell me too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_07_03.text:
…These stakes were probably installed by the Kalards,
who are commanding the soldiers of Chen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_07_04.text:
This could be a problem, so we must let Han's royal
family know about this and take action.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_08_01.text:
Uh, hmm... We forgot to tell you why we came to you
with this information.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_08_03.text:
We tried to go to an acquaintance from the city
before coming to you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_08_04.text:
But the guards of the city tried to capture Yeowoodong,
because she's a patron saint, so we escaped.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_08_05.text: What? What's wrong with being a patron saint?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_08_06.text: …Remember the violent patron saints we met earlier?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_08_07.text:
If they are going berserk like that… Isn't that reason
enough to capture them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_08_09.text:
And the residents who were just watching the forest
fires… This is bad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_08_10.text: If the people reported us, they should be...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_09_01.text:
Here you were.
You didn't get too far, did you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_09_03.text:
King of the mountains of the borders, Halla.
Nice seeing you all little without your power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_09_04.text:
I never liked how you acted as a patron saint,
when you are just a wild beast.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_09_05.text: I'll rip you apart and use your skin as a rug.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_09_07.text:
How rude! How dare you mock a patron saint who guards the
energy of the mountains, as someone who lives here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_09_08.text: Hm? I see. Mr. Full Moon who has fallen for a fox.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_09_09.text:
I heard you were on the run,
what are you doing on the borders?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_09_10.text:
You weren't scheming a revolt here,
were you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_09_12.text:
Who cares. My subordinates have surrounded
this area.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_09_13.text: You think you can do anything about it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_09_14.text:
Hmm, those humans look familiar.
Let's see...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_10_01.text:
Oh, I knew it! The criminals that Grancia is
looking for! {PLAYER_NAME}, and Aubrey?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_10_02.text:
I got a windfall!
How much are all of them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_10_03.text:
…So the bounty was issued in the Eastern Kingdoms too.
This is troublesome.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_10_04.text: We have to defeat them to run away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_10_05.text:
How cute.
Capture them all, now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_11_03.text: Ugh... You think you can run away just by defeating me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_11_04.text:
Soldiers from the police bureau will arrive soon after
hearing the commotion you created.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_11_05.text:
Have you heard of the #First Sword of Han#?
Good luck.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_12_01.text:
H-he's running away!
Shouldn't we capture him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_12_02.text: …I don't think we have the time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_12_03.text:
If it really is the one he said, our pursuer is
#Police Chief B. Sworden#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_12_04.text: Why did it have to be him…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_13_01.text:
B. Sworden? The First Sword of Han?
Who is he that everyone is so worried?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_13_02.text:
Seeing you guys fight, I don't think you need
to fear anyone...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_13_03.text:
I only heard a rumor, but I heard that he put his own
father in prison! How coldblooded he must be!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_13_04.text:
Tsk. How immoral.
I would like to see his face.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_13_05.text:
Hmm… It's just as you said.
{PLAYER_NAME}, was it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_13_06.text:
You are very skilled, indeed. You might really be
able to defeat the First Sword of Han.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_13_07.text:
But if we are fighting against the court, we will be
outnumbered.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_13_08.text:
We should avoid them at all costs.
Halla. Do you have a plan?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_13_10.text:
We are going after the one who imbued the
energy in those stakes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_13_11.text: We will head to Chen first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_13_13.text:
If we had met our acquaintance in the city, we could
have received some help…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST3_14_02.text:
They've already caught up.
We must leave this place!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_01_02.text:
Resistance is futile. The moment I stepped in,
your fate was decided...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_02_02.text:
The nation's hero fell in love with a beast.
Your reputation does precede you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_02_03.text: Don't you feel sorry for your students?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_02_04.text: I heard about you as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_02_05.text:
You became a dog of the court and have been harming
innocent people. How dare you insult me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_02_06.text:
…You don't know the darkness of this world.
You think I captured innocent people?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_02_07.text:
You really think relatives of government officials who
took everything from the people are innocent?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_02_08.text:
Ask those who must pay for their extravagance,
whether they really...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_02_09.text: Hey! Aren't you the lad that bought black sesame tteok?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_03_04.text:
This lad came from time to time to get just that
black tteok...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_03_05.text:
What did he say, something like "I'm taking in darkness
to kill the darkness", was it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_03_06.text:
…When eating that tteok with the color of the abyss and
taste, I could ruminate on my anger for my father.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_03_07.text:
Yea. You mumbled like that while eating, so I thought
you were crazy. I didn't know you had a high post.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_03_08.text: Is that what you thought of me…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_04_01.text:
I have no time for this. Traitor Giparang and 
Yeowoodong shall be arrested.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_04_02.text:
Sworden. We are not your enemies. Secret agents of
Chen have infiltrated this land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_04_03.text:
R-right! They caused the forest fires and installed
stakes! That's why the patron saints turned violent!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_04_04.text:
I don't listen to beasts.
Enough of the excuses. Surrender yourselves!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_04_05.text:
Hey, come on. Stop being so stuck up, and trust me!
You love the tteok I make, don't you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_04_06.text:
…I don't care if you are the owner of my favorite shop.
I'll arrest you all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_04_07.text: L-look at this bastard! How dare you…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_04_08.text: Ugh, ! Stop already and just move away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_05_02.text:
Wow, you really defeated the First Sword of Han!
But...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_05_03.text:
… Yes. It was unexpected,
but nothing changes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_05_04.text:
Even if I fall, my men surrounding these mountains
will arrest you all...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_05_05.text:
Oh, everyone is so energetic.
What brings you all to these deep mountains?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_06_07.text:
…Hanee Baram, it's me, Halla.
You couldn't recognize me because I'm small?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_07_01.text:
Oh, yes. Halla. Of course I remember you.
I'm glad you are safe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_07_03.text: …Who is it? She has an aura.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_07_04.text:
She's the rabbit patron saint, #Hanee Baram#.
She's the head patron saint of Han.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_07_05.text:
She has wanderlust, so he goes all around Hasla.
She's never in her place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_07_06.text:
I see. An Elard and {PLAYER_NAME} were here too.
How is Lesdna doing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_07_08.text:
Hm? Lednas? Was that the name?
Hmm, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_08_01.text: I asked how my old friends were on the way here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_08_02.text: Human, where are all the patron saints you captured?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_08_03.text: …I don’t know what you are talking about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_08_04.text:
I know what happened.
Don't even think about evading me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_08_05.text:
The squirrels and sparrows have told me that
everyone was arrested by one man.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_08_06.text:
A man with a dark and dreary face.
You.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_09_01.text:
And I heard that you are the one who ordered for these
stakes to be installed in the veins of this land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_09_03.text:
Sworden! Is this true?
That's what the envoy of Chen brought!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_09_05.text:
…I move for the greater good. It's how I've been,
and how I will be forever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_10_01.text:
I know that secret agents of Chen are here.
But they also have their reasons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_10_02.text:
They are looking for the General's daughter, who
went missing after the #Eastern Unification War#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_10_03.text:
The General's daughter... You mean War Princess
Rebecca? Why are they looking for her in Han?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_10_04.text:
... The one who kidnapped her is Moon Shadow 
Altair. You should know him well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_11_01.text:
A-Altair… That guy? I saw he looked to be out of his
mind after the war, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_11_02.text: Yes, he was out of his mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_11_03.text:
He was so infatuated with a woman that gave an
enemy nation an excuse for war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_12_01.text:
But... What does that have to do with capturing
patron saints?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_12_03.text:
The envoy from Chen asked to capture patron saints
in exchange for stopping the war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_03.text:
You really think the palace wouldn't know about what
you were up to?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_04.text: It has been revealed through a secret inspection!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_05.text:
You used your position to corrupt the land
and harm the patron saints...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_07.text:
Ashamed? You don't understand! We are at the
brink of war in the borders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_08.text:
We protected our land during the Unification war thanks
to General Mundeok, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_09.text:
We don't have the strength to go through another
war!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_10.text:
But if we can keep the peace by handing over some
beasts, isn't that the obvious solution?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_11.text: Even if I must stain my name...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_12.text: I'm ready to accept the darkness to protect this land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_13.text: Are you determined like me? Mondrian!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_14.text:
You… always talked about darkness this and that
since a young age…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_16.text: H-hey! Stop talking nonsense and open your eyes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_17.text: Nonsense? Did I say something wrong?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_18.text:
If we don't carry out the request from the envoy,
will you go find the general's daughter?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_19.text: Hmm... I'm sorry for interrupting your conversation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_20.text:
So if we bring her, will you stop handing over the
patron saints to Chen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_01.text:
What do you mean?
How would you...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_02.text: ... We have Altair and Rebecca under our custody.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_05.text: Did all this happen because of Altair?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_06.text:
It's the ones who are trying to use this situation
to their advantage. Am I correct?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_07.text: He probably never thought it would get this serious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_08.text: That's why he's not able to step up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_09.text:
...
So... What do you suggest we do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_10.text: Well, as you know, Altair is our fellow classmate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_12.text:
Don't say that. Did you know that he's a third 
generation only son of the Minister of War?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_14.text:
You had a drink with him, too.
You must have a memory like a sieve.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_15.text: What does that have to do with this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_16.text: The point is, Altair is an important figure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_17.text: So if he takes Rebecca to Chen...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_18.text:
And takes the head of patron saints, Hanee Baram,
to offer him, wouldn't that be a nice picture?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_19.text:
Hanee Baram… You will sacrifice yourself for this
country?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_20.text: Of course. I was moved by your patriotism.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_15_02.text:
Mondrian, Hanee Baram.
You will have to take responsibility for your words.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_15_03.text: I'll let you free, so do what you must.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_15_04.text: But... If this was all a lie to get out of this,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_15_05.text:
I will arrest you again and make you regret
you extended your life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_15_06.text:
Come on, black sesame tteok lad!
Stop saying dumb things and get going your way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_02.text: ... I don't understand what is going on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_03.text:
I can somewhat understand the patron saint that 
appeared out of nowhere, but who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_04.text:
Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't introduce myself.
My name is #Mondrian#...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_05.text:
It's embarrassing, but I'm in the lowest seat of the
Office of the Inspector General.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_06.text:
Mondrian! You are the one who captured that
magistrate!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_07.text:
Your exploits were the talk of the town amongst the
Hwarangs.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_08.text:
Oh, it's nothing compared to your exploits, Full Moon,
who shot at the moon to make it fall.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_09.text: Oh, and the Inspector General sends his regards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_10.text:
He said he is sorry he couldn't help you in the city
because there were too many eyes...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_11.text: The Inspector General! What an honor...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_12.text:
Must be someone in a high position.
S-so are we all good now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_13.text: Of course. Sworden actually trusts me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_14.text: I came up with a solution, so he is going along.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_15.text:
He stole a friend's girl, but he's a good guy.
You can trust him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_16.text:
…So the rumor was true?
You have a strong will, more so than what I heard...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_17.text:
Anyway, thank you.
I don't know how I should repay you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_18.text:
Haha, I just did what I was supposed to do.
