TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_2_02.text: Why you can't exceed Lionel, you ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_2_03.text:
Is it not obvious? Even in that state,
Lionel is still my own descendant and heir.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_2_04.text: As for you... You have no making of a ruler in you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_3_01.text:
Who would entrust the throne of an entire kingdom
to mere child whose impatience overwhelms her capacities?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_3_02.text: Your grandfather made a wise decision not to trust you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_3_04.text:
No, give me your body instead.
I will defeat them for your sake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_3_05.text:
Afterwards... I will retreat without question.
Don't you think it is a profitable deal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_5_02.text:
No... No!
I... I didn't do this...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_6_01.text: Aria, how is the Margrave's condition?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_6_02.text:
He was hit in a bad place.
I'm not sure if he can recover...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_7_03.text:
Lord Lionel...
Are you injured anywhere?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_7_04.text:
Please don't worry about me.
It is yourself you should be most concerned about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_7_05.text: Why did you receive that attack in my place?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_7_07.text:
You and Rael... Both of you sacrificed everything
to protect Valencia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_7_08.text:
Yet I, afraid that such sacrifice would be misinterpreted,
suppressed Rael's full potential...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_7_09.text:
... and forced you to carry on your back
the heavy burden of your ancestors' throne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_7_10.text:
I realize only now, to my shame,
that I had been wrong to do so.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_7_11.text:
I beg you, Lord Lionel.
Please save my child!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_7_12.text:
... Of course, Margrave.
Please rest in the meantime.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_7_7_13.text: I will return with her. I promise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_1_01.text:
What... What have I done...?
Oh, Grandfather...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_2_02.text:
Kee kee kee... I see I have been underestimating
your true potential.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_3_01.text: No... No, I didn't mean to do that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_3_03.text:
Admit it... You felt... liberated
when you pierced your own grandfather with your sword.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_3_04.text:
When you overpowered a senile old man too blinded by petty honor
to acknowledge what could have been his - and yours!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_3_05.text:
No... Grandfather...
was only concerned for my sake -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_3_06.text:
Do you genuinely think so? 
And whom did that grandfather of yours bring back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_3_07.text: Didn't Lionel steal your rightful place... your rightful throne?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_3_08.text:
Lionel...
You thief... taking everything away from me...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_3_09.text: Rael...? Who is she talking to?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_4_01.text:
Lionel... Lionel!
If it only weren't for you...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_5_01.text:
Even a strong body and a sound mind
can falter before destructive passions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_5_02.text:
I have waited for rage to consume her...
At last, a living body has fallen under my control.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_5_03.text: This voice... Can it be Soltar?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_5_04.text: Kee kee... Yes, Lionel. It has been a while.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_5_05.text:
Who would have expected for my chance at revenge
against you and the Goddess to arrive so soon?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_5_06.text: I seem to have underestimated the foulness of humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_5_07.text:
It can't be... You were banished to the other side of this dimension
by the Goddess herself...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_6_01.text:
Ha, did you truly think that the dirty armor you fought 
was my actual body?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_6_03.text:
As long as the Fortress of Souls exists,
I am immortal!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_6_04.text:
As long as I possess a body that succumbs to my will, 
even the Goddess won't be able to stop me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_6_05.text:
Even if her heart grew ill with a distorted love, 
Rael fought for the sake of her kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_6_06.text:
I will not let you cause chaos in Valencia again
through her body!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_6_07.text: I will end you here and now - again and again if need be!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_8_6_08.text:
Alone? With what army?
Kee kee kee... Yes, entertain me with your struggling.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_1_01.text:
Was that everything you had?
A weapon forged out of Danan's Fragments?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_1_02.text:
Hahaha! Nothing has changed from before.
Did you think you could defeat me with mere perseverance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_1_04.text:
Enough is enough. You aren't even worth being turned
into a soldier for my Army of Souls.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_1_05.text:
I'll show you an ounce of mercy and spare you your life.
Get out of my sight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_2_02.text:
No Goddess, no legendary wizard stands by your side now.
What can you do, so weak and alone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_2_03.text:
... Once, when I was roaming the lands in search of a way to cleanse
the name of Ferdinand, I saw a true Hero in Edenberg.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_2_04.text:
Even before the legions of charging demons...
They did not surrender. They did not fall back. I wished to be like them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_2_05.text:
As the true king of Valencia,
I will stand true to protect my people!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_3_02.text:
That light... belongs to Goddesses.
How did you...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_3_04.text:
Can it mean that… if one is determined to truly face justice,
the light will show them the way?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_4_02.text:
Leave that body,
ghost of Soltar!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_5_01.text:
This is... truly the end...
Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_5_03.text:
No matter how well you rule this kingdom of ours...
There will emerge hearts full of spite and hatred towards you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_5_04.text:
And if even one seeks the Fortress of Souls, as this one did,
I will return.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_5_05.text: It will not take too long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_6_01.text:
Yes, I may be too idealistic.
But I am doing all that I can do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_6_02.text:
If we must meet again someday,
I hope that someday will be many years afterwards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_7_01.text: All this trouble, and still before the coronation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SOUL_HARD_9_7_02.text:
A king fit to rule his people with grace and compassion...
The road ahead is a long and hard one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0004_1.text:
Hahaha! Apa yang kamu lakukan, Abel? Ini bukanlah 
penyambutan yang kuharapkan dari reuni kita!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0004_10.text:
..Tempat ini dipenuhi dengan mana. Tubuhmu tidak akan 
bertahan lama jika terkenanya terlalu lama.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0004_4.text:
Huh? Abel, apa itu teman - temanmu? Kamu mengecewakanku, 
saudaraku! Kamu tidak berhak atas tahta ini!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0004_5.text: Apa mungkin.. Orang ini adalah Raja dari Trista..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0004_6.text:
Dan setelah pertarungan untuk mendapatkan tahta. Tidak 
ada yang tersisa selain tubuh yang kosong, tanpa jiwa..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0004_7.text:
Aku masih ingat saat aku menyerahkannya pada iblis. 
Hahaha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0004_9.text:
Aku tidak butuh tahta sekarang, tapi aku masih sangat 
membencimu. Tubuhmu, jiwamu. Maukah kamu mati saja?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0005_2.text:
Terima kasih telah menolong Abel. Aku sangat
berterima kasih.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0005_3.text: Abel.. Kamu dapat menyebutnya seseorang yang baik.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0005_4.text:
Dia tidak punya ambisi, tapi dia sangat bertanggung jawab. 
Dan berharap melindungi kerajaan kita.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0005_5.text:
Tanda kebangsawanan?.. Bodohnya dia. Masih saja ingat 
tugasnya meskipun tanpa jiwa..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0005_6.text: ..{PLAYER_NAME}. Suatu saat aku akan menjadi Ratu Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0005_7.text:
Aku akan membuat kerajaan kita kuat, untuk menghindari 
tragedi seperti saudaraku.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0005_8.text: Tanda kebangsawanan ini.. Akan menguatkan tekadku.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0005_9.text:
Untuk itu, aku harus berterima kasih. 
.. Dan saudaraku, betapa bodohnya dia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0010_2.text:
Aku tahu kamu pasti bingung, tapi kamu dan kekasihmu 
sedang dalam bahaya besar. Menjawablah demi keselamatanmu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0010_4.text: Kekasih.. Ya.. Aku.. Aku punya kekasih..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0010_5.text:
Kami.. Lari dari Kelompok Bayangan Mawar , karena yang kami
tahu, kami tidak punya masa depan disini..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0010_6.text:
Kami.. Tertangkap.. Uggh.. Dan.. Disana.. Ada.. Eksperimen..
Dan.. Agh!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0010_8.text:
..Jika apa yang dikataknnya benar, maka seseorang telah 
menggunakan kegelapan untuk memanipulasi orang lain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0010_9.text:
Batu Jiwa dan Destalos telah tersegel dalam celah, dan 
Sylunis telah pergi kesuatu tempat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0011_1.text:
..{PLAYER_NAME}, lihat. Semakin banyak yang terkorup
oleh kegelapan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0011_2.text: Pertama kita harus membawa pasukan ini ke Saintess Maria

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0011_3.text:
Akan lebih baik kalau kita berkonsultasi dengan Chronos 
dahulu sebelum bertindak

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0012_2.text: Oh.. Itu telah dihancurkan.. Tidak bisa dikenali lagi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0012_3.text:
...Tidak ada yang bisa dilakukan. Kita harus menunjukan ini 
pada dewi Chronos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0013_1.text:
Squeak.. Huh? Dimana aku? Aku tidak ingat apa - apa 
setelah mengambil pecahan yang aneh..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0013_2.text: Pecahan? Kalau boleh tahu, pecahan apa?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0013_3.text:
Ketika aku sedang meneliti habitat manusia tikus, aku 
melihat mereka sedang memegang beberapa pecahan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0013_4.text: ku pikir itu pantas untuk diteliti, dan.. Tunggu, siapa kamu?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0013_5.text: Akan kami jelaskan nanti. Boleh kulihat pecahannya?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0013_6.text: Baiklah, aku tidak memerlukannya lagi. Ini..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0013_7.text: ..! Aura ini.. Bentuk ini.. {PLAYER_NAME} ini Soulstone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0013_8.text:
Bukankah Soulstone seharusnya tersegel di celah dimensi.
Bagaimana mungkin?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_1.text: Apa kamu anak buah Kardina? Lepaskan aku sekarang!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_11.text:
Ya. Aku sudah lama bekerja untuk Kardinal.. Tapi kesadaranku 
hilang, tapi aku percaya itu untuk maksud yang baik.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_12.text:
tapi Kardinal itu.. Punya tujuan yang tidak mulia. Dan dia 
tidak pernah sembuh benar setelah mendapat buku itu

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_13.text:
Siapa yang tahu kalau dia akan mengorbankan jiwa tidak 
berdosa untuk membuat pecahan itu. Hah!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_14.text: Pecahan.. Apa yang dilakukan Kardinal dengan itu?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_15.text:
Dia tidak dapat melakukan apa - apa. Begitu banyak yang
mati.. Pecahan itu sebuah kegagalan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_16.text: Setelah itu, aku kabur dari lab dan bersembunyi di saluran air ini.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_17.text:
Kardinal itu, pada akhirnya menjadi orang gila. Dia
membuang sisa eksperimennya ke saluran air..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_18.text: ..sejak saat itu aku menjadi seperti ini.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_19.text:
Terima kasih telah menyelamatkanku. Jika Kardina telah mati,
aku..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_2.text:
Aku lebih baik menjadi gila dan bebas dari pada tunduk 
menyembah manusia yang seperti binatang buas!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_20.text:
..{PLAYER_NAME}. Soulstone buatan.. Telah menyebabkan 
mutasi manusia tikus.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_21.text:
Dan residunya mengalir keluar menuju sungat dan laut. 
Itu akan mengkorup banyak orang menuju kegelapan..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_3.text: Tenanglah, kami bukan anak buah Kardinal

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_4.text: Kardinal telah mati. Dia mati karena dosanya sendiri!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_6.text:
..Kardinal.. Menggunakan kekuatan iblis untuk mengubah 
orang menjadi iblis. Pada akhirnya, keserakahannya membunuhnya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_7.text:
Begitukah? Hahaha! Dosanya sendiri! Sudah kuduga! 
Aku tahu itu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_S2_SUB_Q0014_9.text:
Tentu saja aku tahu! Karena.. Aku juga subjek dari 
eksperiment terkutuk itu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_01_01.text:
Hello, our precious shareholders!
The Hero Town Captain's Choice Polls have finally come to an end!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_01_02.text: Outside, we're counting the final votes that will decide the winner!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_01_03.text:
As soon as the results come out,
we will dish out the dividends!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_02_02.text:
I just know Chocolat will win!
That's why I spent my entire fortune on her stocks!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_02_03.text:
Ugh, I'm broke... And even after I tried dividing my investments
among different candidates...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_02_04.text:
Huhuhu, I knew people would come to their senses
and realize the true value of magical berries!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_03_01.text:
Everyone, the results have come out!
This envelope that I hold in my hand contains the name of the winner.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_03_02.text: Now, the winner of the Hero Town Captain's Choice Poll is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_03_04.text:
Hey, look here!
The voice is coming from here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_03_05.text:
N-no!!
You can't come in here like that - Nyaaaa!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_04_01.text:
Bridget! I thought you were being suspicious
when you so willingly volunteered to host the event

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_04_02.text:
You set up this whole ruse...
along with those crooks and {PLAYER_NAME}! Shame on you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_05_01.text:
Everything is in place now! All those accidents at the bakery...
It was Bridget attempting to manipulate the number of my votes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_05_02.text:
Hmm, or it could be those faulty ovens
you recently purchased 'for a bargain.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_05_03.text:
Erm, that's not important!
What's important is that those votes are invalid!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_05_04.text:
Chocolat is right. I thought there were fewer volunteers at the Association
than usual. You were behind everything, Bridget.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_05_05.text:
What? I think that may be due
to your infamously strict training...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_05_06.text:
Stop! I can't bear to listen to any more excuses.
You must admit to your wrongdoings, Bridget.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_05_08.text:
No, no, no! I won't stand it!
Any sign of corruption that can threaten the integrity of our town...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_06_03.text:
This settles it.
There is no official winner for this year's poll!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_06_04.text:
We were wrong to try to decide a 'winner' in the first place.
Especially when we're all friends living in the same town!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_06_05.text:
You're wright.
I truly am ashamed of myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_07_01.text: I thought everyone just hated to lose.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_07_02.text:
Oh, not at all.
I was only implementing justice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_07_03.text:
Now, then! Let's go and clean up the mess.
We've suffered much damage as it is with all that excessive competition.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_08_01.text:
Wait, if we don't know who won the poll...
What happens to all our investments? What about the dividends?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_09_01.text: Ha... Haha... I wasn't trying to run away...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_09_02.text:
'Wasn't trying to run away'?
Yeah, right! Give us the dividends!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_09_03.text:
Yeah! The Youth Association was winning, too!
What are you going to do about it, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_10_01.text:
W-wait! Calm down for a sec!
I think we're acting too drastically for a little event!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_10_02.text:
Little? NOTHING is little when it comes to money.
Do you know how many Orchard Guild shares I bought? Huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_10_03.text:
You there! If you think you can cheat people out of their money like this,
you're mistaken. You'll have to pay another way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_11_01.text:
Fine, fine. On the name of Bridget Pellencia,
respected merchant of Grancia, I'll take responsibility.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_11_02.text:
I will... open a special store
where you can trade in Bridget Tokens for valuable items!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_11_03.text:
And when I say 'valuable,' I mean very valuable.
Much more valuable than the money you would have received.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_11_04.text: How about it? Sound like a deal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_12_01.text:
Why didn't you say so sooner?
So we're all guaranteed a profit?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_12_02.text:
Then we have no complaints.
... The Youth Association came in last place anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_12_03.text:
I'm gonna let you off this one time.
Remember, we'll be keeping an eye on you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_12_04.text:
Sigh... Fine, fine. Then we'll wait outside
until you open this shop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_13_01.text:
Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I'm sorry about how things turned out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_13_02.text:
...
Will you give me a moment alone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_13_03.text:
I know only I'm to blame for this mess,
but the damage done... It's going to cost me a lot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_14_02.text:
You can come in now,
Master Fergus.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_15_01.text: So, how was my act? Almost had even YOU fooled, eh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_15_02.text: Huhuhu... Yes, quite the act indeed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_15_03.text:
Thanks to you, I could swap the dividends
for the spare cargo from the warehouse.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_15_04.text:
Then let's divide the share fifty-fifty,
as we agreed beforehand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_15_05.text:
No... Now that I think about it, you took the brunt of the work,
so sixty-forty is fine with me. Sixty in your favor. Hoho!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_16_01.text:
Huhu... Who knew I would meet my perfect business partner
here, of all places?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_END_1_16_02.text:
I look forward to doing more business with you in the future!
Here's to the eternal glory of the Hero Town Merchant Guild!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_001.text:
Hello, welcome! Bridget here, your favorite merchant!
Feel free to ask me anything you want to know about the event!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_1_01.text:
At the Exchange, you can use Bridget Tokens
to purchase stocks of candidates!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_1_02.text:
Stock prices fluctuate over time - 
try to use the market to your advantage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_1_03.text: You can buy and sell stocks anytime during a turn...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_1_04.text:
EXCEPT during the Vote Count between turns.
Keep it in mind!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_2_01.text:
Information equals power! Before confirming your trade, you may want
to purchase helpful tips that can direct you in the right direction!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_2_02.text:
During the event period, you can pay the Announcer with Bridget Tokens
to buy info on current affairs around Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_2_03.text:
I personally guarantee that the information is accurate - 
the Announcer is very serious about her job!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_2_04.text:
Of the many rumors that find their way around Hero Town,
only verified information is sold.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_2_05.text:
You can view the information you purchase
in the #Tips# Menu at the #Exchange# anytime!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_2_06.text:
The more trading you do, the more expensive the tips will become!
Mind this when purchasing information.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_2_07.text:
Oh, and the Announcer will take breaks in between turns.
She won't be selling tips near the end of the event as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_3_01.text:
Curious as to how to obtain more Bridget Tokens?
Huhu, it is my job to answer all your questions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_3_02.text: There are three ways to obtain Bridget Tokens!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_3_03.text: One: there are the ones that I gave you at the start of the Event.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_3_04.text:
Two:
sell your shares for more Tokens.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_3_05.text:
Try to make more profit
by buying low and selling high.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_3_06.text:
And finally, three:
clear Event Quests.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_3_07.text:
Event Quests are reset every day,
so remember to get your rewards!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_4_01.text:
Also, at the end of the Event, all your shares
will be converted to Bridget Tokens.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_4_02.text:
The value of your shares is determined by prices of the final turn,
so you may want to plan ahead!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_EVENT_HELP_4_03.text:
That brings us to the most important question: 
what do you use these Tokens for? Huhu, you'll see!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_01_01.text:
Everyone of Hero Town,
well done on all your hard work this month!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_01_02.text:
Then let's commence
with the official Hero Town monthly staff dinner!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_02_01.text:
Hmm. Where are your workers, Lenny?
I thought they would be attending today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_02_03.text:
Huh. They deserve to come,
considering how they slave away on your orchard...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_02_04.text:
Slave away...? What exactly are you insinuating? That I'm
taking advantage of people at a ridiculously low cost?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_02_05.text: Haha, well... I didn't exactly say THAT.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_02_06.text:
Kids these days don't care for staff dinners! They'd rather
be doing other things! And I get blamed for it...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_03_01.text:
Hahaha! Don't give the girl a hard time, Lenny.
Everyone is entitled to their own opinion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_03_02.text: It's never too late to make new friends!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_03_03.text: Huh, we really should meet up more often.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_04_01.text:
Hoho, it's been a while
since I enjoyed a break like today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_04_02.text:
I'm always so busy with work,
with all the Heroes coming and going.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_04_03.text:
Yes. I can't remember the last time I got enough sleep...
My ovens need watching 24/7.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_04_04.text:
Me too... I don't have any time for my original research
due to all the skills I have transfer every day!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_04_05.text:
Our orchard needs more workers as well... Sigh.
The demand for Berries is especially high these days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_05_01.text: I hadn't realized you were all so busy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_05_02.text:
Well, no busier than my smithy,
the busiest shop in Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_05_04.text:
All Heroes who visit Hero Town
stop by my bakery for my bread. I'm sure I'm the busiest around here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_05_05.text:
My atelier also works with magical Rings.
Needless to say, my books are always full.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_05_06.text:
You know nothing about farming, do you?
If you did, you'd know how big a deal my orchard is!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_06_01.text:
No fantasy town is complete without a blacksmith.
Isn't it obvious? I'm the most popular person in Hero Town!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_06_02.text:
No, it's not obvious! My bakery opens 24/7!
My wares are always literally piping hot!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_06_03.text:
Have you ever seen a Hero without a Special Skill?
Without my presence, no one would be able to fight properly!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_06_04.text:
No, no, no. My berry trees are the best in the continent, and you know it.
That's why {PLAYER_NAME} personally provides me with workers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_07_01.text:
Lednas! Tell them!
You know that I'm the most necessary person in Hero Town!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_08_01.text:
Isn't it reasonable to say that Heroes are the most important in 
Hero' Town? We did maintain and defend the town for all these years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_09_02.text: No, my bakery is the best!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_10_01.text: BE QUIET, EVERYONE! Hear me out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_11_01.text: Everyone's claiming that they're the most needed person in Hero Town...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_11_02.text:
Let's not fight.
Why don't we hold a popularity contest instead?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_11_04.text:
Yes! We'll have Heroes vote
for their favorite townsperson in a special poll!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_11_05.text:
I'll make all the necessary preparations!
Everyone's okay with the new arrangements, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_12_01.text:
Hmm... That seems like a good plan.
It sounds fair enough, at least.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_12_02.text:
I have no complaints as well!
I'm sure I'll win!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_12_03.text:
Sigh... People, I'm sorry in advance
that I'll have to SLAY all of you with my fabulous Berries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_12_04.text:
As a noble knight of the Empire,
I will not refuse a battle when it finds me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_12_05.text: Huh? What about you, Bridget? Won't you be participating?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_12_06.text:
Oh, I could never compete with you.
I'll be too busy regulating the event, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_1_12_07.text:
I think we're done for today.
See you tomorrow at the town square, everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_1_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}!
Have you come to cast your vote?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_2_01.text: Haha, have you had a look around? Not too bad, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_2_02.text:
Hee hee, what do you think of my new suit?
A special event calls for the proper outfit!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_2_03.text:
Sigh... I'm worried that everyone seems to on edge
with the competition, though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_2_04.text:
They're doing everything they can
to win votes from Hero Captains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_2_05.text: Soooo... Who're you going to vote for, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_3_01.text:
It's a secret?
Haha, I didn't expect you to tell me anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_3_02.text:
Then have fun at the Captain's Choice Polls!
Oh, and let me give you a piece of advice...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_3_03.text: Everything isn't as it seems♪ Enjoy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_4_01.text:
Hey there, nya! {PLAYER_NAME}!
Over here, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_5_01.text: Did you come after hearing the news, nya?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_5_02.text:
As expected of you, {PLAYER_NAME}!
You sure know where the money is, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_5_03.text:
Go in, go in, nya! Things are just starting up inside there.
You still have time to enter the ring, nya.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_6_01.text: Look at those Fergus Tokens go! I knew I made the right decision!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_6_02.text:
Tsk, tsk... You should have made your exit when you had your chance.
That Fergus is rumored to have broken his hammer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_6_03.text:
I hear Chocolat is developing a new line of desserts for the season!
She has my vote!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_6_04.text:
You know nothing. The power of magic never changes!
Celine's Atelier is the safest bet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_STOCK_START_2_6_05.text:
Hello, people? What don't you understand about 'magical berries'?
Berries that are magic, for Goddess's sake!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0038_1.text:
Osiris berkata itu adalah penjaga,
tapi bagiku tampak seperti bola

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0038_2.text:
Kita harus terus waspada.
Benda itu bisa saja menyerang kita !

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0039_1.text:
Aku pikir kita telah mengalahkannya
Kurasa tidak, dia berubah menjadi bentuk lain !

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0039_2.text:
Sekarang berubah menjadi Kalajengking… Uh..
Kalajengking biasa menyerang dengan ekornya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0039_3.text:
Dia tidak seperti Kalajengking biasa. 
Berhati-hatilah akan ekornya {PLAYER_NAME}

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0040_1.text:
Argghh.. Dia berubah bentuk setiap kali kita
mengalahkannya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0040_2.text: Sekarang dia seperti golem. Cukup nostalgia bukan ?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0040_3.text:
Kita mungkin memiliki pengalaman menghadapi golem,
tapi lengan itu sepertinya cukup berbahaya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0040_4.text: Kita harus berhati-hati terhadap lengannya itu

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0041_1.text:
Apa itu? Bagaimana bisa itu muncul tiba-tiba? Tampilannya
tidak seperti bola yang kita lawan sebelumnya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0041_3.text:
Uh, ini membuat kepalaku sakit
Mari kita kalahkan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0067_0001.text:
That thing... isn't alive at all.
It seems to be made of ice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0067_0002.text:
Well, standing here will do us no good.
If we wish to find out what it is, we must fight it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0068_0001.text: It may seem leaner than our previous foe, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0068_0002.text: It would do well to be careful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0069_0001.text:
Now there stands a true warrior,
trained to the utmost of one's capabilities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0069_0002.text:
In fact, that hammer looks heavy
even for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0069_0003.text:
Haha, the strength of the Nosgardians of old
were truly a force to be reckoned with.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0069_0004.text: This will be a good fight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0070_0002.text: I now see why my blows did not land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0070_0003.text:
Having no physical body
is rather cowardly, don't you think?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0070_0004.text:
But now, with the Guardians
having regained their true powers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_QUEST_Q0070_0005.text:
We should be able to cut the bond
between the true being and its Incarnate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_071_END_001.text:
Nya... All of them were so mean, nya!
Hitting us and roaring at us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_071_END_002.text:
I don't think any of them
are Toto's family, nya...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_071_END_005.text:
...Did Toto just say that 
Toto's only family is Popo, nya?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_071_END_006.text:
Uwah~ Toto~!
I'm moved to tears, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_071_START_001.text:
Nya?! {PLAYER_NAME}!!
Do you see that, nya?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_071_START_002.text: There are lots of Totos, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_071_START_004.text:
Maybe Toto's real family
can be found there, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_071_START_006.text:
Help me find
Toto's family, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_072_END_001.text:
... When the phantoms fell,
their memories came flooding to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_072_END_002.text:
My ancestors of the Valley...
They committed a great evil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_072_START_002.text:
Long ago, the Frost Elves and the Wolf Tribe
formed an alliance and became a single tribe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_072_START_003.text:
But there were some Frost Elves who stayed in the Valley
and kept their bloodline intact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_072_START_004.text:
... And I'm the living proof
of that bloodline, as you can see!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_072_START_005.text:
No one knows, though, why the Frost Elves
became divided like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_073_END_001.text:
You must be strong
to defeat the lieutenant like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_073_END_002.text:
... Do you have an empty spot
in your camp, by any chance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_073_END_003.text:
I'll probably be sent to snow military prison
if I stay here any longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_073_END_004.text: Could you please take me with you? Hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_073_START_001.text:
... What, first time seeing a talking snowman?
Get on your way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_073_START_002.text:
... Oh, wait. Are you the humans
that I should be blocking?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_073_START_004.text:
Ugh, I can't be bothered.
We could just agree to pretend we didn't seen each other.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_073_START_005.text:
...!!! W-wait... Lieutenant?!
The Lieutenant's coming our way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_074_END_001.text:
... I changed my mind
along the way, Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_074_END_002.text:
Even if I return to the army, they'll probably
make me clean up snow for the rest of my life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_074_END_003.text:
This - blasted - never-ending -
snow... snow... snow...!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_074_END_004.text:
Since things have turned out like this,
please let me follow you, Captain {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_074_END_005.text:
The army? They'll probably sign me off
as AWOL, Captain! Hahaha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_074_START_001.text:
Look down, look down...
You're here until you die...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_074_START_002.text:
Look down, look dow- huh?
P-people!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_074_START_003.text:
Sob... I've been shoveling snow for hours
away from the rest of my troop...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_074_START_004.text:
And when I finally looked up from my task,
there were snow monsters all around me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_074_START_005.text:
And now I'm SAVED, Captain!
I'm a Neth Snow Removal Crew member.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_074_START_006.text:
Could you...
Could you take me along with you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_074_START_007.text: You won't be sorry with your decision, Captain!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_075_END_001.text:
...The Wolf Tribe had a tradition of
collecting and cremating the bodies of their warriors,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_075_END_002.text:
while the Frost Elves practiced sky burials
to allow the dead to return to nature.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_075_END_003.text: They may be invisible to our eyes, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_075_END_004.text:
They say the souls of the Wolf Tribe
are present all around us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_075_END_005.text:
... That just gave me the creeps.
Maybe I shouldn't have asked in the first place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_075_START_001.text:
Hmm... You know,
I'm still curious about some stuff.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_075_START_002.text:
Why are only Frost Elves roaming around as phantoms?
Where did the Wolf Tribe go?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_075_START_003.text:
There should be an interesting story
behind all this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_076_END_002.text: I hope it won't appear again...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_076_START_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
Look at the fangs of that wolf! Brr.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_076_START_002.text:
It's even more scary
than Loki Incarnate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_076_START_003.text:
It's not? Of course it is!
Loki Incarnate has legs and arms, and talk like a human.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_076_START_004.text:
Yikes,
have I ever told you I'm kind of scared of dogs?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_076_START_005.text:
All that barking and biting...
And the worst is that you can't talk to them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_077_END_002.text:
Let's get out of here quickly
before it decides to come back alive!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_077_START_002.text:
Brought back to life?
That's what Lakias said?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_077_START_003.text:
Erm, it seems a little angrier
than before...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_077_START_004.text:
It's started growling.
Okay, I can't deal with this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_077_START_005.text:
{PLAYER_NAME},
I'll leave it to you... Good luck...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_078_END_001.text: Hee hee, is that your best?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_078_END_002.text:
If you want to catch me,
you'll have to bring out your biggest weapons!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_078_START_001.text:
Victory in battle
is the greatest glory that a warrior can achieve.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_078_START_002.text:
We, the Einherjar,
have always been the very best of Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_078_START_003.text:
... So I can understand
why they're trying so hard to kill us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_078_START_004.text:
It will be great honor to catch the fugitives
who have been named as enemies of the kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_078_START_005.text:
Dammit, if only I could
capture myself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_079_END_001.text: Hrrmph. Not even worth my time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_079_END_002.text:
And they call themselves
the greatest warriors in Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_079_START_001.text:
Hmm... It's a pity I wasn't in the Capital.
I could have stopped the rebellion then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_079_START_002.text:
Those warmongers,
traitors who conspired with Odin...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_079_START_003.text:
I'll have to deal with them,
just like I dealt with that poacher Frost Elf.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_080_END_001.text: Whew. They're all cleanly broken, all right.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_080_END_002.text:
The truth is that I designed all those ballistas.
Not bad, eh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_080_END_003.text:
I even received an award from
Captain Freyja herself! Captain Freyja!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_080_END_004.text:
But... The Captain's gone missing now,
and the whole troupe's been brainwashed by that Odin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_080_END_005.text:
I'd rather destroy all my weapons
than follow that tyrant!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_080_END_006.text:
So, {PLAYER_NAME}.
You need any skilled technicians in your party?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_080_END_007.text:
I don't think it's a mere coincidence that we've met.
Let me join you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_080_START_001.text:
Oh no... What to do, what to do...!
I wish someone would help me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_080_START_002.text:
Huh? W-wait! You there!
You're the fugitives, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_080_START_003.text:
Ack! Could you please take that sword out of my face?
I'm not trying to fight you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_080_START_004.text: ... Are you thinking of escaping through this route?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_080_START_005.text:
If so, then...
Will you do me a small favor?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_080_START_006.text:
If you see any ballistas on your way,
please destroy them! Every last one!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_080_START_007.text:
They should be stationed along this path.
Thank you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_081_END_001.text: What! I knew it! That's my gun!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_081_END_002.text:
I thought some guns were missing from my workshop!
What's your business with me, you creep?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_081_END_003.text:
Gimme an explanation right now,
or I shoot you here and now! No warning shots!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_081_END_005.text:
I'm just an ordinary poacher
who escaped from prison...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_081_END_007.text:
Grr... That bastard,
making me take the blame for his crimes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_081_END_008.text:
Okay, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Let's drag him away just as he is!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_081_END_009.text:
I can't wait to see the look on Wolfgang's face
when he sees the real criminal. Hee hee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_081_START_001.text:
Hey, you there~
Yeah, you there passing by~

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_081_START_002.text:
Can you help me out
by any chance? Heh heh.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_081_START_003.text:
Think I lost my way,
thanks to that blasted blizzard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_081_START_004.text:
Take me back to my town,
and I'll serve you some good venison jerky as thanks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_081_START_005.text:
Hmm? That gun that man's carrying...
It looks strangely familiar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_082_END_001.text:
I knew it!
I thought I recognized a good machine when I saw one!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_082_END_002.text:
This is a superb model,
oozing with the genius and effort of a great designer!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_082_END_003.text: Just looking at it is so inspiring!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_082_END_004.text:
Let me see now. So this part's like that...
Huh, I see that part is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_082_START_001.text:
Oho, a ballista that requires manual action!
Now that's what I call classic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_082_START_002.text:
Maybe I can get some ideas
for my newest project?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_082_START_004.text: Leave me one ballista for me, will you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_083_END_002.text:
I did not expect
a stone statue to mov... Hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_083_END_003.text:
A piece of paper amidst the fragments...
Something is written on it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_083_END_005.text:
"... thy help that we could defeat
the accursed Gunnar..."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_083_END_006.text:
"Come bearing this letter,
and thou shalt be greatly rewarded."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_083_END_008.text:
Hmm. So the reason for
the Valkyrie's exile...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_083_END_009.text: ... was her failure to remain impartial in war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_083_START_001.text:
Seeing these statues
remind me of an old tale I heard as a child, once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_083_START_002.text:
Long ago, two lords divided up the northern kingdom
and waged a war against each other.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_083_START_003.text:
The war continued for long years until it was put to an end
by the hands of a Valkyrie, sent by the king...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_083_START_004.text:
Yet for some unknown reason, the king dishonorably
dismissed the Valkyrie and expelled her from his court.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_083_START_005.text:
The banished warrior wept for endless days and nights
until she gradually turned into stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_083_START_006.text: The fate of the two lords, you ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_083_START_007.text:
I confess I do not know...
The stories I know end there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_084_END_002.text: This... This is the rune of 'Svefnthorn.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_084_END_003.text:
All pierced by it
shall fall into eternal sleep.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_084_END_004.text:
Perhaps, as in the stories of old,
the Valkyrie statues were humans, once?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_084_END_006.text:
Were the statues created in the likeness of the warriors,
or were the warriors turned into stone themselves, I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_084_START_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. This symbol
that fell from the broken statue...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_084_START_002.text:
It seems to be a rune.
I cannot decipher it, however, broken as it is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_084_START_003.text:
If you ever find the whole piece,
could you give it to me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_084_START_004.text:
In its intact form I should be able to
discern its usage and abilities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_085_END_002.text:
Yet I read in the records that
you wielded your blade at an angle of 15 degrees.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_085_END_003.text:
Just now, however, you swung it at an angle of 23 degrees.
Is it a new variation of your legendary 'Cool Captain Swordsmanship?'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_085_END_004.text: ... What? You know of no such thing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_085_START_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, welcome.
Is it our first meeting since the formation of the alliance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_085_START_002.text:
I will take advantage of this moment to make a confession.
I have long wished for a duel with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_085_START_003.text:
In the Royal Library remain some ancient records of 
a certain Hero Captain who fought and defeated 'Steamers'.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_085_START_004.text:
The warriors of our generation trained as they listened to 
old tales of that Hero Captain's feats of valor. Hahaha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_085_START_005.text:
... Thank you for protecting our lands once more,
long ago and now - beyond the boundaries of time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_086_END_002.text: ... Daddy once told me a story.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_086_END_003.text:
All storms will end
and the sun will always come up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_086_END_004.text: Daddy wouldn't want me to give up nor be sad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_086_END_005.text:
So I'm going to keep going
for Daddy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_087_END_001.text:
Thanks, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Thjalfi can finally rest now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_087_START_002.text:
I stopped by,
as you asked me to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_087_START_003.text:
I heard that you found
what seems to be my brother's body?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_087_START_005.text: You know, I always hated Thjalfi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_087_START_006.text:
He was always bragging
just because he was a little faster than me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_087_START_007.text:
On the day I became a mercenary 
and joined Heim on that trip, he didn't even say goodbye.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_087_START_008.text:
But... That doesn't mean
I can bear to see him dishonored like that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_087_START_009.text: I want to ask you a favor, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_087_START_010.text: Please help me save my brother. Please.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_088_END_005.text: Erm, he seems to be following us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_088_END_006.text:
Perhaps he was trying to say that
he wishes to accompany us...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_088_START_005.text:
... Does anyone understand
what that man is saying?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_089_END_001.text:
Your task is over now.
May you rest in peace, friend.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_089_START_001.text:
Elder Edda... Even in my time, it was a ruin of a city.
Now only the barest relics remain...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_089_START_002.text:
I have always wondered what was happening outside
the Sanctuary. I hadn't thought it would be so desolate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_089_START_003.text:
Huh, that moving figure...
Is that a Sentry of the Sanctuary?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_089_START_004.text:
... I wonder if it's been guarding this place
the past centuries, as we have been.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_089_START_005.text:
Golems do not have feelings,
but I feel for its sake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_089_START_006.text: I want to help put it to rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_090_END_001.text:
So the one we thought to be Freyja...
She was the true enemy in disguise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_090_END_003.text:
The heavens will mourn
a great warrior's passing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_090_START_001.text:
Freyja... I do not understand it,
but she has changed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_090_START_002.text:
She may be one of the greatest rune magicians
even amongst the heirs of Vana, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_090_START_003.text:
I know she has always preferred hitting her enemies
overhead with her staff in battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_090_START_004.text:
Magic is too wishy-washy for my tastes,
is what she used to tell me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_090_START_005.text:
But the Freyja that stands before us
is... quieter than usual.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_090_START_006.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
Can you see if something is bothering her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_091_END_003.text: When you come back, some day...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_091_END_004.text:
We'll leave your place empty
so that you can lead us as our captain once more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_091_START_002.text:
She led us in every battle,
encouraging us from the vanguard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_091_START_003.text:
She was what you could call
a true hero, straight out of a legend.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_091_START_004.text:
She can't be dead.
It's a lie... I know that evil villain was lying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_091_START_005.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, please.
Help me find Captain Freyja.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_092_END_001.text:
This... seems to be
Gullveig's doing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_092_END_002.text:
In order to flee, she must have filled Skrymir's mind
with a terrible illusion...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_092_END_003.text:
An illusion that we slaughtered Loki,
at the end of everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_092_END_004.text:
And as Loki has fallen into slumber
and cannot prove otherwise...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_092_END_005.text: It has become a difficult situation for us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_092_START_001.text:
How odd.
I sense someone's fury nearby...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_092_START_002.text:
... even when the Master of Utgard
has returned to nature.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_092_START_003.text:
We must go
and look into the matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_093_END_001.text:
So those soldiers
have been brainwashed by Gullveig.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_093_END_002.text:
I still can't believe the captain of the Night Ravens
has been reduced to such a dishonorable state.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_093_END_003.text:
Her skills haven't gone anywhere, though,
so it'll be difficult to catch her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_093_END_004.text:
Sigh... At least we got to see
the statue of the great 'Reginleif'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_093_END_005.text:
She's a legendary Valkyrie
said to guide the truest warriors on their paths.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_093_END_006.text:
The statue almost seemed to move - 
it was so lifelike and stately, wasn't it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_093_START_001.text:
Hmm? Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}.
What brings you here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_093_START_002.text:
I'm looking around
the Hall of Fame.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_093_START_003.text:
I like looking for the perfect place to put my statue 
when I have time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_093_START_005.text:
I know all the Einherjar camps
and training grounds by heart,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_093_START_006.text:
and to my knowledge,
there shouldn't be one around this area.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_093_START_007.text: Did they reorganize the troops that quickly?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_094_END_001.text:
I thought that we had finally
captured her this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_094_END_002.text: Who would have known it was merely an illusion?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_094_END_003.text:
So Gullveig... She has fled,
with no clue as to her whereabouts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_094_START_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
We received a report from the scouts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_094_START_002.text:
The dead are starting to rise again
in Elder Edda.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_094_START_003.text: It is Gullveig's doing, I fear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_094_START_004.text:
Committing such atrocities,
to the very end...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_094_START_005.text:
How can a follower of light
do such things?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_094_START_006.text:
We have no other choice
but to put them back to their eternal rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_095_END_01.text:
H-hrrmph. I guess it wasn't as weak as I'd expected.
It's not so bad for a human invention.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_095_END_02.text:
But it's still not worth our bother.
From now on, let's be careful not to run into it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_095_END_04.text:
Eek! D-don't move so suddenly like that, {PLAYER_NAME}!
You sca- I mean, surprised me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_095_START_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. We can't embarrass ourselves
by letting an unfinished robot tie us up, can we?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_095_START_02.text: Let's not waste any time and wheeze on by!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_095_START_03.text: I'll lead the way, so follow me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_096_END_03.text:
Making US work for all HER big words...
She's going to be sorry, just wait!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_096_START_01.text: Ugh... That one has all its limbs intact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_096_START_02.text:
That means it's probably stronger than the one
we fought just now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_096_START_03.text:
Lead the way, {PLAYER_NAME}.
You can specially be my vanguard knight this time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_097_END_01.text: Loviatar... Yes, I think I've heard of her when I was little.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_097_END_02.text:
She was the first human to master Earth Magic...
A genius by both past and present standards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_097_END_03.text:
But she's still a human...How can she still be alive,
and looking so young, no less?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_097_START_02.text:
Do you see that mushroom over there? It's grown to that size
due to the overflowing mana it couldn't - and still can't - contain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_097_START_03.text:
We may not know who's trapped in that Battleloid,
but whoever they are, they're a great mage of considerable strength.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_097_START_04.text:
Unlike the former Battleloids we faced,
that one will prove to be difficult to deal with.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_098_END_02.text:
Goddesses who refused to fight in the Apostle War
and banished themselves to the southern continent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_098_END_03.text:
If what you said is true, {PLAYER_NAME},
and Cora chose them to carry out her will,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_098_END_04.text:
I'll chase her to the ends of the earth
and ask her myself what this is all about!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_098_START_01.text:
Nemesis...
The sight of that face brings no fond memories to mind, I can tell you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_098_START_02.text:
The Apostle who controlled that machine body
should have wholly integrated with Goddess Dionne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_098_START_03.text:
And yet even his mere husk retains an obsession
that knows no boundaries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_098_START_04.text: It's creepy. Talk about a desperate stalker...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_099_END_05.text: We need more modules. The more the better!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_099_END_07.text: Let's go and get our hands on more modules!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_099_START_01.text: {PLAYER_NAME}! I have a favor to ask you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_099_START_02.text: It doesn't seem Master Loviatar will be waking up any time soon, so...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_099_START_03.text:
I've been researching on my own.
And I've made an interesting discovery!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_099_START_04.text:
All Battleloids have a particular module
installed at their core.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_099_START_05.text:
According to my research, all modules were found to contain
mana essence belonging to Master Loviatar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_099_START_06.text: It seems Battleloids require this mana in order to function!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_099_START_07.text:
That's why Master Loviatar's not waking up - 
she lost too much mana to the module manufacturing process!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_099_START_09.text:
If you could defeat the Battleloids and bring back their modules,
it would be great help!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_100_END_01.text: I don't think this is the place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_100_END_02.text:
I'm sorry...
My memories are all mixed up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_100_END_03.text: Could you help me just one more time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_100_START_02.text:
A-are you a police officer?
Could you help me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_100_START_04.text:
I volunteered for an experiment at Rapture Science...
I needed the money.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_100_START_05.text:
I never expected to be converted into a... a robot
and forced to fight on the battlefield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_100_START_06.text:
I can't remember who I am,
what my siblings looked like...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_101_END_01.text:
Thank you!
It's nothing much, but here's payment for your troubles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_101_END_02.text:
Looks like I'm only a few minutes away from being late.
Well then, I'm off!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_101_END_03.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
Why did you help her return to her troop?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_101_END_05.text:
Huh?
You felt sorry for her because she ruined her vacation?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_101_START_01.text:
This can't be real.
I just got out on vacation today... And a war breaks out?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_101_START_03.text:
But the war has broken out in the middle of the city!
How will I return?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_101_START_04.text:
I'll be marked AWOL if I don't return today?
What! First Sergeant? First Sergeant??

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_101_START_05.text:
Sigh... Crap, now what do I do?
Huh? What are you looking at?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_102_END_01.text:
... I just discovered that my home was bombed
while I was talking to the real estate agent...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_102_END_02.text: Excuse me, do you have any free space in your camp?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_102_START_01.text:
Sigh... I won't deal with this any longer!
Edenberg is becoming a dangerous place to live.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_102_START_02.text:
It's only been a few years since the war ended and the city
was rebuilt. It's too soon for any of this mess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_102_START_03.text:
That's it. I'll sell my house, move to Grancia,
and build a new home in the countryside somewhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_102_START_04.text:
Excuse me,
could you please take me to the nearest real estate agency?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_103_END_01.text:
Thank you
for getting me that language module.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_103_END_02.text:
What? Am I waiting for my owner, you ask?
No, I have never registered a user.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_103_END_03.text:
I was simply sunbathing.
My power system runs on solar energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_103_END_04.text:
A whole day's worth of charging
lets me move for only 3 hours, though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_103_END_05.text:
If it's not too much trouble,
could you take me and charge me to full?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_104_END_01.text:
Can I ask you something, {PLAYER_NAME}?
Why did you beat up that soldier?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_104_END_02.text: Wasn't he also on vacation, like the soldier we met before?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_104_END_03.text:
Reserve Forces should be treated differently from actual soldiers?
But aren't they all soldiers? They were wearing the same uniform.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_104_START_01.text:
Excuse me,
could you tell me what in the name of the Goddess is happening?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_104_START_02.text:
I just finished my Reserve Forces training session...
And everyone on the streets seems hysterical.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_104_START_04.text:
ANOTHER civil war? Yeah, right.
I'm sure Commander Yuria's mistaken again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_104_START_05.text:
Hrrmph. If only Commander Dike was alive...
Things were better back then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_104_START_06.text: Guess you can't have everything in life. Well, I'm going home!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_105_END_03.text:
That was... me there.
With my siblings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_105_END_04.text:
But... How? Why?
... Who am I?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_105_START_01.text: I think my memories are coming back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_105_START_02.text:
This street... A few blocks from the police office,
and we should reach home!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_105_START_03.text: Let's hurry! My siblings are waiting for me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_106_END_01.text:
I'M SO ANGRY! That piece of steel has better upgrades...
and much more advanced weapons than me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_106_END_03.text: That's it, I'm going in to claim what's rightfully mine!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_106_END_04.text:
Thanks back there, {PLAYER_NAME}.
See you around!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_106_END_06.text:
Whenever I see her, she is angry at me.
For a long time, her rage was all I knew of her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_106_END_07.text: I am happy to have discovered another side to her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_106_END_08.text:
The next time she comes to visit you, {PLAYER_NAME},
I will hide and watch from afar again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_106_START_02.text:
Ack, stop surprising me like that!
Why are you so shocked to see me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_106_START_04.text:
Doctor Gunther... He told me he was asking all those questions
for an MBTI test! That liar!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_106_START_05.text:
Hey, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Help me destroy that imposter!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_107_END_01.text: Sigh... This is tiring. I want to get out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_107_END_02.text:
I got hit with more lasers than I need in a lifetime... sob...
Goddess Bella... Please calm down...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_107_START_01.text:
Grr... I hate this place!
What does it have against me?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_107_START_03.text:
If you use your Goddess powers,
we all won't be escaping from this place alive...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_107_START_04.text:
And what's with your tone?
Are you two making fun of me?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_107_START_05.text:
No - you really do need to calm down!
Or we're going to get hit with lasers again - oh, too late!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_108_END_01.text:
Did you see how they had
an indoor roller rink?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_108_END_02.text: This company has some great perks!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_108_START_02.text:
The unarmed scientists...
They were roller skating in a strangely familiar position. Did you notice?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_108_START_03.text:
But why were they doing it indoors?
Does it help with their research?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_109_END_01.text:
My... My experiment that took three years in the planning...
My equipment... My thesis...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_109_END_02.text:
You - you monster!!
What am I going to do now?! Do something!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_109_START_01.text:
Oh, are you the volunteer?
I've been waiting for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_109_START_02.text:
You're not? But you have to be!
I'm already running late... Any later and I'll have to pay an extra fee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_109_START_03.text:
It doesn't really matter whether you're the volunteer or not.
Please help me... I'm out on a limb here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_109_START_05.text: It's a very simple experiment, so you don't have to be nervous.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_109_START_06.text:
You only need to see if our laboratory's
latest optical camouflage generator works properly on normal people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_109_START_07.text:
If you can't see anything, that's normal! Check how much
you can't see when you think you should be seeing something!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_109_START_08.text:
After the experiment, please fill out this survey before you leave!
Thank you so much!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_110_END_01.text:
When I moved to stop you from leaving,
{PLAYER_NAME}...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_110_END_02.text:
I discovered that I could move much faster
than my initial speed limit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_110_END_03.text: I understand now. This is the secret behind R and V's strength.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_110_END_05.text:
An android that feels embarrassment.
This is interesting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_110_START_02.text:
Thank you for the emotion module.
It has successfully been integrated into my core system.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_110_START_03.text: There is one last thing I wish to confer with you, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_110_START_04.text: Do you see that android guarding the Conference Room?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_110_START_05.text:
After installing the emotion module,
my power circuit repeatedly malfunctions whenever I see her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_110_START_06.text: What do you think this means?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_110_START_07.text:
I must... go and talk to her?
I - Please stop. I am unprepared...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_111_END_02.text:
So, you defeated Pandemonium...
This is... unexpected! Not bad for an uncivilized brute!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_111_END_03.text:
I will reward you
with the glory of receiving the world's greatest genius - me - as a Hero.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_111_END_04.text:
You don't want to? You must.
It is your... destiny as decreed by fate herself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_111_START_01.text:
I have come. Doctor Gunther - the greatest genius in history -
the scientist who threatens the Goddess from her place!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_111_START_02.text: What's with that expression? Why are you laughing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_111_START_03.text:
I seem different from the last time you saw me?
Kee kee kee... You have it all wrong...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_111_START_04.text:
Sigh... Trivial is the mind of the sparrow
that cannot understand the dragon's will...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_111_START_05.text:
What you saw was merely an act to obtain funding for my research.
Such skilled camouflage is nothing to a true genius!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_111_START_06.text:
I deigned to come all the way here
so that you may have a chance to surrender.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_111_START_07.text:
Before my ultimate masterpiece, Pandemonium,
you will burn in brine and hellfire...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_111_START_08.text:
Surrender is the only way you will preserve your insignificant lives!
Cower in fear and bow down before me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_111_START_10.text:
I show you mercy and this is how you repay me?
With... belittling smirks?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_111_START_11.text: Then there's no helping it. Off with your head!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_112_END_01.text:
I felt like rhythmically pressing a button
throughout the entire battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_112_END_02.text:
Maybe I've been overworking myself
these past few months.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_112_END_03.text: After all this is over, I'm taking a long break.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_112_START_02.text:
I've never seen her before,
but she see seems oddly familiar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_112_START_03.text:
I had the same feeling
when I first met other androids such as R-0 and V.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_113_END_01.text:
I looked into it, and there were many rumors
surrounding Patrick Ludovico's retirement.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_113_END_02.text:
The most convincing one is that 
he argued with Levine over the treatment of their test subjects.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_113_END_03.text:
He allegedly earned what he wanted
by handing over his position of Director to his granddaughter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_113_END_04.text:
And yet, Patrick goes second to none in his complete lack of humanity.
He is infamous for having conducted some of the vilest experiments

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_113_END_05.text:
in the history of this Empire.
Do you think he had a change of heart in his final years?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_113_START_01.text:
Loviatar... mentioned the name 'Ludovico'
when you rescued her from Rapture Science?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_113_START_02.text:
Mm... The Ludovico she spoke of
should be the former Director of Road Industry:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_113_START_03.text:
Patrick Ludovico.
He is also Levine Ludovico's grandfather.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_113_START_04.text:
Which is rather strange. Why would Ludovico's test subject
be found locked in the laboratories of Rapture Science?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_113_START_05.text:
It puzzles me...
I will look into the matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_114_END_01.text:
Everyone of the Kindred was very kind to me.
I suspect it is because of my face design.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_114_END_02.text:
To use the terminology
of human family structures...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_114_END_03.text: I have a lot of new uncles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_114_START_01.text:
My creator, Benjamin...
It is strange to think that he too is another being's creation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_114_START_03.text: I wish to speak to them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_115_END_03.text:
The 'alien' I'd been chasing was just an extremely muscular man.
Another failure, tsk.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_115_END_04.text:
However, I think I see the makings of a future alien hunter in you.
Won't you come hunt extraterrestrial creatures with me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_115_START_01.text:
Hey, you there!
Hmm, you don't look as if you've flown in like I did...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_115_START_02.text: How did you get aboard this spaceship?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_115_START_03.text:
What? This isn't a spaceship?
You're lying!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_115_START_04.text:
I saw an alien with tubes coming out of its back
only a few moments ago!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_115_START_05.text: Oh, look! He's going through that passageway!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_116_END_01.text:
Sigh...
He calls it 'fashion.' Simply looking at him makes my skin crawl.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_116_END_02.text:
Have I been away from home too long?
Everything has become so strange.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_116_START_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
The clones of Heaven are all created from the same gene.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_116_START_02.text:
Besides the few anomalies such as myself,
all clones share the same appearance, personality, and skills.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_116_START_03.text:
Some units are purposefully altered through experiments,
but most 'impurities' are filtered at the genetic level.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_116_START_04.text:
And then you have clones like that one standing over there. You can see
all the impurities oozing from every synthetic pore of his body...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_116_START_05.text:
I hate to admit it, but...
He may be... the same 'type' as I am.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_116_START_06.text:
Help me see if he really is.
We'll do a proper inspection and, if necessary, maintenance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_117_END_02.text:
... I'm figuratively back to where I started, though,
now that my employers fled and I'm out of work.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_117_END_04.text: Are you in need of a spy, by any chance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_117_START_01.text:
Thank the Goddess! A proper human being at last!
Please help me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_117_START_02.text:
Ugh... I've been seeing the same face for hours now...
I thought I was going insane.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_117_START_03.text:
I didn't know the Rapture Science Fourth Laboratory
conducted cloning experiments!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_117_START_04.text:
What? This isn't the Laboratory?
What is this place, then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_118_END_01.text:
Oh, you're back!
Good. Let's see...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_118_END_02.text:
Hmm... 'Heaven Intranet?'
'General Forum'...? What is all this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_118_END_06.text: ... What is this? Are they talking about me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_118_END_07.text:
... Go and bring back everyone who commented on this forum.
I will rip apart every. Single. One of them with my bare hands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_118_START_01.text:
I've noticed that those clones of Heaven
keep touching that cardboard thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_118_START_02.text:
Why do they stare at it the whole day?
Do they find it fun?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_118_START_03.text: Let's get our hands on one and see for ourselves!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_119_END_01.text:
I can't believe it...
The Sacred Being of Wind really exists!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_119_END_02.text:
It's as you said before, about
Utgard Loki and the Seal of the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_119_END_03.text:
Could it be that all the legendary creatures and deities
of Hasla's native myths are actually still alive?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_119_START_01.text:
I'd never imagined to find myself in Heaven -
a place I thought existed only in old fairy tales!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_119_START_02.text:
In Master... I mean, Arart's archives, 
there are many records documenting legends surrounding Heaven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_119_START_03.text:
Let's go find out how much the real Heaven
matches those legends!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_120_END_02.text: I want nothing more in life...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_120_END_04.text:
I am not dying any time soon.
Stop staring at me with that worried expression on your face.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_120_START_01.text: That body, being controlled by Arart...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_120_START_02.text:
It is the physical incarnation that Mother used
when she needed to communicate with the lifeforms of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_120_START_03.text:
Those wings were once known as the incarnation of grace,
protector of the weak. Now it has become a weapon of destruction.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_120_START_04.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
You must stop that 'husk' as quickly as possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_120_START_05.text: I can't watch this any longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_121_END_01.text:
Ooh, 'Burning Earth and Bloody Roses'!
Now that I've seen it in person, I'm envious!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_121_END_02.text:
I know! I'll make a suggestion to Frantz
that he should also add something similar to AMK-001!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_121_START_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, did you hear the news?
PMK 20 was stolen by the rebel troops!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_121_START_02.text:
What? What do you mean, what's PMK 20?
I can't believe you don't know about the PMK series, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_121_START_03.text:
PMK is a popular series of robots
being secretly developed at Rapture Science!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_121_START_04.text:
It was the direct rival of Project A.M.K. of Road Industry,
which was terminated a few years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_121_START_05.text:
It's supposed to be 'confidential information,'
but anyone who's even remotely interested in robots has heard of it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_121_START_06.text:
I heard that the latest version is a transformable mobile weapon
that can be used in real battle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_121_START_07.text:
If you ever happen to meet one on the battlefield,
please tell me how strong it was!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_122_END_01.text:
The crimes of Rapture Science and Road Industry...
must be repented by all of the Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_122_START_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
We have discovered Levine Ludovico's whereabouts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_122_START_02.text:
She is hiding on the top floor
of the closed Research Hall of NMT.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_122_START_03.text:
She must be after the research data of the human experiments.
She will flee the country once she gets her hand on the database.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_122_START_04.text:
Ludovico... She sickens me. All those innocent lives lost,
and she only thinks of using them to the very end...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_122_START_05.text:
We must stop that at all costs.
Please hurry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_123_END_01.text:
I find myself in your debt again,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_123_END_02.text:
It seems Arart has hidden these fragments of power
all throughout the Neth Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_123_END_03.text:
Perhaps we should collect these fragments and take them to Mother.
They may help her regain her strength,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_123_END_04.text:
and separate herself from that child named Ellie sooner. 
... Hmm. It couldn't hurt to try.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_123_START_02.text:
One of Arart's followers had been hiding
a fragment of Mother's strength.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_123_START_03.text:
With it, he revived the 'husk'
you defeated last time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_123_START_04.text:
It's unbelievable how he insists on tormenting Mother like that,
when he and I essentially share the same brain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_124_END_01.text:
The other Magic Sword she mentioned that has
an ego, Balrog.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_124_END_02.text: I feel like I heard about it somewhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_124_END_03.text: …I think it's not just a feeling.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_124_START_02.text:
It's the same as the Apostles we faced before...
But I feel an even deeper dark energy than them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_124_START_03.text:
If you fall for it, you won't be just falling into
darkness, they might take away your existence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_124_START_04.text:
…You want to know what happens to those
who are consumed by that Magic Sword?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_124_START_05.text:
She has already become one with that
unknown being. You better give up trying to save her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_125_END_02.text:
I have a lot of questions.
Hmm... I've never interrogated a book.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_125_END_03.text: Huh? Whether I've interrogated other things?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_125_END_04.text:
...{PLAYER_NAME}.
I traveled to many places the past 3 years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_125_END_05.text:
Let's just say I experienced many things
in the process.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_125_START_02.text:
#Master Arart# must be the one that delivered the
Book of Magic to Hellad and the others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_125_START_03.text:
…Do you think she knew about the one who created
the Book of Magic and the Magic Sword?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_126_END_01.text: Maré… What in the world has she done out in the sea that Lasirenne was so afraid of her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_126_START_01.text:
According to Haerang and Maré, the one who broke
into the Sacred Ground looked like a mermaid…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_126_START_02.text:
Recently, I heard that the town of criminals near
the Deep Sea has completely disappeared.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_126_START_03.text: You think it's the same person as that criminal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_127_END_02.text:
If like Umrat says, if it's true that Kalard erased
the history of Hasla...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_127_END_03.text:
And if it is now our turn to be erased,
are we supposed to just accept it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_127_START_02.text:
I think trying to confirm that
is a forbidden act.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_128_END_02.text:
Interesting.
It's so black that it looks like there's a hole in the air.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_128_END_06.text:
W-what, that thing just now...
{PLAYER_NAME}, did you see... Huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_128_END_07.text:
Wait, are you playing with me?
…I didn't think you would be so mischievous.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_128_END_08.text:
Hmm. It looks like it's too dangerous to
touch with bare hands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_128_END_09.text: Maybe we should put it inside a book…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_128_START_02.text:
Ever since we left the Sacred Ground,
Umrat's condition hasn't been good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_128_START_04.text:
He said that every piece of the body that was scattered
since the battle that day contains part of his memories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_128_START_05.text:
…Please don't look at me like that.
I know it sounds ridiculous.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_128_START_06.text:
But... If we obtain that person's fragment,
what if we hand it over?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_129_END_01.text:
... Okay, I'll admit it: you're stronger than you look.
I'm kind of relieved that we didn't get into a proper fight before!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_129_END_02.text:
Sigh... This job as a bandit has no future
