with monsters like you roaming the mountains. Maybe it's time to quit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_129_END_03.text: You know what? This is all for the best.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_129_END_04.text:
Now I can finally go
and retry my luck on the high seas as a pirate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_129_END_05.text:
... Before I go, let me ask one last thing:
how do I get to the ocean?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_129_START_02.text:
You're out of luck!
I don't know what business brings you deep into the mountains...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_129_START_03.text: ... but you're in the territory of the fearsome bandit, #Bandit#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_129_START_04.text:
... Yeah, you heard right. My name is #Bandit# the bandit.
The first 'Bandit' is my name. The second 'bandit' is my title of sorts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_129_START_05.text:
You can tell that my parents
really wanted to me to become a bandit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_129_START_06.text:
I've dreamt all my life of becoming a #pirate#,
but it turned out that I'm prone to suffer from severe seasickness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_129_START_07.text:
I had to become a mountain bandit instead, just like my parents wanted.
Hmm... But why am I telling you all this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_130_END_01.text:
Well, that was the last one. We'd have had a better chance of finding him
had he revealed his whereabouts with flare signals.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_130_END_02.text:
I should give up and just enjoy the view, shouldn't I? 
Yes... Maybe I could think of this as an early holiday...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_130_END_03.text:
Say... As we were traveling together, I noticed
that you were leading a promising troop of heroes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_130_END_04.text:
If you need an attendant,
perhaps you could take me with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_130_END_05.text:
I'm thinking that it might be better to join your troops
than waste my life wandering around the country.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_131_END_01.text:
Whew... That felt good.
Better than I expected, in fact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_131_END_03.text:
You want to introduce someone
who shares my 'little problem'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_131_END_04.text:
You should know that your offer's more offensive than you realize,
but I'll let it pass as I know you mean well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_131_START_01.text: ... Why are you staring at me like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_131_START_02.text: What, never seen a bald person before?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_131_START_03.text: I'll teach you to pick a fight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_131_START_04.text: ... What? You were curious to see whether or not I was an Ethereal...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_131_START_05.text:
... I apologize for my former behavior.
Stress can change a man for the worse...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_131_START_06.text:
A certain woman told me that she could teach me an easy way to
acquire power, so I came to the capital with my fellow brothers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_131_START_07.text:
But those Ethereals! They refused to teach us on account of our being
bald and told us to return with a full head of hair.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_131_START_08.text:
My brother monks decided to grow out their hair,
but I - I can't! It's not a matter of choice for me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_131_START_09.text:
Whoever decided that long hair is everything?
I won't stand for it! I'll go back and teach them a lesson or two!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_132_END_01.text:
I give you my sincerest thanks, milady. The high and mighty
blow of your fists returned me to my senses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_132_END_02.text:
It is a strange matter indeed. The last thing I remember
is my home in the mountains, engulfed in terrible flames...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_132_END_03.text:
And now, I find myself here, of all places.
All is black in between.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_132_END_04.text:
Sigh... The neverending cycle of war,
the greed and hatred of humans...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_132_END_05.text:
Alas! The world is indeed a cruel place.
Shall peace ever be found in the vast lands of Hasla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_132_END_06.text:
Yet fortune smiles upon our meeting, even in these bleak times.
To seal this happy memory, perhaps the fair lady shall allow me to...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_132_END_07.text:
You may fool everyone else but not me, you thieving monkey!
I saw you eyeing our purses from the beginning!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_132_START_02.text: Eek ee? Oo ack ack! Eek oo ook!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_132_START_03.text:
Kyak kyak! Eek eek!
Oo ook eek eek!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_132_START_04.text:
Ew, what’s this monkey doing, following us around?
Get away from me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_133_END_01.text:
... Thank you.
Although I still wonder if I should have gotten that autograph…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_133_END_02.text:
I regret it more that we only managed to retrieve
the second edition of all the banners.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_133_END_03.text:
Why I don't ask to get it signed? As much as I treasure this banner,
it's hardly an item worth being handled by the Generals themselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_133_END_04.text:
I can see from your expression that you don't understand.
Let me explain how everything works, from the very beginning...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_133_END_05.text:
The Five Tiger Generals Official Fan Club has a long and rich history.
You see, when it was founded in the year of...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_133_START_01.text: How strange… I put it here just a moment ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_133_START_02.text:
I should have known better than to leave
such valuable treasure unattended and so tempt a no-good thief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_133_START_03.text:
Hmm? Who’s there?
Can it be… the return of the thief?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_133_START_04.text:
T-the Five Tiger Generals!
E-excuse me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_133_START_05.text:
Who are you to walk together with #the greatest heroes of Chen,#
#whose souls are loftier than the highest peaks of the kingdom,#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_133_START_06.text:
#whose virtue is deeper than the deepest seas to the east,#
#whose wisdom and beauty indeed render them a paragon over men...#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_133_START_07.text:
The Five Tiger Generals! I don't know where or how you came about
accompanying them, but I beg of you to help me recover my treasure!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_133_START_08.text:
Because... I-I need to get their autograph! Nobody's around to stop me -
this is a one-in-a-lifetime chance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_134_END_01.text: Okay... I had NOT known that the Palace was infested with monsters...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_134_END_02.text:
That certainly explains the lack of customers.
Huh, I should have realized sooner, in retrospect.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_134_END_03.text:
I... don’t think I want to cook here anymore.
There's no way I'm risking my life for my job.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_134_END_04.text: You there… Your name was {PLAYER_NAME}, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_134_END_05.text:
Aren’t you in need of a chef?
I’m the #Imperial Head Chef#, so I come with good references.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_134_END_06.text:
I’ll whip up some sesame chicken and egg rolls
as soon as we’re out of danger! Please take me with you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_134_START_01.text:
Sigh... No customers day in, day out...
Does no one need to eat around here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_134_START_02.text:
Ooh, welcome!
Have you come for a meal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_134_START_03.text:
So you're not a customer? Tsk...
Do you know what's going on around the Palace these days?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_134_START_04.text:
There's no one to be seen night or day, and nobody seems to mind
the lanterns remaining unlit in the nighttime...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_134_START_05.text:
The #Imperial Head Chef# of Chen
shouldn't have to waste their time like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_134_START_06.text:
Hmm? What do you mean,
you don't know what the #Imperial Head Chef# is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_134_START_07.text:
Have you been living under a rock? How can you NOT know me?
A taste of my dish, and you will change your idea of food forever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_134_START_08.text:
Follow me to the kitchen! I'm feeling generous today: I'll
introduce you to the world of gastronomical delights!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_135_END_02.text:
We managed to save the bear mountain saint
before it was too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_135_END_03.text: Hmm? What's that about my daughter?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_135_END_04.text:
Tsk, tsk. Haven't you seen Simcheong's muscles?
Mere bear claws can't hurt her, pft!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_135_END_05.text:
Anyway... Thank you for preventing unnecessary
bloodshed. Things could have been ugly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_135_START_01.text:
You there, passing by.
Help a blind old man and do your one good deed of the day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_135_START_02.text:
I'm looking for a girl the size of a bear.
What's that? You saw a real bear? Whew. Still safe...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_135_START_03.text:
The truth is... My daughter went for a swim in the lake
in the mountains behind our home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_135_START_04.text:
A while after she went out, some hikers told me that the
mountains' patron bear saint had gone rampant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_135_START_05.text:
If he ever comes across my daughter… I don't even
want to think about what would happen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_135_START_06.text:
Please help me.
Bring back my daughter before it's too late!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_136_END_01.text: Thank you. My white flowers will be happy as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_136_END_02.text: ... Now, then. I'll have a sip first...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_136_END_04.text:
The recent shifting of the ley lines... have changed the taste
of the water. I can't give this to my flowers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_136_END_05.text:
Then there's no helping it.
Plain old tap water it is for them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_136_END_06.text:
If they're thirsty enough, any water will be good enough for
them. That will teach them to complain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_136_END_07.text:
... Why are you looking at me like that?
Flowers need to grow up strong!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_136_START_01.text:
Hello, {PLAYER_NAME}. What brings you all the
way here, to the Eastern Kingdoms?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_136_START_02.text:
I have business to attend to regarding a certain
fountain deep in the mountains near the border.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_136_START_03.text:
The #white flowers# under my care
are very picky about the water they drink.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_136_START_04.text:
They say that the water of this fountain tastes the most similar
to the water from the Flower Fields of the Heavens.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_136_START_05.text:
I traveled a long way for my flowers...
But it seems all isn't well here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_136_START_06.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, could you accompany me
to the fountain?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_137_END_01.text:
There was no spy, was there?
I seem to have caused you unnecessary trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_137_END_02.text:
Come, I'll serve you a good Han-style meal; it is the least I can
do. There's a tteok shop that sells delicious gukbap...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_137_START_01.text:
Ah, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I have been looking for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_137_START_02.text:
Most of the riots around the kingdom borders 
have subsided after your arrival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_137_START_03.text:
However, there have been a few reports
of spies from Chen hiding deep in the mountains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_137_START_04.text:
I'm hoping that my soldiers have mistaken oddly-shaped
branches for the enemy, but I can't just ignore it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_137_START_05.text:
My soldiers will be no match against the mountain saints
who have yet to return to their senses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_137_START_06.text:
It would help me greatly if you could
look around the area.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_138_END_01.text:
... through it, one shall know the true will of one's sword, 
through the glint of its blade, one's inner darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_138_END_02.text:
That darkness is a contorted reflection that glares at one's
soul, a part of another self that could've been and will be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_138_END_03.text:
To slay the darkness of others,
one must first accept one's own darkness within.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_138_END_05.text:
... {PLAYER_NAME}. Your eyes have been closed for
quite some time now. Do not tell me you are asleep.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_138_START_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. I have heard of your numerous feats
within and outside our Kingdom of Han.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_138_START_02.text:
Inexcusable as it was, 
I wish to apologize for my behavior a few days ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_138_START_03.text:
I had not known that you would be the one who would save
not only Han, but all the Eastern Kingdoms.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_138_START_04.text:
That is why I wish to gift you with my most valued
possession, as a means of apology.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_138_START_05.text:
My secret technique, the #First Sword of Han#: the
Judgement of the #Black Shadow Tiger Sword#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_138_START_06.text:
You seem rather wary of my gift.
... I understand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_138_START_07.text:
You are unsure whether you possess the potential
to master such an elegant form of swordsmanship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_138_START_08.text:
Don't worry. The world may be wide, but there is no better
swordsman who can teach the art of the flying blade.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_138_START_09.text:
There is no need to refuse. Now, hold your stance.
I will teach you everything there is to know...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_139_END_01.text:
Hmm... It was as I thought. An otherwordly power was
rooted deep underground.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_139_END_02.text:
I shattered it with my 'Fourth Stance - Force of the Penetrating
Palm,' so your 'ley lines' will heal with time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_139_END_03.text:
I thank you for your help. I have decided to stay and train
further, so we must part ways here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_139_END_04.text:
When fate crosses our paths again...
Won't you spar with me then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_139_END_05.text:
It will help me to pass the time
until I find a new dragon to battle in this world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_139_START_01.text:
Oho, your ki is something to behold... Tidy, clean, yet
powerful… Have you trained in martial arts? No? Hmm...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_139_START_02.text:
Oh? Me?
I am Gae Nari of #Dragon Slaying Fists#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_139_START_03.text:
Fate has relinquished my original powers and carried me
from #Wulin# to this new dimension of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_139_START_04.text:
My appearance belies my years. I am much older than
I seem... A lifetime older, in fact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_139_START_05.text:
I have been searching for a land of pure and clean aura
that will help me regain my powers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_139_START_06.text:
These mountains seemed a fitting place to train, but recently,
I have been sensing disruptions to my energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_139_START_07.text: Do you know anything about this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_END_01.text: Panpan... We meet again, under rather unpleasant circumstances.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_END_02.text:
Why did you stop me?
I only did as I was told...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_END_03.text:
This was my opportunity to capture that rabbit
and obtain her liver!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_END_04.text:
... He Xiangu... Was it you
who sent that crazy bear my way?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_END_05.text:
T-that is a complete misunderstanding!
I never told you to eat Hanee Baram's liver!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_END_06.text:
I... just couldn't stand all that complaining and crying
outside my home - day in, day out...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_END_07.text:
So I thought, if I told you to obtain a rabbit's liver from the
lands of Han... you wouldn't bother me anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_END_10.text:
D-don't look at me like that! I must see myself off now;
I have some urgent business to attend to...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_END_11.text:
M-Master Ethereal! Where are you going?
Master Ethereal!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_START_01.text:
Excuse me, human!
I promise not to take too much of your time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_START_02.text: Perhaps you've seen a #rabbit mountain saint# around here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_START_03.text:
My child is ill.
He needs medicine made from rabbit liver.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_START_04.text:
What? Of course, ordinary rabbit liver won't do!
I had taken you for a much wiser human.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_START_05.text:
It is for the last heir of our clan.
He will have only the best of the best!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_START_06.text:
Anyway, I've been hunting in the Taebaek Mountains...
when I heard she escaped here to the lands of Chen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_START_07.text: If you see her, please alert me of her whereabouts at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_START_09.text: ... Eek! It's that persistent bear again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_140_START_10.text:
I-I found you at last, Rabbit Princess!
Give me your liver!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_141_END_01.text:
Oh, Elizabeth! Does it taste good? Do you like it?
I've never seen you eat so well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_141_END_02.text:
Hmm. Looks like this kiddo prefers meat
to bamboo shoots.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_141_END_03.text: A rather unexpected diet for a panda.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_141_START_01.text: Sob... Oh, Elizabeth, what should I do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_141_START_02.text: Huh, it's not every day you see a grown-up panda crying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_141_START_03.text: Do you know what this is about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_141_START_04.text:
His baby is ill and needs medicine,
but he couldn't find any?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_141_START_05.text: I don't know... His kid seems okay to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_141_START_06.text:
He should be around the same age as my Puppy. Suffering
from a little malnutrition, maybe, but nothing serious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_141_START_07.text:
Okay! Leave me to it! I'll whip up a healthy and nutritious
meal that will fatten him up in no time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_141_START_08.text:
... Well, you'll have to bring me the ingredients.
Go on, we don't have all day!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_142_END_01.text:
The Pumpkin Stake prices dropped again during my walk,
so I sold them all at 780 REMI.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_142_END_02.text:
I lost more than I bargained for, but I did cut my
losses… I walked out of that crash alive, at least.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_142_END_03.text:
... Wait. Why are the prices rising?
And so quickly...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_142_START_01.text:
Oh... Hi there.
Now isn't the best of time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_142_START_03.text:
I've spent my entire fortune on #Pumpkin Stakes#, a mana
currency that has recently grown popular in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_142_START_04.text:
I bought them at 1400 REMI... They've been falling since
and now they've dropped to 800 REMI.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_142_START_05.text:
Should I hold until they rise again,
or should I cut my losses and sell now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_142_START_06.text:
...I should cool my head first... I'll take a walk around
the neighborhood before making any rash decisions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_143_END_01.text:
... You mean to tell me that the reason of your coming
here was to ask me about... good-quality beef?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_143_END_02.text:
Yes, the cow you're riding is also fine! After all, meat
tastes better when the livestock is raised with love -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_143_END_03.text:
Cows are friends... Not food!
How could you eat your friend?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_143_END_04.text:
You barbaric beef-eaters!
I'll show you some real 'beef'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_143_END_05.text: Ahh! W-what did we do wrong?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_143_START_02.text: I apologize for my unruly behavior.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_143_START_03.text: Oh? The part about the rabbit liver?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_143_START_04.text:
Sigh... That baby panda seemed undernourished, so I meant
to advise to feed his child something nutritious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_143_START_05.text:
I... am not sure where I got the combination of the words
'rabbit' and 'liver.' It was completely random.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_143_START_06.text:
As I have... unwittingly caused them trouble, however, I
should get the panda family an apology gift.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_143_START_07.text:
The baby didn't like bamboo shoots, did he?
Then maybe he'll prefer meat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_143_START_08.text:
Perhaps you could introduce me to someone
who handles high quality beef?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_144_END_01.text:
Hmm. Were Mengqi and Gapgwi not on good terms?
It surprised me when they suddenly started fighting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_144_END_02.text:
They should've known better than to cause all that noise
around poor Palaku, though. I hope they recover soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_144_START_03.text:
I'm here to attend the #Animal Companions and
Their Humans Club# meeting!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_144_START_04.text:
It's very helpful: we trade tips
and also hold regular bazaars and garage sales!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_144_START_05.text: It would be nice if you could come too, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_END_01.text:
Ahh! {PLAYER_NAME}!
How could you do this to me? Let me go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_END_02.text:
Thanks for your cooperation, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I didn't expect for our paths to cross again so soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_END_03.text:
This badass here is a notorious underground hacker, wanted
in both Chen and Neth for the damage she caused.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_END_04.text:
Many people's lives were destroyed by what she wanted
to believe were harmless jokes. ... Including my own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_END_05.text:
... {PLAYER_NAME},
I know there are people looking for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_END_06.text:
But as you've helped me not once, but twice,
and I don't plan on following any orders from Grancia...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_END_07.text: We've never met, if you catch my drift.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_END_08.text:
But when we meet next time, whenever that may be,
we'll really get a drink.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_START_01.text:
Shh... {PLAYER_NAME}. Do NOT look behind you and
listen carefully to my instructions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_START_02.text:
You remember my voice, right? Yeah, it's #Cronette#.
... What do you mean, you don't know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_START_03.text:
Oh, that's right... Oops. Guess we haven't actually 'met.'
On your side, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_START_04.text:
I know you because… I may have been watching you
through my spy cam for some time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_START_05.text:
Anyway... Erm, can you find me a place to hide? I've been
out of the country, and I just found out I'm wanted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_START_06.text:
Don't get me wrong, I tried to take the matter into my own
hands and delete my records from the database...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_START_07.text:
... but apparently, there's no public wi-fi around here.
Unbelievable! That's why I infiltrated the Palace to -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_START_08.text: Found you at last! You can't escape forever!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_145_START_09.text:
Oh, crap. The cops are already here.
{PLAYER_NAME}! We've got to go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_END_01.text:
Master Zhang Bao!
What do you mean, you can't pay for the noodles?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_END_02.text:
I-I'm sorry,
I forgot to bring my wallet with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_END_03.text:
I'll come by later to pay.
I promise on my father's name!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_END_04.text:
The Golden Dragon Wagon doesn't take credit,
especially on fathers' names. Cash only, so pay up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_END_05.text: Unless... you pawn something valuable for a personal loan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_END_06.text:
Hmm... 
That tassel hanging on your spear seems nice enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_END_07.text:
T-that's the legendary 'Red Dragon Whiskers'!
It's a national treasure, handed down from my father!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_END_08.text:
Oh, what a funny coincidence. That noodle dish you enjoyed
so much is also called 'Red Dragon Whiskers.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_END_09.text:
You know where to find me - and this tassel of yours.
Okay? Goodbye!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_END_10.text: W-wait! I-I'm sure we can arrange something!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_START_01.text:
Delivery from Chai's Golden Dragon Wagon catering service!
One 'Red Dragon Whiskers' for a Master Zhang Bao!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_START_02.text:
Master Zhang Bao! Where are you?
You forgot to pay for your order!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_START_03.text:
Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}!
I'm glad to see a familiar face around here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_START_04.text:
The Palace is bigger than I expected. I can't locate a
customer. I have to deliver this bowl of noodles…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_146_START_05.text:
Could you help me? Please let me know if you see
General Zhang Bao of the Five Tiger Generals!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_147_END_02.text:
P-pardon?
I seem to have misheard you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_147_END_03.text:
That picture depicted... Shuwen and I...
doing... what?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_147_END_04.text:
...
S-stop! Stop it, I tell you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_147_END_05.text:
By the heavens over Chen, this is the first time I am
truly grateful for the dimming of my eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_147_END_06.text:
I cannot even begin to think how or why Yin Ping
would be keeping this in her desk drawer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_147_END_07.text: ... The very thought of interrogating her tires me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_147_START_01.text:
Thank you for coming, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I have an urgent request to ask of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_147_START_02.text:
Recently there have been reports of an... obscene painting
being circulated within the Palace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_147_START_03.text:
It is rumored to contain the most horrible slander defaming
the honor of the Five Tiger Generals.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_147_START_04.text:
We must stop the problematic #image# from being released
to the public and undermining the authority of the throne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_147_START_05.text:
But there's not much I can do, as I am blind… I wish
to entrust this investigation to someone I can trust.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_147_START_06.text:
You have proven your valor and honor before the Empire
of Chen. Needless to say, you are the Hero.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_148_END_02.text:
She was an ordinary woman
from the countryside...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_148_END_03.text:
... who could have been happier had she not been led to
believe that she had ambitions that weren't hers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_148_END_04.text:
Da Ji... Behind her crimes lies a deep tragedy
that even she has forgotten.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_148_START_02.text:
Do you not find it strange that nobody seems to
comprehend the true identity of Da Ji?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_148_START_03.text:
The late Emperor of Chen was not a fool. Once beloved for
his keen judgement and the goodness of his heart,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_148_START_04.text:
he changed after he met Da Ji, who gained full control over
him. But she too became a victim to the Kalard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_148_START_05.text:
No one in the capital remembers whom she truly was
before she became a courtesan of the palace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_148_START_06.text:
That is why I wish to trace her past
through the tracks she left behind in the Palace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_149_END_01.text:
Mm... I remember now.
Yes... We used to sing this song, together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_149_END_02.text:
This is another fond memory
I'll tell Sylunis when we meet again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_149_START_02.text: The past Lethe erased musn't be forgotten.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_149_START_03.text:
When Gullveig let Lethe escape moments before her own
death, a few memories from Lethe returned to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_149_START_04.text:
They are incomplete, but I know they're from before I
became an Elard: memories I share with my sister.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_149_START_05.text:
I vaguely remember... us singing together.
A certain melody.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_149_START_06.text:
If we return to the place where we fought our last
battle, I may be able to remember something more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_150_END_01.text:
Sigh... Jang San Beom was indeed a bizarre creature.
Where and why did the rest of its body disappear?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_150_END_02.text:
Masks are sources of strength for all kinds of beings, but
this fur and powder... Oh, it's cotton and flour.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_150_END_03.text:
It seems as if... Jang San Beom had no tangible body but
attempted to imitate lifeform out of some desire...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_150_END_04.text:
Perhaps it only wished to make new friends...
and find a home in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_150_START_01.text:
Mm... {PLAYER_NAME}...
I knew you would be coming.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_150_START_02.text:
Do you remember the strange monster
that the human called Shuwen mentioned?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_150_START_03.text:
As soon as I returned to the Taebaek Mountains,
I asked the residing beasts what they knew.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_150_START_04.text:
Apparently, a peculiar being called the #Jang San Beom#
is roaming the region and creating a commotion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_150_START_05.text:
It is said to be a beast with a crimson face and a body of clouds,
bearing a close resemblance to a tiger...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_150_START_06.text:
It isn't a mountain saint, but it imitates a human voice.
Some say it sounds like 'help me.' Strange, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_150_START_07.text:
I want to see if it's capable of holding a conversation. 
Do you want to come with me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_151_END_01.text:
Goodbye, my friend. I hope to see you again in the
Taebaek Mountains someday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_151_END_03.text:
Thank you for your help, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Goodbye, then...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_151_END_04.text:
... I don't feel like talking today.
Maybe I'll go home and have a drink by myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_151_START_01.text:
Ah, {PLAYER_NAME}.
You couldn't have come at a better time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_151_START_02.text:
Let me cut to the chase:
I want to ask you a favor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_151_START_03.text:
Can you help me
defeat my 'friend'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_151_START_04.text:
I wanted to do the job by myself, but my friend's strength
is something to be reckoned with.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_151_START_05.text:
Please.
It would mean a lot to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_END_01.text:
Hmm... How troublesome.
The shadows refuse to dissipate completely.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_END_02.text:
There's no helping it - 
we'll have to disperse them whenever they appear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_END_03.text:
...? Wait, is that...
the Imperial #Proof of Courage# in your hand?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_END_04.text:
This is a valuable talisman, bestowed directed by the Emperor
to the Five Tiger Generals alone - one for each.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_END_05.text:
No matter what hardships we faced,
holding it would always renew my courage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_END_06.text:
Do  you mean to say that that precious treasure...
can be duplicated?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_END_08.text:
If you ever discover any more of these tokens
while you handle the shadows of the past...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_END_09.text: ... promise to bring them to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_END_10.text:
If you do, you have my word as one of the Five Tiger
Generals that I will aid you in time of need.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_START_02.text:
I wished to ask you a question
about that... thing Phantasmic-something you defeated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_START_03.text:
An unknown energy emerged from her body and disturbed the
remnants of the trigram, creating a rift in the Palace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_START_04.text: Stepping into that space would reveal shards of the recent past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_START_05.text:
... If they were harmless visions, I would have regarded
them interesting. But these apparitions of the past

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_START_06.text:
are affecting the present: They are disrupting our
preparations for the Eastern Alliance, and they may

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_152_START_07.text: harm the inhabitants of the Palace. Will you help?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_10_1.text:
Hey there, {PLAYER_NAME}.
You ever hear about certain magical Rings of power?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_10_2.text: I hear they improve certain abilities of the wearer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_10_3.text:
A new Gear - now that's what excites us blacksmiths!
Could you bring one back to me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_11_1.text:
Ah, it's good that you're here.
The Royal Postman delivered your mail.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_11_2.text:
One of them, strangely enough, seems to be a letter from Roman...
Why don't you take a look, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_12_1.text:
Oh, {PLAYER_NAME},
there is one more letter addressed before you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_12_2.text:
This requires some more explanation, 
so please come to the town entrance when you are ready.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_13_1.text:
... I've finally arrived, nyan! This must be Hasla, nyan.
But I think I'm lost, nyan... There's nothing here but a forest, nyan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_13_2.text:
...!!
You there, nyan! Take me to the nearest village!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_14_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. It has finally been decided:
Hero Town is to become a center of continental diplomacy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_14_2.text: I will make the necessary introductions. Please follow me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_15_1.text:
Hmm, I know I'm close by...
These country villages are so hard to tell apart, grr.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_16_2.text:
I apologize in advance... The Fortress of Souls is yet to be recovered -
but I fear I must burden you with more responsibilities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_16_3.text:
It is the Apostles you conquered, {PLAYER_NAME}. Their husks,
for some unknown reason, have recovered - stronger than before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_16_4.text:
The one to whom I have dedicated my life... She told me to gather
able-bodied Captains of Hasla and fight against the resurrected Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_16_5.text:
This portal will take you to the husks.
Cooperate with other Captains to vanquish them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_17_1.text:
Oh, and who are you? {PLAYER_NAME}, you say? 
Hmm, I've heard that name before somewhere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_17_2.text:
... Huhu, don't worry, 
half the things I say aren't meant to be taken seriously.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_17_3.text:
I suppose you're here for my new services? 
And not to see me for my own sake, boo hoo!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_17_4.text:
Come here, then! I'll explain what you have to know -
why don't you give it a try?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_18_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
I discovered a way for you and your Heroes to grow stronger!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_18_2.text:
I can't wait to show you the results of my experiments.
Come find me when you have the time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_19_1.text:
Books of Inheritance... Those qualified to accept the ancient knowledge
within will be bestowed great strength upon reading them, I hear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_19_2.text: I didn't feel any difference when I read it, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_19_3.text:
I am sure you will be able to draw out
the hidden power of these books, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_1_1.text:
Hi, are you {PLAYER_NAME}?
I'm Chocolat! I run the bakery in this town!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_1_2.text:
Welcome to Hero Town! I baked some delicious bread
to celebrate your arrival, so please come by when you have the time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_20_1.text:
The Cardinal has fallen... But his minions and monsters remain,
causing discord throughout the kingdom of Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_20_2.text:
...I never thought I'd have to fight not only those corrupted by the Apostles,
but also those blinded by their own misguided faith.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_21_1.text: Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}. I've been looking for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_21_2.text:
Do you know the meat recipe everyone's talking about these days?
It is said to use magical seasoning as a special ingredient.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_21_3.text:
Although the dish itself requires a lot of meat...
It's said that one bite tremendously invigorates your body and will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_21_4.text:
If this recipe proves to be more than a rumor,
it could greatly help with training our Heroes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_21_5.text: We could try it out ourselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_22_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
Why don't you try delegating battle to your Heroes?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_2_1.text:
Hey there!
I haven't seen you around before. You a newcomer?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_2_2.text:
You seem like you could do with a stronger weapon...
If you do, Fergus is your man to seek!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_3_1.text:
What an interesting presence...
You. You're {PLAYER_NAME}, aren't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_3_2.text:
I've been waiting for you.
Come find me whenever you have the time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_4_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. A moment?
When you find the time, please come find me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_5_1.text:
I prepared lodgings for your Heroes, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Please come see them when you have the time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_6_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
The training grounds have been installed just outside the town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_6_2.text:
The scarecrows there may seem ordinary, but they are, in fact,
highly advanced machines equipped with many helpful functions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_6_3.text:
It seems a good opportunity
to check the strength of your Heroes before the actual battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_7_1.text:
Recently, many other Captains
have been visiting our town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_7_2.text:
Why don't we go and greet them?
Perhaps you could befriend a like-minded comrade.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_8_1.text:
There is something I must show you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Let me accompany you on your next battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_9_1.text:
Ooh, shiny here, shiny there!
It's shiny, shiny everywhere, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TQ_9_2.text:
... Eek! What is this place, nya?!
There are monsters everywhere, nya. Somebody help us, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTORIAL_DOC_1_2.text: I hear #Dungeons# are now open throughout the continent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTORIAL_DOC_2_1.text: Lady Hellad will tell you about the Dungeons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTORIAL_DOC_2_14.text: Mm. We should leave as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTORIAL_DOC_2_3.text:
As the town's best expert on magic, 
I'll teach you everything there's to know about Dungeons!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTORIAL_DOC_3_1.text:
... We have to carry out Goddess Prestina's mission right now.
I don't think we have the leisure to explore dungeons or the Colosseum.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTORIAL_SIS_SKILL_1.text:
Oh! Thanks to you, {PLAYER_NAME},
I can use my powers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTORIAL_SIS_SKILL_3.text:
Gunakan kekuatanku secara instan akan menurunkan 
kerusakan akibat serangan para monster.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTORIAL_SKILL_EQUIP_6.text:
Skill Perpindahan Skill memerlukan sumber daya,
tapi kali ini aku yang traktir manis …!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTORIAL_WEAPON_2_1.text:
Upgrading a Weapon will give it a random option
within the category of the option slot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTORIAL_WEAPON_2_7.text:
This weapon is bound to make any Hero stronger,
so give it to someone of the appropriate class.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTORIAL_WEAPON_2_8.text:
Ah, don't tell me you didn't know every weapon
can only be equipped by Heroes of a certain #class#?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTORIAL_WEAPON_2_9.text:
If you have the right weapon but not the right Hero to wield it - well now,
that's a real tragedy. Try recruiting allies through #Contracts# at the Shop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCOUNT_LINK_0001.text:
I will now show you how to safely register your information,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCOUNT_LINK_0002.text:
You can check and manage
information of your account here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCOUNT_LINK_0003.text:
Please keep in mind that you must synchronize your account
to prevent your information from being permanently lost!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ACCOUNT_LINK_0004.text:
We definitely do not want that.
Thank you for taking the trouble, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_001.text:
Hey there, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Ever heard of #Sigils#? They're said to be items of great power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_002.text:
You can combine it with Weapons to grant both the Sigil
and the Weapon's original powers to the wielder. Incredible, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_003.text:
It is extremely difficult to handle,
but after much practice, I finally gained some mastery over it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_004.text:
In order to inlay a Sigil,
you must first #add a Slot# to the Weapon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_005.text:
In order to add Slots,
you need #another Soulbound Weapon#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_006.text: However, I'll add a Slot for free this one time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_007.text:
Our lady knight who always strives to protect our little town.
Why don't you let me improve your weapon for you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_008.text:
... Master Fergus. Can you promise me that my weapon will keep intact?
I still haven't made all the down payments...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_009.text:
Don't you trust me?
I'm the town's best blacksmith! You'll be in good hands!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_011.text:
Here you can check the Weapon you have selected.
If you look down here, you can see whether it has been added with Slots.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_012.text:
This Soulbound Weapons doesn't have any Slots yet,
so you must use another Weapon to add one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_013.text:
When adding a Slot, look here
to check #the list of Weapons that can be used as the material#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_014.text:
Material Weapons don't need to be identical to the original weapon:
if they're Soulbound Weapons, they'll work, regardless of their type.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_015.text:
Make sure to check the Weapon's upgrade status, option,
and Slots before selecting it as material for another Weapon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_016.text:
Be careful - the material Weapon will disappear upon adding the Slot.
A good demonstration's worth a thousand words, so let me show you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_017.text: Success! A Slot has been added to your Weapon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_019.text:
What's with that sigh of relief? So, you weren't joking back then! Tsk, tsk…
You must have more faith in your favorite blacksmith!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_020.text:
Select at least one Material Weapon
and I'll get to adding the first Slot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_021.text:
Now then... Do you see the #Slot Point Bar# at the bottom of the menu
increasing as I add a Slot to the weapon? It's a new point system I've prepared.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_022.text:
Get enough points and I'll add the second Slot to a weapon of your choice.
Slot Points are calculated by the amount of Danan's Fragments you have used to add Slots.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_023.text:
The higher the grade of the Soulbound Weapon spent to add a Slot,
the more Slot Points you'll gain as a result.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ADDSLOT_024.text:
#100 Points# should be enough to add the second Slot to a weapon.
Oh, and I can convert #Fergus Points# into Slot Points as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_CHAMPION_LINK_1_001.text:
Congratulations, {PLAYER_NAME}. Your hard work has paid off -
your Friendship with this Faction has reached maximum level.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_CHAMPION_LINK_1_002.text:
When you reach maximum Friendship with a Faction,
you can form a #Bond# with that Faction.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_CHAMPION_LINK_1_003.text:
As your Bond grows stronger, so will the Champion and Heroes of
that Faction. Achieving certain conditions will unlock special #Bond Skills#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_CHAMPION_LINK_1_004.text:
Reinforce Champions to increase Friendship and strengthen your Bond.
I have a feeling it will greatly help increase the power of your Heroes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_CHAMPION_LINK_SKILL_.text:
Magnificent. You have formed a #Bond# with a Champion.
The Champion can now use their #Bond Skill#.
Bond Skills can be #equipped# or #unequipped# anytime.

I also hear that you can obtain more powerful #Bond Skills#
as you form stronger Bonds with Champions.

Use them wisely,
and Bond Skills will greatly help you in battle.

{PLAYER_NAME}. May your stronger #Bond# with Champions
help you protect Hasla together, side by side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_STOCK_1_01.text:
... Huhuhu... Welcome to the #real# Captain's Choice Polls.
The vote outside? Pssh, that's just a cover for the real deal!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_STOCK_1_02.text:
Presenting the #Hero Town Stock Market#!
This is where you buy or sell the #value# of each candidate for profit!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_STOCK_1_03.text:
At a loss for words? Let me show you how things work around here!
Now, if you'll take a look at the screen...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_STOCK_3_01.text: And check the prices and other relevant information here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_STOCK_4_01.text:
And voila! You can buy or sell #stocks# for each candidate!
Of course, the market currency is #Bridget Tokens#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_STOCK_5_01.text:
Here you can check your #Turn#
and the amount of #Bridget Tokens# you own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_STOCK_5_02.text:
Each turn lasts #one hour#.
During that time, you can freely buy and sell shares...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_STOCK_5_03.text:
But at the end of each turn, your trade will be set for good!
Please keep this in mind when trading!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_STOCK_6_01.text:
Finally, you can check the state of your #Investments#
or buy helpful #information# here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EVENT_STOCK_6_02.text:
If you need to hear my explanation again,
feel free to press the #? Button# whenever!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXCEED_1_16.text:
Now, for the Fragments of the Crystal Sword.
I need more of those #Danan's Fragments# that you brought back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXCEED_2_3.text:
The amount of Danan's Fragments you retrieved
isn't enough to forge your weapon to the next level.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXCEED_2_4.text: Come back when you've gathered all the necessary materials.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXCEED_2_5.text:
Berikutnya, kurasa aku akan memperlihatkan DUA desain
senjata daripada Cuma satu

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXCEED_2_6.text:
Sepertinya dengan latihan dapat menyempurnakannya
Sampai jumpa lagi

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_0002.text:
Mari kita lihat ... Hei, kamu!
Benarkah Pemimpin Pahlawan itu tinggal di kota ini?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_0005.text:
Saya? Nama Arjuna.
Tampan, kaya, menawan, sebut saja ..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_0008.text: Pokoknya ... apakah kamu melihat itu di kejauhan?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_0009.text: Apa yang terjadi pada Stasiun Pesawat itu..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_0010.text:
Ya, saya disini hendak menawarkan tempat untuk anda
di kelompok ekspedisi berri saya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_0014.text:
Jika kamu tidak menemukan berri tersebut, kamu dapat 
menyimpan berri yang lain, Tidak buruk bukan ?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_0015.text: Ya ,Kedengarannya terlalu bagus untuk jadi kenyataan

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_0017.text:
Asisten saya Lenny telah menandai beberapa tempat
dimana ada beberapa Berries tumbuh.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_0018.text:
Tentu saja kamu bisa kemana saja yang kamu mau, tapi
percayalah, Lenny sangat bisa diandalkan

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_0019.text:
Oh, dan tujuan yang berbeda akan membutuhkan
waktu eksplorasi yang berbeda dan anggota kru. Ingatlah

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_0020.text:
Kamu bisa memilih anggota ekspedisi disini. 
Butuh saran dariku ?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_0021.text:
Jika pahlawan yang ikut eksplorasi berasal dari
daerah itu, peluangnya akan lebih baik

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_0022.text:
Terdapat pula beragam kondisi, yang akan memberimu 
hadiah yang menarik, tetap pasang mata.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0001.text:
Well, I put all the berries that we obtained in the storage...
But I'm afraid we don't know whether they are safe to eat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0003.text: Wait, that's... That's a Superior Berry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0005.text:
Aku baru saja lewat
Saat aku merasakan uang yang memanggilku!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0006.text:
But what are you doing, putting these Berries in the storage?
If you can't find a use for them, you could sell them to me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0007.text:
Do you know about these Berries, Miss Bridget?
Could you tell us more about their properties?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0008.text:
Eh, jangan bilang kamu tidak tahu!
Berry ini cukup istimewa, kamu tahu ...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0009.text:
Coba satu gigitan pada permata langka ini,
dan kamu akan mendapatkan kekuatan luar biasa!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0010.text:
Ehem! Berri ini harganya mahal! 
Makanya aku ingin mendapatkannya sendiri

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0011.text:
Ugh, Lednas... Your brutal innocence 
always takes the fun out of haggling for better bargains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0012.text:
Any other merchant would strip you to the last penny.
You have to learn how be more discreet!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0014.text:
Ehem! Biasanya aku meminta bayaran atas petunjuk ini
tapi aku akab berikan diskon kali ini

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0016.text:
There are several different kinds of Berries.
Berries that make you stronger, faster, sturdier...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0017.text:
Berri berbeda, berbeda pula kemampuannya dan kamu 
bisa mengenalinya dari bentuknya

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0018.text:
Kamu dapat melihat
seberapa kuat Berry ini akan membuatmu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0020.text:
Makanlah dan kamu akan menjadi kuat!
Sesederhana itu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0021.text:
Terima kasih, Bridget.
aku tidak tahu bagaimana mengucapkan terima kasih.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0022.text: Huhu, ini bukan apa-apa, kau tahu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0023.text:
Not at all. It was thanks to you 
that we realized the full potential of this mysterious fruit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_0024.text:
Hmm~ Well, if you ARE so grateful,
I do have this great new item in stock at the store...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_GAME_PLAY_1.text:
The enemy has appeared!
I will now explain how to fight in battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_GAME_PLAY_2.text:
That enemy looks stronger than the one before.
We must use a stronger skill.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_GRADEUP_1_8.text:
Pahlawan dapat dipromosikan ketika level & latihan 
mereka maksimal. Honor juga diperlukan untuk promosi

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
I heard you discovered a mysterious book.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_002.text:
Can I take a look at it?
... It seems like an ordinary old book on the surface.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_003.text:
I have a feeling, however
that it contains some powerful properties yet to be uncovered.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_004.text:
Oh, my! I thought I sensed some interesting magic around here -
and what a fascinating object you have in your hands!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_005.text:
Oh, Lady Hellad.
Do you know anything about this book?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_006.text:
This is... a volume of the #Ancient Books of Inheritance#!
They're quite well known among scholars of magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_007.text:
During the Apostles' War one hundred years ago,
the legendary Chrona Heroes each kept a record of their adventures.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_008.text:
Ancient Books with a Chrona Hero's name in the title
can only be read by Heroes of that particular #class#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_009.text:
#Ancient Books# are a compilation of all six Heroes' knowledge
and can be used by #all classes#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_010.text:
Frankly speaking, the text itself isn't all too inspirational...
They read like journal entries full of everyday know-hows.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_011.text:
... but in the hands of a #qualified# Hero,
these Books can unlock a great power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_013.text: You can check your inventory of Books here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_014.text:
Some still remain intact, but many Books are found torn in bits
and fragments, as they are over a century old.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_015.text:
Torn Books, or Pages, #will not raise a Hero's Inheritance Level
beyond a particular limit#. Please keep that in mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_016.text:
Whole or torn, all Books
will #raise 1 Inheritance Level each#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_017.text:
Heroes who gain Inheritance Levels
will #display their levels in a special color#, I hear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_018.text: Now, will you read an excerpt for me, Lednas?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_020.text:
... 'Today's lunch was awful. Fishsticks AGAIN.'
... 'A bad meal on the battlefield leads to a decline in one's will to fight.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_021.text:
Hmm... It certainly seems enlightening, but I don't feel any difference.
Perhaps I am not ready to read this, just yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INHERIT_022.text:
I am sure you will be able to
use the power of these books to the fullest, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INLAY_001.text: Ahem. Let's now try adding a Sigil, now that the Slot is ready.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INLAY_002.text:
Here you can see the list of Sigils that can be inlaid to the added Slot.
I'll give you a demonstration with one of my own this time as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INLAY_003.text:
The Sigil has successfully been inlaid!
The power of the Sigil should have been added to the weapon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INLAY_004.text:
You're right.
My sword feels different... Imbued with a new power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INLAY_005.text: So, this is the power of Sigils...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INLAY_006.text:
Haha, how is it?
Now that is a weapon worth calling legendary!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INLAY_007.text:
Sigils can be inlaid or removed at any time,
but I'll have to ask for a small fee for my efforts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INLAY_008.text:
Removing a Sigil from its Slot without any damage
requires delicate handiwork, you see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INLAY_009.text:
Well, smashing the inlaid Sigil in order to inlay a new one
isn't so difficult, so I'll do that for free, if you wish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_INLAY_010.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
If you have any Sigil-related business to see to, come find me any time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_LIBRARY_18.text:
... {PLAYER_NAME}, you can be really curious, huh?
That book contains pictures of the people of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_LIBRARY_19.text:
That's all it contains, so make sure to view other information
in the other Tomes of the Library.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_LIBRARY_22.text:
Buku ini berisikan informasi tentang batu sihir tertentu
yang disebut .. Sigil kan ?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_LIBRARY_23.text:
Yawn...
If you ever want to read up on Rings, try this book.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_LIBRARY_24.text:
That book holds information on the Fish that can be caught
all around Hasla. I didn't know there were so many interesting species.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_LIBRARY_25.text: ... That book records Heroes of other dimensions who visited Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_LIBRARY_26.text:
It also contains information on the Weapons they use.
Why don't you take a look?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_LIBRARY_28.text:
This is where records will be kept
of all your adventures in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_LIBRARY_29.text:
I'm a little busy as I need to tend to countless stories, so I'd appreciate it
if you come find me yourself if you have anything to record.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_LIBRARY_30.text:
I know it's a little troublesome, but...
I'll reward your efforts with some helpful presents.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_MIX_1.text:
Hee hee. Welcome!
This is - ta-da! - the Alchemy Lab!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_MIX_2.text:
You can combine ingredients here
to craft new items that will prove helpful for your adventures!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_MIX_3.text: Let's take a look at what we can make!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_MIX_4.text: This here is the list of items that can be crafted...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_MIX_5.text: And here you can see the recipe for the selected item.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_MIX_6.text: You can easily check what you need to craft each item.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_MIX_7.text:
All recipes have been thoroughly tested by yours truly,
so don't worry about failing to craft a recipe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_MIX_8.text: I will be requiring a teeny tiny fee for that matter, though!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_10_0001.text:
I'm sure you and your Heroes will need a little bit more help 
than what I told you, so let me give you a good tip.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_11_0001.text:
Here in the Orchard Shop, you can hire new employees or purchase items
that will help you grow and harvest Berries!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_11_0002.text:
Employees, Animals, and Scarecrows all have different abilities,
but everyone will be a great help to you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_11_0003.text:
Once assigned to your Orchard, they will help out with all Plots.
Remember, only one of each category can be assigned to your farm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_11_0004.text:
Well, that seems to be everything!
I look forward to working with you, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_1_0001.text:
And here is my Orchard! This is where you will help me out,
{PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_1_0002.text: As it'll be your first time farming, let me give you a quick lesson.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_2_0001.text:
The Orchard has five Plots of land 
where you can plant Berries of your choosing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_2_0002.text:
There are special Plots where you can plant certain Berries to increase
your chances of a Great Harvest. I'll explain more about this later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_2_0003.text:
Now, about planting and growing Berries!
Why don't you try pressing the 'Plant' button?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_3_0001.text: Let's go choose a Berry to plant before we continue.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_4_0001.text: Here you can select the type of Berry to plant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_5_0001.text: You must select the Berry to plant from here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_5_0002.text:
You remember how I said some Plots are good for 
growing certain Berries? Berries have three properties, as you can see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_5_0003.text:
These properties are shared by Plots.
Plant Berries on Plots with the same properties to farm more efficiently.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_5_0004.text:
After choosing the type of Berry to plant,
you have to decide how long you wish to cultivate it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_6_0001.text:
Varieties that take more time to grow will yield more Berries upon harvest,
but they're a little expensive. You'll have to pay up for these, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_6_0002.text:
I can trade you some good Berry varieties for some Life Essence.
Of course, better types will cost more!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_6_0003.text:
Harvesting Berries will also yield some Sap. I hear the Alchemy Lab 
need it for their research, so remember to check with them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_6_0004.text:
Now that we've chosen a Berry to plant, let's assign Heroes to work!
Press the 'Plant' button and return to the Plots.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_7_0001.text:
This is where you come in, {PLAYER_NAME}! Running an Orchard
is a lot of work. Not only do you need a lot of workers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_8_0001.text:
But you also need proficient workers who are good at their job.
As such, only ★4+ Heroes can farm on the Orchard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_8_0002.text:
And always remember that you need
at least five Heroes to work on the Orchard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_9_0001.text:
Ah, I almost forgot about Great Harvests and Bonus Rewards.
Great Harvests are what they sound like: great harvests!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_9_0002.text:
They will yield not only more Berries than usual,
but also Berries of more superior quality.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_9_0003.text:
Bonus Rewards are gained through assigning Heroes
that meet certain conditions for every harvest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_9_0004.text:
So make sure to check out the Farm Conditions 
and assign your most suitable Heroes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_ORCHARD_9_0005.text:
Now, there's one last thing I need to tell you.
Let's go back to the Orchard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_PACKAGE_1.text:
This shop is where I work.
You can buy most of what you need here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_PACKAGE_2.text:
And guess what, a -very- special package arrived for you today!
It's free, so why don't you take it right away?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_PACKAGE_3.text:
Huhuhu... Do you like it?
If you do, make sure to visit often and check out my other wares!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_QUEST_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, how did you find Bridget's Shop?
There is one more place I need to introduce before you set out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_QUEST_2.text:
This is the Quest Board.
People who need help will post their requests here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_QUEST_3.text:
The town guards are doing their best to meet everyone's needs,
but it seems more and more people require our assistance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_QUEST_4.text:
Your help would be greatly appreciated,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_QUEST_5.text:
Oh, and please note that 
quests are organized by type, like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_REPEAT_1.text:
Welcome, {PLAYER_NAME}. I will teach you what you
need to know about #battle delegation#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_REPEAT_2.text: A stage can be delegated after you clear it for the first time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_REPEAT_3.text:
First, choose the Heroes who will fight in the stage. This is
our first delegation, so send our strongest Heroes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_REPEAT_4.text:
You're ready, so let's delegate the battle to the Heroes.
You need enough #currency# to enter the stage...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_REPEAT_5.text:
Set the number of battles to delegate. Delegation ends
automatically at the end of the set number of rounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_REPEAT_6.text:
Please note that delegation will end when all Heroes
are defeated or your inventory becomes full.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_REPEAT_7.text: Then let us start the battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_REPEAT_PLAY_1.text:
When you delegate the battle to your Heroes,
you will play the stage in #Auto Battle Mode#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_REPEAT_PLAY_2.text:
In Auto Battle Mode,
Heroes will automatically use their skills.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_REPEAT_PLAY_3.text:
#Main Type# Heroes automatically use #3-chain# block
skills, #Sub Type# Heroes #1-chain# block skills.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_REPEAT_PLAY_4.text:
Each Hero's battle type is listed
in their respective skill information.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_REPEAT_PLAY_5.text: You can activate or deactivate auto battles here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_REPEAT_PLAY_6.text:
This is all I have to say about delegation for now. Now,
try #activating# #Auto Battle Mode# to clear this stage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_SHOP_1.text:
Hemm ini seharusnya berkenaan dengan hal lainnya
tapi aku merasa ada yang ketinggalan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_SHOP_14.text:
Hmm. Baiklah! Peluang untuk mendapatkan 
#Kontrak Premium# dengan gratis. Dapat merekrut hero baru!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_SHOP_17.text:
Kami memiliki paket terbatas tersedia khusus untukmu, 
jangan lewatkan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_SHOP_4.text:
Oh, no! You met a bad match. However... You 
absolutely need a trusty ally for future adventures.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_SHOP_9.text:
Tentu saja, Lednas! Kau bijak seperti biasanya.
Ayo, cepat!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_TRAIN_1_2.text:
Musuh hanya akan terus bertambah kuat.Kita harus
#melatih# anggota kita untuk meningkatkan kemampuan

TEXT_DIALOGUES_TUTO_WEAPON_DATA_3.text:
I can #upgrade# your Weapons for you.
How about giving it a go right away?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_1_02.text:
I know Susa... I mean, I know he likes rice cakes.
I've often seen him frequenting the vendors back home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_1_03.text:
I suppose everybody has a craving for sugary treats
every once in a while.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_1_05.text:
The taste of the strawberry tarts that Maria bought for me
years ago still lingers on my tongue...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_1_06.text:
... Ahem. We should be on our way to the cellars.
{PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_1_08.text: That's strange. They were right by my side a moment ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_1_09.text:
Hrrmph! I won't let Himiko have all the fun!
So Susanoo likes sweets, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_1_10.text:
NO! This sweet milk chocolate is MINE!
{PLAYER_NAME}! Let's make a run for it! Hurry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_1_12.text:
Oh no, {PLAYER_NAME}!
You're mistaken! She isn't the client!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_01.text: Let's go with bittersweet dark chocolate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_02.text:
Almost as bitter as my own heart
that continues to wait without reprieve...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_03.text:
You sound as if your heart dwells
not only in love but also in hate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_04.text:
... Please don't laugh, Lednas. I'm embarrassed enough as
it is. What do you think, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_05.text:
You like bitter foods?
Haha, we're more alike than I thought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_06.text: Then shall we head on to the cellars?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_07.text:
Yes, let us.
What about you, Miss Kaguya?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_09.text:
I like my chocolate sweet.
Do you have any in store?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_10.text:
Then I will accompany Kaguya.
Chocolat's cellars can be dangerous to visit alone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_11.text:
Haha, what do you mean by 'dangerous'? I know for a
fact that this town should be perfectly safe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_12.text:
Then, Himiko,
I'll be back soon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_13.text: Sigh... She's still a kid, that Kaguya.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_14.text:
There's not a great age difference between us, so I don't
know why she can be so... frustratingly childish at times.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_15.text: Oh. I shouldn't have said that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_16.text:
For some reason, I feel like I can be myself before you,
{PLAYER_NAME}. Like the rest of the world doesn't exist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_2_18.text:
... Cough, cough. We've wasted enough time with small talk.
We should go now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_01.text: Let's go with the #fire chicken chocolate#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_02.text:
Fire... What? Please tell me you're joking.
Such things can't exist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_03.text:
How do you know about the fire chicken chocolate? That's
a confidential recipe known only to Chocolat herself

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_04.text:
and a few select members of the merchant guild. Not many
are acquainted with its taste, let alone its existence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_05.text:
Don't underestimate our skills of gathering intelligence.
We know everything, including your salaries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_06.text:
... That reminds me of one report I recently received.
Lednas, don't leave this job. It's not worth it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_07.text:
Wh-what do you mean? I never thought for a single moment
about leaving! I love it! I'm staying in Hero Town for life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_10.text:
Ahem, ahem! Cough, cough!
Anyway, the special 'fire chicken chocolate'...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_11.text:
It's known among gastronomes for its numbing spicy taste.
It's an acquired taste, and you might find it too strong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_12.text:
I don't mind.
Will you help me get it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_13.text:
Hmm... Strictly speaking, this chocolate is prohibited from
export, but as you are already aware of its existence...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_14.text:
I will go persuade Chocolat to make an exception.
What about you, Miss Kaguya?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_15.text:
Erm, no thanks.
I like my chocolate the regular kind. Sweet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_16.text:
Could you guide Miss Kaguya
to the storage, please, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_17.text: Himiko and I will return to the bakery.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_3_18.text:
Okie dokie! All the sweet milk chocolate will be mine!
Come on, {PLAYER_NAME}! Hurry up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_CHOICE_END_.text: Is that you, {PLAYER_NAME}?

Kaguya wanted to thank you
for helping her get the chocolate.

Me? Oh, after you turned your back on me,
I had no choice but to follow Lednas to the cellars.
That's not all. I didn't even get the chocolate I wanted.

No. Kaguya hogged all the sweet ones,
leaving behind only bitter dark chocolate for me.

Sigh... If only a certain someone
hadn't abandoned me...

Huhu, I'm just giving you a hard time.
Don't mind me.

When I first met you, {PLAYER_NAME}, I'd heard you were
an invincible hero who had fought the Apostles

and saved the world. But here you are, being knocked out by
a punch from Nari, helping out with this silly plan...

Funny to think how nervous I was when we met. There's
much more to you than meets the eye, {PLAYER_NAME}.

Anyway.
What's the next step?

Whew! Who knew the cellars of a bakery
could be so deep and dangerous?

Do you brave such dangers
whenever you want a loaf of bread?

I now know how a hero from a small country town on the
outskirts of Grancia trained to save the world.

... Oh, the reason why I chose
the dark chocolate over the milk?
Haha, it's a little embarrassing to say.

Susanoo... has stood by my side for a long time,
as my personal bodyguard.

I thought things would continue like this forever… And that
Susanoo would return my feelings for him, too.

Things changed when Kaguya visited my castle and saw
Susanoo for the first time... and fell in love at first sight.

Susanoo...
seemed flattered by Kaguya's attention.

... There's no helping it, I suppose.
I can't force my feelings onto someone.

That's why I chose the dark chocolate… so that Kaguya
has a better chance of getting what she wants.
Susanoo likes sweets. I know that for a fact.

Look at me.
I keep babbling in front of you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

Anyway... That's that.
What's the next step?

Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Did you have a good time with Kaguya?

Yes, I too successfully retrieved
the #fire chicken chocolate#.

The merchant guild members  weren't too keen to carry out
my request, but we came to an understanding in the end.
Hmm? Is this chocolate so tasty, you ask?

Of course not. One bite will, nine cases out of ten,
lead to hours spent sweating on the toilet.
Susanoo is especially weak to spicy food...

Huhu, am I being too mean?
But the very thought amuses me.

...
Oh, don't look at me like that. He had it coming.

Hmph. Serves him right for being an idiot. Spending all those
years as my guard, and never realizing my feelings for him...

Anyway, I heard from Lednas
that we'll be choosing the fruit topping next.
Let's go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_01.text: So the preparations for the #Cupid Committee# are complete.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_02.text:
I repeat, we simply came to purchase some chocolates.
We hadn't expected you to... go all out for us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_03.text:
Yeah.
Are things always so... excessive at Hero Town?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_04.text:
... I won't deny it. However, I can assure you that we\
finish what we start.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_05.text:
Haha, all right, then.
Let's see if you can live up to your word.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_06.text:
First, select the #type of chocolate#
you want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_07.text:
Gourmet chocolate that you can't purchased anywhere else
than Chocolat's Bakery'... is what I was told.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_08.text: {PLAYER_NAME} will accompany you to the cellars.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_09.text:
Accompany me? I assumed that we'd be shown the
wares... here. As a customer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_10.text:
Oh, no. You must defeat Chocolat to access her storage
and earn her prized chocolate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_11.text:
... I don't understand.
Is this a tradition of Hero Town?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_12.text:
I would say it's common sense rather than a tradition.
'Beat the baker and earn your bread,' no?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_13.text:
... And with that, I give up all hope of understanding this
town and its residents. Well, no matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_14.text:
The sooner I get my chocolate,
the faster I'll return home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_1_START_15.text:
Then, {PLAYER_NAME},
the chocolate I want is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_01.text:
Then I'll choose
the #critical damage# berries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_03.text:
However, I do wish I could know more about it
before I make my final decision...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_04.text:
Critical damage berries resemble pitaya,
more commonly known as the #dragon fruit#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_05.text: Dragon fruit? I don't think I've ever eaten one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_06.text:
They're relatively less sweet than other fruit,
so they're not often used in desserts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_07.text:
... but the variety grown at our orchard are exceptionally
sweet and go great with chocolate!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_08.text:
Huh, you almost sound like a professional farmer,
considering that you don't even have strawberries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_10.text:
Okie, then I'll have what Himiko is having,
please!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_11.text:
Kaguya... We can't BOTH choose the same one. It would be
pointless. Sigh... Then I'll have the attack power berry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_12.text:
I only hope we don't have to fight you for the berries,
like we did for chocolates and bread.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_13.text:
What? Of course not.
I'm not ridiculously strong like Chocolat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_14.text:
Just drop by my orchard and take whatever you need.
However...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_16.text:
Erm, the trees MAY try to attack you due to a teeny tiny
side effect of a special fertilizer I use.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_18.text:
BUT! You should be okay - probably!
{PLAYER_NAME} will keep you safe. Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_19.text:
Lednas...
Are you sure this town is safe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_20.text:
... It all contributes to our daily training.
Let me lead the way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_1_EN.text:
... I hadn't realized that you were being literal when you
said 'the trees' bark is harder than their bite.'

How do people 
even survive in this town?

I wouldn't be surprised if that smithy over there has a
secret hideout below.

... Please don't tell me that that smithy really does have
a secret hideout.

Stop making that face!
I don't want to know.

So. It's complete.
My #Valentine's Day chocolates#.

... Although I won't be giving them
to Susanoo.

Oh, don't say that you didn't notice,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

Throughout my entire life, I've let Kaguya get what she
wants. Even if it coincides with... what I want.

As the Priestess of Ryu,
I have duties that come before anything else.

Duties that... may prove to be a heavy burden
not only for me, but for those around me as well.

That's why I can't burden Susanoo with my selfish
feelings. He would be happier with Kaguya…

That's why... I want you to have my #Valentine's Day
chocolates#, {PLAYER_NAME}.

Thank you for helping me out with everything. I won't
lie - Kaguya did force me to come, in the beginning.

But I don't regret coming here - I met you, {PLAYER_NAME},
and your friendship means much to me.
Himiko!
Oh? Susanoo?

You disappeared after leaving only a note.
You had me worried.

I heard from Lady Kaguya, that you two came to make
a western confectionery called chocolates.

... Yes, that we did. But it was a waste of time and
effort. I ended up making nothing.

Are those Kaguya's chocolates
you have in your hand?

Oh... Yes. I hadn't realized
that she was aware of my penchant for sweets.

Hmm. All right, then.
I hope you like them.
...? Yes, I am sure I will.

Then... {PLAYER_NAME}.
It's time for me to return home.

I apologize for all the trouble we've caused you.
Don't ignore my letters after I return.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_01.text: Then I'll have the #attack power# berry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_02.text:
However, I do wish I could know more about it
before I make my final decision...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_03.text:
Oh, don't worry. You should find attack power berries very
familiar. They look and taste similar to apples!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_04.text: Hmm, what about critical damage berries?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_05.text:
Huhuhu... Critical damage berries are...
How should I say this? 'Special.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_07.text:
Weeelll... I can only say that it's good for people...
looking forward to engage in certain activities...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_08.text:
...? Well, then...
I'll have the critical damage berries!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_10.text:
I only hope we don't have to fight you for the berries,
like we did for chocolates and bread.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_11.text:
What? Of course not.
I'm not ridiculously strong like Chocolat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_12.text:
Just drop by my orchard and take whatever you need.
However...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_14.text:
Erm, the trees MAY try to attack you due to a teeny tiny
side effect of a special fertilizer I use.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_16.text:
BUT! You should be okay - probably!
{PLAYER_NAME} will keep you safe. Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_17.text:
Lednas...
Are you sure this town is safe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_VALENTINE_1_2_CHOICE_2_18.text:
... It all contributes to our daily training.
