I’ll restore your stuff back with piano music!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_6_05.text: Deemo! Can you play one more time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_6_07.text: Caroline! We can use your help!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_6_08.text:
Don’t order me around!
I was getting ready!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_7_01.text: I think he’s awake! He's fine!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_7_02.text:
Jeez... We were so worried!
Running into danger like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_7_03.text: What’s all the fuss about? He’s stronger than you think.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_7_04.text:
But you tried so hard to save him?
Just admit you were worried.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_7_05.text: W-Well... I just give my everything when I play music!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_7_06.text: You don’t have to be so shy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_7_07.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, are you okay? How are you feeling?
Can you move?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_8_01.text:
Alright!
Well, now that we have our weapon. Shall we?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_9_01.text:
Wait... Hold on.
Someone else woke up when we were playing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_9_03.text:
No, we will.
It’s a bit dangerous.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_1_01.text:
Oh, this is good!
The Rain clearly eased up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_1_02.text:
So we’ve just proven that 
louder music makes the Rain stop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_1_04.text:
Deemo? What do you think?
Did I get better or what?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_1_06.text:
Haha... I guess I still have a long way to go.
I’ll practice more when we get back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_2_01.text:
Hold on.
Someone woke up while we were playing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_2_03.text:
The flowers go away when we play.
The life, stuff... everything returns to normal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_01.text:
I see.
So this is where the HMF stage was earlier?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_02.text:
And everyone in the audience has passed out.
That sounds serious...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_03.text:
Did he ruin things again?
What do you have against HMF?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_04.text:
It was an accident.
This isn’t what I planned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_05.text:
By the way, what is that white thing?
Is it a... human? A ghost?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_06.text:
Haha... Everyone asks.
I'm Echo and this is Deemo, a Guardian.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_09.text:
Meri! Look! He doesn’t have a mouth!
Don’t be so disrespectful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_10.text:
Oh, I-I didn’t notice!
I’m sorry Cano!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_14.text: Mmm, I doubt Deemo would mind. Probably.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_01.text:
So, to recap,
Levine did something and made this mess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_02.text:
The Rain blooms flowers and kills.
And the only way to stop all that is to play music?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_04.text: That pretty much sums up my entire day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_05.text:
But we are saving people that way, right?
If you have any other suggestions, be my guest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_06.text:
Why don’t we just get rid of the rain clouds?
You two over there, any suggestions?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_08.text:
I mean,
we don’t have any device here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_09.text:
If that fool operated the teleporter to cause mess,
then why don’t we do the same thing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_10.text:
It was an accident.
And no scientific solution to this problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_5_02.text: So we have no other choice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_6_01.text:
Just enjoy the music and the stage!
Everyone, let’s give it our best!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_6_03.text: How can you even enjoy this situation?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_6_04.text:
I know we have an urgent problem.
But worrying won’t solve the problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_6_05.text:
So if we are going to do this, let’s at least have fun!
That’s what HMF’s supposed to be - loud and fun!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_6_06.text:
Yes, that’s right!
I agree with what Cano said!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_6_07.text:
I was about to get sick and tired of sitting as a judge!
As long as I have Cano with me, I’m good!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_02.text:
Are you tired already?
It’s fine. Go sit over there. We have enough people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_03.text: Do you think I’m going to...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_04.text:
fall for that?
Okay, fine! Let’s do this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_05.text:
I always admire
how you don’t overthink things.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_06.text:
Guitars, you good?
Deemo! Will you be fine without a music score?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_08.text: Uh... Is it too much to ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_09.text:
No worries!
He’s been doing it without any sheet music!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_10.text:
Deemo's great at piano!
You can trust him on this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_8_02.text:
Deemo...
Everyone seems to be happy here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_8_03.text:
They’re not discouraged by the danger.
Everyone came together to get through this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_8_04.text: Could our world be like this if it weren’t for the Rain?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_8_07.text:
We are going to find the Composer who will stop the Rain.
And one day, we’ll all play together like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_8_08.text:
So, let’s give this performance our best!
Let’s go back home full of hope!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_9_02.text: Maybe I could use those two naive idiots...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_10_02.text:
Well, the Hasla Music Festival finally beings!
Everyone, let’s have fun!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_1_03.text: Deemo! The Rain stopped completely! We can stop playing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_1_04.text:
Cano! Look beneath you!
The audience - they're waking up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_1_05.text: Whew... I was worried they were all going to die...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_1_06.text:
Let’s go help them before they panic!
{PLAYER_NAME}! Will you lend a hand?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_01.text:
Uh... So you are saying
this is where HMF was being held?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_02.text:
Levine’s commotion knocked everyone unconscious.
The two from another world saved us. Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_04.text:
Oh, wow!
You two are truly brave heroes! We are grateful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_05.text: No, it wasn’t just the two of us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_06.text:
Shush! Quiet!
We could always use a new hero.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_07.text:
Cano...
She captivates the audience with that innocent face.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_08.text: I know all he wants to do is just get those two involved.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_10.text:
Well, they weren’t all lies!
Without you, we would've been buried in flowers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_12.text:
It’s just a little cheering up - no pressure.
Just enjoy this moment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_14.text:
Everyone! Now that we are all awake,
we don’t have anything else to worry about!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_15.text: But make sure you all go see your doctor!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_3_01.text:
Hahahaha!
We don’t have anything else to worry about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_3_02.text:
Oh, right.
We still have that to take care of.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_3_03.text: Tied up but still high-spirited as ever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_3_04.text:
No, I’m not the problem.
Do you guys not get it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_3_05.text:
The Rain?
Can’t you see it’s starting to rain again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_4_01.text:
You... You're right.
It’s starting to rain again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_4_02.text: Isn’t it dangerous to get rained on?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_4_03.text:
What?! What’s happening!?
I thought it was all over.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_4_04.text:
The Rain only stops for a little while.
It will rain again as long as the Rainclouds exist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_4_06.text:
W-What is this?!
Am I going to pass out like earlier!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_4_07.text:
We need to run!
We are all going to die otherwise!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_01.text:
You're safe as long as you're under this shield!
I’ll protect you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_02.text:
But not for long!
Is there another way?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_03.text:
Stay calm, Yuna.
Cano and I are fearless together. Nothing to worry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_04.text: Do you think Cano is some god!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_05.text:
Okay, the situation may seem hopeless...
The Rain briefly stopped, nothing more than that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_07.text:
But the Rainclouds aren't that big at the moment.
Now that everyone’s awake, we can escape now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_08.text:
Um... that’s going to be difficult.
We don’t know how much longer we can last like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_09.text: Should we beat up Levine to open the portal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_10.text:
What should we do...
Are we all going to die for real this time!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_11.text: No! I don’t want to die here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_12.text:
E-Everyone, stay calm!
We’re not going to die!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_13.text: But it doesn’t look like we have a choice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_14.text: If you have a way out of this, now is the time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_15.text: Ah, I’m a reporter covering HMF. How did I get into this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_6_01.text: The more people, the more chaotic it gets.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_6_02.text: Should we all just make everyone pass out again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_6_03.text: Stop! What do you think you are doing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_6_04.text:
Cano, let’s help everyone to escape.
Their lives should come before anything else.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_6_06.text:
I can’t breathe when we’re all about to die!
...Cano?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_7_01.text: Did someone say hopeless? That might not be true.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_7_02.text:
We are all awake - we can all sing together!
Right now might be the most hopeful ever!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_7_03.text:
Our music, our song can make this Rain go away!
Right? Echo!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_7_04.text: But, what about the rain clouds...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_7_05.text:
Louder music! More sound is all we need!
We can do anything together!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_7_06.text:
Don't worry!
Together, we can be as strong as we want to be!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_7_07.text:
Oh, Cano, our hero!
She never gives up in the face of hardships!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_7_09.text: Cano’s right. What is the point of worrying?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_7_10.text:
Maybe Cano Band planned this whole thing!?
The Rain, the apocalypse-like situation...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_7_11.text: Alexander! A super rich guy, but this is wow...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_7_12.text: Someone definitely wanted this HMF to be memorable!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_7_13.text: A new stage in the blink of an eye!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_7_14.text:
Everyone! Let’s just enjoy ourselves for now!
Cano Band's title track! Everyone familiar?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_7_16.text:
Deemo!
Do you think you can help us out one last time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_8_01.text:
No problem!
Deemo can play along to any song!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_8_02.text:
Even to something he’s never heard before?
That’s some talent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_8_03.text:
Those Rainclouds have been our lifelong mission.
Deemo do would anything to make it happen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_8_05.text:
Great! So reliable!
What about you guitar people!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_9_01.text: We can play for as long as we need!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_9_02.text:
Although we would want to be at the center of the stage.
But, we can worry about that later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_9_04.text: All set to go! Whenever you are ready, Cano!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_9_05.text:
Darn it! Nothing's going to stop us now!
It’s either those clouds or us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_9_06.text:
And everyone in the audience!
Ready to scream, jump, and enjoy!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_10_01.text:
Hahaha! I’m free now...
...What is this place?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_10_02.text:
The coordinates were correct!?
Why does this keep on happening?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_10_03.text:
Can you stop causing a mess?
There’s only so much that can be recorded in a book.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_10_05.text:
You don’t want to know.
Just go back to #where you were#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_10_06.text:
As if nothing had happened
I will send you back to that prison.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_10_07.text:
Nonsense!
Do you have any idea how I got out!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_10_08.text: Ha! Humans these days just don’t listen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_12_01.text: Go in through that portal, and you’ll be home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_12_02.text:
To exactly where you came from.
As if nothing had happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_12_03.text:
I guess you are helping us, right? Thank you!
I will never forget your kindness!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_12_05.text: ...Will I forget everything once I go back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_12_06.text: Oh, I guess I didn’t need to tell you that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_12_07.text: Is there a way to go back without forgetting everything?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_12_08.text:
I gained so much courage and hope here.
I was so excited to see a clear sky back home...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_12_09.text: I don’t want to forget everything that happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_12_11.text:
Universes must not interfere with each other.
What you learned here cannot be used in your world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_12_12.text: What happened here should stay here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_12_14.text:
Yes, very.
To the extent that it could distort the galaxy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_12_15.text:
Alright, then.
I won’t be stubborn.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_13_01.text:
Um. Can I ask for...
one last favor?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_13_02.text:
Can you tell everyone
that I’m grateful for all the good memories?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_13_03.text:
Don’t you worry.
The records will remember what happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_13_04.text:
Great! Thanks!
We should get going!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_13_05.text:
Bye bye.
...Good luck to you too, guardian spirit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_14_01.text: Well, shall we close the book now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_1_01.text: The Rainclouds... they are all gone...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_1_02.text:
I knew it was possible!
Together we saved the world!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_1_03.text:
Such a cliche, but oh well.
We actually did it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_1_04.text:
Deemo! The Rainclouds vanished completely!
Look! The sky is so clear!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_2_01.text: That happy over a clear sky?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_2_02.text:
I feel for her.
She’s never seen a clear sky where she came from.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_2_06.text:
You still shouldn’t give her the eye for being happy.
As superstars, we are supposed to make kids smile.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_3_01.text:
Haha, did I sound too excited?
But a clear sky has never made me this happy before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_3_02.text:
If only I could be assured this would be my reward.
I would be so motivated!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_3_03.text: I would love for my friends at the station to see this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_01.text: Well, I don’t want to ruin the excitement, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_02.text: you two should hurry back home before it’s too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_03.text:
Oh What do you mean?
You said going back was a piece of cake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_04.text: Well, yes, because I know the return coordinates.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_05.text:
You mean, those coordinates might become useless soon 
because the universe just keeps expanding?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_06.text:
You know what you’re talking about.
The teleporter can handle only so much arithmetic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_07.text: Um, what on earth are we talking about...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_08.text: That you might not be able to go back if it’s too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_09.text:
T-That's really bad!
We should go back and stop the Rain in our universe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_11.text:
It’s okay, Deemo.
I would want to admire the sky a little longer...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_12.text:
but first, find the Composer and stop the Rain back home!
The sky over the station will clear up like this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_13.text:
Well, will someone loosen the rope?
So that I can open up the portal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_14.text: I’m sure I can teach myself to operate the device.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_15.text:
That would be too late.
You're wasting the golden hour.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_17.text:
What... Hey, I know I’m the one to blame.
So? Are you going to untie me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_18.text:
Hmm, I don’t believe that you’ve turned over a new leaf.
But I guess I have no choice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_4_19.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, You can untie him if you want.
Even if he tries to do anything, I can handle him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_5_01.text:
Hey, you two.
Come this way if you want to go home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_6_02.text:
It’s because of this guy you two ended up here.
If anyone, it’s this guy who should apologize.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_6_03.text:
Uh, that’s not true.
It was an accident, but a good one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_6_04.text:
I saw what a clear sky is,
and I learned the joy of playing music together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_6_05.text:
Honestly, I’m very grateful!
I will never forget what happened today!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_6_07.text:
That’s great to hear!
We had fun too, thank you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_6_08.text:
Are you done saying your goodbyes?
You two should get going.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_7_03.text:
You fools! I’m free!
I can run away all I want!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_7_04.text:
Of course he was planning something.
Where will that portal take you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_7_05.text:
What makes you think I would tell you?!
I’m the one running!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_7_06.text:
What? You piece of...!
What happened to the other two!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_7_07.text:
Don’t worry, they're safe.
They’re going to be my travel buddies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_7_08.text:
I needed someone to do the chores anyway.
And I could use that shield she was using.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_7_09.text:
So long, kiddos!
I’ll anticipate a showdown match next time we meet!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_8_01.text:
Jeez!
I should've been more careful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_8_02.text:
Don’t worry.
I placed a location tracker on him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_8_04.text:
I knew he would pull off something like this.
We will know where he went...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_8_05.text:
Alright! They helped us get through this!
So let’s go save them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_8_06.text: Uh, um, I don’t think that will be necessary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_8_08.text: Levine - he went back to the prison in Neth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_8_09.text:
What are you talking about...
You think he turned himself in?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_8_10.text:
I don’t take him for that type.
What has happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_9_01.text:
Uh, are we at...
the Composer’s room?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_9_03.text:
Oh, never mind.
All those books had me confused.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_9_05.text:
You don’t want to know.
Think of this place as a library.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_9_06.text: Does that mean we didn’t make it back home?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_END_9_07.text:
Don’t worry. I will send you back soon.
There was just a little glitch.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_10_01.text:
Ooh! We have some enthusiastic audience here with us!
Your screams are enough to shake the stage!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_10_02.text: But the audience didn’t move at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_10_04.text:
W-what’s going on?
This wasn’t part of the script!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_10_05.text:
Calm down, Meri.
As superstar idols, we must stay calm...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_10_06.text:
Everyone, run!
Reaction from a gigantic teleporter! Everybody, out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_10_07.text:
Wahhhhhhh!!! Help!
I’m too young to die!!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_10_08.text:
Everyone! Stay calm!
Everyone, don’t panic! Keep order!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_10_09.text:
It might be too late...! Cover your heads!
The dimensional shift will distort the space!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_11_01.text:
What on earth is this?!
Where is the stage!? Where are we?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_11_02.text:
That was definitely a reaction from the teleporter.
But... Have the universes been mixed?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_11_03.text: Does that mean we are in a different universe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_11_04.text:
No, our coordinates are the same as before.
We didn’t move but... our world changed partially.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_11_05.text:
The world has changed!?
Who would do something like that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_11_06.text: There’s only one who’s capable of doing it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_12_01.text:
Yes, Levine.
I knew that fool was involved somehow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_12_02.text: Well, we are not lost in space at least.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_12_03.text: Hey, Levine! What have you done this time!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_12_05.text:
I could punch him in the stomach right now...
Let me go check on the others!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_13_01.text:
Why are you stopping me, {PLAYER_NAME}?
We must save the people!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_13_02.text:
Relax and just look around.
Why are we the only ones who are unaffected?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_13_03.text: That’s because... of our rock spirit?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_13_04.text: I don’t have anything like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_13_06.text: Accidents don't discriminate based on the backgrounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_13_08.text:
Look around. It’s raining everywhere but here.
Those who have been exposed to the Rain collapsed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_13_09.text:
I think those weird Rainclouds came through the portal.
The acidic Rain could be harmful, so don't get wet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_13_10.text:
Ugh! That’s nonsense!
No time to be careful. We should save the others!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_13_11.text: Wait... Hold on! Don't move! Stay away from the Rain!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_14_01.text:
Deemo! Everyone collapsed!
The Rain made the flowers bloom...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_14_02.text: Everyone's going to vanish at this rate!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_14_03.text:
But the shield doesn’t get any wider than this...
What should we do...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_14_05.text: Deemo? Why are you holding the Magic Bottle…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_14_07.text: Okay, let me focus once again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_14_08.text:
I don’t know if it will work, but...
I feel something different this time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_01.text:
D-Deemo! Look!
The power from the Magic Bottle grew really big!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_03.text:
Do you think this universe helped it grow?
Thank goodness we could save everyone...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_04.text:
I don’t know where you came from, but thank you anyway.
If it weren’t for you, we would’ve been unconscious too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_05.text:
No need to thank us!
We are all altruistic in one way or another.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_06.text:
So... who are you guys exactly?
Do you have any idea of what happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_07.text:
We are not sure.
We suddenly fell into a hole, then from the sky...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_08.text:
It’s fine.
Once that idiot wakes up, we’ll know what happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_09.text:
It's not fine! The Rain made the flowers bloom!
They might all vanish if we don't do anything!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_10.text:
Well, he does deserve it.
But it's kind of a pain if he vanishes in this world…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_11.text:
Uh... Rain!?
The Rain kills people!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_12.text:
Do you not know what this Rain is?
This Rain will cover you with flowers and make you vanish!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_13.text:
It just looks like normal rain though?
It doesn't make sense that rain can make you disappear…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_14.text: By now, you should know that nothing makes sense.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_15.text:
Everyone who's been exposed to the Rain has collapsed.
We were lucky we stayed under the shield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_16.text: Stay under the shield if you want to stay alive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_17.text: So we wait until the Rain stops leaving them die?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_18.text:
No, it’s okay!
Luckily we have a piano here, we can do something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_19.text:
This piano can stop the Rain temporarily.
Then, we will bring everyone under the shield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_20.text:
Deemo! Can I ask you a favor?
Could you play the piano and stop the Rain?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_15_22.text:
Of course! Thanks!
When Deemo plays, bring everyone by the piano! Okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_1_01.text:
I’m going to ask one last time. Levine Ludovico.
Where did you hide the #teleporter device# you made?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_1_02.text:
Like I said, I don’t know.
Maybe it’ll ring a bell if you let me go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_1_03.text:
That’s not possible because
you’re going to overthrow the state.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_1_04.text:
Your ability is too dangerous to be let loose.
We are looking for your teleporter to hide it from the world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_1_05.text:
Huh? Hide? Why not just destroy it?
Don’t you worry. I can make it a hundred times over.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_1_06.text:
So let me go!
My brain deserves better than this place!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_1_07.text: Not until you are ready to reflect on what you’ve done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_1_08.text:
That’s what I’m doing!
I’ll help you build all-new Neth, so let me go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_1_09.text:
I will when I'm convinced 
that you've learned your lesson.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_1_10.text: Would a one-page letter of apology do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_1_11.text: Hah... I’m going to give you some time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_1_12.text: Hopefully you will understand what you've done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_2_01.text:
Sir Levine.
I bring with me a delivery from the noble members.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_2_02.text:
Oh, you are the agent they sent?
You are way past your ETA.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_2_03.text:
My apologies, sir.
The noble powers have grown weak,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_2_04.text: So you need my help to reclaim the lost powers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_2_05.text:
I don’t want to have anything to do with them...
but I guess I have no choice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_2_06.text:
Where’s the #teleporter remote control#? Give it to me.
I can’t wait to get out of this place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_2_07.text: Do you want to come along?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_2_08.text:
I’ve already secured my own escape route.
I’ll be on my way. Good luck, sir.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_3_02.text:
I’m a goner now.
I don’t know how I ended up being so disrespected...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_3_03.text:
...all because of those Hero Town fools.
Just wait till I get out of here. I’ll get revenge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_3_04.text:
Well, it’s about time to escape.
Is the teleporter where I left it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_3_05.text:
Oh, good. I guess it's warmed up properly. 
Let me configure the settings...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_4_01.text:
W-what is this! What’s going on?
Weird... I didn’t press wrong buttons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_4_02.text:
Wait, the received signal was redundant.
Did someone jam the signal? No, it can’t be...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_4_03.text:
No! It won’t stop!
I’m doomed! At this rate...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_5_01.text:
Sorry, Deemo.
Can we take a short break?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_6_01.text: It’s fine. I’m not hurt - just a little tired.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_6_02.text:
What about you, Deemo?
That was quite a walk. Aren’t you tired?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_6_04.text:
Hehe, well, you’re a Guardian created by
The Magician afterall. Must be way stronger than me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_7_01.text:
W-what’s going on?!
The ground is shaking... How come?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_7_04.text:
It-It should stop soon!
Let’s wait it out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_8_02.text:
The ground disappeared!
Deemo! Hold my hand! Don’t let it go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_01.text:
Yes! Here we are again!
It’s back! The 5th Hasla Music Festival! a.k.a. #HMF#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_02.text: We have the members of Cano Band as judges!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_03.text:
Nice to see everyone!
I’m Cano—Cano Band’s leader! Show us what you got!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_04.text:
I’m Yuna, a superstar idol!
Good luck this year as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_05.text:
I’m here only because Cano asked me...
I think this festival happens way too often.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_06.text: It's only been a few months since the last one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_07.text:
Meri! Don’t say that!
The more festivals, the merrier!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_08.text:
Well, if you say so...
I get it, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_09.text:
You seem to obey Cano for everything.
Try not to spoil her too much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_10.text:
Don’t be silly, Yuna.
We're just a good team, that’s all. Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_11.text:
Exactly! Forever one, Cano Band!
We’re looking forward to your sincere comments!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_13.text: Now! Over there, we have the winners from the last HMF!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_14.text:
Jeomrye, our 3rd winner! Caroline, our 4th winner!
And, of course, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_15.text: Now! Let’s hear some tips from our defending champions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_16.text:
I don’t think I deserved the championship last year.
So this year, I’ll make sure I truly win it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_17.text:
Bring it on!
I’ll show you what I got.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_OP_9_18.text:
Wow! I love this enthusiasm!
Well, let the 5th HMF get started!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_10_1_03.text:
I finished the job!
This is the power of Ogre Tech!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_10_1_04.text:
I-it should be a best of 3!
When Bo grows back up, let’s fight again...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_10_1_05.text:
Nah! Haha! You suck! Your plants are soooo weak!
Puhaha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_10_1_06.text:
Hng... I have to stand up for Bo...!
I’ll fight then!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_10_1_07.text:
My babies... watch me...!
Mommy will avenge you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_10_2_01.text:
You sure turn into someone
else when your plants are involved...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_10_2_02.text: This is annoying... what should I do...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_10_2_03.text:
O-oh yeah! Don’t you remember?
Sir Gordian prohibits fights between the Elite Four!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_10_2_04.text:
I really want to teach you a lesson,
but I’m a really busy ogre! Bye!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_10_2_05.text:
The Elite Four disbanded ages ago...
Are you s-scared, Ozma?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_10_3_01.text:
W-what?! Do you really want a piece of me?!
Fine! Let’s do this then!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_10_3_02.text:
Aubrey! Can you be the referee for this fight?!
So the fight’s fair and square!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_10_4_01.text:
...No. I’m busy.
Deal with this on your own...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_10_4_02.text:
These girls are so childish.
{player_name} must be a saint to put up with them...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_11_1_02.text:
Where did {player_name} go...?
I’ve been looking everywhere for Captain!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_11_1_03.text:
The resting place of the departed...
I should stop and rest a bit here, heh.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_11_1_04.text: ...The resting place for those who’ve departed...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_11_1_05.text: The beings buried here were once “all-powerful.”

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_11_1_06.text:
They just happened to mess with the wrong person.
{player_name} put them in their place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_11_1_07.text:
That’s why you don’t mess with just anyone!
It’s karma! Haha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_11_2_01.text:
W-what the?!
Did you hear me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_11_2_02.text: So what! What are you going to do about it?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_11_2_03.text: I might be tired, but I can take you on myself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_1_01.text: Whew... that was a difficult fight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_1_02.text:
There were too many of them.
If only Dionne was here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_1_03.text: So many sacrifices were made to end this fight...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_03.text:
My bad!
I didn’t see you guys there, heh.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_04.text:
Anyway, thanks for your help!
I would’ve struggled without you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_05.text:
But were you three always this close?
What a combo, haha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_06.text:
I feel the same way. But the three of us
worked really well as a team, long, long ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_07.text:
We coincidentally ran into each other. It reminded us
of the old days, so we decided to stick together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_08.text:
I heard {player_name} is missing. We also heard
that the Goddesses are looking for the Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_09.text:
But how did the dead come back to life?
What’s happening here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_10.text:
I’m not too sure myself.
But I think Bella told me about this before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_11.text:
When the dimensions are twisted beyond control,
the border between life and death weakens.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_12.text: Are you saying that the dimensions are twisted right now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_13.text:
Oh? I guess so?
I even saw Sera. Something’s definitely off.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_14.text: Maybe the world is coming to an end, haha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_15.text: ...Don’t say such a scary thing, Anut.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_16.text:
Of course I’m kidding! This world will never end!
{player_name} is protecting Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_18.text: That’s why we are looking for the Captain...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_19.text: So, where in the world is the Captain hiding?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_20.text: Maybe something serious is going on...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_12_2_21.text:
Are the twisted dimensions the root of the problem?
Agh, I should get going.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_13_1_01.text:
It’s almost over.
Hold still. Don’t move.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_13_2_02.text: Once I’m done, I’ll let you go. Don’t worry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_13_2_03.text:
I wouldn’t have needed to do this if you didn’t
interfere!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_13_2_04.text: You should’ve kept your word, Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_13_2_05.text: Hold still and bear with me for a while longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_13_2_06.text:
The #Most Powerful Scarecrow# that you were
looking for will soon be complete!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_14_2_03.text:
It’s a bit too long to explain... do you not remember?
Fergus bonked you on the head with his hammer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_14_2_04.text:
(You tell Sera your head still hurts and that you
think you saw a cutscene of it happening.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_14_2_06.text:
We are outside of Hasla, at the #Crevice of Dimensions.#
We are stuck in-between dimensions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_14_2_07.text:
It’s a place of the past, present, and future.
Anything is possible here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_14_2_08.text:
We were sucked in through the dimensions
and ended up here. Everything is twisted in a knot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_14_2_09.text: (You ask if we are lost in the dimensions.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_14_2_10.text:
Yes, Captain. That’s why we look different right now.
Anything can happen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_14_2_11.text:
You look really unique here in this dimension.
A long time ago, I mistook you for Leon, hehe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_14_2_12.text:
But I can still recognize you.
I had a feeling you were the Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_14_2_13.text: You will always be our beloved Captain!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_14_3_01.text:
This reminds me of the old days, {player_name}.
You rescued me at Hyro Forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_14_3_02.text:
I’m so glad to have you stuck here with me!
You always find a way out. No matter the situation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_14_3_03.text: (You shrug and ask what to do.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_14_4_01.text:
Oh, wait, Captain! This isn’t the time!
Prestina is in danger, help!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_2_04.text: (You ask why she’s a golem again.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_2_05.text:
I’m sorry, but I don’t remember.
The Apostles’ influence on me should’ve disappeared.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_2_06.text:
I was on my way to help you and Sera...
The next minute, I woke up, here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_2_07.text:
Where are we?
It looks like Hyro Forest, but it feels different.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_3_01.text:
I see. The Crevice of Dimensions.
A place of infinite possibilities...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_3_02.text:
I think the dimensions are based on my memories.
It’s reacting to my thoughts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_3_03.text: It’s probably the reason why you transformed into a golem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_3_04.text:
(“Is that also the reason why I’m talking like this?”
You ask.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_3_06.text:
I heard others talking about it.
That long ago, you used to talk like that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_3_07.text: I guess I wanted to hear you talk, Captain. Hehe...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_3_09.text: But it’s kind of lame, to be honest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_3_10.text: (You tell her you don’t want to communicate like this.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_3_11.text: (“But life doesn’t always work out as planned,” you say.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_3_12.text: Hehe, that’s why life is so fun, don’t you think so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_01.text: Ugh, you’re going silent again, Captain!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_02.text: ...But that’s exactly why I like you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_03.text: It relaxes me to see you guys quarrel again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_05.text:
But if we are stuck here in-between the dimensions,
what’s happening to our home?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_06.text:
Fergus’s new scarecrow was too powerful.
It warped time and space around it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_07.text:
It eventually ripped through the dimensions
as it was weakened with Arart’s absence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_08.text:
...And we were sucked in.
I think there are more people who’re affected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_09.text:
I feel like strange things are happening all over Hasla.
I can feel it in my body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_10.text:
That scarecrow isn’t even complete, yet...
Things will escalate if Fergus finishes his project.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_11.text:
Sera! When did you learn to speak
so clearly like that without stuttering?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_13.text:
Hng... I’m not an apprentice anymore, Prestina.
I’m Goddess Hasla...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_14.text:
My apologies, it’s an old habit...
I keep seeing you as my apprentice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_15.text: But we’re indeed in a dangerous situation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_16.text:
Hasla will fall into grave danger if we leave it be.
Let’s hurry back and stop this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_4_17.text: Okay! My powers should be sufficient to bring us back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_5_01.text: I’m so glad you’re alright, Prestina!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_5_03.text:
But... I was super worried, Prestina.
I’m so glad we got back safely.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_5_05.text:
Despite all that’s happened,
you are still you, Sera.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_15_5_09.text:
{player_name}, I think...
We need your help, again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_1_02.text:
Where am I?
I was in Pumpkin City a moment ago!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_1_04.text: This is our Hero Town. I’m back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_1_05.text:
Whew...
My body still feels hard and cubey...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_1_06.text:
Kukukuku!
I see you’ve all been troubled with something!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_1_09.text: I’m glad you are all okay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_1_10.text:
Wait the Captain is here?!
Where were you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_1_11.text: We’ve been looking all over for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_1_12.text:
Now’s not the time for chit chat.
It looks like we have a bigger problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_1_14.text:
*Gasp* You’re right!
We need to hurry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_2_01.text:
Oh! Captain {player_name}!
You’re back! I knew you’d survive that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_2_02.text:
That’s not important!
What is this malicious-looking machine?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_2_04.text:
Hahaha! Lednas! You sure are observant!
I just completed it! Let me introduce you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_2_06.text:
This is my masterpiece! A true work of art!
Its powers match that of the gods!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_2_07.text:
It’s named, #Absolute Ultimate Deluxe Ultra Practice#
#Scarecrow Type DX-ZERO#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_3_01.text:
Abso-what?
Uhm, can you repeat that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_3_02.text:
Hahaha! I can repeat it a thousand times!
Listen closely. This is #Absolute Ultimate#-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_3_03.text: No! You don’t have to repeat it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_3_04.text:
Fergus, this scarecrow...
Did you just say you finished making it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_3_05.text:
Oh, are you interested in it, too?
Doesn’t it look wonderful, Sera?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_3_06.text:
I finished it,
just before you guys arrived!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_4_01.text:
Oh look! It’s activating!
Hahaha! Show the Goddesses a trick!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_4_06.text:
Huh? Papa? Did you just call me papa?
Did you hear that?! It recognized me as its parent!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_4_08.text:
Look! {player_name}! Did you hear that!
Oh, my sweet child!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_4_09.text: I don’t think it’s saying what you think it’s saying...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_5_04.text: Kukuku! Get up! Let’s follow it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_6_01.text: We almost caught up to it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_6_02.text: It ran into the practice room!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_6_05.text:
The scarecrow went missing recently in the practice room.
Fergus must’ve taken it to upgrade it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_6_07.text:
...That means this place is that scarecrow’s
home in a sense?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_6_09.text:
I think now’s our chance.
Before it realizes we are here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_7_02.text: My apology for speaking so rashly!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_16_7_03.text:
This isn’t the time to chat.
Let’s get ready to stop that thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_1_01.text:
No don’t do this! Please! I beg you!
Think about the good times we shared!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_1_02.text:
This scarecrow is like a child to me!
It recognized me as its father!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_1_03.text:
The child didn’t do anything wrong! It’s my fault!
As its father, I’ll teach it well. Please!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_1_04.text:
It didn’t say what you are claiming it said...
It was trying to say it was in pain...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_1_05.text:
T-that’s not important! Look at its eyes!
It’s asking to be cradled and loved!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_1_06.text:
All it wants is to be loved!
It’s not good at expressing its feelings yet!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_1_07.text:
...Maybe you shouldn’t have hammered it so hard.
I think it’s genuinely in pain...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_1_08.text: How many times did you hit it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_1_09.text: It was in such pain that it ran home!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_2_02.text:
You heard that, right?!
I’m not mishearing this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_2_04.text:
I guess there is a father-child relationship
going on here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_2_05.text: This brings a tear to my eye... Kuku.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_2_06.text:
Oh my sweet child! Papa is here!
#Absolute Ultimate Deluxe Scarecrow#, my child!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_3_02.text: I don’t feel any malicious intent from the scarecrow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_17_3_03.text:
Since Fergus is asking us so sincerely,
maybe we should stop and leave them be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_3_02.text: What did you... do to me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_3_04.text: That’s what I want to ask.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_4_07.text: Now that you say it, you do look like Lednas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_4_09.text: Since you say that, does that mean...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_5_02.text:
My apology for not recognizing you.
You look... stubby and you aren’t even yellow...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_5_03.text: I barely recognized you, too. Your outfit gave you away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_5_04.text:
Even a goddess has been transformed...
I wonder how I look right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_5_05.text: So where are we? Why have we transformed like this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_6_04.text:
We wouldn’t even be able to recognize the Gacha Rangers.
This place feels dull and colorless.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_6_05.text:
At a time like this, our best bet would be to
speak with the town NPCs.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_6_06.text:
I understand that is our best option,
but you also used to be a town NP...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_6_07.text:
I see Bridget over there!
I also see Popo and Toto.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_6_08.text:
Bridget! It’s me, Lednas.
I have a few questions I want to ask you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_6_09.text: ...There’s no response. It’s just a background.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_6_10.text:
It’s very strange. The whole town seems... dead.
What happened here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_6_11.text:
This can’t be the Hero Town that we know.
It has to be another place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_6_12.text:
But...
What in the world is going on here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_6_14.text:
What was I doing?
Ugh, my head. I don’t remember.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_6_15.text:
All I remember is that
I was looking for something important.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_6_16.text:
What do you think happened?
Why did we end up here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_7_03.text:
Although it looks blocky,
there’s no way I’d miss that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_7_04.text:
It’s a warmachine used during the war in Neth.
It spits out flame that engulfs its victims.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_7_05.text:
Countless mercenaries fell victim
to that tank...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_7_07.text: ...But why is that thing here in Hero Town?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_7_08.text: Something bad is definitely going on here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_7_09.text:
And a monster is tailing us...
A jellyfish? How random.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_7_10.text:
That’s a deep sea jellyfish!
Be careful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_7_11.text:
It’s just a jellyfish...
It doesn’t look dangerous, at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_7_12.text:
You have no idea! Jellyfish were at the top of the food
chain in the deep sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_7_13.text:
They were the apex predators!
Countless captains cowered at the sight of them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_7_14.text:
Then I suppose it’d be bad news if they
continue to follow us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_7_15.text:
...Lednas.
I think you just jinxed it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_1_8_02.text: We should avoid it at all cost!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_2_1_01.text:
Hasla would’ve been in ruins if there were more of them.
That wasn’t an easy fight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_2_1_02.text:
Thank you for your help.
You are D’Artagnan, Maria, and Robin, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_2_1_03.text: It was easy to tell who you were.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_2_2_01.text:
...Everyone here sure is quiet.
Just like {player_name}...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_2_2_03.text:
I remember now!
I was looking for Captain before coming here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_2_2_04.text:
I think I was doing the same.
{player_name} suddenly disappeared.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_2_2_05.text: Did you three see the Captain by any chance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_2_3_01.text:
I don’t think they understand us.
Captain could’ve communicated without talking...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_2_3_02.text: Who knows. I don’t think the Captain is here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_2_3_03.text:
This is quite troubling.
I thought we were finally at peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_2_3_04.text: Let’s find a way out of here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_2_3_05.text:
I agree.
Let’s look for the Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_1_02.text: The most powerful and evil being?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_1_03.text:
...Alright. I’ll give you what you want.
The power that matches the gods.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_2_03.text:
It feels like I got bashed on my head with a hammer.
...I guess I had a bit too much to drink.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_3_02.text:
Ugh, I barely remember anything...
Did I blackout?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_3_03.text:
Okay, let’s recall my memory.
I think I was looking for the Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_3_04.text:
Then I met Alexander at the Mystic Sea beach.
Then we had some #Chateau de Hasla 811#...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_3_05.text:
Ugh, I told him that we shouldn’t overdo it.
...But where am I?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_3_06.text:
Seeing the tents here, I don’t think it’s Hero Town.
They look old and worn. Is this a campsite?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_3_07.text:
But there are also buildings...
Where in Hasla is this place?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_3_08.text: Ugh, my hangover probably has nothing to do with this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_3_09.text:
I guess I should prioritize figuring out where I am.
Let’s get moving.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_4_01.text:
Is this Hyro Forest?
That means the place I was at... is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_6_01.text:
Yeowoodong, look at her!
She has a gorgeous face!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_6_02.text:
She looks so beautiful...! Even topping Rachel,
the star of the Succubus Troupe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_6_03.text: Is she a movie star from another country?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_6_04.text:
She might be! I can’t believe she walked into
this dangerous forest unarmed though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_6_05.text:
...Are you Joan, Yeowoodong, and Rachel?
Why do you look so different?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_6_07.text:
...Do you not recognize me?
I’m the Daughter of Cora, the Chancellor of Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_6_11.text: I don’t understand what you’re saying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_6_12.text:
...I am the Goddess Sylunis.
Do you not remember me and the Empire?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_6_15.text: Are you acting as a movie star?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_6_17.text:
Joan, you are a knight of Grancia!
We used to work together!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_6_18.text: What are you talking about? I’m a mercenary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_6_19.text:
What?
Am I dreaming or something?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_6_20.text:
I suppose...
I’ve mistaken you for someone I know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_6_22.text:
We are heroes of the #Let’s Go Hero Group#.
We were patrolling the woods.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_3_7_03.text:
They’re here again! Stop them!
We will protect you! Get back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_1_01.text: Are you alright? Are you hurt?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_1_02.text:
Sorry I wasn’t of any help.
This hangover is killing... Let me thank you properly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_1_03.text:
Anyway, you guys said
that you are from the Let’s Go Hero Group?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_1_04.text: Yes. It’s our job to protect this area.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_1_05.text:
...I heard of that name before.
This must be the past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_1_06.text:
A time where even the Goddesses didn’t exist yet.
And the Let’s Go Heroes that protected the lands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_1_07.text:
I always thought it was just a legend.
If I’ve traveled to the past...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_1_08.text:
No, it can’t be true.
The flow of time doesn’t seem twisted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_1_09.text:
The only explanation is that I’m in another dimension...
This isn’t the Hasla I’m familiar with.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_1_10.text:
A place of the past in its present...
A Hasla of another dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_1_12.text:
I was looking for the missing Captain...
Is this in any way related to {player_name}‘s disappearance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_2_01.text: ...What are you talking to yourself about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_2_02.text: Maybe, she’s REALLY into her character for the movie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_2_03.text: Let’s not bother her then and move along.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_4_3_03.text:
Ugh, I’ll have to find a way out of here.
I wonder what’s happening in my home dimension...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_1_01.text: Ugh... I didn’t think a sinkhole would appear...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_1_02.text:
I was looking for the Captain,
but I ended up venturing out too far.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_1_03.text:
Kukuku, but to catch a tiger, I have to enter its den!
I’m sure {player_name} is up to something dangerous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_1_04.text:
Hmm, so where am I?
It seems like a type of ancient ruins of some kind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_2_01.text:
Oh, there seems to be some familiar faces here.
I thought I fell into something soft!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_2_02.text:
These animals... are you #Divine Beasts#?
It’s been so long since I’ve seen your kind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_2_03.text:
I thought all of you were sealed away
by {player_name}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_2_04.text:
When the Roman Colosseum shut down, the beasts who had
nowhere to go had an explosive population growth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_2_05.text:
They were sealed away for the sake of preserving the
environment. Kukuku.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_3_01.text: Hmm, these beasts seem wild and untamed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_3_02.text:
When the seal wore off and they woke up,
did it also trigger their animal instincts?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_3_03.text:
Hmm, I shouldn’t ignore this.
I should seal them away just in case.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_4_01.text: Kukuku, how exciting! Do you want a piece of me?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_5_01.text:
Kukuku! How aggressive!
I love it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_5_02.text:
Since it came down to this,
I guess I’ll play with you for a while!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_5_03.text:
Ah... this feeling...
It’s been 7 years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_5_5_04.text: It’s time to go back to being “Goddess of War, Dionne.”

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_6_1_01.text:
Kukukuku!
That felt great! I feel like myself again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_6_1_02.text: Hmm, I hope I didn’t accidentally kill them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_6_1_03.text:
They’re technically endangered animals...
Maybe I should’ve been more considerate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_6_1_04.text:
How unfortunate.
You guys should’ve stayed asleep!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_6_1_05.text: But with that said, I still had fun. Kukuku!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_6_1_06.text: But I wonder what awakened them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_6_1_07.text:
A person like {player_name} wouldn’t make this mistake.
Something big must be at play here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_6_1_08.text:
I have a bad feeling about this.
I should hurry and look for {player_name}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_6_2_01.text:
Heh, gearing up for another round, are we? It's obvious I'll win anyway.
But bring it! I’ll take you on anytime! Kukuku!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_7_1_02.text: How much longer do I have to run for?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_7_1_04.text: Ahh! What is going on here?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_7_1_05.text: What am I doing?! I’m sorry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_7_1_06.text: What’s {player_name} doing at a time like this?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_7_1_08.text:
Hey, come to your senses!
Why are you doing this?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_7_1_11.text:
Ah, screw it!
Kyahaha!!! Rampage more, Pumpking!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_7_1_12.text: Don’t just give up! DO SOMETHING!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_01.text:
*Huff*
I haven’t run like this my whole life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_02.text:
Pumpkin patch gardener Pumpqueen and Pumpking.
You are under arrest for mischief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_03.text:
You have the right to remain silent.
Anything you say can and will be used against...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_04.text:
Hey! Listen to me! It isn’t my fault!
Our mana suddenly spiked for some reason!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_05.text:
If I wanted revenge, I would go after YOU!
Why would I destroy the city? It’s my home, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_06.text: Look! Even Pumpking is looking sad right now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_09.text:
Didn’t you scream, “Rampage more, Pumpking?”
You yelled really loudly...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_10.text: I mean, if I can’t avoid it, I should at least enjoy it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_12.text:
But it’s the truth!
Wah! You guys are always so mean to me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_13.text:
We should punish them. Make them watch over
the pumpkin patch for the rest of their lives!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_14.text:
Hmm, but...
I don’t think she’s lying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_15.text:
I feel the shift in flow of mana all throughout Hasla.
Too much of it is being focused into one place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_16.text:
I don’t know what’s going on,
but it might’ve caused that pumpkin to react to it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_17.text: If that’s what you think ma’am, I guess we’ll let her-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_1_20.text: But I wonder if THEY will forgive you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_2_02.text: Excuse me, can I leave now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_8_3_01.text: Did you really not expect this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_10_01.text: D-did you just call my plant a dummy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_10_02.text: ...Whose side are you even on, Jack?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_10_03.text: I won’t lose to some bundle of grass!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_10_04.text:
I will burn them all down,
like weed in a garden!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_10_06.text:
It doesn’t matter if you call Bo a “bundle of grass.”
It’s true...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_10_07.text:
B-but I won’t just let this slide!
How dare you call Bo a “bundle of grass!”

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_10_09.text:
Besides!
Bo is stronger than that hunk of metal!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_11_01.text: Did you just call my invention a hunk of metal?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_11_02.text:
B-but...!
That puny invention can’t stop my plant!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_11_03.text:
Are you done talking?!
Let’s see who’s stronger right here and now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_1_01.text:
Hmm... I ended up climbing so high.
I can see Hasla at its entirety from up here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_1_02.text:
...Too high to spot anyone though.
Where in the world is {player_name}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_3_01.text: Wait, are you looking for {player_name}, too?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_3_02.text:
Yeah!
Do you know where Captain is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_3_03.text:
I was going to ask you the same thing!
Why are you looking for {player_name}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_3_04.text:
It’s urgent!
Only {player_name} can help me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_3_05.text:
Unfortunately, {player_name} is missing.
I’m also looking for the Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_3_07.text:
If it’s that urgent, I might be able to help.
What is your issue?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_3_08.text:
My plants are on a rampage!
They won’t listen to me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_3_09.text: {player_name} is an expert at calming them down...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_3_10.text:
Your plants...? I think I heard {player_name}
mention that your plants act strange occasionally.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_3_11.text: Royal Beans blah blah, nutrients blah blah...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_4_01.text:
What did you do?
Did you overfeed them again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_4_02.text:
I didn’t do anything!
My babies are normally docile!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_4_04.text:
Yes I’m sure!
They even visit Chocolat’s Bakery to buy bread!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_4_05.text:
They did cause trouble a long time ago...
But not anymore! They’ve reformed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_4_06.text: I was on a walk with them, then suddenly...! *Sob*

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_01.text:
W-what the?! J-Jack?
And G-Goddess Aubrey?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_02.text: What are you guys doing here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_03.text: I want to ask you the same thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_04.text:
I-I just really like high places, that’s all!
I’m not looking for a quiet place to eat lunch...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_05.text:
Anyway, is something going on?
I heard someone yell, so I came running...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_08.text:
W-what do you need help for?
I’m a busy ogre, y’know!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_09.text:
Jack caused trouble again. Her plants are out of control.
The two of us won’t be enough to stop them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_10.text: Hng... I told you I didn’t do anything...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_11.text: Isn’t {PLAYER_NAME} the most qualified person for that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_12.text:
I’m just a weak ogre, hehe...
You should ask Captain for help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_13.text:
...The Captain is missing.
We need your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_15.text:
D-do I have to?
Is my help 100% really, really necessary...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_16.text:
I’m not entirely sure myself.
But I heard that Jack’s plants are no joke.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_17.text:
Hmm... I guess I have to help, then.
No choice for the ogre...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_19.text:
If Vivian hears about this, she’ll force me to help
anyway. Time to get to work, then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_20.text: Ahh... Vivian is going to scold me again...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_21.text: Is THAT what you’re worried about?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_5_22.text: Anyway, so we need to calm the plants down?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_6_01.text:
Kuhaha! This destructive power!
I can’t hold it in! And I don’t want to either! Haha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_7_02.text: You want me to fight that thing? For reals?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_8_01.text:
Berserker mode, OFF.
Opponent is too powerful for me to handle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_8_03.text:
N-no! What do you take me as?!
I’m not big enough to fight that thing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_8_04.text:
I will need bigger tech to fight it off!
I’ll use my best weapon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_8_05.text: I’m sorry, Popo, but I need to use your friend!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_8_06.text:
Hangar No.1, unlock! Enhancement System, ON!
Safety, OFF! Friend Kit ACTIVATE!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_9_9_03.text:
Pinnacle Ogre Tech! Friend Kit will do the job for sure!
That dummy won’t stand a chance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_1_02.text:
Did you report the event of that scarecrow?
It was a very odd thing to happen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_1_03.text:
I wanted to tag along, but I thought it’d be
better for me to remain and watch over Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_1_04.text: ...I was doing my best to keep the town safe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_1_05.text:
Stop giving me the squinty-eyes!
You might be more established, but I’m a captain too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_1_07.text:
After the war, the crown was passed on to a new emperor.
I’m sure the Empire is in disarray at the moment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_1_08.text:
But... I believe Victoria will become an amazing Empress.
She will put everything back to order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_2_02.text:
I was thinking of the old days.
This is where we first met.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_2_03.text:
Who would’ve imagined that the rookie Captain
from then will one day become a hero that saves Hasla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_2_04.text:
I’m getting emotional talking about the future of Grancia
with you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_2_06.text:
...I got too chatty.
Let’s head to the town square, shall we?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_3_01.text:
Didn’t I tell you? We’re
having a party to celebrate the end of the war!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_3_02.text:
It’s a special party, just for you, {PLAYER_NAME}!
The people of Hero Town worked hard for this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_3_03.text:
You never heard about this beforehand?
No way...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_3_04.text:
Well, at least you know now.
I know you aren’t busy right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_3_06.text: I thought you were done talking in parentheses!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_02.text:
Why are you so late?!
Hurry and sit down!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_03.text: Anut! Keep quiet and hold still!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_04.text: And {PLAYER_NAME} is going to sit next to me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_05.text: Both of you guys are so loud...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_06.text:
It’s been a while since we all gathered together.
Who cares if it’s a bit loud!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_07.text:
I agree. Remember when we were tasked with protecting
the Apostle’s Soulstone? Time sure flies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_08.text:
We don’t know what’s awaiting ahead of us.
But let’s stop and enjoy ourselves once in a while.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_09.text:
Oh yeah. We have someone we want to introduce
to you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_10.text:
Ellie, come and say hi. You were waiting for
{PLAYER_NAME}, weren’t you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_11.text:
Uah... Prestina...
You didn’t have to say that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_13.text:
When I was with Galatea, I saw you!
But I didn’t get a chance to say hello.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_14.text: How many years have passed since then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_15.text: I was watching your adventure with Galatea...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_16.text:
I saw your struggle against the evils of Hasla...
You overcame your adversaries to save the world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_17.text: (“It was all thanks to you, Ellie,” you reply.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_18.text: You’re the captain I know and remember!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_19.text:
If I didn’t help you at the Temple of Illusions,
the Kalards might’ve won instead, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_20.text: I guess I played a pivotal role in saving the world!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_21.text:
Of course Ellie. But don’t put yourself in that type of
position again. We don’t want to lose you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_22.text: Uhh... I want compliments not scolding...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_23.text: Of course you deserve compliments. You were very brave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_24.text: ...Everyone played a role in bringing peace to Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_25.text: But I was a corrupt Goddess... Do I deserve to be here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_26.text:
Kukuku. Cheer up Sylunis.
Elanuma would laugh at what you’re saying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_27.text:
Don’t dwell in the past.
Learn to be better and become better.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_28.text:
Once this party is over, let’s head to Elandia.
We have a lot of rebuilding to do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_29.text: I have to help rebuild the buildings that I destroyed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_30.text:
...I’m sorry, but Sylunis have plans with me. Habaek
and Haerang asked us to help recover the veins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_31.text:
Kukuku! I see!
Then I guess I’ll drag {PLAYER_NAME} along.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_32.text:
Wait! I was going to ask {PLAYER_NAME} to help me
dig up and uncover the Temple of Illusions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_33.text:
Hey! I was going to ask {PLAYER_NAME} to
give Ellie a ride to Trista!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_34.text: I’m sure Rata wants to see Ellie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_35.text:
Woah, Rata! That’s a name I haven’t heard in a while!
He’s a mouse-human! I mean, Ratman!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_36.text:
It’s more urgent to read over what our teac-
I mean, Arart left behind for us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_38.text:
As the minister of the Empire,
I can summon Grancia scholars to help us with that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_39.text:
Captain, since you just came back from the capital,
can you help me-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_41.text:
What are you doing?!
We’re here to party, not work!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_42.text:
Look at {PLAYER_NAME}!
The Captain looks miserable!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_43.text:
Let’s enjoy the party,
and talk about work later!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_44.text:
Yes! Please enjoy this fantastic party brought
to you by none other than the Merchant’s Guild!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_45.text:
F-fine.
I guess I was being a bit annoying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_46.text: Sera seems to have become very bossy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_47.text: I think I like this Sera better.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_48.text: Here comes the food! Tidy up the table please!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_49.text: Whew, finally, the party has kicked off!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_50.text:
Sorry about all of that, {PLAYER_NAME}.
They were getting on your nerves, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_51.text:
But don’t worry. Deep inside,
everyone appreciates and adores you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_52.text:
A lot of things happened since we first met
at Hyro Forest...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_53.text:
But before our truly big adventure,
a little relaxing won’t hurt us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_4_55.text:
...Now, let’s sit down and enjoy the party.
Let me go reserve the seats over there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_5_01.text:
With this final chapter, the second book
of the Hasla Chronicles is finally complete.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_5_02.text:
How was the adventure, Captain {PLAYER_NAME}?
Was it fun?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_5_04.text:
Your expression seems to have an odd mix of emotions.
I’m sure it was filled with hardships and struggles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_5_05.text: Then... I guess it’s goodbye for now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_END_5_06.text:
I will always be here waiting for you.
Here at the #Library#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EPILOGUE_SCARECROW_END.text: And the World came to an end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_2022_FOOLSDAY_NEW_O.text:
Defeat...
A word I did not know. A familiar word now.

Monsters were driven from forests and beaches to
deserts and snowy lands, pushed all the way.
The Heroes were greedy and we've made the same mistake.
But Hero of Monsters, we’re not done yet.
We will fight to the end!

We will fight in the air and
on the land to protect what’s ours.
We will get through the darkest hours.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_AUCTION_SHOP_LOCK_0.text: We aren’t open yet! Come back later!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOOLSDAY_NEW_END_1_.text:
He wasn't a Tiger General for no reason.
He was a worthy opponent.

Ugh... (Groans) You bunch of food discriminators...
You will be judged someday.

If you want some respect,
don't force it on others. Just enjoy it yourself.
Guan Yin Ping! Guan Yin Ping! Guan Yin Ping!

Good job.
We eliminated another mint chocolate lover today.

I would like to reward you.
What about delicious food?

Surely... You were full an hour ago,
but you must be hungry after such an intense battle.

Whatever is fine!
We will follow your food wisdom, General!
Fine. Let's head to my favorite restaurant then.

It is a traditional Valencian restaurant.
Famous for #pineapple pizza#.

They also offer #mango rice# as well.
Isn’t it exciting? Let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOOLSDAY_NEW_END_2_.text: See? See the power of my well-defined muscle!

Easy come, easy go, boy.
Remember today's lesson.

Devote yourself to weight training
for better muscle gain.

Anyway... You have perfect muscle.
Considering your age...

I'm ashamed of myself for slacking off leg days
always making an excuse.

Oh, you’re mistaken. I am working at a construction site
and my body is just swollen a bit.
Mine is not as developed as yours or Wolfgang's.

Hahaha! You make me blush. When you return to Elder Edda,
try my routine with me.

Oh, that sounds good.
Let’s go back with this buddy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOOLSDAY_NEW_END_3_.text: Wow! I relied on this too much!

Nearly invincible! The Taoists finally
created something formidable!
These things may drive us from our job!

What is happening?
Why are they all lying dead here?
You over there! Are you a new sacrifice?
This... Are you responsible for this?
Yes. Our Taoist Mask did it all to be exact.

Little urchins like you can never defeat
Taoist Mask, the ruler of the skies!
Tell me it’s a joke! You got bashed for good!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOOLSDAY_NEW_START_.text:
Ugh... I am full.
You had enough?
Yes, sir! General Zhang Bao!

Heh, good. The boss in the palace is in a good mood
and it’s okay to have a regiment dinner night.

I would like to have some ice cream
for dessert, what say you?
Excellent, sir! We’d love to have some, sir.

I found a good place in the market.
A new place selling ice cream.
The best is #mint chocolate#.

Well... Oh, boy.
Mint chocolate?
Hmm? What’s the matter?

General... I am very disappointed. I have never
thought that you'd enjoy such blasphemy!
Please, tell us it was a joke!

We can't serve an officer
who is delighted with mint chocolate!

Wha- What? What’s wrong with mint chocolate?
It goes well with meat.

Argh! Just brush your teeth!
Toothpaste tastes like mint!
How foul-mouthed! Toothpaste is not mint chocolate!

Oh, I see.
I can't tolerate your tyranny anymore!
General Guan Yin Ping!
General Yin Ping! What are you talking about?

Zhang Bao... I knew we’d fight each other someday,
but didn’t expect it to be like this.

I am disappointed.
I even regarded you as my rival. Shame on me.

As a Tiger General serving Emperor Chen,
I must dispense justice.
Good soldiers, are you with me?
We will fight for you, General!
Are you all serious?!

Our Hero guests will join our fight
against mint chocolate lovers!
(Warcry)

... Total insanity here! You want to cause mutiny over
such a trivial thing?

Fine. Come get some! I will lock your arms and legs
and shove mint chocolate into your mouth!

He strikes his true colors!
Everyone! Kill that mint chocolate addict!
(Warcry)

I am troubled these days. No matter how much I exercise,
I don't gain any more muscle.

Big brothers suggested me
to change the routine, but...
Ah... This is splendid!

Sadly, I can't stop thinking about
having the top-tier muscles with magic already.

Nothing less is acceptable now.
The problem is that it won't last long.

I hear that there is an elixir that promotes
quick muscle growth in #Heaven#.
Oh?

I refuse to believe it! This is outstanding!
Are you the Master of Workout in Heaven?
(Muffled sound) (Babbling)

Oh, you must have trained even your tongue muscle?
I am deeply impressed! You are a master of workout!
(Muffled sound) (Babbling)

You will teach me right now?
That's exactly what I wished for! Inject it now!
(Muffled sound) Uhh!
(Muffled sound) Ooh...

You! Winston! You’re a proud Norsgardian!
Don't you walk the path of a roid junkie!
Huh?

A spell temporarily enhancing muscle is acceptable,
but injecting steroid is a totally different matter!

A proud Norsgardian would never degrade
his health over a short-term muscle gain!

I will give you a lesson the hard way!
With my natural muscle!
Winston. Steroids rob you of your hair.
(Muffled sound) (Babbling)

What are you dallying for? Hurry. A brat named
{PLAYER_NAME} entered the streets.

Captain threw me a fit to
have me send familiars quicker.

Hold on. Did you forget how much
we worked to create this bad boy?

Deva King Version 5.2. You’re our lifetime masterpiece.
And I have to deploy you for such a trivial thing...

... I know how you’d feel, but we have no choice.
Orders are orders, you know.

Sigh... Failures like Taoist Mask
is not good enough even for a cannon fodder.

It does nothing but float.
Even Phantom Army rejected to operate it. Useless.

It's a shame of our regiment.
The hole in budget review.
Hey, hey. Cut that out and move.
Well... What?

Deva King Version 5.2!
NO!!
Huh? There are still monsters?
This is annoying.

Well... What?
It spits the bullets from the bottom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_10_01.text:
Ah... It’s seeping through again...
That’s it…!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_10_03.text:
Stop! 
Your body can’t take it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_11_02.text:
Why…? The magic powers are leaking.
Why... can’t I handle it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_11_03.text: I only just earned this body of the Absolute...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_1_01.text: Finally, the real thing at last.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_1_03.text:
Finally... 
I've been waiting for you children...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_1_04.text: Persephone, the culprit behind all this misfortune!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_1_05.text:
I shall put an end to your evil doings 
in the name of my father... and the Styx members!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_1_06.text: Today shall be the end of our ill-fated relationship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_1_07.text:
Hmm. I did nothing wrong.
All I did was eliminate an outlaw.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_1_08.text: Huhu... Reckless, just like your father.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_2_04.text:
Kneel before me, 
bow down, and worship me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_3_06.text: We can free you from Manacar!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_3_07.text: ...I heard that a thousand times in my 100-year sleep.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_3_08.text: I’m sick of the hypocrisy of you #Heras#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_3_09.text:
Persephone!
Please don’t give up on yourself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_4_01.text:
Persephone!
Please don’t give up on yourself...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_5_03.text:
No more sacrifice like this... 
So stop it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_7_02.text: You've... You’ve been protecting me all this time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_7_04.text:
The mental bodies of former Senators? Are those what’s 
residing in the rings?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_7_05.text:
Serving their duties even after death, 
how... ridiculous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_7_07.text:
Medea... 
The time has come to fulfill your wish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_7_08.text: Please, free yourself from the agony.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_8_01.text:
I could care less.
Look at you making a last-ditch effort.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_8_02.text: Look at you making a last-ditch effort.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_8_04.text:
I’ll devour them... 
as I devour everyone’s wishes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_9_02.text:
Ugh... I’m the Absolute with undying magic powers.
These wounds don’t bother me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_9_03.text:
Give me blood and magic powers...!
I can grow stronger once again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_9_04.text:
No, Persephone,
we won’t let you suffer any longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_10_9_06.text: Give me your blood and magic powers... Now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_01.text:
It’s worse than I expected.
Re-living the nightmare of the past...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_02.text: I feel like walking straight into a monster’s den.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_03.text:
Yes, the unstable current is disturbing
the magic powers. It’s worse than I expected...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_04.text:
The Tower is specifically built
to interfere with Manacar’s recovery.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_05.text:
That magician girl from Hero Town
taught me how to survive the Tower. You just...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_06.text:
go with the flow and move constantly
without trying to go against the energy. Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RL_1_1_07.text:
That’s right. Lady Athena!
You are well-versed in magic as well!
