But now I know.
You’re a good person, just like {PLAYER_NAME} said.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_53.text:
Now I understand why you stalked me.
And I forgive you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_54.text:
Well, I’m glad to hear that.
There’s one more person who knows my secret now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_55.text:
If this secret gets out, one of you are the suspects.
So keep that in mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_56.text:
You don’t need to worry. I’m good at keeping secrets.
And I have a lot of them myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_57.text: For example...I can’t control myself on full moons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_58.text:
Then you’re a true werewolf!
I’m jealous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_59.text:
There’s nothing to be jealous of.
I've been lonely my entire life because of this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_60.text:
I lose my reason when I see a full moon.
I feel a sudden urge to destroy everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_61.text:
If it weren’t for these chains he gave me,
I would still be hiding in the woods all alone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_62.text:
Losing reason during full moons...
it's those details I should keep in mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_63.text: Should I order those chains online?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_64.text:
Aren’t you scared of me?
I could attack you one day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_65.text:
Scared? Not at all.
Gordian is the only one who could beat me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_66.text:
Bring it on whenever you want to.
I’ll gladly spar with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_67.text:
You...
You're a much better person than I thought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_68.text: So, would you mind sharing a few things about werewolves?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_69.text:
I don’t want to disappoint my fans.
I would gladly fake being a werewolf for them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_4_70.text: Okay, if you must. I’m willing to tell you anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_01.text: So do werewolves go on a lone hunt at a particular time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_02.text:
At least I do.
I don’t know about others. I have no friends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_03.text:
Nonsense! You have one right here!
I’ll tag along next time you go on a hunt!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_05.text: It seems like you ladies have become good friends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_06.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} must have done something.
Isn’t that right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_07.text:
You always step up when things like this happen.
Thank you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_08.text:
That’s strange.
Charlotte’s rarely on good terms with others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_09.text: She’s changed a lot compared to the past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_10.text: Well, you can’t blame me for frowning whenever I see you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_11.text:
That’s not what I mean.
Don’t you know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_12.text:
You never truly respected anyone except Gordian.
The rest, you regarded as your subordinates.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_13.text:
You used to pounce on the strong, and loathe the weak,
isolating yourself for no good reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_14.text:
Then you started being all cute after becoming an idol.
You used to hate your looks, but not anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_15.text: You seem way more obedient now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_18.text: By the way, Miss Charlotte. I have one question.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_19.text:
Why did you decide to become a werewolf all of a sudden?
It's not like there is an actual problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_20.text: Well, my fans have begun to question my werewolf-ness,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_21.text: saying “Charlotte’s too cute to be a werewolf.”

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_22.text: “Charlotte might be something else, like an angel.”

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_23.text: “How can a werewolf be this lovely?!”

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_24.text:
They keep saying things like that
and doubting my werewolf-ness!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_27.text:
I finally have someone to open up to.
And I can’t afford to lose her yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_28.text: Wouldn’t this lead to more misunderstandings?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_29.text: She’s the one who started lying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_30.text: I guess she's desperate to be loved.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_31.text: If that’s what Miss Vivian says...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_32.text: Okay, I've made up my mind!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_33.text: I’m going to come back here regularly for vacation!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_34.text: What?! What about your schedule as an idol!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_35.text: Your fans are going to follow you everywhere!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_36.text: The only other option is to bring Fenrir to Devil Island.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_37.text:
I don’t want to go.
I like it here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_38.text:
And what if a scandal breaks out between the two?
That would be a disaster.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_39.text: Why would a scandal break out between two ladies?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_40.text:
It’s totally possible.
Don't you dare underestimate the #Red Cape Squad#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_38_5_42.text: I guess it's better than her settling here for good...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_11_01.text: Why... Why are you giving me the eye?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_11_02.text:
I haven’t done anything wrong yet!
Oh, by ‘yet’ I mean...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_12_01.text:
My face rings a bell?
T-That’s not possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_12_02.text:
I’m always so business with my business in Demon Realm,
I rarely have the time to visit Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_12_03.text: Are you perhaps confusing me with someone else?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_13_01.text:
How would I know what that is?
It’s definitely something I've never seen before!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_13_02.text:
Well, well. Why don’t we finish the conversation
at the VIP-only shop?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_13_03.text: You’ll be surprised to find all the rare, precious goods!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_1_01.text:
Hello, {PLAYER_NAME}.
The square seems to be filled with people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_1_02.text:
I heard that the owner of a famous resort in Demon Realm
by the name of #Greedy Casino# came to promote.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_1_03.text: Would you want to go take a look?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_2_01.text:
Is this the line?
It’s more successful than I expected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_2_02.text:
Well.
I guess we’ll have to wait a little.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_2_03.text:
A little? The gold pig just said
that it’s going to be 3 hours from here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_2_04.text:
Brace yourself.
It’s going to be a long wait.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_3_01.text:
Well, well! Welcome to a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!
A discount to make you flip!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_3_02.text:
Has the owner gone mad?
Well, I’m the owner! Hahaha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_3_03.text:
The grand winner gets... a round trip to the Demon Realm
and a two-night stay at the resort!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_3_04.text:
Please line up in a queue!
Hey you! No cutting!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_3_05.text:
There’s enough to go around for everyone!
I’ll be here for two days and you can come... What?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_4_02.text:
Um... there! At the end of the line!
Isn’t that {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_4_03.text:
Oh... you're right. You have 20/20 vision.
That face... I saw it on the newspaper.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_4_04.text:
What? Why is he still
in Hero Town?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_4_05.text:
Rumor had it he was staying at
some luxury mansion in Impelis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_4_06.text:
What if he recognizes me?
What if he asks me for a refund for that magic markers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_4_07.text:
You must pull yourself together, sir!
Stay confident!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_5_01.text:
You came to the Demon Realm
after doing #something#, I know that much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_5_02.text:
But! Now, you are
Mammon, the owner of the 'Greedy Casino'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_5_03.text:
You must keep your dignity! Or else,
he will find out who you are!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_5_05.text:
... You’re right. This is a trivial matter.
I shouldn’t be bothered.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_5_06.text:
Alright! Send everyone home!
It’s going to be a VIP-only event from now on!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_5_07.text:
Just wait until you find yourself
tangled up in the swamp of greed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_6_01.text:
Alright, that’s it for today!
Everybody, please head home!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_6_02.text:
Meow? What - meow?
We’ve been standing in line for hours now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_6_03.text:
Come back tomorrow with your number,
and you’ll get a complimentary discount!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_6_04.text:
Nya Nya... I should go back home
and get some sleep.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_8_02.text:
You're Lednas, the Captain of Hero Town,
and you are {PLAYER_NAME}, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_8_03.text:
I’m #Mammon#, the owner of ‘Greedy Casino’!
It’s a pleasure to meet you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_9_02.text:
I wanted to let you in on a special VIP-only shop
for keeping this town always safe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_9_03.text:
Huh? So you sent everyone home
because of us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_9_04.text: Oh, don’t you worry about that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_9_05.text:
Secretary, Secretary Gold! Please,
can you show him to the VIP-only shop?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_LUCKYSHOP_9_06.text: Yes, sir, on my way! This way, please!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_112_END_01.text:
... Hearing your stories, I get the feeling
that they are much more mature than me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_112_END_02.text:
It’s going to feel hysterical
when I hear them call me mother...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_112_START_02.text:
I heard from Aubrey
that you met Habaec in the eastern countries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_112_START_03.text:
You also met Loki at Nosgard
and Galatea at Neth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_112_START_04.text:
The truth is,
my memories still haven’t fully returned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_112_START_05.text:
Like Chantico, the ‘Ancient Sacred Beings’ call me “mother”,
but I barely know them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_112_START_06.text:
So I was wondering, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Can you tell me about them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_112_START_07.text:
My relationship with the sacred beasts would surely
become less... ‘awkward’ if I get to know them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_113_END_03.text:
They all closed their doors
because they heard a war was coming...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_113_END_05.text:
When the war is over,
promise me you’ll eat desserts with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_113_START_02.text:
We are now ready to depart for Impelis. But... there’s
something important to do before the battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_113_START_03.text:
We need to visit the famous
bakeries of Impelis and try their desserts!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_113_START_05.text:
Don’t make that face!
I’m serious!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_113_START_06.text:
It’s been 3 years since I’ve been to Impelis!
I never tried their awesome desserts...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_113_START_07.text:
When I was an executor,
I was only given MREs...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_113_START_08.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. You do not know
how deprived I am of desserts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_113_START_09.text:
So! Before we begin fighting,
we should explore Impelis for desserts!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_114_END_01.text:
Kukuku. Nothing less from {PLAYER_NAME}.
This isn’t enough to threaten you, hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_114_END_02.text:
You blew them away like leaves!
Kukuku!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_114_END_03.text: Oh my, my throat aches from laughing so much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_114_END_04.text:
After accepting Nemesis,
I grew a habit of saying ‘kukuku’.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_114_END_05.text:
Is there anything I can do about this?
I don’t think it’s good for my throat...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_114_START_02.text:
It seems like a lot has happened
since we said our farewells at Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_114_START_03.text:
You met three more deities like Loki?
It must’ve been awful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_114_START_04.text:
Hmm? The other guardian deities
weren’t as bad as Loki?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_114_START_05.text:
I see. So Loki is the special one
among the bunch! Kukuku!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_114_START_06.text: I want to hear more in detail...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_114_START_07.text:
But the enemy is coming.
Let’s take them out before we chat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_115_END_03.text:
You’ve grown so large!
You look so intimidating now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_115_END_04.text:
I did well gifting you to Alexander.
You used to eat so much!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_115_END_05.text:
Hmm? {PLAYER_NAME}?
Why are you giving me that look?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_115_START_02.text:
I knew you would overcome the bounty
Grancia has placed on your head.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_115_START_03.text:
And now you are even preparing a counterattack.
You really live up to your name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_115_START_04.text:
Now that we’re here at Impelis,
it really brings back memories of my old dog.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_115_START_05.text: Hmm? Why the sudden talk about a dog?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_115_START_06.text:
I gifted a dog to Alexander
after we formed our alliance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_115_START_07.text:
He was a smart and loyal dog.
I’m sure he grew up with lot of love.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_115_START_08.text:
Yes... his name was Rocky.
He had the same color fur as that wolf...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_116_END_02.text:
Ehem... these knights...
were stronger than I expected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_116_END_03.text:
Their thick, steel armor allows them
to focus more on attacking than defending.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_116_END_04.text:
Their individual swordsmanship is also
on par with the Chen warriors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_116_END_05.text: It could’ve been dangerous without you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_116_END_06.text:
So who do I think is stronger?
The knights or the warriors?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_116_END_07.text:
Hmm... I can’t say for sure, yet.
I’ll have to fight a knight 1 on 1 to be sure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_116_END_08.text:
It’s not easy measuring the strength of individuals
in a massive brawl.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_116_START_01.text:
We’re finally here at Impelis.
It feels unreal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_116_START_02.text: I can finally fulfill my dreams!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_116_START_03.text:
What have I been dreaming about?
I always dreamt of dueling a Knight of Grancia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_116_START_04.text:
I always wondered who’d be stronger.
The warriors of Chen or the knights of Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_116_START_05.text:
However, I was never able to visit Grancia
and satisfy my curiosity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_116_START_06.text:
Look over there! Grancia knights are approaching!
Watch this, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_116_START_07.text:
Look at how disorganized they are!
I should be able to take them on by myself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_117_END_01.text:
...
It was an aura of a cat that’s been affected by magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_117_END_02.text: I guess this is nothing out of the ordinary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_117_END_03.text:
Long ago, I made a deal with the Pharaoh of the
#Millennial Kingdom#. I promised cats 9 lives.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_117_END_05.text:
But I can’t talk about this deal in detail
as it was done in secret.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_117_START_02.text:
Nearby, there is a being that is well past its time.
It should’ve died long ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_117_START_03.text:
Grim Reaper is very thorough in his work...
How peculiar...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_117_START_04.text:
I need to see what it is.
{PLAYER_NAME}, come with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_118_END_01.text:
Whew, I found the prince
all thanks to you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_118_END_02.text:
I didn’t expect the heir of Valencia
to act so thoughtlessly!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_118_END_03.text: I will have to scold him later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_118_START_01.text:
Oh my, {PLAYER_NAME}!
How nice to see you here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_118_START_02.text:
Uhm... I’m searching for the prince who
disappeared as soon as we arrived at Impelis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_118_START_03.text:
He always gets lost
whenever we leave Valencia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_118_START_05.text: There’s no way he’d charge the gates alone...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_118_START_06.text: ... Wait, who is that running over there...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_119_END_02.text:
Yuck, I expected their lunch
to taste better than this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_119_END_03.text:
Ugh, lunch made by Rochefort
is much better than this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_119_START_02.text:
... Whew, we didn’t get caught
by the boss!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_119_START_03.text:
Nice to meet you. I’m a prodigy
within the musketeers, Athos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_119_START_04.text:
You can also call me by one my countless
nicknames, #Violet Lightning#. Hehehe...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_119_START_05.text:
I called you because I needed to find
something out without the boss knowing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_119_START_06.text:
I really need
your help for this, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_119_START_07.text:
I need to collect intel regarding
the state of Grancia army’s supplies!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_119_START_08.text:
Look over there!
What timing, the Steel Knights are approaching us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_119_START_09.text:
If you distract them,
I will sneak away their supply!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_120_END_01.text: Nyahahaha! How do you like that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_120_END_02.text:
This is great!
No one can stop me now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_120_END_03.text:
Now then, let me prepare my special bomb...
...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_120_END_04.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}? Why are you slowly
backing away with my bomb?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_120_END_06.text: You betrayed me!!! Nyah! I will never forgive you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_120_START_01.text:
Nyah... it’s nice to be back
here at the garden.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_120_START_02.text:
That area over there
with thick bushes and trees!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_120_START_03.text:
It’s my favorite place in the whole garden!
It’s perfect for testing bombs!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_120_START_04.text:
But there is a bad person here
that always interferes with my bomb testing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_120_START_05.text:
It’s the Garden Janitor!
He really gets on my nerves!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_120_START_06.text:
If only I could get rid of him...
I can burn and destroy the garden as I please!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_120_START_07.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. Can you help me
get rid of him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_120_START_08.text:
I will show you
an awesome explosion as a reward!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_121_END_02.text:
Did you feel the powerful magical vibration
that shakes the atmosphere?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_121_END_03.text:
Looking at the scale I brought
to measure the magic output of the golems...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_121_END_05.text:
The AMK - 001 that Frantz showed me
had an output of 230,000...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_121_START_01.text:
Hello, {PLAYER_NAME}!
It’s nice to see you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_121_START_02.text:
I should’ve stayed in Hero Town?
It’s too dangerous here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_121_START_04.text:
This is a great opportunity
for magical research!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_121_START_05.text:
There are powerful guardian golems here at Grancia!
The golems were sculpted by none other than

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_121_START_06.text: the great witches of Pumpkin City themselves!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_121_START_07.text:
You can say that the mana cores that fuel the golems
are the pinnacle of modern-day magic!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_121_START_08.text:
When you give genius minds enough time and money,
they can create awesome products like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_121_START_09.text:
I’m even willing to risk my life
to experience it firsthand!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_122_END_02.text:
Since humans are mostly responsible for destroying
nature, we simply had to destroy humans!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_122_END_03.text:
I learned something great today!
I will follow in your steps!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_122_END_05.text: I don’t like resorting to violence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_122_END_06.text:
But since you did it to help us,
I’m very grateful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_122_START_01.text:
Hmm... What can I do to the sign
so that people won’t ignore it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_122_START_03.text:
Oh, hello there, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Surprised to see you here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_122_START_05.text:
I am contracted by the royals of Grancia
to periodically visit the gardens here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_122_START_06.text: It’s an honor to meet you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_122_START_07.text: Oh? You heard me talking to myself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_122_START_09.text:
It’s not that big of a deal... but I was concerned as people
have been stepping over the grass here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_122_START_10.text:
Éfendére and I have been working really hard
to keep the lawn here gorgeous and clean.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_122_START_11.text:
We’ve been taking care of it as it is
the perfect resting place for spirits of nature.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_122_START_12.text:
I put up signs here incase they get stepped on...
People aren’t paying attention to the sign though...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_123_END_01.text:
Ugh... I don’t think it was a good idea
to follow you around...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_123_END_02.text: I got into so many fights because of you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_123_END_03.text:
I guess I’m not surprised. I did hear that it’s largely
your fault that we are even at war right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_123_END_04.text:
I’m gonna go off on my own again.
Good luck with your adventure...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_123_START_01.text:
*Yawn* Oh, hello there,{PLAYER_NAME}.
You look exactly like what the rumors say! Hahaha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_123_START_03.text: I heard a lot about you from my boss.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_123_START_04.text: What am I doing here alone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_123_START_05.text:
I went chasing after
another musketeer when she suddenly ran off.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_123_START_06.text:
But I got lost...
Why are the gardens here so large and complex?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_123_START_07.text:
Well, things couldn’t get worse,
so I thought I might as well look for a place to nap.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_123_START_08.text:
You think it’s odd to nap at a time like this?
Eh, who cares.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_123_START_09.text:
Hmm... but I was getting really bored.
I think I’ll follow you around and map out the area.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_124_END_01.text:
You...!
How dare you bring me to Joan of Arc!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_124_END_02.text:
Do you know how much I used to suffer
at her hands... Ehem!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_124_END_03.text: Darn, I can’t use this path.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_124_END_04.text:
You...! You’re lucky I’m afra-
I mean, I don’t have time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_124_END_05.text:
When I finally take the throne,
you will pay!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_124_END_06.text:
I will remember you!
You better watch out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_124_START_01.text:
Hey, you there.
You know me, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_124_START_02.text:
You don’t?
Hmm... are you a new servant here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_124_START_03.text:
Who taught you?
How can a servant not recognize their master?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_124_START_04.text: Well, whatever. You at least know the names of the royals, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_124_START_05.text:
The name’s Morgan.
I’m the true heir to Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_124_START_06.text:
I heard that a massive war broke out in Grancia.
So given the opportunity, I came to strike Alexander down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_124_START_07.text:
But... the guards I bribed from before
have all been replaced with new guards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_125_END_01.text:
We found the passage,
but Robin Hood was a step ahead of us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_125_END_02.text:
I suppose we should’ve
planned better before departing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_125_START_02.text:
Wait... I’m sure this was the right path...
How strange... {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_125_START_03.text:
What do you mean by what’s going on?
Nothing’s wrong!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_125_START_04.text:
You don’t seriously think that I can’t read
a simple map, right? Haha...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_125_START_05.text:
I was second in command of the Green Apples!
I don’t make rookie mistakes like that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_125_START_07.text:
Can you... help me?
To be honest, I was never good at reading maps...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_126_END_01.text:
Whew, I think we got rid
of all the nearby traps.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_126_START_02.text:
It’s been a while!
The last time I saw you was at the Temple of Illusions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_126_START_03.text:
What is an archaeologist doing here?
I am a wanderer, you see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_126_START_04.text:
In order to seek the truth,
I don’t mind heading straight into war!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_126_START_05.text:
Hmm, seeing things here,
I imagine you’re troubled by Green Apple’s traps.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_126_START_07.text:
Let me show you what a seasoned archaeologist can do!
I’ve removed countless traps during my explorations!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_END_01.text:
Himiko... I’m shocked.
You treat me like a child.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_END_02.text: Do you see me as some kind of fool?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_END_03.text:
... What’s that on your hand? Is that cake?
You are eating it with your bare hands?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_END_04.text: This is called cake? It’s delicious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_END_05.text:
I plundered it from the pantry over there.
There’s a lot left, do you want some too, Himiko?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_END_06.text: PLUNDER? Don’t do that, even if it’s from the enemy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_END_07.text:
And how many times did I tell you?
Don’t eat with your hands!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_END_08.text:
Come with me!
Let’s wash those dirty hands!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_START_03.text:
Hmm? She suddenly disappeared
when you guys arrived at Impelis?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_START_04.text:
I trusted you, {PLAYER_NAME}!
You should’ve kept a good eye on her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_START_05.text:
She’ll be fine as long
as she doesn’t fight the Kalards alone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_START_06.text: Well, obviously, but that’s not what I’m worried about!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_START_07.text: When she came across a cockroach one time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_START_08.text: No, no, now’s not the time to chat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_127_START_09.text: Let’s go look for her RIGHT now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_END_01.text:
I ran when war suddenly broke out...
But I heard everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_END_02.text: My brother was troubled by such a thing...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_END_03.text:
A lot of people actually
warned me over the years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_END_04.text:
That I should avoid the Green Apples,
as there are bad rumors surrounding them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_END_05.text:
So... I already knew they were up to no good.
But I couldn’t just avoid them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_END_06.text:
Robin Hood was the first to approach me with kindness.
I used to be a lonely, troubled girl, you see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_END_07.text:
He was often gloomy...
and I wanted to make him happy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_END_08.text:
... Even now, despite knowing the truth,
I still care about him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_END_09.text: I know he has to pay for his sins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_END_10.text:
But I can at least be at his side
through his anguish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_START_01.text:
Oh my, {PLAYER_NAME}!
What are the chances of running into you here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_START_03.text:
Hohoho! My family is quite reputable you see!
I am permitted by the empire to visit as I please.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_START_04.text: I came here to give something to my brot... Robin Hood.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_START_05.text:
It’s a new product from GE24.
Apple noodles...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_START_06.text:
We preordered these before release,
but I think Robin Hood forgot about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_START_07.text:
I waited for him at the convenience store,
but he never came!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_START_08.text: You’re surprised that convenience stores haven’t closed?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_128_START_09.text:
Hohoho! {PLAYER_NAME}!
Convenience stores are open 24 hours, 7 days a week!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_129_END_02.text:
To witness your elegance...
I feel blessed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_129_END_03.text:
I’ve abandoned my thoughts of
having her for my own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_129_END_04.text:
How can I, someone so dirty,
dare to have someone like her at my side?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_129_END_05.text:
Oh, but still... how I wish for her
to turn around just once to see me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_129_START_02.text:
I didn’t plan to meet you here.
How troublesome.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_129_START_04.text:
... In normal circumstances, I would have you arrested
and sent to the guillotine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_129_START_06.text:
You are a well-known figure in Hasla.
You’ve done countless heroic deeds for this continent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_129_START_07.text:
To frame you heresy...
Something is definitely off.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_129_START_08.text: What do you mean you’re surprised? How rude.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_129_START_09.text:
I’m not some crazy inquisitor
that just arrests people without thinking.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_129_START_10.text:
Where are you headed?
I will take you there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_129_START_11.text:
The Guest’s Room?
You plan to meet Victoria?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_129_START_13.text:
You heathen!
You dare exert your evil influence on my goddess?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_129_START_14.text:
I can’t forgive you!
I’ll kill you with my own two hands!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_130_START_01.text: We are finally here at the emperor’s quarters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_130_START_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
It’s time to turn everything back to normal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_MAIN_Q_S2_130_START_03.text: We need to defeat the Kalard controlling Alexander

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_1_01.text:
Cinder Fall... You're alive.
I thought you were dead for sure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_1_02.text:
Did you think I would die that easily?
You should've cut my throat to be sure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_1_03.text: Are you after my power again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_1_04.text:
No, I have no time to waste on you.
I have a more important matter to handle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_1_05.text:
I don't know how I got here, but I’ll finish
Ruby Rose while Salem's minions are not around.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_1_06.text:
If I say she died after falling into another world,
she would have no choice but to accept.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_1_07.text:
I don't know what grudge you have against her,
but is it more urgent than returning to your world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_1_08.text:
It is urgent.
At least for me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_1_09.text:
I know Ruby Rose is here now,
so I’ll eliminate Ruby and her team.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_1_10.text:
While watching those kids begging for mercy,
I will slowly finish them one by one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_2_01.text: I know how to return to my world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_2_02.text:
Kindred Link...
The last time I checked it, it worked fine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_2_03.text: Through the portal, you can go there where my brother is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_2_04.text:
You are a heartless sister.
You think I won’t go after him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_2_05.text: Well, he and I aren’t that close.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_2_06.text: …He'll turn to a crow and escape anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_2_07.text:
So?
What do you want in exchange for sending me back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_2_08.text:
Leave the kids alone.
Just return to your world quietly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_2_09.text:
Huh? Was it Yang Xiao Long?
Your daughter was with Ruby Rose, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_2_11.text: So you're not a good sister but a good mother, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_2_13.text:
Haha! Wonderful!
I can get my revenge on you after killing Ruby Rose.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_2_14.text: Tsk, I guess the only way to stop you is by force.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_3_03.text:
Save that for later!
Those kids are following me! Keep me safe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_3_05.text:
Yes, I’m talking about Ruby Rose's thugs! 
She brought a bunch of her friends!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_3_06.text:
Haha! Great! They are coming here on their own!
Alright! Stand behind me! I'll keep you safe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_3_07.text:
Darn it… This is awkward.
I didn't intend to meet you here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_3_08.text:
What? You're running away?
Aren't you supposed to protect your daughter?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_3_09.text:
Told you already.
I'm not a good mother.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_4_01.text: No harm in having you out on your own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_4_02.text:
You need to retreat, Cinder!
The kids brought some others as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_4_03.text:
Run? Don't be ridiculous.
Whoever comes, I'll kill everyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_2_4_04.text:
That would be the best scenario but…
Argh! I don't know! Neo! You should join too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_2_5_0002.text: Well, I expected that from you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_3_3_0002.text: Collected that without knowing the difference? C’mon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_3_3_0003.text:
I have to admit, it's got a similar look
and a mysterious aura.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_3_4_0001.text:
Hm, {PLAYER_NAME}?
Thank you for helping me to catch Roman.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_3_8_01.text:
Dang, I can't handle all of you.
And she'll be on my tail soon…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_3_8_02.text:
I’ll see you soon again, Ruby.
Next time, I will take everything away from you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_3_8_03.text: Wow, what a cliche line for a villain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_3_8_04.text:
Wait, Cinder!
Save me and Neo too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_3_8_05.text: I have no time to take care of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_3_9_01.text: Jeez! I shouldn't have trusted her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_3_9_02.text:
Now there's no one to help you.
Why don't you surrender?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RB_3_9_03.text:
Never mind surrendering... 
I can't even move anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_1000_1.text:
I would like to get some food from Palor.
I do not wish to hurt the animals in the forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_1000_2.text:
I’ve grown accustomed to the quiet life here.
But occasionally, I wish there was more to do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_1000_3.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. I have a favor to ask.
I wish to witness your strong powers and skills.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_1000_4.text:
I wish to explore where there could be shiny treasures.
Near the dungeon, I suppose.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_191_4_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. I know you’re busy,
but can I ask you something?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_191_4_02.text:
Achilles has gone into hiding - in shame - after
being defeated by Laporte.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_191_4_03.text:
I would’ve been embarrassed, too, if I lost to a dog...
But Laporte isn’t exactly your everyday dog...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_191_4_04.text: If you see him, can you give him a word of encouragement?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_193_5_01.text:
Hmm... I do want to help the alliance,
but I don’t have enough iron.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_193_5_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. Can you bring back some weapons
dropped by the Steel Knights during your adventure?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_193_5_03.text:
I kind of feel bad about stealing their weapons,
but I’m sure they will manage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_193_5_04.text: My matter’s more important than theirs.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_199_6_02.text:
The Central Knights stationed near the Guest’s Room
have gone rogue.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_199_6_03.text:
We are in a hurry to recover the sustained damages,
but they are not following orders...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_C_199_6_04.text: Can you help me knock some sense into them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_E_1000_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, you've got many good friends, right?
Get in touch with them not to disappoint them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_E_1000_2.text:
We need more people for the repair!
Send anyone, even an inexperienced one will do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_E_184_4_01.text:
...{PLAYER_NAME}. You see the red light on the mountainside?
It's still early... for the volcano to be stabilized.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_E_184_4_02.text:
We'd better intervene now
before more clones of the mad Chantico are created.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_E_184_4_03.text: Let's go deeper into the volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_L_1000_1.text:
Mm, human... I’m craving a lot of meat today.
Bring me an unvigintillion meats, will you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_L_1000_2.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, I hate to ask, but I urgently need money.
Could you help me out a little?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_L_111_3_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}...!
There was a big explosion at the core of the volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_L_111_3_02.text:
Unbelievable! His image is manifested by
the remaining power of Red Lotus...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_L_111_3_03.text: I know it's going to be tough, but we must stop it now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_L_85_3_01.text: Nyah... Captain, can you do me a favor?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_L_85_3_02.text:
I left behind some catnip back at my lab...
No, I mean “important research materials”...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_L_85_3_03.text:
Since I’m no longer the Palace Mage, I can’t go back.
Can you bring them back for me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_1000_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, your battle calls are always interesting.
Do you mind teaching me a lesson?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_1000_2.text:
I heard there was a nearby dungeon full of bread.
I want to explore it right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_1000_3.text:
Call me whenever you need help!
I will lend a hand!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_1000_4.text:
Hey friend! Is there such a thing as the Alchemy Lab?
A wizard like myself should take a look!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_182_4_01.text:
The Walls and Gate of the Impelis Palace
is known to be impenetrable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_182_4_02.text:
In addition, Caeneus of the Cobalt Knights
is personally guarding the gates.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_182_4_03.text:
We are in dire need of your help,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_184_7_02.text: I have a favor to ask you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_184_7_03.text:
I heard that the Royal Gardens of Grancia
harbor rare breeds of flowers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_184_7_04.text:
Nosgard is a barren strip of land
with no such luxury.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_184_7_05.text:
So... when you’re there, can you bring me back
a few flowers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_184_8_01.text:
Hey, you look familiar...
Have we met before?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_184_8_02.text:
I guess it’s unimportant to remember a commoner’s face.
I’m Morgan, the true heir to Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_184_8_03.text:
I heard that a massive war broke out in Grancia.
So given the opportunity, I came to strike Alexander down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_184_8_04.text:
But... the guards I bribed from before
have all been replaced with new guards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_185_4_01.text:
There are still lost fragments of
residual power wandering the volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_185_4_02.text:
It seems that Sera has not recovered enough
to control all her powers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_RQ_R_185_4_03.text:
We would like to help you.
Will you allow us to join your cause, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_10_01.text:
A great pleasure, Korin at your service!
Today, I have come to speak to {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_10_02.text:
You are... Aubrey, Himiko.
And Haerang... if I’m not mistaken?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_10_03.text:
This presence...
You are no ordinary person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_10_04.text:
Oracle of Water, indeed. I knew you would recognize me!
That’s right, I’m a Death Angel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_10_05.text:
I don’t usually reveal myself
to humans, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_10_06.text:
I have a favor to ask of
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_11_01.text:
D-Death Angel?
I thought that was an imaginary entity...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_11_02.text:
... Even if you were a Death Angel,
what favor do you have to ask of a human?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_11_03.text:
I know, it sounds strange, right?
This doesn’t happen often, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_11_05.text: But this time, this is no ordinary matter at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_11_06.text:
My boss has ordered me to guide
{PLAYER_NAME} to the Primal Volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_11_07.text:
I heard you should be in Han with an #Oracle#,
so I followed your traces...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_11_08.text: I’m relieved I caught up with you before it’s too late!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_12_01.text:
Volcano... Did your boss make {PLAYER_NAME} have the
same dream over and over? Who is this boss of yours?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_12_02.text:
I was expecting that question. She is #Great King Yama#,
the Underworld Judge and one of the Kings of Hell!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_12_05.text: He is not an imaginary being?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_13_01.text:
I heard about such belief in the afterlife...
One of them was about the Judge of the Underworld.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_13_02.text:
I was completely forgetting about it because Habaek never
gave me a straight answer... This is interesting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_13_03.text:
Um, if it’s okay, can we start going about our way?
Not too much time left until the day of promise...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_13_04.text:
I was ordered to bring {PLAYER_NAME} as soon as I can.
He wants to discuss important continental matters...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_13_05.text:
I understand you may have a hard time believing
all these Underworld and Death Angel stories,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_13_06.text:
But since {PLAYER_NAME} and I are old acquaintances...
Do it for {PLAYER_NAME}’s sake, please?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_14_01.text:
Matters concerning the continent?
...You don’t say it has something to do with Kalard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_14_02.text:
…{PLAYER_NAME} and you all.
What do you think?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_14_04.text:
I see neither an aura of the living nor the dead...
Fortunately, I don’t sense any sign of deceit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_14_05.text: I have no doubt about what you have just said.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_14_06.text:
... Thanks to both of you, our urgent matter
has been resolved for the most part.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_14_07.text:
We only have trivial matters left
until Habaek returns...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_14_08.text:
I understand how worried you have been here.
Sorry for not being able to help you in that matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_14_09.text: The least I can do is have you leave in peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_15_01.text: Heading to the Primal Volcano, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_15_02.text:
I cannot accompany you or offer you tremendous support,
as I need to stay here for the Kingdom of Ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_15_03.text: But I cannot let the two of you go just by yourselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_15_04.text:
For your safety, please have #Kurenai# accompany you.
I am certain she will be of great help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_15_05.text:
Are you sure? She is a big asset to the Kingdom of Ryu.
Sending her off overseas at times like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_15_06.text:
It's fine. The last thing we need for peaceful union is
the power that holds the Eastern nations in check.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_15_07.text:
Also, the vengeful spirit left the Legend in peace,
I wish to let her have what she desires.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_15_08.text:
After all, Kurenai has been waiting
for her time to revisit the Primal Volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_15_09.text: So all has been decided, I believe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_15_10.text:
I shall be waiting here
until you are ready!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_16_01.text: So... I don’t know much about ancient guardian deities,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_16_02.text:
But you are basically saying the Great King Yama summoned
{PLAYER_NAME} concerning the continental matters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_16_05.text:
So do you think this doesn’t have anything to do with
the last ancient guardian deity Habaek talked about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_16_06.text:
...Ah. It does feel like too many things
are happening all at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_16_07.text:
By the way, what business does the King of the Underworld
have in the world of the living?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_16_08.text:
Well, how would a petty being like me understand
what goes on in the minds of the Great King?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_16_09.text:
In fact, I’ve rarely met him while my service
as a Death Angel over a couple centuries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_17_02.text:
We just have to look for the entrance
to the Primal Volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_17_03.text:
... We are nowhere near the volcano,
and the air is already scorching hot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_17_04.text:
Haha, you’d better get used to it.
It will only get worse once we go inside.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_17_05.text:
It will be much beyond scorching hot, believe me!
You are strong enough to withstand the heat, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_17_07.text:
Disturbing? I’m not trying to tease you here.
Are you heat intolerant indeed?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_17_08.text:
I though you would be totally fine since
you have inherited the Legend of Primal Flames...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_17_10.text:
This sense of bizarreness,
different from what I felt during my last visit...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_18_01.text: I have been waiting for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_18_02.text:
Wait, the Great King mentioned someone would be
coming to greet us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_18_03.text:
but I never expected it would be
the legendary chief of the Woompa tribe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_18_04.text:
Whoa, that outfit is truly one of a kind.
You mind if I try it on later?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_18_05.text:
So it was true that {PLAYER_NAME} would be accompanied
by a hopelessly naive loudmouth Death Angel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_18_06.text:
Follow me. I shall guide you
to the entrance to the Primal Volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_18_07.text: ... So Yama has some business with the Woompa tribe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_18_08.text: Hmm, I guess. I never would have imagined

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_18_09.text: our Great King was such a people-person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_18_10.text: I don’t know who you are talking about...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_18_11.text: but our god Paparochoal has sent us a divine message.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_18_12.text:
that a hopelessly naive loudmouth Death Angel
would bring an important guest here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_19_02.text:
Something bothers me from the moment I got in here.
Did a battle take place here or something?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_19_03.text:
That is right.
Some outsiders came here causing a nuisance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_19_04.text:
Outsiders causing a nuisance? Those holes on the ground
don’t seem to be the result of a mere nuisance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_19_06.text:
... You have sharp eyes, I give you that.
Yes, they were no ordinary outsiders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_19_07.text:
A blond knight carrying a greatsword and an elven archer.
I could recognize them by their Grancian attire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_19_08.text:
A blond knight carrying a greatsword? Elf?
Oh, no way…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_19_09.text:
That knight, was he wearing a florid helmet
with feather-like decorations?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_19_10.text:
That sounds right.
A helm that perfectly matched the blond hair.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_19_11.text: And a greatsword adorned with blue gems in the middle?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_1_01.text:
The smoke clears, but the sins remain,
any soot they brought shall see no light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_20_01.text:
... That must be Leon, didn’t you say
you saw him last in Neth?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_20_02.text:
What is he doing here?...
Were we perhaps followed?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_20_03.text:
But we are guided by a Death Angel
who is invisible to the ordinary eye... How?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_20_05.text:
Grancia has put out a warrant
for {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_20_06.text:
It's just that, how could anyone have known
that {PLAYER_NAME} was heading this way...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_20_08.text:
Jeez, as if we didn’t have enough on our hands.
I hope we don’t run into them inside the volcano...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_20_09.text:
It’s not like we are going to get anywhere
by agonizing over it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_20_10.text:
Let’s get going for now.
To the entrance of the volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_21_01.text:
Urgh, the plants here even lash around
the feet of a Death Angel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_21_02.text:
This is exactly why I felt bothered
every time I went to see Yama.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_21_03.text:
Bear with them. We are almost there.
We should be arriving at the entrance soon… Well?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_22_01.text:
That’s strange. This totem should be standing here,
not broken like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_22_04.text:
Kurenai?
What is going on? You are speaking low...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_22_07.text:
Somewhere nearby. It sounds like a battle taking place.
The sound is coming from... the volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_22_09.text:
Everywhere are traces of the Coatl tribe.
Other tribes may be in danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_22_10.text:
...If we go now, we might be able to join forces.
Let’s go offer them our help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_23_01.text:
Hear me out, we are not a company of heroes!
Don’t point the gun at us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_23_03.text:
Don’t move!
Nobody shall enter the Primal Volcano!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_23_04.text:
Please just listen to me. We are no enemies.
Just allow me a moment to explain...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_24_01.text: Look, all pagans are gathered here at one place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_24_02.text:
I guess today is a lucky day for me. I shall bestow
the grace of the goddess on your false beliefs

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_25_01.text: Who in the world are you...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_25_03.text: I was hoping this wouldn’t be the case, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_25_04.text:
Chrona Heroes!
How did they get here before us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_25_05.text:
Ooh! {PLAYER_NAME}...
you got here sooner than I expected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_26_01.text:
I mean, everything is almost ready,
so it won’t be a problem...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_26_03.text:
I don’t know what you are up to,
but if I were you, I would let it go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_26_04.text:
All of you have been fooled. Do you not realize
who stands behind the Order of the Goddesses?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_26_05.text:
You are still clueless. Your false beliefs and sins...
Your ignorance is beyond my expectations.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_26_06.text:
Not knowing yourselves is
what makes the shameful bunch of you keep alive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_27_01.text:
Hey, you should save up that energy for later.
We are nowhere near the main event.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_27_02.text:
Stop! Not inside the Primal Volcano...
Ugh!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_28_02.text:
Woomparoom Woopa?
Woopapa! Paparoom rooroompa woompa!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_28_07.text: ...What on earth are they talking about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_29_01.text:
Anyway, I never expected to
see you here, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_29_02.text: What business brings you to the Primal Volcano?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_2_01.text:
The chaos in the mountain range seems to be settled.
We put out the big fire, and what's next is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_2_02.text:
Still, many people are suffering from the curse
near the capital of Chen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_2_03.text:
It would be a good idea to
send them some support.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_2_04.text:
I see. We shall check how many men
are available to fight...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_30_01.text:
Kalard, as difficult it may be to believe, there's
one striking similarity to what we've experienced.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_30_02.text:
We were also led here
by Demona’s dreams.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_30_03.text:
Volcano, burning lizards... She also kept seeing the
ominous vision of the totems.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_30_04.text:
Yes, I was so annoyed by all the visions 
I was having of places burning down!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_30_05.text:
I don’t know how to put this, but.... It felt too real
to shrug it off as just a dream.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_30_06.text:
It was as if the volcano itself
was trying to talk to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_30_07.text:
... I felt something serious was happening somewhere,
so here we are...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_30_08.text:
If {PLAYER_NAME} had similar dreams,
then they must indeed mean something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_31_01.text: ... Pardon me? Death Angel? Great King Yama?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_31_02.text:
I have heard about those beings,
but aren’t they imaginary figures? I am confused.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_31_03.text:
But {PLAYER_NAME} is
not someone to talk nonsense. So I will buy it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_31_04.text:
...Then, was Demona’s dreaming of volcanoes
also a part of the Great King Yama’s plan?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_31_05.text: ... This is giving me a headache.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_31_06.text:
Well, what's done is done. It’s not like
we are going to turn back now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_31_07.text:
Now that we’ve met {PLAYER_NAME}
why don’t we go inside the volcano together?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_31_09.text:
Demona, you’d better not be such a freewheeler
since a serious mission is assigned to them...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_31_10.text: And you wish to barge in like so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_32_01.text:
... Don’t indulge Demona so much.
You are going to spoil her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_32_02.text:
Thank you. To be honest, running into the Chrona Heroes
has put me in an impossible position,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_32_03.text: since we are all being chased by the Order...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_01.text:
Apparently, Luca has also received
divine revelation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_02.text:
To protect the Sanctuary of the volcano
from the knights who worship the #false light#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_03.text:
So... I don’t know how else to put this,
but who would consider us the knights of light?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_04.text:
You must feel pretty terrible
for blocking us for no good reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_05.text:
Or should I praise your lack of prejudice...
She was simply allowing not a single person inside.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_06.text:
Well, at least now it’s clear
who those knights are...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_07.text:
Very unusual to get the same message from different gods,
don’t you think you should let us in?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_08.text: Luca, we’ve known each other for so long, you know me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_09.text:
Absurd. The same message from different gods?
Quaxolotl is the one and only god to send a message!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_10.text:
What will happen if I interpret His message as I please
and ruin everything?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_11.text:
That means the end of us,
not only the Coatl but also the Woopa!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_12.text:
But wait, just as a reminder,
two people already went in, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_13.text:
Yeah, exactly. If I were you, I would pay more attention
over that way than on us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_14.text:
They had ‘Knights of Light’
written all over.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_33_15.text:
Also, that bug helm came too late missing who went in,
but we didn’t. We saw a few more going in.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_34_01.text: B-but... I was ordered to guard the entrance...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_34_02.text:
Jeez, you are persistent, I will give you that.
Alright, how about this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_34_03.text:
I will help you guard the entrance.
The rest of us can go in and kick out the knights.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_35_01.text:
...Okay, I guess. As long as the chief of Woopa
swears by the name of their god.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_35_02.text:
Sure. I swear by my tribe
and the name of Paparochoal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_35_03.text: Woopapa roompawoom. Woompa Quaxolotl woompapa room!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_35_04.text: Woopapa roompawoom. Woompa Paparochoal woompapa room.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_35_05.text:
I swore by the name of Paparochoal.
If I ever break my promise...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_35_06.text:
I shall throw myself into the crater of the volcano.
I've sworn an oath, and I’m a man of my word.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_35_07.text: Now, you shall let us pass.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_35_08.text:
Whew, we haven’t even met the Great King,
and I already feel so out of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_35_09.text:
Okay, let’s get inside
the volcano!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_36_01.text:
The Primal Volcano...
this is my first time being inside.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_36_02.text:
...It feels a little suffocating.
{PLAYER_NAME}, you alright?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_36_03.text: ... Here, this should make you feel better.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_37_02.text:
Yes, the surrounding air does feel cooler.
This is the power of the goddess...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_37_03.text:
Let’s see... If we go in a little further
we will meet the Great King...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_37_04.text:
Are you sure this Volcano is okay?
Something feels off.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_37_05.text:
Besides my power feels
somewhat volatile.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_38_01.text:
You feel it too?
This sense of bizarreness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_38_02.text:
I can feel it stronger
now that we are inside the volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_38_03.text:
Not to mention these things
scattered on the ground...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_38_05.text:
The blocks of wood and pieces of paper? It’s strange to
see those unaffected by the burning flames.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_38_06.text:
They seem to be some sort of research logs...
I don’t think they belong to Great King Yama.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_38_08.text:
They have no business
being inside a volcano...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_38_09.text:
Maybe they fell off of the Chrona Heroes
who came in before us

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_38_10.text:
I guess. Yama is too lame to play such numbers game...
Arg! W-Why is that broken?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_39_01.text: Huh? What is this sloppy block of wood?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_39_02.text:
T-That is no ordinary block of wood!
That is a totem of this volcano!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_39_04.text:
From Primal Volcano comes the Legend of Primal Flames.
It’s like the heart of this continent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_39_05.text:
If its flow is disturbed even a little, no one knows
what kind of catastrophic event would happen...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_39_06.text: So in order to keep this place safe and sound...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_39_07.text:
These totems were built with the help
of the natives a long time ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_39_08.text: But they all have been damaged badly...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_39_09.text:
It’s no wonder I sensed the unstable flow
of energy in this area.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_39_10.text: Ugh, who would have done something like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_3_01.text:
... So I take it we have yet to
hear back from ‘Habaek’?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_3_02.text:
He clearly said he would be on his way
to wake up the next guardian deity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_3_03.text:
He has not made any other
special requests, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_3_05.text:
I think it may be dangerous for {PLAYER_NAME}
to stay in the East for too long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_3_06.text:
We sent {PLAYER_NAME} on our behalf
to form an alliance...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_3_07.text:
But as you know, the powerful kingdom of Grancia
has put out a warrant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_3_08.text:
Judging from Grancia’s history,
they won’t end it here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_3_09.text:
without knowing what Kalard will do next,
it is too risky to stay in one place for too long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_3_10.text:
We are surrounded by unsolved issues.
We should take some actions to resolve each issue.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_40_01.text:
Aside from these small totems, there are larger totems
called #Totems of Protection# inside the volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_40_02.text:
If those totems have also been tampered with,
then we are in big trouble...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_41_01.text:
*Sigh* My legs feel heavy. I’m tired.
Let’s take a snack break!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_41_02.text:
Demona, I know you are perfectly fine. Stop whining...
And we don’t have any more chocolate left, remember?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_41_03.text:
Grr... Darn you, Melissa.
Did you hide them so you can eat all by yourself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_42_01.text:
Gosh, this one seems to work...
but something feels... out of place...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_42_02.text:
It looks as if it’s barely maintaining its form...
Is it supposed to look like this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_42_03.text:
That can’t be!
It is obviously damaged by someone on purpose.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_42_06.text:
The energy around this totem flows fine.
So I believe it is working, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_42_07.text:
What can it be? I get this uncomfortable feeling...
something I’m familiar with...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_43_01.text:
Oh!!!
Y-Your Majesty, our Great King!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_43_02.text:
Great King...?
You mean, this is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_43_03.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, Aubrey. This is our first time
meeting each other in person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_43_04.text:
Great pleasure. I am #Yama the King of Hell#.
I appreciate your presence here at the Volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_44_01.text:
No way, this is Yama the ‘Great King’?
Looks like a peculiar kid with... *Gasp*

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_45_01.text:
Demona… I know you from reading
the scattered memories of the earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_45_02.text:
The King of Daybreak, right? The once-immature kid is
now capable of handling the Legend of Primal Flames!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_45_03.text:
But... you should give more heed
to your speech.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_46_02.text:
*Puff and huff*
My mouth, it just shut closed...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_46_03.text:
When you address me next time,
you'd better show more respect.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_46_04.text: A mouth shut will be the least of your worries then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_46_05.text:
W-What... We... We’ve never met before,
yet you treat me with such familiarity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_46_06.text:
You are endowed with the Legend of Primal Flames.
Of course I know who you are.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_46_07.text:
Who do you think showed you
the dreams of the volcano?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_46_08.text: I was watching you all this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_46_09.text:
Your entire journey from walking into the volcano
and gaining the Legend to arriving here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_46_11.text:
I am Yama.
The overseer of life and death in this world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_46_13.text:
The last ancient guardian deity of Hasla,
and the Primal Flames itself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_47_01.text:
You are?... The ancient guardian deity? The Great King of
the Underworld is the last guardian deity?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_47_02.text: Give me a break... What in the world is going on?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_48_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME},
that energy around you... I get it now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_48_02.text:
Habaek was right. You are the chosen one
without doubt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_48_03.text:
I had to be careful because I had my doubts...
But I should have sent Korin sooner.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_48_04.text: My hesitation resulted in havoc here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_48_05.text:
You must have seen it on your way what
Cora’s minions have done during their invasion here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_48_06.text:
Cora’s minions...
...you mean the Chrona Heroes?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_48_07.text:
Yes, Chro-- something...
Something silly like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_48_08.text:
The beasts of light are bringing disgrace to the volcano
and disturbing the peace of this volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_48_09.text: Have you been told the importance of this totem?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_48_10.text:
It is to stabilize the energy of the volcano
and protect its flow...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_48_11.text: Yes, Korin must have given you a heads up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_49_01.text:
There are many totems inside this volcano. 
From small ones

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_49_02.text:
to gigantic ones
like the one you are seeing now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_49_03.text: Among them are the four central Totems of Protection,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_49_04.text:
the core pillars that stabilize
the overall energy of the volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_49_05.text:
But... the state of the volcano
does not feel all that stable now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_49_06.text:
Except around this totem... I can feel the entire volcano
stirring somewhat ominously.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_49_07.text:
A child of Primal Flames.
You are right.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_49_08.text:
Because the Chrona Heroes, deceived by the False Light,
haphazardly destroyed the totems,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_49_09.text: the Primal Volcano is now on the verge of exploding.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_49_10.text:
The unleashed Legend of Primal Flames
might run so wild that it could cause an eruption.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_49_11.text:
... Can it be stopped?
If you are indeed an ancient guardian deity...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_4_02.text:
As soon as I get my job done here,
I’d like to continue looking for my sister.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_4_03.text:
With all that’s going on, blind to the danger of Kalard,
we never know what trouble she is going through now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_50_01.text:
Before all this,
that wouldn’t have been a problem...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_50_02.text:
Kalard has been meticulously weakening the powers of
us ancient guardian deities over many years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_50_03.text:
Too bad that my power has been so weakened that I can
no longer show my omnipotence to the living world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_50_04.text:
My natural powers cannot be exercised,
unless four totems are restored.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_50_06.text:
Look at this, a damaged yet fully functioning
totem, as Korin said.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_50_07.text:
Actually, this one has been repaired
by my subordinate who arrived here before you did.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_50_08.text:
If we are able to rebuild the remaining three,
my power shall be restored...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_50_09.text: well enough to make the volcano stable again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_50_10.text:
Then, we’d better make our way to the next totem.
Where is the location?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_52_01.text:
I’m barely on time.
Sorry to keep you waiting, #Thanatos#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_52_02.text: Aubrey?! What are you doing here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_52_05.text:
You must have a lot to say,
but not now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_53_02.text:
If what Yama said is true, the inside of the volcano is
a place where the unleashed Legend runs wild.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_53_03.text:
In such an unstable state,
a big shock like that could...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_54_01.text:
This shaking... d-don’t tell me
the volcano is about to erupt!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_54_02.text:
Everyone, get down!
The walls are crumbling down!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_54_03.text:
Oh, no... danger alert.
Roland, our work here is done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_54_04.text:
Let’s join our friends
at the fourth spot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_54_06.text:
Wait, hold on!
Running away again...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_55_02.text:
M-monster... What is a monster like that doing
inside the Primal Volcano?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_55_03.text: A monster? But this aura from that monster...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_55_04.text: Save that for later, it’s coming!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_5_01.text:
...keep seeing the same location in your dream,
what do you mean? Jungle and volcano?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_5_02.text:
That sounds very much like... #Primal Volcano#.
I heard from Bella that…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_5_03.text:
it was the source of the #Legend of Primal Flames#.
But why did it appear in {PLAYER_NAME}’s dreams?...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_6_01.text:
Ugh...
Should be somewhere around here…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_7_02.text:
...What are you looking at?
Who is there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_8_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, I've been looking for you all over!
So long since we guided souls together!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_8_03.text:
I happen to have an important favor
to ask of you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_8_04.text: Would you come with me please?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_1_9_02.text:
Apologies,
I forgot to show myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_10_01.text:
... Are you worried for me, {PLAYER_NAME}?
I'm alright.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_10_02.text:
Aubrey...
I feel like I’ve hurt her one too many times.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_10_03.text:
... The ground is a little unstable. 
We should be extra careful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_11_01.text: It should be around here somewhere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_11_02.text:
Is it just me, or has the ground been
shaking for some time now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_11_03.text:
It’s not just the heat.
The farther we go in...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_11_04.text:
This entire space feels like
it’s in the blink of exploding.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_11_05.text:
It feels as though some rough,
unrefined energy has filled up this place...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_11_06.text:
There is no time to waste on worrying.
We should hurry and find the other totems!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_11_07.text:
We came to the right place. 
Over there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_12_01.text:
It’s been damaged... as we expected.
Was it struck with an axe or something?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_12_02.text:
But can this even be destroyed
with an ordinary weapon?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_12_03.text:
If it indeed is a divine weapon
of such utmost importance...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_12_04.text:
It wouldn’t get destroyed so easily
with a mere strike of an axe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_12_06.text:
Those weapons these Knights use,
do they look ordinary to you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_12_07.text: What they have is the #Flame of Cora#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_12_08.text:
It is a fanatic light
that doesn’t allow even a small trace of darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_12_09.text:
And the fact that these Knights could control that flame,
it only means that they are puppets of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_13_01.text:
Mm... how shall we restore this?
It’s not like we can just stick them together...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_13_02.text: Why do you think I summoned you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_14_01.text:
This totem is the divine weapon that protects the Legend
of Primal Flames and guides its righteous flow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_14_02.text:
I, myself, cannot intervene in the flow...
but my successors inheriting my power can.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_14_03.text:
Are you saying... we can repair the totems
with the powers we have?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_14_04.text:
Yes, with all due respect...
Elard, was it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_14_05.text:
Despite this collaboration, the powers you have
are different in nature from that of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_14_06.text:
Some help might trigger
a violent adverse reaction from the volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_14_07.text:
What we need is a virtuous spirit of those
entrusted with the Legend of Primal Flames,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_14_08.text:
who used the enormous power to fight for others
in this world, rather than for their own good...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_15_01.text:
What, I didn’t expect you to speak so highly of me.
A spirit of virtue, I like it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_15_02.text:
Okay! If that Death Angel from the West could do it,
I, an expert, sure can.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_16_02.text:
It’s more enervating than I expected.
My vision is getting blurry...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_16_03.text:
Are you okay? Don’t push yourself too hard,
take breaks if you need to...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_16_04.text:
B-but...
as an exemplary Death Angel...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_16_05.text:
This is why I usually refrain from complimenting you.
You would kill yourself trying to get my praise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_16_07.text:
We need someone to
stay and protect the totem anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_16_08.text:
Since we don’t know what will happen
after we are gone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_16_09.text:
Besides...
if all the other totems are restored,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_16_10.text:
The Legend of Primal Flames will find its flow once again
and you will soon regain strength.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_16_11.text: I shall leave this place in your hands. Korin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_16_12.text: Can I trust you with the job?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_16_14.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, it’s a shame
I cannot accompany you until the very end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_17_01.text:
... It’s too hot. I can hardly breathe. 
How far do you think we’ve come inside the volcano?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_17_02.text:
To be honest, I’m getting worried. What if something…
comes out of nowhere while we are exhausted?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_17_03.text:
Worry will exhaust us even more. At times like this,
we need to find peace of mind... Hm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_17_05.text: Look at this, these pieces of paper on the ground.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_17_06.text:
They look like the ones
we saw near the entrance earlier.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_17_07.text:
Did someone intentionally lay a trail?
Let me... oh, I think I can actually read this one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_18_02.text:
Injection of experimental wastes and Apostles’ traces,
and injection of #Flame of Cora#...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_18_03.text:
Nothing could extinguish
the fire of the Primal Volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_18_04.text:
This fire burns and purifies
all foreign presence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_18_05.text:
Perhaps, the goal of my study,
#the Heart of Hasla#, is this exact place itself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_18_06.text:
I would need to control the Legend of Primal Flames...
to make sure that is the case.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_18_07.text:
And to do that, I shall summon
the last ancient guardian deity, Chantico...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_18_08.text:
But she doesn’t show herself
no matter what experiment I perform.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_18_09.text: Setting explosives directly inside the volcano,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_18_10.text:
was the last thing I wanted to do,
as this continent has many potential strategic uses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_18_11.text:
But, if I’m left with
no other choice...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_19_01.text:
Mm, it’s all ripped after this, so I cannot read it.
But what is this all about anyway?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_19_02.text:
Some kind of experiment log… It seems to be written
by an environmental vandal or something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_19_03.text: Who would write such a thing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_19_04.text:
They are not just any experiments -
they were performed to summon Chantico.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_19_05.text:
Come to think of it, the Primal Volcano
is out of reach of ordinary humans,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_19_06.text:
in which case, whoever wrote this diary...
Could it be Kalard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_19_07.text:
Who could have written this diary...? I believe I know.
A goddess by the name of #Arart#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_19_08.text:
How could I forget her when she was handling
a dangerous Soulstone right under my nose?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_19_09.text:
I didn’t mind her conducting experiments of all sorts,
calling herself as the goddess of the volcano,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_19_10.text:
during the last hundred something years -
I never considered her as a threat...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_19_11.text:
Little did I know, she was keeping a diary.
...How arrogant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_1_02.text:
What on earth was that? That monster,
it was controlling the Legend of Primal Flames.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_1_03.text:
That was #Quaxolotl# the God of Death and Ashes,
an elemental of volcano worshiped by Coatl tribe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_20_01.text: This one has been damaged also.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_20_02.text:
So... Demona and Kurenai,
which one of you will restore the totem?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_20_03.text:
Well, the sooner the better,
I will go first! So, let’s -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_21_03.text:
The Elven archer of the Chrona Heroes and next to it,
a glimpse of a female warrior in red armor...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_21_04.text:
But they retreated so quickly.
Just a one-time raid, maybe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_21_06.text:
We treaded so carefully coming here, and imagine what
would happen if they crush the walls with their axe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_22_01.text:
I knew it!
What this time?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_22_02.text:
That’s Paparochoal, the supernatural being
that brought fire in the legend of the Woopa tribe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_22_03.text:
Everyone, stay calm. We will be fine if we
prepare ourselves as we've done before. Get ready!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_2_01.text:
Quaxol... Huh?
The name sounds familiar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5WB_2_2_02.text:
